2001.desc: Dorry, critically injured by exploding ale, blames the Straw Hats. Luffy is enraged that someone would pull such a cowardly trick to sabotage the giants' honorable duel.

2001.title: Brogy Wails in Victory! Elbaf's Judgement
2001.desc: Luffy tries in vain to convince the injured Dorry not to fight Brogy. The Officer Agents who sabotaged Dorry's ale further tamper with the giants' duel.

2001.title: The Devil's Candle! Tears of Regret and Tears of Anger
2001.desc: Having subdued the giants, Baroque Works makes their move. Mr. 3 introduces Zoro, Nami, Vivi, and Brogy to the slow torture of becoming living statues of wax.

2001.title: Luffy Attacked by Magic! Colors Trap
2001.desc: Luffy attempts to rescue his friends but only accelerates the deadly waxing process. To make matters worse, Miss Goldenweek interferes and reveals her own terrifying ability.

2001.title: Critical Counterattack! Usopp's Quick Wit and Kaenboshi!
2001.desc: Usopp frees Luffy from Miss Goldenweek's control. With Karoo's help, Usopp and Luffy rescue the others, who take on Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine. Luffy and Karoo pursue Mr. 3 and Miss Goldenweek into the forest.

2001.title: Farewell to the Giants' Island! On to Alabasta
2001.desc: After having a pleasant chat with Mr. 0 and encountering the "Unluckies", Sanji retrieves an Eternal Pose for Arabasta. The crew leaves Little Garden and sets sail for Arabasta.

2001.title: Nami Is Sick? Beyond the Snow that Falls on the Ocean!
2001.desc: Nami is sick, but the crew does not have a doctor to help her.

2001.title: Ambush! The Bliking and Wapol the Tin-man
2001.desc: While looking for a doctor, the crew meets the pirate Wapol, who attacks them, but only makes Luffy send him flying. Meanwhile Smoker manages to intercept the conversation between Mr. 0 and Sanji and plans to go to Arabasta. Back with the crew they arrive at last to an island only to find out they are not welcome.

2001.title: A Doctorless Island? Adventure in the Country Without a Name!
2001.desc: The Straw Hat crew manages to gain the trust of the people that attacked them, and are taken to the village, except for Zoro and Karoo, who guard the ship. Luffy and Sanji must take Nami to the island's sole doctor who lives on a mountain-top. Vivi and Usopp discover the past of the island, and about the pirate Wapol from Dalton.

2001.title: Ya Happy? The Doctor who is Called a Witch!
2001.desc: While Sanji and Luffy fight off the wilderness, the islander's worst nightmare turns true, as Wapol returns to the island. The doctor is discovered to be on the other side of the island, and Usopp, Vivi and Dalton rush to find her. Dalton however returns as he hears of Wapol's return.

2001.title: Dalton's Resolve! Wapol's Forces Land
2001.desc: Dalton faces Wapol, but only gets himself hit by arrows thrown by his former comrade Chess. An avalanche stops the battle, but injures Sanji. Luffy must carry both Nami and Sanji to the doctor, and begins his ascent.

2001.title: Island that Lives in Snow! Ascend The Drum Rockies!
2001.desc: The Lapahn help Luffy escape from Wapol, giving him enough time to climb to the castle where doctor Kureha lives. Vivi, Usopp and Zoro deal with the king's army in order to save Dalton. The recovering Nami meets a strange creature.

2001.title: The Blue-Nosed Reindeer! Chopper's Secret
2001.desc: Nami asks Chopper to join the crew, but he is not interested. Kureha tells Nami some of what was Chopper's background. After realizing the abilities that Chopper has, Luffy is eager to make him join the crew.

2001.title: Dream of the Outcasts! The Quack Doctor Hiruluk
2001.desc: Doctorine continues to tell how Chopper lived his life and how the quack doctor Hiriluk took care of him.

2001.title: Hiruluk's Cherry Blossoms and Inherited Will
2001.desc: More of Chopper's past is revealed, including the fate of doctor Hiriluk and Wapol's cruelties as the king. Meanwhile, Wapol reaches the castle where the crew is residing.

2001.title: VS. Wapol's Army Corps! The Abilities of the Baku Baku Fruit!
2001.desc: Wapol is determined to bring down Hiriluk's flag, and to do that, he engages Sanji, Luffy and Chopper in a fight.

2001.title: Devil's Fruit of the Zoan Family! Chopper's Seven-Level Transformation
2001.desc: Chopper demonstrates the abilities of Rumble Balls when fighting Chessmarimo. Dalton is uncovered from the avalanche.

2001.title: When the Kingdom's Rule is Over! The Flag of Conviction Lasts Forever
2001.desc: After trying every trick in the castle, Wapol is finally hunted down by Luffy. The villagers along with Zoro, Vivi and Usopp start their ascent to the castle through a ropeway.

2001.title: Hiruluk's Cherry Blossoms! Miracle of the Drum Rockies
2001.desc: After finally been convinced to join the team, Chopper announces his intentions to Dr. Kureha, who does not take it too well; but after escaping from the castle, she has decided to give the whole Straw Hat crew a farewell gift.

2001.title: Farewell, Drum Island! I'm Going Out to Sea!
2001.desc: Chopper joins the Straw Hat crew as they continue their journey to Vivi's homeland.

2001.title: The Hero of Alabasta and the Ballerina on Deck
2001.desc: Crocodile appears to stop rampaging pirates. Luffy and his crew meet Mr. 2 Bon Kurei, who shows off his Devil Fruit power; Vivi sees a shocking sight.

2001.title: Coming to the Desert Kingdom! The Rain-Calling Powder and the Rebel Army
2001.desc: Luffy separates from the rest of the crew, right after arriving at Arabasta's port city of Nanohana. The crew dons disguises while Luffy learns of Dance Powder.

2001.title: Reunion of the Powerful! His Name Is Fire Fist Ace
2001.desc: While in Nanohana, the Straw Hats encounter Smoker and Tashigi. A powerful pirate named Portgas D. Ace appears, and is revealed to be Luffy's older brother.

2002.title: Ace and Luffy! Warm Memories and Brotherly Bonds
2002.desc: Ace fights Smoker while the Straw Hats run for their ship. Luffy reunites with his brother, and together take down agents of Baroque Works.

2002.title: The Green City, Erumalu and the Kung Fu Dugongs
2002.desc: Ace decides to travel with the Straw Hats, as he is hunting for a man known as Blackbeard. The group arrives first at the 'Green City' of Erumalu only to find it abandoned to the desert. Vivi and Nami explain what Dance Powder is and what it has done to Arabasta.

2002.title: Adventure in the Country of Sand! The Demons that Live in the Scorching Earth
2002.desc: After leaving Erumalu, the Straw Hats plus Vivi & Ace continue through the desert, facing the many dangers of it.

2002.title: Here Come the Desert Pirates! The Men who Live Free
2002.desc: Nami and Vivi found themselves an easier way to travel in the desert and leave all men behind. While trying to catch up with them, Ace gets lost. Luffy and the rest of the gang find the Desert Pirates, and Vivi meets a figure from her past.

2002.title: Spirit of the Fakes! Heart of the Rebel Army, Kamyu!
2002.desc: After hearing that a small village has fake Rebel Army bodyguards that have been keeping peace, Vivi asks the men of the crew to test if they are worthy of staying.

2002.title: Rebel Warrior Kohza! The Dream Sworn to Vivi!
2002.desc: Still trekking through the Arabasta desert, the crew beats up a giant desert scorpion for lunch, while Vivi tells Nami about her past and her friendship with Koza.

2002.title: Showdown in a Heat Haze! Ace vs. the Gallant Scorpion!
2002.desc: Ace finds out that Blackbeard is not in Arabasta after all, and leaves the group to continue looking for him. He leaves Luffy a mysterious piece of paper, explaining that it 'will let them meet again.'

2002.title: Ruins and Lost Ones! Vivi, Comrades, and the Shape of a Country
2002.desc: Zoro, Chopper and Luffy manage to get themselves lost and stumble across some huge underground ruins.

2002.title: At Spiders Cafe: The Enemy Ringleaders Meet at 8 o'clock
2002.desc: Baroque Works plan starts to take effect, and for that, the Number Agents gather to meet Mr. 0. Meanwhile, crew finds out that the Rebel Army has moved out of Yuba and headed to Katorea, and the rebel leader Koza is determined to attack.

2002.title: Luffy vs. Vivi! A Tearful Vow for Comrades
2002.desc: Vivi and Luffy disagree in how to stop the rebel army and Baroque Works, leading to a fight.

2002.title: The Alabasta War Front! City of Dreams, Rainbase
2002.desc: The crew travels to the city of Rainbase to take down Crocodile and Baroque Works, but run afoul of Smoker and Tashigi.

2002.title: Trap in a Desperate Situation! Breaking Into Rain Dinners
2002.desc: Most of the Straw Hats, along with Smoker, are trapped by Crocodile. Vivi reunites with the royal guardian Pell, but is captured by Miss All-Sunday. Crocodile reveals his invincible Devil Fruit power.

2002.title: Operation Utopia Commences! The Wave of Rebellion Begins to Move
2002.desc: Baroque Works' plan to take over Arabasta is set in motion. The king is kidnapped and framed for a crime, and the rebel army begins to move.

2002.title: The Fearsome Bananawani and Mr. Prince
2002.desc: Most of the Straw Hats are helplessly trapped, but Crocodile is contacted by "Mr. Prince".

2002.title: The Key to Turning the Tide and a Great Escape! Doru Doru Ball!
2002.desc: Chopper distracts Crocodile while Sanji frees the rest of the crew, but find themselves trapped yet again. Smoker's view on Luffy changes a little.

2002.title: Merciless Fight to the Death! Luffy vs. Crocodile
2002.desc: After escaping from Rain Dinners, the Straw Hats and Vivi cross the desert to Alubarne, where the final battle will take place. Crocodile, however, manages to catch Luffy, beginning the first round of their battle.

2002.title: The Miracle Sprint! Alabasta the Animal Land
2002.desc: Luffy is left for dead by Crocodile, but is helped by the mysteríous Miss All-Sunday. Meanwhile, the rest of the Straw Hats reach Alubarna after encountering the Spot-Billed Duck Squad and dangers of Arabasta's main river.

2002.title: Rebel Army vs. Royal Army! The Battle will be in Alubarna!
2002.desc: The revolution is on the verge of starting and the crew comes out with a plan that could stop it.

2002.title: Alubarna Grieves! The Fierce Captain Karoo!
2002.desc: Vivi's attempts to stop the rebel army go to waste, and she is attacked by Mr. 2 Bon Kurei, but manages to escape. Meanwhile, the battle of Usopp and Chopper vs. the Mr. 4 team begins.

2002.title: Swear on Your Comrade's Dream! Battle at Molehill 4th Avenue
2002.desc: Things look hopeless for Usopp & Chopper as they continue to suffer from every attack that the Mr.4 team makes. However, the tides may be beginning to turn as Usopp learns what it truly means to be a man.

2002.title: Today's Grand Performance! Mane Mane Montage!
2002.desc: Albeit severely beaten and bruised, Usopp and Chopper have finally defeated the Mr.4 team. However, Mr. 2 has figured out Sanji's weakness.

2002.title: Transforming Into Nami! Bon Clay's Hard-Hitting Ballet Kenpo
2002.desc: Though Mr. 2 discovers Sanji's weakness, Sanji still defeats his opponent after an evenly-matched fight. Meanwhile, before Vivi could give the word to blow up the palace, Crocodile appears.

2002.title: Nami's Whirlwind Warning! Clima Tact Explosion
2002.desc: Nami faces off against Miss Doublefinger and tries to figure out her new weapon that Usopp made, the Clima-Tact.

2002.title: Secret of the Royal Family! The Ancient Weapon, Pluton
2002.desc: While Crocodile reveals to Vivi about the ancient weapon Pluton, Nami attempts to defeat Miss Doublefinger with her most powerful attack: The Tornado Tempo.

2002.title: Essence of a Mighty Sword! The Power to Cut Steel and the Breath of All Things
2002.desc: While Miss. Doublefinger's fight with Nami was challenging, Zoro is having an even more difficult time fighting Mr.1: A man who can change his entire body into steel - something that Zoro cannot cut. As Zoro nears death, he must discover the secret to "the breath of all things".

2002.title: The Battle is Over! Kohza Flies the White Flag
2002.desc: When Vivi reveals Crocodile's plan to Koza, he attempts to stop the fighting, but is shot. Crocodile reveals that he has set up a massive bomb in the city.

2002.title: Vivi's Voice Goes Unheard! A Hero Descends!
2002.desc: As Koza tries to stop the Rebel Army, both sides are once more fighting due to the intervention of Baroque Works. Vivi is thrown to her certain death when Luffy saves her and challenges Crocodile to a second round.

2002.title: Sand Crocodile and Water Luffy! Death Match: Round 2
2002.desc: Luffy fights Crocodile with more success this time by using water, but still loses this round. Meanwhile, the other Straw Hats hurry to locate the bomb before it goes off. Nico Robin forces the king to take her to the tomb where the Pluton Poneglyph is hidden.

2002.title: Smells Like Croc! Run to the Tomb of the Royal Family, Luffy!
2002.desc: Crocodile joins Robin in the tomb, and orders her to translate the Poneglyph. Robin tells him that Pluton was not mentioned and that it was only about history, but Crocodile figures out that she was lying and stabs her in response. When Luffy recovers from the last round of fighting, he chases after Crocodile into the tomb.

2002.title: The Nightmare Draws Near! Secret Base of the Sand Sand Clan
2002.desc: Luffy fights with Crocodile by using blood on his fists. Meanwhile Vivi finds the bomb, and calls the Straw Hats together.

2002.title: Magnificent Wings! My Name is Pell, Guardian Spirit of the Kingdom
2002.desc: Vivi finds the bomb inside of the clock tower, but the Mr. 7 pair of Baroque Works are there to protect it. Vivi defeats them, but she realizes the bomb cannot be stopped so easily. It has a timer, and right before it blows up, Pell shows up and takes it into the atmosphere, where he sacrifices himself to save Arabasta.

2002.title: I Will Surpass You! Rain Falls on Alabasta!
2002.desc: Luffy defeats Crocodile by punching him through solid bedrock. When Crocodile falls, the rain-drops calm the soldiers.

2002.title: A Farewell to Arms! Pirates and a Little Justice
2002.desc: Now that the battle has ended, the outcome is tallied. Igaram appears with proof of Cobra's innocence, as well as Koza telling everything. Tashigi and Smoker both are rewarded for taking on Crocodile, but neither one of them believes that is right, considering the Straw Hat pirates did all the work.

2002.title: The Pirates' Banquet and Operation Escape Alabasta!
2002.desc: Luffy is rescued from the collapsed tomb where he fought Crocodile and brought into Cobra's palace to rest. When he awakens, a magnificent banquet is thrown for the pirates, then, the Straw Hats are invited to enjoy the hot spring steam room inside the palace.

2002.title: Everything Began that Day! Vivi Tells of her Adventures!
2002.desc: It's the day for Vivi's speech and her decision whether or not to continue to be with the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Bon Kurei and his crew attempt to protect the Straw Hats from Hina.

2002.title: Beware her Scent! The Seventh One is Nico Robin!
2002.desc: The Marines fail again to catch the Straw Hats. After escaping from Marines, Nico Robin (Ms. All Sunday) appears from inside of Straw Hats ship. She manages to persuade the crew to let her join. Pell is seen at the end standing over his own grave.

2002.title: The First Patient! Anecdote of the Rumble Ball
2002.desc: After their adventures in Arabasta, the crew come upon another deserted island and split up tasks amongst themselves. Chopper is left in charge of guarding the ship, and he reminisces about the day he first made the rumble ball and his first patient, Dr. Kureha, while spending some time with the newest crewmember: Nico Robin.

2002.title: The Navigator's Mutiny! For an Unwavering Dream!
2002.desc: A weird salesman is fished out of the water and onto the Going Merry, and Nami buys a ton of "1000 year paper" from him to draw her sea maps. However, that's not going to be easy with the rest of the crew goofing off as usual.

2002.title: Inherited Recipe! Sanji the Curry Expert
2002.desc: The Going Merry runs into several Marine ships in some fog, and the Straw Hats meet a trainee Marine chef named Tajiyo. Sanji helps him out of a bit of cooking trouble.

2002.title: I'll Make it Bloom! Manly Usopp's Eight-Shaku Ball
2002.desc: The crew stops on an island that's having its annual fireworks festival; Usopp meets a young fireworks-maker named Kodama and helps her achieve her dream.

2002.title: Infamous Pirate Hunter! The Wandering Swordsman, Zoro
2002.desc: Zoro has a flashback about the time when he first met Johnny and Yosaku, and faced off against Bandits and, Dick.

2002.title: Zenny Lives on Goat Island and There's a Pirate Ship on his Mountain!
2002.desc: After escaping from several Marine ships, the Straw Hats land on an uncharted island and meet an old man named Zenny. Chopper finds out that, because of his bad heart, Zenny probably only has three days to live.

2002.title: How's That for Profit? Money Lender Zenny's Ambition!
2002.desc: The Straw Hats help Zenny out, hoping to make his last days good ones; they learn about Zenny's past as a money lender, and his dream of becoming a pirate. But Zoro realizes that Zenny has outlived Chopper's predictions and so the straw hats decide that, after helping him finish his pirate ship, they will leave the island.

2002.title: Where the Island's Treasure Lies! Zenny Pirates Full Charge!
2002.desc: Zenny decides to follow his dream and become a pirate, despite his age. He helps the Straw Hats out of trouble with the Marines, and then they part ways.

2003.title: Legend of the Rainbow Mist! Ruluka Island and the Old Man Henzo
2003.desc: On Ruluka Island, some of the Straw Hats make enemies of the Mayor and his men, who have placed high taxes on everything. Robin, Usopp, and Luffy meet Professor Henzo, who's doing research on the island's rainbow mist. When some of the mist shows up, Henzo borrows the Going Merry to go explore it.

2003.title: Inhabitants of Neverland! The Pumpkin Pirates!
2003.desc: The inside of the Rainbow Mist full of wrecked ships and treasure, and is guarded by five kids. The kids are actually friends of Henzo's that got lost in the mist over 50 years ago.

2003.title: A Longing for Home! The Inescapable Pirate Graveyard!
2003.desc: Henzo, his friends, and the others try to find a way out of the ship graveyard. Meanwhile, the Mayor and his men let the information about the Rainbow Mist slip to the remaining Straw Hats still on Ruluka.

2003.title: Frantic Struggle! Whetton's Plans and the Rainbow Tower
2003.desc: Luffy accidentally propels himself and Rapanui to the end of the mist. Nami appears in the ship graveyard with a rowboat full of treasure and a string connected to the real world, which are both stolen by Wetton's subordinate. The Mayor uses the Rainbow Tower to make a bridge to the Rainbow Mist.

2003.title: And Then the Legend Begins! To the End of the Rainbow
2003.desc: The Going Merry escapes from the Rainbow Mist, getting badly damaged on the way. The Mayor gets arrested by a bunch of powerful marines that turn out to be older versions of Henzo's friends, who were thrown 50 years into the past by the Rainbow Mist's collapse.

2003.title: The Log is Taken! Salvage King, Masira!
2003.desc: Nami's log pose begins to point to the sky, and the crew finds a map of an island named 'Skypiea' on a 200-year-old ship. They compete with the monkey-like Masira's salvage crew while they search for more clues on how to get there.

2003.title: Monsters Appear! Don't Touch the Whitebeard Pirates
2003.desc: The Straw Hats decide to go to Jaya island to look for information on Skypeia. Meanwhile, Ace suddenly shows up on Buggy's ship; Buggy does not let any of his men attack Ace, fearing Whitebeard's retribution.

2003.title: Stop Dreaming! The City of Ridicule, Mock Town!
2003.desc: Jaya's main town is full of famous pirates that are constantly brawling with each other. Luffy and Zoro have a run-in with a pirate known as 'Bellamy the Hyena,' who ridicules their dreams and beats them up.

2003.title: A Pirate's Height! The Man who Talks of Dreams and the King of Underwater Exploration
2003.desc: Luffy, Zoro and Nami meet the man who is later revealed to be Blackbeard. They leave Mock Town, and get into a fight with Masira's brother Shoujou, another salvage monkey.

2003.title: The Legendary Family! 'Liar Norland'
2003.desc: The Straw Hats meet with Mont Blanc Cricket on another part of Jaya; Cricket is a descendant of Montblanc Noland, an infamous "liar" who told of a gold city on Jaya, and Cricket was outcast for looking for artifacts of the gold city. He may be the only person who knows how to get to Skypiea.

2003.title: Hard Turn to the Clouds! Find the Southbird!
2003.desc: Cricket explains how the Straw Hats can ride a dangerous vertical current called the Knock-Up Stream to get to Skypeia. However, they first have to catch a southbird to point them toward the point where the stream will erupt from the ocean.

2003.title: Dreams Don't Come True!? Bellamy vs. The Saruyama Alliance
2003.desc: While the Straw Hats are looking for a Southbird, Bellamy and his crew attack Cricket's house, and steal the gold artifacts he'd collected over the years from his salvage work. When the Straw Hats return and see what happened, Luffy decides to take a side trip back to Mock Town.

2003.title: The 100 Million Man! The World's Greatest Authority and the Pirate Blackbeard
2003.desc: Luffy takes out Bellamy with a single punch. Meanwhile, the world government heads are concerned over Whitebeard, Shanks, and Luffy. The marines try to decide who will replace Crocodile as a Shichibukai - one of Blackbeard's crew shows up uninvited and nominates his captain.

2003.title: Sail into the Sky! Ride the Knock-Up Stream
2003.desc: The Going Merry is refitted by Masira and Shoujou to be more flight capable, and the Straw Hats catch a ride on the Knock-Up Stream for Skypeia.

2003.title: This is the Sea of the Sky! The Knight of the Sky and Heaven's Gate
2003.desc: The Straw Hats arrive in an ocean above the clouds. Usopp almost falls out of the Going Merry but is saved at the last minute. The crew is also attacked by a mysterious looking warrior, but is saved by the Knight of the Sky. Finally, they arrive at the border which transports them to the upper realm, Skypiea.

2003.title: Godland Skypiea! The Angels Of the Cloud Beach
2003.desc: As the crew arrives in Skypiea, they are greeted by Conis and her pet Su. Both she and her father start explaining how the life in Skypiea is and how the different Dials work.

2003.title: Forbidden Sacred Ground! The Island Where God Resides and Heaven's Judgement!
2003.desc: Nami finds out what should happen to anyone who enters the forest. Meanwhile, the rest of the gang are waiting for the wind to change but are rudely assaulted by Skypiea's police who are going to carry out Heaven's Judgement.

2003.title: Already Criminals?! Skypiea's Upholder of the Law!
2003.desc: The Straw Hats have some problems with the local justice enforcer force called "The White Berets."

2003.title: Is Escape Possible?!? God's Challenge is Set in Motion
2003.desc: While trying to escape from Sky Island, Robin, Chopper, Nami and Zoro are held hostages by God Enel.

2003.title: Trap on Lovely Street! Almighty God Enel
2003.desc: Conis leads Luffy, Usopp, and Sanji to a boat to get to Upper Yard, but she tells them it is a trap and almost gets hit by "Heaven's Judgment".

2003.title: Go Forth, Little Crow! To the Sacrificial Altar
2003.desc: Luffy, Usopp and Sanji finally enter Upper Yard, only to find out that the whole road is trapped heavily, but at last they arrive at the Ordeal Gates. Meanwhile Robin, Zoro, and Nami go out to explore Upper Yard while Chopper stays behind to guard the ship.

2003.title: 10 Percent Survival Rate! Satori, the Mantra Master!
2003.desc: Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp enter the Ordeal of Balls gate and encounter the Priest Satori.

2003.title: Peril of the Ordeal of Balls! Fight to the Death in the Lost Forest
2003.desc: Usopp, Sanji and Luffy fight Satori, but the power of Mantra seems to be too strong.

2003.title: Chopper's in Danger! Former God vs. Shinto priest Shura
2003.desc: Chopper, threatened by priest Shura, blows the whistle for Gan Fall to come, but before he can arrive, Priest Shura assaults Chopper and begins destroying the Going Merry.

2003.title: Ever Mysterious! Ordeal of String and Ordeal of Love!?
2003.desc: Gan Fall cannot handle Shura and lost the battle. Meanwhile, Satori is finally defeated by Luffy and Sanji.

2003.title: Light the Fire of Shandora! Wyper the Warrior
2003.desc: Chopper is saved by a bunch of giant Southbirds, who tell him that Gan Fall was actually God. Nami, Zoro and Robin discover the reason why Upper Yard is a soil island: It was once part of Jaya, and this is the part that Liar Noland saw. Meanwhile the Shandia attack Upper Yard.

2003.title: Floating Land of Gold, Jaya! To God's Shrine!
2003.desc: The Shandia attack on Upper Yard has started. The crew is finally reunited, and everyone speaks up about what has happened. Chopper takes care of Gan Fall, and the pirates plan to steal the gold on the island.

2003.title: Eve of Gold Festival! Feelings Toward 'Vearth'!
2003.desc: After befriending a wolf pack, Gan Fall tells the crew a little more about the history of Upper Yard.

2003.title: God Enel Appears! Aubade to the Survivors
2003.desc: Enel takes away the limitations of the priests. Also, Usopp witnesses a mysterious person fixing the ship; the next day Merry is found to be back to her original form. After getting her off the altar, the pirates plan out their course of action.

2003.title: The Python Strikes! The Survival Game Begins
2003.desc: A giant python makes Luffy, Robin, Chopper and Zoro split while going to the ruins at the south.

2003.title: The Life-Threatening Reject! War Demon Wiper's Resolve
2003.desc: Wyper takes out Shura and tells his goal to the Shandia, and Enel speaks up about how many people will be alive by the end of his plan.

2003.title: Fierce Sky Battle! Pirate Zoro vs. Fighter Braham
2003.desc: Zoro fights the Shandia warrior Braham, and defeats him with Ittoryu (one sword style) 36 Pound Cannon technique.

2003.title: The Roaring Burn Bazooka! Luffy vs. War Demon Wyper!
2003.desc: Luffy fights Wyper, but after some time, he falls into some underground ruins. Meanwhile, Enel appears on the Going Merry and after telling that his true goal was the City of Gold, he takes out both Usopp and Sanji; then he vanishes and leaves Satori's brothers: Hotori and Kotori to avenge him.

2003.title: Ordeal of Swamp! Pirate Chopper vs Gedatsu!!
2003.desc: Chopper is attacked by Gedatsu, who turns out to be a complete moron, and eventually defeats him, sending him plummeting to the Blue Sea. Conis and Pagaya help Aisa, and head to Upper Yard.

2003.title: The Invincible Ability! Enel's True Nature Revealed
2003.desc: Enel defeats several members of the Shandia Tribe. Meanwhile, Gan Fall and Nami start and finish their fight with Kotori and Hotori. Hotori is defeated by Nami while Kotori is defeated by Gan Fall.

2003.title: The Vanished City! The Magnificent Ruins of Shandora!!
2003.desc: While Robin is looking at some ruins she found, Yama, The Chief Enforcer, attacks her. Yama is easily defeated by Robin. Later, she discovers the legendary city, Shandora.

2003.title: Chance of Survival: 0%!! Pirate Chopper vs. Shinto Priest Ohm
2003.desc: Priest Ohm appears and starts fighting everyone.

2004.title: Climb Giant Jack! Deadly Combat in the Upper Ruins
2004.desc: At the Upper Ruins, the fight between Ohm, Zoro, Gan Fall and Wyper begins. When Nami appears, she is swallowed by the giant python, along with Gan Fall and Aisa.

2004.title: Ultimate Test of the Ordeal of Iron! The White-Barbed Death Match!!
2004.desc: Ohm makes matters worse, creating a barbed wire cage around the area. Laki is knocked out by Enel, and Nami, Aisa, and Gan Fall find out why the python was rampaging so much.

2004.title: Gushing Blade Attack! Pirate Zoro vs Shinto Priest Ohm!!
2004.desc: Zoro finally defeats Priest Ohm with his 108 Pound Cannon technique. Meanwhile Pagaya and Conis hear the terrible truth about the goal of Enel: to eradicate every person in the sky.

2004.title: The Upper Ruins Crumble! The Quintet Finale!!
2004.desc: Enel appears only to reduce the group as close to his prediction as he can.

2004.title: Battle in the Ancient Ruins! God Enel's Desire!!
2004.desc: Enel counterattacks Gan Fall and lands a finishing hit. He then knocks out Robin as she tries to manipulate him. Zoro impresses Enel with his power but is easily beaten, while trying to make him pay for what he did to Robin; but it takes Wyper with a secret weapon to take Enel down.

2004.title: Ambitions of Fairy Vearth - The Ark, Maxim!!
2004.desc: Enel defeats Zoro and Wyper. Upon seeing this, Nami follows him to a cave where his ark, Maxim, is. Luffy finally gets out of the snake, along with Aisa, only to find out the outcome of the fight against Enel. When Aisa tells him that she knows where he is, he asks her to take him there.

2004.title: Finally Clashing! Pirate Luffy vs God Enel!!
2004.desc: Luffy and Enel start fighting. Conis tells the dangers of staying in Sky Island to the other Skypieans.

2004.title: Maxim Rises! The Start of Deathpiea!!
2004.desc: The fight between Enel and Luffy continues with Enel starting a machine that would bring the death of Skypiea: Deathpiea.

2004.title: Luffy's Fall! God's Judgement and Nami's Desire!!
2004.desc: Luffy falls from the ark. Nami starts fighting Enel while Sanji and Usopp try to rescue her.

2004.title: Two People Awaken! A Rescue in Front of Burning Love!!
2004.desc: Usopp and Sanji split up to rescue Nami, but the first one to get on deck is Usopp.

2004.title: Capriccio to Destruction! The Impending Doom of Sky Island!!
2004.desc: Enel's thunderclouds are coming down to Sky Island while the evacuation is half complete.

2004.title: Guidance from the Sound of a Bell! The Great Warrior and Tales of an Explorer
2004.desc: The history of Noland and Kalgara is told, as a flashback from Wyper.

2004.title: Released from Disgrace! The Tears of the Great Warrior!!
2004.desc: Noland and Kalgara are enjoying themselves, as well as the villagers and Noland's crew, but that changes one day, as the villagers start hating their new friends.

2004.title: Eternal Friendship! The Bell of Oath Echoes Throughout the Giant Ocean!!
2004.desc: The cause of the hatred is discovered and explained. Meanwhile, Kalgara vows to meet Noland again.

2004.title: The Destruction of Angel Island! Terror of The Descending Raigou!!
2004.desc: Angel Island is destroyed by Enel's attacks. Luffy decides to go and ring the golden bell before Enel takes it away.

2004.title: Chop Down Giant Jack! The Last Hope of Escaping
2004.desc: Nami finds out a way to get to Enel, by cutting down Giant Jack. Wyper finds out from Robin that Noland has a descendant that is searching for the Gold City, and that's the reason why Luffy wants to ring the Golden Bell.

2004.title: The Miracle in God's Country! A Love Song Heard by Angels
2004.desc: Luffy defeats Enel, ringing the Golden Bell in the process.

2004.title: The Battle Ends! Proud Fantasia Echoes Far!
2004.desc: The 400 year war on Sky Island comes to an end. Montblanc Cricket and the Masira Brothers hear the Golden Bell ringing and realize that the Gold City was always in the sky. Enel, who was thrown to the Blue Sea heads out to the Fairy Vearth (the Moon). The Sky People (both Skypieans and Shandia) celebrate the end of the war with a great bonfire.

2004.title: I Have Come Here! The Weaving of the Poneglyphs
2004.desc: Robin deciphers the poneglyphs on the Golden Bell and realizes how to find the Rio Poneglyph. She also discovers that the poneglyphs on the Bell were written by Gol D. Roger, who could understand poneglyphs, who had discovered the Rio Poneglyph, and had once visited Skypiea. Soon afterwards, the Straw Hats steal a bunch of gold from the Giant Anaconda's belly and they begin to leave Skypiea.

2004.title: Now Heading Towards the Blue Sea! Memories of an Interwoven Finale
2004.desc: The Golden Bell rings as the Straw Hats are going down to the sea, meaning that they are welcome and are deeply thankful for what they did. When the ship finally rests on the sea, problems appear, as the ship has landed in a Marine base.

2004.title: Emergency Announcement! An Infamous Pirate Ship has Invaded!
2004.desc: The Marines are convinced the Going Merry is a ghost ship after it crashes inside their fortress from above. The crew members are scattered around the premises.

2004.title: Sanji the Chef! Demonstrating True Pride at the Marine Mess Hall!
2004.desc: In disguise, Sanji shows the Marine chefs the proper way to prepare a meal.

2004.title: Zoro's Imprisonment and Chopper's Emergency Operation!
2004.desc: Zoro is taken prisoner as Chopper and Nami assist a nervous doctor in treating injured Marines.

2004.title: The Marine Search Party Draws Near! Another of the Crew is Captured!
2004.desc: Robin and Usopp both disguise themselves as the same visiting inspector, and Usopp is thrown in the brig with Zoro. Luffy and Sanji are discovered by Jonathan after a slight mishap.

2004.title: Luffy and Sanji's Determination! The Great Escape Plan!
2004.desc: The real Inspector is thrown in the brig with Zoro and Usopp, while Sanji and Luffy race to rescue the two while avoiding detection.

2004.title: The Squadron of Burning Souls Attack! Battle on the Bridge!
2004.desc: Sanji and Luffy, after freeing Usopp and Zoro, try to escape Navarone. As the Burning Soul combat unit is deployed, Dr. Kobato leads Nami and Chopper to the docks.

2004.title: Breaking Through Enemy Lines! The Rescue of the Going Merry!
2004.desc: The crew meets at the docks and are surrounded by Marines. Using Nami as their fake hostage, they trick the Marines into letting them back on the Going Merry.

2004.title: The Pirate Ship Disappears! Stronghold Battle, Round 2
2004.desc: The crew disguises the Going Merry as a Marine ship so they can get their treasure back. With the gold, they decide they'll hire a shipwright.

2004.title: Operation Gold Recovery and Operation Waver Retrieval!
2004.desc: Usopp splits up the crew into two teams: the gold retrieval team and the waver retrieval team. Inspector Shepherd decides to catch Luffy on his own.

2004.title: The Pirate Round-Up Plan! Jonathon's Secret Winning Strategy!
2004.desc: The Straw Hats continue to search for their treasure. Luffy leads Nami to the captain's quarters where they retrieve their gold.

2004.title: So Long, Marine Base! The Final Battle for Freedom
2004.desc: The Going Merry is grounded during a period of low tide and Jonathan believes they've reached "checkmate". They cleverly use the impact dial to boost the ship and the breath and flame dials to inflate the octopus balloon again so they can escape.

2004.title: Big Adventure in Long Ring Long Land
2004.desc: Luffy and company come across a mysterious pirate ship after trying to escape a giant wave. Soon, they arrive on an island inhabited by strange animals. Going Merry is captured by the Foxy Pirate crew.

2004.title: The Foxy Pirate Crew and the Davy Back!
2004.desc: After Tonjit re-unites with his horse, they are soon attacked by Captain Foxy and his subordinates, who challenge Luffy in a Davy Back Fight, a contest of pirates where the stakes are members of the crew.

2004.title: Round 1! One Lap of the Donut Race
2004.desc: The first round of Davy Back Fight involves a race around the island with tiny boats. Zoro's and Chopper's boat is eliminated.

2004.title: Foxy the Silver Fox! A Violent Interference
2004.desc: With only Luffy, Nami, and Porche's boat remaining, it's an all out war to the goal, but after Foxy exposes his Devil Fruit powers, Porche wins and takes Tony Tony Chopper from Luffy. The second round prepares to start.

2004.title: Round 2! Shoot into the Groggy Ring!
2004.desc: Without Chopper, Sanji and Zoro must face the Foxy Pirates in a ball game, but are hampered by their blatant cheating and the crooked referee.

2004.title: Rapid-Fire Red Cards! Groggy Ring
2004.desc: The bickering rivals Sanji and Zoro manage to overcome the opposing team by working together. Luffy chooses Tonjit's horse, Shelly over Chopper.

2004.title: Round 3! Round and Round Roller Race!
2004.desc: The Straw Hats face Foxy a race around a giant ring on roller skates.

2004.title: Burning Roller Race! Dash into the Final Round!
2004.desc: The Straw Hat Pirates stop Foxy and his dirty tricks and win the race.

2005.title: The Screaming Speed Serve! Pirate Dodgeball!
2005.desc: With Luffy's victory, he takes Chopper back, but foolishly accepts another challenge by Foxy.

2005.title: Final Match on the Edge! Dharma has Fallen!
2005.desc: Foxy decides to take Robin from Luffy this time because of her Devil Fruit ability. The next match is a race to the top of the island.

2005.title: Captain Confrontation! The Last Fight: Combat!
2005.desc: With Chopper gone again from Luffy's crew, Luffy and Foxy face off in the final game: a battle of brawn aboard Foxy's ship.

2005.title: Full Power Noro Noro Beam vs The Invulnerable Luffy
2005.desc: Luffy continues to battle Foxy with the odds not in his favor, and the fight continues inside Foxy's ship.

2005.title: Heroic Fierce Combat! The Fateful Last Battle
2005.desc: Luffy manages to finally defeat Foxy by using his ability against him. After dismissing his new crewmembers, the Straw Hats leave in search for a shipwright.

2005.title: Lost? Stolen? Who are You?
2005.desc: A mysterious figure appears during the night and steals the memories of the crew. In the morning, Robin is the only one who remembers the Straw Hats adventures together. Her attempts to keep the crew together fail as Nami and Zoro go separate ways.

2005.title: The Mysterious Boy with the Whistle and Robin's Guess
2005.desc: Robin suggests that only those who were sleeping lost their memories. Luffy and the others then remember seeing the mysterious boy who played some kind of flute. Later that night, they discover the boy outside and Luffy tries to fight him. At the last second, he proclaims his memory has returned.

2005.title: Get Back the Memories! The Pirates Land
2005.desc: During the night, Usopp, Chopper, and Sanji question what brought them to the Going Merry. In the morning, Usopp builds them a raft and they sail to the island where they meet Nami again. Meanwhile, the boy sets his sights on Zoro.

2005.title: Zoro Sharpens His Fangs! A Fight with a Wild Animal
2005.desc: On their way to "The Palace of the Sea God" Robin's group meets an entranced Zoro. It looks like Zoro wants to fight so Luffy urges the others to keep going without him. They apprehend the kid but the whistle was what was really stealing their memories. Zoro returns, still entranced, but Luffy's nowhere to be seen.

2005.title: The Real Memory Thief's Final Counterattack!
2005.desc: Luffy returns and knocks some sense into Zoro. Cornered, the sea horse spreads illusions of the people in their memories to distract them. It steals their complete memories and claims that it has become a Sennenryu. Luffy defeats it and returns all the memories but the townspeople are convinced they are the memory stealers.

2005.title: The Man of Pride! Foxy the Silver Fox
2005.desc: Luffy rescues Foxy, Hamburg, and Porche from a storm at sea. When they reunite with the Sexy Foxy ship, they find it captained by somebody new. Foxy accepts a Davy Back Fight in order to regain his ship and crew. Donning the afro once again, Luffy vows to defeat the captain.

2005.title: The Unbeatable Power Draws Near? A Very Dangerous Man!
2005.desc: Once Foxy wins back his crew, he captures the Straw Hats. Nami and Luffy fight Foxy and although he's defeated, his crew accepts him back. Later, they sail to an island where they meet someone Robin knows: a Marine named Aokiji.

2005.title: Marine High Admiral Aokiji! The Threat of the Greatest Power
2005.desc: The man they met, Marine High Admiral Aokiji, appears to be incredibly lazy. He first displays his Devil's Fruit ability by freezing the sea so some deserted people can get off the island. Unfortunately, he's determined to catch Robin. Luffy, Sanji, and Zoro attack but they seem to be no match.

2005.title: Rubber and Ice One-On-One Fight! Luffy vs Aokiji!
2005.desc: Luffy insists on fighting Aokiji alone and risks it all so the crew can save the frozen Robin.

2005.title: Running Sea Train! The City of Water, Water 7
2005.desc: After the Going Merry narrowly escapes being hit by a Sea Train, the crew meets an old woman, Kokoro, and her granddaughter, Chimney. Kokoro gives Luffy a map to Water 7.

2005.title: The Adventure in the City of Water! Aim for the Giant Shipyard
2005.desc: Luffy, Nami, and Usopp get strange greetings from the residents and they get to experience the roller coaster-like channels of Water 7. Luffy's group finds out that some pirates had been beaten at the hands of some powerful craftsmen; the Galley La Company. Chopper loses Robin and some strange new people threaten Zoro back on the ship.

2005.title: The Franky Family and Iceburg!
2005.desc: The people who attacked Zoro reveal themselves to be the feared "Franky Family", though they are no match for Zoro. Luffy's group has the gold exchanged for cash. After, they meet a man who resembles Usopp, Galley La's carpenter employment foreman, Kaku. Two of the suitcases of money are stolen by the Franky Family.

2005.title: Galley-La Company! The Magnificent Dock #1
2005.desc: Paulie makes his debut when he retrieves Usopp's stolen money as he runs from debt collectors. Kalifa shows Luffy, Nami, and Usopp around Dock No.1 and tells them how Iceburg founded the Galley La Company. Kaku returns from the Going Merry and tells them that their keel is irreparably damaged.

2005.title: The Pirate Kidnapping Incident and the Pirate Ship Waits for Death!
2005.desc: Luffy refuses to believe that Galley La cannot repair the Going Merry. The two soon realize that not only is Usopp missing now, the two brief cases that were returned to them are empty! Nami decides to head to Franky House and finds Usopp on the way in a pitiful state. As she heads back to the ship for help, Usopp goes to the Franky House himself.

2005.title: Rescuing a Friend! The Raid on the Franky House
2005.desc: Luffy, Sanji, Zoro, and Chopper follow Usopp's bloody trail to the Franky House where they find him passed out in front. The four of them challenge the Franky Family only to find out that their real target, Franky himself, is gone and has taken the money with him.

2005.title: Quarrel in the Moonlight! The Pirate Ship Trembles in Sadness
2005.desc: Once they are back on the ship, Luffy has to finally tell Usopp that the Going Merry can no longer be repaired and that they've chosen to get a new ship without him. Usopp believes that Luffy has abandoned the dignity of their ship and says he's leaving the crew. That night, he challenges Luffy to a duel.

2005.title: Luffy vs Usopp! The Spirit of the Clashing Men
2005.desc: Usopp fights Luffy in order to decide who keeps the Going Merry; he fights harder than he's ever fought before. Luffy actually seems to pose no threat but all the while, he's remembering what great friends they used to be, sailing together on the same ship.

2005.title: The City of Water is Shaking! Iceburg was Targeted!
2005.desc: The Straw Hats get themselves a hotel room. Nami finds the crew on the roof with urgent news; Iceburg has been shot. As the Galley La Company frantically search for answers, Nami and Luffy decide to check on his condition - only to be met by closed gates. Franky appears then to exact his revenge - with style.

2005.title: Rubberman vs Fire-Breathing Cyborg
2005.desc: In the streets outside of the hospital, Luffy fights Franky. Inside, Iceburg recalls seeing Nico Robin and another tall man before he was shot. The Galley La company run outside and stop Franky and Luffy and tell them that they suspect the Straw Hat Pirates of the crime.

2005.title: The Criminals are the Straw Hat Pirates? The Bodyguards of Water 7
2005.desc: The Galley La Company continues to fight Luffy and Franky is enraged that they've stolen his opponent. An incredibly high tide called the "Aqua Laguna" is coming and Chopper and Sanji rush to warn Usopp. Luffy raises some chaos in order to meet with Iceburg and he demands to know what's happening. Iceburg says he wants to see Robin one more time.

2005.title: An Eternal Farewell? Nico Robin, The Woman Who Bears Darkness
2005.desc: In a bar, Franky talks with Kokoro about her theory on who shot Iceburg. The rumors she speaks of seem to have some truth as we see Robin meeting with someone from an organization called CP9. While the crew hide from angry residents, Sanji and Chopper discover Robin and she tells them what they've feared: she's responsible and she wants to part ways.

2005.title: Catch Robin! The Determination of the Straw Hat Pirates
2005.desc: Chopper reunites with the others without Sanji and they discuss what's happened. Luffy decides that in order to know the full truth, they must catch Robin. Usopp attempts to repair the ship enough to withstand the Aqua Laguna and the Straw Hats make their way to the Galley La Company.

2005.title: The Signal is the Explosion! CP9 Starts to Move
2005.desc: The Straw Hats (still missing Sanji) rush to Galley La where Robin and CP9 begin a raid. In Iceburg's room, Robin and the mysterious man Iceburg saw before, tell him that they've purposely placed the blame on the pirates. Their true aim is the blueprints he would've passed down to Paulie. Luffy separates from his group.

2005.title: CP9 Unmasked! Their Shocking True Faces
2005.desc: Robin speaks with Iceburg inside his room still. We already know that Robin can read the poneglyphs - and it seems Iceburg is the one with the blueprints to the ultimate weapon, Pluton. The true enemies are revealed to be Iceburg's own allies. Elsewhere, Luffy is tied up with Paulie after Paulie tells members of CP9 that his blueprints are fake.

2005.title: The Secret Bond! Franky and Iceburg
2005.desc: Lucci tells Iceburg their hypothesis and has Kaku check his pulse to tell if the things he tells him are true. They suspect that Iceburg's friend from the past, Cutty Flam, is really Franky and it's revealed to be true. Therefore, Franky has the real blueprints. The Straw Hat Pirates and Paulie break into the room where they find Iceburg and CP9.

2005.title: Come Back, Robin! The Confrontation with CP9
2005.desc: Luffy and the others request that Robin comes back to the crew. She refuses and tells them that she cannot accomplish her "wish" if she were to stay with them. Robin turns to leave and CP9 try to hold the pirates back. Robin successfully escapes and Lucci shows those remaining his "transformation".

2005.title: Destruction of the Straw Hat Pirates? The Terror of the Model Leopard!
2005.desc: Lucci's transformation is a result of a Devil's Fruit; a Zoan Type leopard. He quickly disposes of the crew and CP9 tie up Paulie and Iceburg, leaving them alone as the building slowly burns down around them. In Franky's underground hideout, Usopp tells him his story and Franky is finally touched. In return, Franky tells him a little about Tom's contributions to Water 7.

2005.title: The Man who is Loved by his Ship! Usopp's Tears!
2005.desc: Usopp believes that the person who repaired the Going Merry in Skypeia was really the Going Merry itself. Franky says that the ship was inhabited by a spirit who enters ships who are dearly cared for. The spirit repaired their ship just enough for them to reach the next island. The doorbell rings from the sea side and CP9 enter.

2005.title: Franky's Past! The Day the Sea Train Ran
2005.desc: CP9 discover Franky's hidden room and he fears they'll trample his memories. A long flashback ensues, covering Franky's past in Tom's Workers and how he and Iceburg helped create the Sea Train.

2005.title: Spandam's Conspiracy! The Day the Sea Train Shook
2005.desc: (Franky's flashback) Spandam, a CP5 representative, was determined to get Tom proven guilty in his trial so he could get the blueprints. As Franky walked into the town, people from the government began to attack with the battleships he had personally constructed. Tom and Iceburg run to their shipyard where they are attacked by two ships which also destroy the others. Iceburg tells Franky that he has to take responsibility or he will never forgive him.

2005.title: The End of the Legendary Man! The Day the Sea Train Cried
2005.desc: (Franky's flashback) Franky said that if a ship of his were to be used as a weapon, then it's no longer one of his ships. That enraged Tom and he punched Franky for the first time, telling him he had to take pride in the ships he created. He then told the judge that he would accept the punishment for both his previous crime and the recent attack. Franky tried to stop the train to Enies Lobby with his bare hands.

2005.title: The Truth Behind the Betrayal! Robin's Sorrowful Decision!
2005.desc: Chopper escapes the burning building with Paulie and Iceburg on his back and collapses outside. Iceburg makes it clear to Nami that Robin wanted to recover the blueprints and to do that, she wanted her companions to leave the island without her. Nami rushes to tell Chopper so they can go looking for the rest of the crew. Elsewhere, the foremen let go of the Going Merry so she would be destroyed at sea.

2005.title: The Steam Whistle Separates the Group! The Sea Train Begins to Run
2005.desc: Paulie helps clear the name of the Straw Hats but does not tell the mob everything he knows. He gets the mob to follow Chopper so they can search for the rest of the crew. Nami goes her own way so she can rush to the Sea Train. As Nami nears the station, Sanji, ahead of her, approaches the train.

2005.title: Sanji Breaks In! The Sea Train Battle in the Storm!
2005.desc: Nami and the conductors are rescued by Paulie when the Aqua Laguna floods the main station. A man hands Nami a letter he found from Sanji. It informs her that Usopp, Franky, and he are on board the train that had just departed. On board, he storms the cars. High up in the city, Nami speaks with Kokoro and spots Luffy, stuck in between two buildings, in the back streets where the Aqua Laguna will hit first.

2006.title: The Shout of Nami's Soul! The Return of the Straw Hat!
2006.desc: Nami finally reaches Luffy and tells him that he needs to hurry before Robin reaches Enies Lobby. Chopper finds Zoro and hands him the Sandai Kitetsu so he can escape the chimney. Luffy pushes apart the buildings he was stuck between and Paulie grabs them all so they can escape the Aqua Laguna's massive wave.

2006.title: Another Sea Train! Rocket Man Sortie
2006.desc: Sanji fights his way through another train car and finds Usopp and Franky. Seeing how determined Luffy is to save Robin, Kokoro and Iceburg lends the Straw Hat crew the use of another sea train, Rocket Man. The Franky Family shows up, pleading with Luffy to let them join them because they'll do anything for their leader.

2006.title: Rescue our Friends! The Oath that Links the Enemies
2006.desc: The Rocket Man finally makes it out to sea. As the train connects with the tracks, Luffy has to rescue Chimney before she's thrown off by the wind. In the meantime, Iceburg has a flashback about when he finally met Franky again in Water 7. With Luffy and Chimney safe in the train, Paulie tells his fellow carpenters who the real culprits were. The Straw Hats, Franky Family, and Galley La Company form an alliance.

2006.title: Smash the Wave! Luffy and Zoro, The Strongest Combo!
2006.desc: Luffy and Zoro perform a move that acts similar to a cannon and blasts a hole through the wall of the tidal wave ahead of them, opening up a channel for them to pass through. They miraculously pass through unscathed and the passengers rejoice. Sanji contacts the rest of the crew and fills them in on his current situation. Usopp separates from them but later, when Sanji and Franky are spotted, a man named Sogeking comes to their rescue.

2006.title: A Mysterious Man Appears?! His Name Is Sogeking!
2006.desc: Sogeking makes his grand entrance. Franky and Sanji aren't fooled by his costume but they try to humor him. They devise a plan first, then detach the last two cars and fight their way through the rest. Back in the Rocket Man, Luffy, Zoro, Nami, and Chopper get an outfit change; Nami shows off the weapon Usopp upgraded for her while he was still with them.

2006.title: Cook Confrontation! Sanji vs Ramen Kenpo
2006.desc: Kalifa updates the CP9 on the situation with Franky, Sanji, and Usopp. Sanji tells Franky and Usopp to go on without him so he can fight Wanze and his "Ramen Kenpo". Franky begins to fight Nero, CP9's "Weasel", and Sogeking meets with Robin.

2006.title: Duel on the Roof! Franky vs Nero!
2006.desc: Franky's fight with Nero continues. Nero discovers that Franky's weak spot is his back, so Franky lies down flat so he cannot get to it. Nero demands that he fight seriously, so Franky gets up to perform his "Centaur" form. Sogeking talks with Robin and tells her that the crew knows about her reasons for leaving. Those on the Rocket Man encounter the discarded cars and Zoro slices them so they can pass.

2006.title: Crash! Demon-Cutting Zoro vs Ship-Cutting T-Bone!
2006.desc: Zoro clashes with "Ship Cutter" T-Bone. The fight is short and Zoro joins the crew again in the Rocket Man. On the Puffing Tom, Sanji beats Wanze beautiful, though Wanze thinks he's ruined his face. Franky finally gains the upper hand against Nero and defeats him. After beating their respective opponents, Franky and Sanji stand to fight against the other CP9.

2006.title: Robin Struggles! Sogeking's Clever Scheme!!
2006.desc: After hiding under Robin's cloak for a few episodes, Sogeking finally shows himself. They stumble into the room with the CP9 and meet with Sanji and Franky. Sogeking produces a smokescreen. The four head into another car, detach it, and escape. It's not long before Blueno pulls their car back, though. Franky knocks down the wall so they can escape but ends up on the enemy car. Blueno opens a door then back in the Straw Hat car.

2006.title: The Judiciary Island! The Full Picture of Enies Lobby!
2006.desc: Robin willingly follows Blueno into his improvised door and Sogeking and Sanji are left alone. For a while, Blueno explains a little of Robin's past involving the Buster Call. Back at the Rocket Man, Yokuzuna the frog jumps onto the front of the train, knocking them from the rails. After Kokoro speaks with him, he joins the group. The CP9, Franky, and Robin finally reach Enies Lobby and disembark.

2006.title: Operation Disembarkation Commences! The Straw Hat Crew Rushes In!
2006.desc: Luffy and the others finally catch up to Sanji, Usopp, and the rest of the Franky Family as they near Enies Lobby. Paulie sits down with the group and talks about their plan. Luffy does not bother to follow the plan, and slingshots himself beyond the gates before the train stops.

2006.title: Luffy Charges In! Great Decisive Battle on the Judiciary Island!
2006.desc: Spandam is informed that an intruder has entered the area. Luffy confuses the Marines guarding the entrance gate by manipulating one of their own comrades to fight against them. The rest of Luffy's group come in after he already slingshot himself over the gates. Because they aren't all quite as limber as Luffy, they have to band together to get inside. Giant Gate Keepers Kaashii and Oimo come to fight the Franky Family.

2006.title: Battle with the Giants! Open the Second Door!
2006.desc: In a David and Goliath turn around, the Franky Family and Galley La bring down Kaashi. Spandam receives an incomplete report about Luffy and believes that he's no longer a threat. The Cipher Pol 9 members meet with Spandam and it looks more like a comedy routine than a briefing.

2006.title: The Means of Escaping is Opened! Fly through the Sky, Rocketman!
2006.desc: While Robin and Franky are brought before Spandam, Luffy blasts his way through another wave of marines. In order to get past the gate, Zoro orders that they just keep going. Yokozuna the frog bends down the outside gates and they fly over the gate inside. Back on the ground, Paulie is stabbed by someone from "The Law's Watch Dogs", the Houbantai. The Rocket Man flies over the gate and the point of the train smashes into Oimo's back, knocking him out cold.

2006.title: Catch Up with Luffy! The Straw Hat Pirates' All-Out War
2006.desc: As the title of the episode suggests, the Straw Hats enter an all-out war to catch up with Luffy, albeit a humorous one; Sanji and Zoro bicker over who's more dangerous, Nami injures her own comrades with her improved weapon, and Sogeking fails at being a decoy. The Houbantai show up to stop them and the foremen of Galley La stay behind to fight.

2006.title: Robin was Betrayed! The Expectations of the World Government!
2006.desc: Robin questions why Spandam was given rights to the Buster Call. The CP9 plan to kill the Straw Hats because they violated the original arrangement; that they entered Enies Lobby after leaving Water 7. Back in the fray, Franky's Giant Bulls talk with Chopper. He translates and they notice that Sogeking is not with them anymore. Elsewhere, Blueno appears before Luffy.

2006.title: Give Robin Back! Luffy vs. Blueno!
2006.desc: For a while, Sogeking talks with Oimo about how he and Kaashi came to support the marines and hears a familiar story. The majority of the episode is a Little Garden flashback. Soddom the Giant Bull takes severe damage and urges those riding him to run before he collapses. Back at the fight between Blueno and Luffy, Luffy throws the first punch to initiate the battle.

2006.title: Don't Stop! Raise the Signal Fire of a Counterattack!
2006.desc: Kokoro contacts the Straw Hats by way of Nami's baby den den mushi. The Franky family decide to lower the inner bridge so the others can enter the courthouse first. After Gomorrah is blinded, Sogeking arrives with the giants as back up. Shortly after, Gomorrah tells those riding him to hold on, as he plans to take them to the courthouse. Inside, Spandam gives Kaku and Kalifa Devil's Fruits.

2006.title: Luffy is in Sight! Gather at the Courthouse Plaza
2006.desc: Although Gomorrah was blinded, he continues to rush ahead. Spandam receives word of their progress right as the Straw Hats reach the gate. Zoro slices right through it and while up top, Luffy activates "Gear Second".

2006.title: All for the Sake of Protecting My Friends! Gear Second in Motion
2006.desc: The Straw Hats enter and Yokozuna the frog and the Franky Family stay behind at the door to watch their backs. The three-headed judge attempts to stop them but the Franky Family holds him off. Elsewhere, Luffy's Gear Second is put into action, ultimately defeating Blueno without having to activate Gear Third.

2006.title: Answer Us, Robin! The Outcries of the Straw Hat Crew!!
2006.desc: Franky helps Robin escape from their chains and they make it outside to see Luffy. Luffy wants to come over to rescue Robin but she tells him to stay, that she only wants to die. Below, as Yokozuna falls, the giants come to cover. All the Straw hats arrive on the roof, and ask Robin to return.

2006.title: Robin's Past! The Girl who was Called a Demon!
2006.desc: 20 years ago, on the West Blue island of Ohara, Nico Robin becomes an archaeologist, but Professor Clover forbids her from researching the Void Century. She meets the giant Saul who has washed up on the beach. Meanwhile, Spandine is just off the coast of Ohara.

2006.title: The Fated Parent and Child! The Mother's Name is Olvia!
2006.desc: Robin continues talking with Saul, and Saul is shocked to learn that Robin is Nico Olvia's daughter and that he is on Ohara. Olvia returns to Ohara to warn the other scholars that the World Government's forces are headed there. She decides not to reveal herself to Robin, not wanting her daughter to be branded a criminal because of her. CP9 arrives on the island, capturing Olvia and rounding up the scholars.

2006.title: Tragedy of Ohara! Fear of Buster Call!
2006.desc: Clover reveals that the Poneglyphs were most likely carved by an ancient country in order to prevent their enemy, the World Government, from completely erasing their history, but is shot by Spandine, who then activates the Golden Den Den Mushi. Robin recognizes Olvia as her mother, but Olvia denies it, causing Robin to admit that she is an archaeologist and can read the Poneglyphs. The Buster Call commences, and, after a tearful reunion with her daughter, Olvia entrusts Saul with Robin's care.

2006.title: Say You Want to Live! We are Friends!!
2006.desc: Robin finishes her story and says that while she considers the Straw Hats her friends, she believes that one day, they will be no longer able to protect her from her pursuers, and betray her like the others did. After Spandam points out that taking in Robin means declaring war on the entire world, Luffy tells Sogeking to shoot the World Government flag. Sogeking uses his Sure-kill Firebird Star to burn up the flag, declaring war on the world for Robin's sake. Robin, moved by the depth of Luffy's action, cries out that she wants to live and return to the sea with Luffy, and Luffy and the others prepare to do battle with CP9 and save Robin.

2006.title: Jump Into the Falls! Luffy's Feelings!!
2006.desc: Luffy's backstory.

2006.title: A Man's Way of Life! Zoro's Techniques, Usopp's Dream
2006.desc: Zoro and Usopp's backstories.

2006.title: Tears Which Weaved the Bond of Comrades! Nami's World Map
2006.desc: Nami's backstory.

2006.title: Separation Refines a Man! Sanji and Chopper
2006.desc: The backstories to Sanji and Chopper.

2006.title: All for my Comrades' Sake! The Darkness Within Robin!
2006.desc: The reasons for Nico Robin's recent actions, as well as a summary of her back story.

2006.title: The Blueprints Aren't Passed! Franky's Decision
2006.desc: After Robin decides she wants to live, the Straw Hats wait for the bridge so they can battle CP9. Franky reveals that the Pluton blueprints are with him and burns them in front of Spandam, saying that he's betting it all on the Straw hats. With unexpected help from Kokoro, Franky and the Straw Hats make a dramatic entrance into the Tower of Justice.

2006.title: Retrieve the 5 Keys! The Straw Hat Crew vs CP9
2006.desc: The Straw Hats and Franky made it to the Tower of Justice. However, Fukurou reveals that one of the CP9 members has the key to Robin's handcuffs, and will not say which, so the Straw Hats must fight every member to find the key. Meanwhile, Chimney follows Spandam and Lucci down a secret corridor.

2006.title: Power of the Devil Fruit! Kaku and Jyabura Transform
2006.desc: Zoro begins his intense battle with Kaku, and Sogeking fails to retrieve the key from a sleeping Jabra. Kaku reveals his Devil Fruit power and causes the floor to collapse in the process. Meanwhile, Luffy searches high and low in the Tower of Justice, and attempts to cross the whirlpools to the Bridge of Hesitation.

2006.title: Even if I Die, I Won't Kick You! Sanji's Manly Chivalry
2006.desc: Nami barely escapes from Kumadori, stealing his key in the process. Kaku utilizes his new body to cut the Tower of Justice in half, and Sanji attempts to get the key from Kalifa.

2006.title: Fukurou's Miscalculation - My Cola is the Water of Life!
2006.desc: Chimney and Gombe show Luffy the secret passage that leads to Robin; Franky puts on a display of raw punching power.

2006.title: Zoro's New Technique Explodes! The Katana's Name is Sogeking?
2006.desc: Franky's brawl spills into the ocean; Usopp and Sanji attempt to overcome their handcuffs by outsmarting their opponents.

2006.title: Uncontrollable! Chopper's Forbidden Rumble
2006.desc: After Chopper's first Rumble ball wears off and his second fails he is forced to break a promise to Dr. Kureha. He uses his third Rumble Ball in a row and transform into his most powerful and deadly form: Monster Point.

2006.title: Boss Luffy Returns! A Dream or Reality Lottery Trouble
2006.desc: A madcap adventure starring the Straw Hats; A camel that eats lottery tickets.

2007.title: The Great Mochimaki Race to the Castle! Conspiracy of the Red Nose
2007.desc: The madcap throwback continues as Luffy and the gang competes for a priceless treasure hidden inside a tasty snack.

2007.title: Bubble User Kalifa! Nami Draws Near to the Soap's Trap
2007.desc: Nami battles a bathing beauty and her lethal bubbles; Chopper unleashes his inner beast; Luffy inches even closer to catching up with Robin.

2007.title: The Resounding Bad News! The Buster Call is Invoked
2007.desc: Spandam accidentally invokes the Buster Call on Enies Lobby with the Golden Den Den Mushi. He also accidentally informs everyone on the island of the coming destruction.

2007.title: 5 Namis? Counterattack with the Mirage!
2007.desc: Zoro uses Usopp as a decoy in his beast battle; Nami discovers a secret.

2007.title: Nami's Determination! Shoot the Rampaging Chopper!
2007.desc: Franky and Nami form a plan to stop Choppers rampage; Usopp and Zoro spend time apart.

2007.title: Hunter Sanji Appears? Elegy to the Lying Wolf
2007.desc: Usopp's life is saved by a familiar foot; Luffy struggles to hit a formidable foe.

2007.title: Kick! Full Course of Sanji's Footwork
2007.desc: Sanji uses the Devil's leg to even the odds.

2007.title: The Drawn Sword's Fierce Attack! Zoro vs. Kaku Powerful Slash Showdown
2007.desc: The battle between Zoro and Kaku rages on. Meanwhile Franky finally reaches Luffy.

2007.title: Zoro the Fierce God! The Incarnation of Asura Revealed by His Soul
2007.desc: Zoro unleashes a demonic nine-sword fighting style on his giraffe opponent. Meanwhile Luffy activates Gear Second in his fight against Rob Lucci, who transforms into his half-leopard form.

2007.title: Spandam's Shock! A Hero Stands on the Tower of Justice
2007.desc: Robin finds out that Spandam is the son of Spandine, the man who invoked the buster call on Ohara. Sogeking stops Spandam with his Kabuto and saves Robin, while Franky releases her Seastone handcuffs. Now free to use her Devil Fruit powers again, Robin finally releases her anger on Spandam with her Seis Fleur Slap. However, the Buster Call on Enies Lobby has just begun.

2007.title: Robin's Liberation! Luffy vs. Lucci: Peak of the Decisive Battle
2007.desc: Luffy's battle with Lucci reveals the powerful secrets of the rubber man's second gear; Spandam's thoughtless Buster Call begins.

2007.title: The Criminal is Boss Luffy? Chase the Vanished Great Sakura Tree
2007.desc: An ancient tree is stolen by a madman with the power to freeze time.

2007.title: If I Can't Win, I Can't Protect Anyone! Gear Third Activates
2007.desc: While Sanji and the others are trapped in a tunnel with water pouring in, Luffy activates Gear Third in the battle against Lucci.

2007.title: The Terrifying Past! Dark Justice and Rob Lucci
2007.desc: The past of Rob Lucci is told by the commander of the Marines.

2007.title: A Phantom Mermaid is Here? Within Fading Consciousness
2007.desc: Robin rejoins the fight; the Straw Hats struggle to survive underwater.

2007.title: The Island Sinking in Gunfire! Franky's Outcry of Regret
2007.desc: Thanks to a Mermaid the Straw Hats make it safely to the ship. However, Luffy is still fighting Lucci in the first tower of the Bridge of Hesitation.

2007.title: Wait for Luffy! Fight to the Death on the Bridge of Hesitation!
2007.desc: Luffy pushes his body to the breaking point during his battle with Rob Lucci; the rest of the Straw Hats try to fight off a fleet of Marines.

2007.title: Feelings Put Into Fists! Luffy's Full-Power Gatling
2007.desc: Usopp's desperate pleas inspire the rubber-man to mount one final attack on Rob Lucci.

2007.title: A Friend Approaches from the Sea! The Straw Hat Crew's Strongest Bonds
2007.desc: The Straw Hats must throw themselves into the sea to survive.

2007.title: The Crew's Great Escape! The Victor's Path is for the Pirates
2007.desc: With the arrival of Going Merry, the Straw Hats make their great escape from Enies Lobby. Thanks to Sanji and his clever strategy of closing the Gates of Justice, the Marines are unable to get a clear shot at Merry.

2007.title: Thank You Merry! The Sea of Separation in the Snow
2007.desc: The Going Merry cracks and breaks under her own weight, and the crew say their own farewells as they give the ship a Viking funeral, finally putting her to rest. As she goes up in flames, Merry apologizes and then thanks the Staw Hats for treasuring her for so long.

2007.title: The Disturbance of Peace! The Vice-Admiral with the Fist of Love
2007.desc: The Straw Hats get some much needed rest; Franky makes a big announcement; Vice Admiral Garp tracks down his grandson.

2007.title: The Strongest Family Line? Luffy's Father Revealed!
2007.desc: Luffy's friends learn that Luffy's grandfather is a marine hero, Luffy learns who his father is.

2007.title: Its Name is The New World! The Whereabouts of the Great Grand Line!
2007.desc: Luffy has the chance to catch up on things with his old friend Coby; Nami does some serious snooping around.

2007.title: Shanks Moves! Ceremony to the Rampaging Age
2007.desc: Shanks visits Whitebeard with a serious request; Franky and Iceberg begin construction on a ship.

2007.title: The Girl Searching for the Yagara! Great Investigation in the Water Metropolis!
2007.desc: Luffy and Chopper risk their lives to help a heartbroken young girl track down her long lost pet.

2007.title: The Mother is Strong! Zoro's Slapstick Housework Help
2007.desc: Zoro's day is ruined by a group of orphans as he searches for a new sword.

2007.title: Sanji Crashes! The Mysterious Old Man and Intense Cooking
2007.desc: While out shopping with Chimney, Sanji is persuaded by her to go to a good cook whom which she calls grandpa, the old man teaches Sanji the reason why his food tastes so good, salt which is produced by the Aqua Laguna.

2007.title: Everyone's Finally Wanted! The Crew of Over Six Hundred Million!
2007.desc: Franky and Iceberg stay up all night, trying to see who can do the most work to finish the new ship for the Straw Hats.

2007.title: The King of Beasts that will Cross the Ocean! The Dream Ship's Magnificent Completion!
2007.desc: Luffy and the rest of the Staw Hats prepare to set sail on their newly completed ship; Franky discovers that he now is wanted by the government.

2007.title: Goodbye my Lovable Followers! Franky Departs
2007.desc: The Straw Hats press Franky to leave with them.

2007.title: Departing the Water Metropolis! Distinction of the Manly Usopp's Duel
2007.desc: While awaiting the return of Usopp, Luffy and the Straw Hats face a barrage of cannon fire by the marines.

2007.title: The World-Wide Bounties! The Hometowns Dance as the Ship Sails Forward!
2007.desc: The Straw Hats choose a name for their new ship, the crew has a chance to show off the ship during battle with the marines.

2007.title: The Most Evil Ability! Blackbeard's Darkness Attacks Ace
2007.desc: Blackbeard and Ace match their devil fruit powers against each other.

2007.title: Mysterious Party of Pirates! The Sunny and a Dangerous Trap
2007.desc: The Straw Hats try to help another ships crew.

2007.title: Sunny in a Pinch! Roar, Secret Superspeed Mecha
2007.desc: The Straw Hats are lead into a trap when they encounter what appears to be marines.

2007.title: The Dream Sinking in the New World! The Pirate of Despair, Puzzle
2007.desc: The captain of the Phoenix Pirates loses his will to fight; The Straw Hats try to figure out the Iceberg trap.

2007.title: The Assassins Attack! The Great Battle Above the Ice Begins
2007.desc: Using the Shark Submerge III, Nami and Franky find out that penguins are moving the icebergs. Afterwards, they are attacked by Hockera. Usopp and Sanji are knocked off the Thousand Sunny by an iceberg, and encounter Salchow and Arbell.

2007.title: The Hard Fights of the Straw Hat Crew! The Pirate Soul Banking it All on the Flag!
2007.desc: The fights continue with Luffy, distracted due to the lost flag, has initial trouble with Brindo, but the Phoenix Pirates help capture him.

2007.title: Hot Full Throttle! The Twins' Magnetic Power Draws Near
2007.desc: Luffy battles a set of magnetic twins; Zorro drinks with the man who stole the Straw Hats Flag.

2007.title: The Great Chaos Mansion! The Angry Don and the Imprisoned Crew
2007.desc: Robin's cola care package helps spring her friends from an icy prison; Luffy's bold words inspire a battered and beaten pirate to keep fighting.

2007.title: The Phoenix Returns! The Dream of the Pirate Flag Sworn to a Friend
2007.desc: Luffy continues his battle with the magnetic twins; Chopper uses a rumble ball in his battle with a hockey player.

2007.title: The Red Hot Decisive Battle! Luffy vs. the Scorching Don
2007.desc: Luffy battles an opponent too hot to handle; Robin is attacked by a jungle when a little girl does not get her way; Chopper makes a heroic dash.

2007.title: Waiting in the New World! Farewell to the Courageous Pirates
2007.desc: Luffy's battle with Papa threatens to destroy the entire icy island.

2007.title: Chopperman Departs! Protect the TV Station by the Shore
2007.desc: Chopperman must battle a hideously evil villain to regain control of his favorite tv station.

2008.title: Venture Into the Devil's Sea! The Mysterious Skeleton Floating Through the Fog
2008.desc: The crew is surrounded by a dense fog and they meet skeleton Brook, who tells them his sad story.

2008.title: The Delight of Having Met People! The Gentleman Skeleton's True Colors
2008.desc: The Straw Hats attempt to unravel the mystery of their new comrade then discover that they have a problem.

2008.title: One Phenomenon After Another! Disembarking at Thriller Bark
2008.desc: After getting stranded at Thriller Bark, Chopper, Nami, and Usopp are chased by a three headed beast. Back on the boat, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats are terrorized by an unseen enemy!

2008.title: The Man Called a Genius! Hogback Appears!
2008.desc: Chopper, Nami, and Usopp get scared out of their minds when they encounter a graveyard full of zombies! Meanwhile, the rest of the crew gets trapped in super creepy sea web!

2008.title: Nami in Big Trouble! The Zombie Mansion and the Invisible Man
2008.desc: Nami, Usopp and Chopper meet Dr Hogback and they spend a crazy night in his castle. The rest of the crew is crossing the forest in order to rescue them.

2008.title: Mystery of the Zombies! Hogback's Nightmarish Research Laboratory
2008.desc: The Straw Hats discover who the creator of the Zombies is.

2008.title: His Name is Moria! Trap of the Great Shadow-Stealing Pirate
2008.desc: The Straw Hats find out that they were specifically lured to this strange place.

2008.title: Feast of the Zombie Song! The Bell of the Night Raid is a Sound of Darkness
2008.desc: Usopp, Chopper, and Nami get trapped in a coffin after being slashed by a zombie samurai. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats make short work of some haunted paintings!

2008.title: A Bunch of Animals? Perona's Wonder Garden!
2008.desc: Usopp, Chopper and Nami do battle with a garden full of adorably dead zombie animals.

2008.title: Disappearing Strawhat Crew! The Mysterious Swordsman Appears!
2008.desc: A mysterious swordsman appears during the fights, Luffy has a encounter he may not be able to escape from.

2008.title: Leftover Chivalry! The Traitorous Zombie who Protects Nami
2008.desc: Robin and Franky end up having to deal with the giant spider zombie while Luffy is turned into a zombie and expected to fight his fellow Straw Hats.

2008.title: Coming from the Sky! That Man is the Humming Swordsman
2008.desc: Nami gives love advice to a zombie; Luffy finds himself face-to-face with Gecko Moria; Robin gets caught in a spookyspider web.

2008.title: Luffy in an Emergency! The Living Place of the Strongest Shadow!
2008.desc: Brook strikes the final blow in his battle with the spider monkey, Gecko Moria's plan is revealed. Luffy almost escapes.

2008.title: The Warrior Known as the Devil!! The Moment of Oars' Revival!
2008.desc: Brook tells Franky and Robin the secret to slaying Zombies; Gecko Moria revels the terrifying monster that will be the recipient of Luffy's shadow.

2008.title: Awakening After 500 Years!! Oars Opens His Eyes!!
2008.desc: After Luffy's shadow is forced into a monster, Nami is kidnapped and Usopp and Chopper try to rescue her.

2008.title: Conviction Strong Enough to Beg for One's Life!! Brook Protects his Afro
2008.desc: Gecko Moria's minions struggle with the burden of feeding a giant zombie.

2008.title: A Man's Oath will Never Die! From Far Memories to the Waiting Friend
2008.desc: Luffy, Zorro and Sanji discover that their shadows are missing; Franky relates to Brooks story about a promise he made to a very special whale.

2008.title: We will Definately Meet Again! Brook and the Promise of the Cape
2008.desc: Luffy and the Straw Hats flash back to the story of Laboon the abandoned whale; revelations about Brook's battle with the zombie samurai.

2008.title: Food, Nami, and Shadows!! Luffy's Enraged Counterattack
2008.desc: Luffy sets out to regain his shadow and convince the walking skeleton Brooks to become a member of his crew. Meanwhile, Sanji races to stop the Zombie leader from his plan to marry Nami.

2008.title: Usopp the Strongest? Leave the Negatives to Me
2008.desc: Usopp surprises everyone when he encounters the ghosts.

2008.title: The General Zombies Are Down In A Flash!! Oars Feels Like An Adventure!!
2008.desc: Brook is overmatched by the zombie samurai; Luffy prepares for his battle; Sanji interrupts the undead wedding.

2008.title: Blazing Knight Sanji!! Kick Down The Fake Wedding
2008.desc: Luffy struggles to land a blow against Gecko Moria; Sanji's passionate attempt to defeat Nami's beastly abductor.

2008.title: Invisibility Connection? Sanji's Stolen Dream
2008.desc: Sanji takes a beating when his opponent suddenly turns invisible; Usopp battles with a zombie bear.

2008.title: Saving Hero!! The Enemy is the Invincible Princess
2008.desc: Usopp battles the ghost girl and tries to discover the secret of her sudden confidence.

2008.title: Perona's Terror!! The U in Uso is the U in Usopp
2008.desc: Usopp reaches deep into himself to help even the odds during his battle with the tricky Perona; Luffy finds during his battle that even laying a finger on Gecko Moria may be a major problem.

2008.title: Slashes Dancing on the Roof!! Finale - Zoro vs. Ryuma
2008.desc: Ryuma and Zoro duel in Hogback's laboratory while Franky guards the injured Brook. Neither opponent is able to gain over the other during the fight. Their attacks on each other quickly destroy the lab.

2008.title: Chopper is Furious!! Hogback's Evil Medical Practices
2008.desc: Dr Hogback tells Chopper how he met Cindri. Chopper goes mad and bids Cindry to rebel against her zombie nature. Robin fools Hogback so he makes Sanji and Zoro's zombies fall from the tower. Luffy finally faces Oars.

2008.title: Oars Roars!! Come Out Straw Hat Crew
