2008.desc: Moria's mansion is reduced to ruins as the zombie with Luffy's shadow stalks the Straw Hats! As the walls come tumbling down, Chopper puts the hurt on Hogback, and Nami vanishes right before Sanji's eyes!

2008.title: The Enemy is Luffy!! The Strongest Zombie vs. the Straw Hat Crew
2008.desc: One by one, the Straw Hats attack Oars, but the monstrous zombie appears too powerful to be defeated. Luffy's got his sights set on Moria, but he'd better hurry if he wants to save his crew!

2008.title: You're Going Down, Absalom!! Nami's Lightning Attack of Friendship!!
2008.desc: Absalom is about to kiss Nami when she wakes up and suddenly Lola appears and pretends to fight Nami so she can escape. Absalom falls under Nami's lightning bolt while the rest of the straw hat crew is gathering to stop Oars.

2008.title: One Down!! Sure Kill Straw Hat Docking?
2008.desc: Nami attempts to track down some missing treasure; Brook searches the kitchen for a mystery ingredient; a heroic team battle against Oars in a effort to topple him.

2008.title: Soundless Invasion!! The Mysterious Visitor: Kuma the Tyrant
2008.desc: Nami chases after Perona, who is fleeing from Thriller Bark; Kuma arrives and wrecks the place.

2008.title: Oars + Moria - The Greatest Combination of Brains and Brawn
2008.desc: Luffy discovers that he has been chasing Gekko's shadow wile the real Gekko escaped.

2008.title: A Crazy Strategy to Turn the Tables - The Creation of Nightmare Luffy
2008.desc: Oars manages to turn the tide of the battle by countering the Straw Hats; Nami arrives and joins the fight; Luffy meets some interesting individuals who might be of help.

2008.title: The Straw Hat Crew annihilated! Full-throttle Kage Kage abilities!
2008.desc: Brook joins the fight; the Straw Hats try to hold off Oars and Moria until Luffy is able to return but they may not be able to.

2008.title: The Battle for Superiority Starts! Luffy vs. Luffy
2008.desc: While Oars and Moria is ruthlessly pummeling the Straw Hat pirates, Nightmare Luffy arrives to join the battle.

2008.title: The Conclusion Arrives! Deliver the Finishing Blow
2008.desc: After Luffy's shadow power disappears, he needs help from the rest of the Straw Hats to land the finishing blow in his battle against Oars.

2008.title: The Bodies Vanish! The Morning Sun Pierces Through the Nightmare Island!
2008.desc: Moria gobbles up every shadow in sight to power up for the final showdown with Luffy.

2008.title: The Endless Crisis! Orders to Obliterate the Straw Hat Crew
2008.desc: The battle between Luffy and Moria reaches it's end; Kuma causes panic on the island.

2008.title: It Repels Everything! Kuma's Paw-Paw Power!
2008.desc: The World Government orders Kuma to obliterate every living being on the island.

2008.title: My Companions' Pain is My Pain - Zoro Prepares to Die
2008.desc: A heated confrontation occurs when Zoro and Sanji have to make a decision so they can save Luffy.

2008.title: The Promise on that Distant Day - The Song of Pirates and a Small Whale
2008.desc: Hogback and Absalom escape Thriller Bark with the unconscious Moria and reveal that Blackbeard gained his status as a Shichibukai by defeating Ace.

2008.title: Brook's Past - Sad Farewell to the Cheerful Crew
2008.desc: Brook recalls his past, when the whale Laboon started following his pirate ship and befriended the crew.

2008.title: Binks' Sake - The Song that Connects the Past and Present
2008.desc: Brook continues to tell the tale of the Rumbar Pirates' fateful journey into the Grand Line, and the decision he made at the end of his original life.

2008.title: A New Crewmate! Musician - The Hummer Brook
2008.desc: Brook pledges himself to the Straw Hat Pirates, becoming their ninth member, as the crew settles their affairs at Thriller Bark and continue their journey.

2008.title: Noro Noro Menace - Return of Foxy the Silver Fox
2008.desc: The Straw Hat Pirates are taking a vacation at Spa Island, but there, they encounter Foxy and his crew, who are pursuing two small girls: Lina and her older sister, Sayo.

2008.title: The Great Treasure Contest! Collapse! Spa Island
2008.desc: In order to rescue Lina's sister, the crew destroys the Spa Island and look for the hot cross which is the clue to make the gems of Lina's father.

2009.title: Brook's Hard Struggle - The Difficult Path to Becoming a True Nakama
2009.desc: Brook tries to help his new nakamas because he fears that otherwise he will be dispensed, but Robin tell him her story of Water 7 and he recovers his confidence.

2009.title: Arriving at Halfway Through the Grand Line! The Red Line
2009.desc: The Straw Hat Pirates are about to reach the Red Line but a terrible storm delays them. Log Pose is pointing downwards and the crew needs more information to get to Gyojin Island.

2009.title: Hatred of the Straw Hat Crew - Enter Iron Mask Duval
2009.desc: Camie and Pappag introduce themselves to the Straw Hats, who then later find out that their fishman friend has been kidnapped by Iron Mask Duval and the Macro Gang.

2009.title: The Fated Reunion! Save the Imprisoned Fishman
2009.desc: The mysterious Duval gets excited when the crew that rescued Camie turns out to be the Straw Hat Pirates.

2009.title: Tragedy! The Truth of the Unmasked Duval
2009.desc: The Straw Hat Pirates do battle with the Flying Fish Riders and Macro Fishman Pirates. The stakes rise when Duval reveals himself, and exactly who his grudge is against: Sanji.

2009.title: Explosion! The Sunny's Super Secret Weapon: Gaon Cannon
2009.desc: Duval reveals that he was once a small-time bandit until Sanji's wanted poster came to light. Since then he hid his face with the iron mask until he could get revenge on Sanji.

2009.title: Landing to Get to Fishman Island - The Sabaody Archipelago
2009.desc: With the Flying Fish Riders taken care of, the Straw Hats rest as Hatchan treats them to the promised takoyaki.

2009.title: Tyranny! The Rulers of Sabaody, the Celestial Dragons
2009.desc: After landing on the Sabaody Archipelago, the Straw Hats begin searching for a man Hatchan knows who can coat their ship, so they can continue onto Fishman Island.

2009.title: New Rivals Gather! The 11 Supernovas
2009.desc: The Straw Hat Pirates fight and defeat some bounty hunters who want their bounty.

2009.title: The Target Is Camie!! The Looming Clutches Of A Professional Kidnapper
2009.desc: Departing from Shakky's Rip-off Bar, Luffy's group attempt to search for Rayleigh but is distracted by the Sabaody Park. Zoro is disrespectful to Saint Charlos, causing him to be shot at.

2009.title: Rescue Caimie - The Dark History of the Archipelago
2009.desc: Duval and his crew arrive on the Archipelago and start gathering the Straw Hats up to bring them to the Human Auctioning House, where the kidnappers have brought Camie.

2009.title: Time Limit - The Human Auction Begins
2009.desc: The human auction finally begins, and it is only then that the Straw Hats discovered that their mermaid friend is being sold off at Grove 1.

2009.title: The Exploding Fist! Destroy the Auction
2009.desc: The auction continues, but Saint Charlos arrives and ruins the Straw Hats' plan to buy Camie back by placing an exorbitant bid on her.

2009.title: Huge Panic! Struggle in the Auction Hall
2009.desc: After Luffy punches Charlos, the guards begin to attack the Straw Hats, and most of the observers, except for Charlos' family, Kid and Law's crews, evacuate.

2009.title: Admiral Kizaru Moves! The Sabaody Archipelago in Chaos
2009.desc: Sengoku dispatches Admiral Kizaru to defend the honor of the Celestial Dragons at Sabaody Archipelago.

2009.title: Break Through the Encirclement! Marines vs. Three Captains
2009.desc: Luffy, Law and Kid's crews join the fight and defeat the rest of the Marines outside the Auction House. The three captains promise to meet and fight in the New World.

2009.title: Roger and Rayleigh - The Pirate King and His Right Hand
2009.desc: Upon arriving back at Shakky's Bar, Silvers Rayleigh reveals to the Straw Hats that he was the first mate of the legendary Gol D. Roger and also reveals the truth about his crew's dismissal.

2009.title: No Escape!? Admiral Kizaru's Light Speed Kick!!
2009.desc: Admiral Kizaru appears at the Archipelago and demonstrates his mysterious light abilities, before taking on the Supernova, Basil Hawkins, whilst Urouge and X Drake fight a Pacifista.

2009.title: Overwhelming! The Marine Combat Weapon Pacifista
2009.desc: The Straw Hat Pirates fight one of the Pacifistas, and while it does not have Kuma's Devil Fruit powers, it is still able to withstand their strongest attacks.

2009.title: Another Strong Enemy Appears! Broadaxe-Wielding Sentomaru
2009.desc: The Straw Hat Pirates combine their strongest attacks to defeat the Pacifista, but are exhausted after the battle.

2009.title: Admiral Kizaru's Fierce Attack. The Straw Hat Crew's Desperate Situation!
2009.desc: Usopp and Brook's attempt to attack Kizaru and save Zoro's life failed.

2009.title: Disappearing Crewmates - The Final Day of the Straw Hat Crew
2009.desc: Sentomaru reveals that Kuma has the ability to make people fly through the sky to far away places.

2009.title: Special Historical Arc - Boss Luffy Appears Again
2009.desc: In an alternate universe set in Edo period Japan, the Mikoshi (portable shrine) race is about to take place, the winner of which receives Beli1,000,000, and Boss Luffy and his friends recruit Franky to build them a mikoshi.

2009.title: Special Historical Arc - Destroy! Thriller Company's Trap
2009.desc: Robin reveals Brook's past to Luffy and his friends, and decide to help him. Brook is captured by Thriller LTD, but Luffy and Zoro arrive to help him escape.

2009.title: Landing! Young Men Forbidden Island Amazon Lily
2009.desc: Having been hit by Kuma, Luffy is teleported to an unknown island.

2009.title: Hurry! Get back to your friends. Adventure on the Island of Women.
2009.desc: It is revealed that Luffy is on Amazon Lily, an island populated entirely by the Kuja tribe of women warriors.

2009.title: Everyone is Lovestruck! Pirate Empress Hancock
2009.desc: Luffy decides to leave the island, reunite with his crew and defeat the enemies who had overpowered them earlier, and is determined to borrow a ship.

2009.title: The Secret Hidden on Their Backs, Luffy Encounters The Princess
2009.desc: Boa Hancock's ship reaches Amazon Lily and she returns to her palace.

2009.title: The Heartless Judgment! Margaret Turned to Stone!!
2009.desc: Luffy looks at Boa Hancock's back and notes that he has seen what was on it before. Hancock tries, but fails to turn him to stone with her powers when he mistakes her Mero Mero no Mi abilities for Foxy's Noro Noro Beam.

2009.title: Luffy's Hard Trial! The Power of the Snake Sisters' Willpower!
2009.desc: Luffy is challenged to battle Boa Marigold and Boa Sandersonia in the Amazon Lily arena with the spectators calling for Luffy to be executed.

2009.title: Battle with Full-Powered Abilities! Gomu Gomu vs. Hebi Hebi
2009.desc: Luffy activates Gear Second and is currently taking the lead.

2009.title: Hancock's Confession - The Sisters' Disgusting Past
2009.desc: Hancock decides to test Luffy by giving him an ultimatum: either he gets a ship so he can leave the island while the girls remain statues or she changes them back and Luffy finds another way to the archipelago.

2009.title: Rescue Ace! The New Destination is the Great Prison
2009.desc: Following a party, Luffy learns from Nyon that Hancock is a Shichibukai, and that they have been called together as the Marines is launching an all-out offensive on Whitebeard.

2009.title: Love is a Hurricane! Hancock Madly in Love
2009.desc: When Nyon visits Hancock, she deduces her illness and when she mentions Luffy wishes to see her, this causes Hancock to get up and speak with him.

2009.title: The Crew's Whereabouts - Weather Science and Karakuri Island
2009.desc: After being sent away by Kuma, Nami lands on a sky island called Weatheria, while Franky lands on a snowy island called Karakuri Island.

2009.title: The Crew's Whereabouts - The Island of Giant Birds and the Pink Paradise!
2009.desc: Chopper is awakened by giant birds that want to use him as a toy. Meanwhile, Sanji wakes up in the lap of a beautiful "woman" on an island thats makes everything girly.

2009.title: The Crew's Whereabouts - The Bridge that Connects Islands and Man-Eating Plants
2009.desc: Robin is found unconscious by Soran in the snow on the Tequila Wolf, a huge bridge that has been under construction for over 700 years. Usopp is chased by a large beetle, but he is saved by a man named Heracles.

2009.title: The Crew's Whereabouts - The Negative Princess and the Devil King!
2009.desc: Zoro lands on the island where Kuma also sent Perona, who treats his wounds. Brook finds himself on Namakura Island, where he is mistaken for Satan, whom the islanders had summoned for revenge against the Longarm Tribe. Meanwhile, the Marines gather at Marine Headquarters.

2009.title: A Life-threatening Break-in! The Underwater Prison Impel Down!
2009.desc: Vice Admiral Garp talked proudly to Ace at Impel Down about some of Luffy's actions, and mentions that they both have the blood of a world class criminal.

2009.title: A Reunion in Hell?! The Man Who Ate the Chop-Chop Fruit!
2009.desc: Hancock turns Domino to stone before she can undergo the body-check, allowing Luffy to escape into the prison.

2009.title: Break through Crimson Hell! Buggys great Uproar Plan
2009.desc: Buggy and Luffy fight their way through to the entrance of Level 2 by going through Level 1, Crimson Hell, where the lowest ranking criminals are held.

2009.title: The Prison's strongest Man! Introduction of the Poison-Man Magellan
2009.desc: Hancock and the others finally reach the office of Magellan, a large man who has eaten the Doku Doku no Mi.

2009.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! A Gold Lion's Ambition on the Move!
2009.desc: Luffy, Zoro, Usopp, and Sanji arrive on an island called Little East Blue, a smaller version of the East Blue, which is where they met each other.

2009.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! Little East Blue in Danger!
2009.desc: Luffy, Sanji, Zoro, and Usopp arrive on the island and go to their favorite places in the East Blue.

2009.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! The Fierce Onslaught of the Amigo Pirates!
2009.desc: Largo uses his devil fruit power to create nets from his body and trap Zoro and Sanji.

2009.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! Luffy vs. Largo - The Battle is On!
2009.desc: After escaping from the net, Luffy knocks Largo far away and goes off to fight him.

2009.title: The Imprisoned Royal Shichibukai! Jinbei, Knight of the Sea
2009.desc: Luffy and Buggy find Galdino and together they continue to fight through Level 2 of Impel Down, hounded by both Manticores and Puzzle Scorpions.

2009.title: The Trap of Chief Guard Saldeath - Level 3 Starvation Hell
2009.desc: Luffy, Buggy, and Galdino find themselves on Level 3, a barren floor of extreme heat.

2009.title: The Liberated Swan! Reunion! Bon Kurei
2009.desc: The prison staff and Hancock finally arrive on the floor where Ace is being held.

2010.title: Chief Warden Magellan Moves - The Net to Trap Straw Hat Is Complete!
2010.desc: Magellan finally receives word of Luffy's break-in, and decides to gather his forces to Level 4, to cut off Luffy and his allies.

2010.title: Preparations for War! A Decisive Battle in Level 4 - Inferno Hell
2010.desc: Luffy and his team fall to the hot fire while Magellan works out the plan to capture them.

2010.title: Magellan's Strength! Bon Kurei Flees Before His Enemy Out!
2010.desc: Luffy begins fighting Magellan despite Bentham's warnings to flee, and finds that he is unable to go on the offensive because of Magellan's poisonous body and long-range poison attacks.

2010.title: The Fight Finished! Luffy's Final Life-Risking Attack
2010.desc: Magellan has Luffy backed into a corner and is using his devil fruit powers to poison Luffy.

2010.title: Because He's Our Friend - Bon Kurei's Do-or-Die Rescue
2010.desc: Luffy is thrown into a cell where he is left to die of poisoning.

2010.title: A Paradise in Hell! Impel Down - Level 5.5!
2010.desc: Mr. 2 apologizes for abandoning Luffy and searches for Ivankov.

2010.title: Luffy's Treatment Begins! Ivan-san's Miraculous Power!
2010.desc: Emporio Ivankov displays some of his powers, including stopping a vengeful pirate's cannon shot merely by winking.

2010.title: Believe in Miracles! Bon Clay's Cries From the Heart!
2010.desc: Bentham learns that Ivankov has the ability to control hormones.

2010.title: Luffy's Back! Ivan-san Begins the Breakout Plan!
2010.desc: As Luffy is finally revived, he is informed by Emporio Ivankov about Iva's background.

2010.title: Ace's Convoy Begins! Battle on the Lowest Floor - Level 6!
2010.desc: When Luffy made it to Level 6 with Ivankov and Inazuma, they met up with the former cellmate of Ace, Jinbe.

2010.title: The Ultimate Team Has Formed! Shaking Impel Down!
2010.desc: Luffy is reluctant to free Crocodile, but Ivankov offers to keep him in line by blackmailing him with a weakness he knows about.

2010.title: Even More Chaos! Blackbeard Teach Invades!
2010.desc: While Luffy and his allies continue fighting on Level 4 of Impel Down, Buggy and Mr. 3 reach Level 2 and release the prisoners there to cause a riot to cover their escape.

2010.title: A Dangerous Meeting! Blackbeard and Shiryu of the Rain
2010.desc: The Jailer Beasts arrive and overpower many of the prisoners, but Luffy, Jinbe and Crocodile defeat them in a single attack each.

2010.title: His Spirit Won't Break! Hannyabal Goes All Out
2010.desc: Luffy fights Hannyabal who tries to stop the escapees, but then Blackbeard shows up and breaks up the fight between Luffy and Hannyabal.

2010.title: The Jet Pistol of Rage - Luffy vs. Blackbeard
2010.desc: Although Luffy wants a proper battle with Blackbeard, Jinbe reminds him there's no time for that as Ace's execution will occur in only a few short hours.

2010.title: Stop Magellan! Ivan-san Unleashes His Secret Attack
2010.desc: Luffy and the other prisoners are getting closer to the surface, having made it through levels 3 and 2.

2010.title: Magellan's Scheme! The Jailbreak is Obstructed
2010.desc: Luffy becomes enraged after learning about Magellan defeating Emporio Ivankov and Inazuma, but Mr. 2 and Jinbe persuade him that escaping takes priority.

2010.title: The Jailbreak Team Driven Into a Corner - Forbidden Move 'Venom Demon'
2010.desc: Jinbe, Crocodile and Daz Bones finally secure a Marine vessel to escape with. Meanwhile, Luffy continues his fight against Magellan, with the assistance of Galdino's Doru Doru no Mi powers.

2010.title: Create the Final Miracle - Break Through the Gate of Justice
2010.desc: Bentham puts himself on the line to save Luffy and the others, by disguising himself as Warden Magellan.

2010.title: The Destination is Marine Headquarters - The Ship Sets Out to Rescue Ace!
2010.desc: Shiryu saves Blackbeard and his crew by giving them antidotes to Magellan's poison before taking the opportunity to join with them.

2010.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! Weatheria Report and Cyborg Animals
2010.desc: As Luffy's ship heads to the Marine Headquarters, the scene shifts to a point some time in the past.

2010.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! A Cheeper of Giant Birds and a Pink Showdown!
2010.desc: Sanji is chased by okamas to Caroline - the queen's stand in.

2010.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! The Revolutionary Army and the Trap of the Forest of Gluttony!
2010.desc: Robin was captured by the guards of Tequila Wolf and was sent to the Prison Tower.

2010.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! The Giant Gravestone and Panties of Gratitude
2010.desc: While heading to the sea to return to the Sabaody Archipelago, Zoro and Perona stumble upon an enormous tombstone. Brook decides he has to wait to find Luffy and the others until he can fulfill his debt to the people of Harahettania.

2010.title: Flashback Special Before Marineford - The Brothers' Oath!
2010.desc: Luffy recalls his childhood with Ace and meeting Marshall D. Teach in Jaya without knowing who he was.

2010.title: Flashback Special Before Marineford - The Three Admirals
2010.desc: While Luffy's on his way to rescue Ace, everyone at Marine Headquarters gets ready for the execution.

2010.title: Ticking Down to the Time of Battle! The Navy's Strongest Lineup in Position!
2010.desc: Only three hours remain until Ace's execution. Luffy reaches Marineford but finds the Gates of Justice closed.

2010.title: An Enormous Fleet Appears - The Whitebeard Pirates Invade
2010.desc: The world is shocked by the revelation of Ace's father's identity.

2010.title: The Beginning of the War - Ace and Whitebeard's Past!
2010.desc: Whitebeard reveals his Devil Fruit powers in front of the Marines.

2010.title: The Force That Could Destroy The World! The Power of the Tremor-Tremor Fruit!
2010.desc: The sea-quakes made by Whitebeard cause a tsunami to come upon Marineford.

2010.title: An All-Consuming Inferno!! Admiral Akainu's Power!
2010.desc: All the various Whitebeard Commanders show off their skills and abilities, as do some Marines.

2010.title: Descendant of the Devil! Little Oars Jr. Rushes!
2010.desc: Oars Jr. goes straight for Ace, but the Giant Squad attempts to stop him without much success.

2010.title: The Winner Will Be Justice - Sengoku's Strategy Is Put Into Action!
2010.desc: Koby and Helmeppo attempted to flee from the war after feeling too overwhelmed by the deaths and chaos, but stumbled upon Akainu and an apparent plan by Sengoku.

2010.title: The Straw Hat Team Arrives - Tensions Grows on the Battlefield!
2010.desc: Luffy finally shows up together with his formed alliance from the escaped prisoners of Impel Down.

2010.title: Even If It Means Death! Luffy Vs. The Navy - The Battle Starts!
2010.desc: With Luffy as their inspiration, the other pirates fight back with renewed vigor.

2010.title: Hard Battles, One After Another! Devil's Fruit Eaters vs. Devil's Fruit Eaters!
2010.desc: One battle after another, it is complete chaos out on the battlefield.

2010.title: Kuma's Transformation! Ivan's Attack of Anger!
2010.desc: Luffy receives the key to Ace's handcuffs from Hancock, who then fantasizes about a wedding ceremony held on Amazon Lily.

2010.title: The Great Swordsman Mihawk! Luffy Comes Under the Attack of the Black Sword!
2010.desc: Luffy stumbles upon Mihawk, whom he tries to avoid.

2010.title: The Extermination Strategy in Action! The Power of the Pacifistas!
2010.desc: The Pacifista enter Marineford as part of Sengoku's plan to win the war against Whitebeard.

2010.title: Akainu's Plot! Whitebeard Trapped!
2010.desc: As Squard stabs Whitebeard, the pirates and even marines in the war are shocked due to his betrayal.

2010.title: The Encircling Walls Activated! The Whitebeard Pirates Backed into a Corner!!
2010.desc: In a desperate attempt to stop Whitebeard from advancing to the execution platform, the Marines activate walls to block Whitebeard's path, but gets stopped by the ice.

2010.title: The Order to Perform the Execution is Given - Break Through the Encircling Wall!
2010.desc: Akainu's Meteor Volcano melts the nearly all the ice and destroys the Whitebeard Pirates' ships, dropping them into boiling water, enabling the cannons on the wall to bombard them while the Pacifistas block the way out.

2010.title: Moving Into the Final Phase! Whitebeard's Trump Card for Recovery!
2010.desc: Luffy attempts to slip past the admirals, but Kizaru easily catches up to him and knocks him to the ground.

2010.title: Luffy's Strength is Exhausted! All-Out War in the Oris Plaza!
2010.desc: Ace thinks back to his childhood, when he fought with anyone who spoke ill of Roger, and wondering if he should ever have been born.

2010.title: Power that Reduces One's Life - Tension Hormones Return
2010.desc: Whitebeard falters for a moment as a result of his age and physical condition.

2010.title: For a Promise!! Luffy and Coby Clash!
2010.desc: Luffy with his newly restored strength continues on to the execution platform to save Ace and is warned by Ivankov that the hormones only trick his body.

2010.title: The Scaffold At Last! The Way To Ace Has Opened!
2010.desc: Luffy uses Haki unintentionally just as Ace is about to be executed.

2010.title: Each On Different Paths! Luffy vs. Garp!
2010.desc: Luffy unwillingly hits Garp, who is blocking his way to Ace. As Garp falls, the bridge crumbles.

2010.title: Ace is Rescued! Whitebeard's Final Captain's Orders!
2010.desc: Ace is freed at last as he and Luffy fight their way back to escape from Marineford.

2011.title: The Power that Burns Fire - Akainu's Final Move
2011.desc: Whitebeard aims to take down the whole of Marineford and orders his crew and the other pirates to flee.

2011.title: Looking for the Answer! Fire Fist Ace Dies on the Battlefield!
2011.desc: An eerie silence falls over the battlefield as Luffy and Ace share a heartbreaking final moment together.

2011.title: Marine Headquarters Crumbles! Whitebeard's Silent Rage!
2011.desc: Luffy's has a breakdown due to the emotional trauma of Ace's death, causing Jinbe to take him away.

2011.title: Settling the Score - Whitebeard vs. The Blackbeard Pirates
2011.desc: Blackbeard and his pirates arrive in Marineford, as they are taken down from the execution platform by Whitebeard.

2011.title: The Start of the Show - Blackbeard's Plot Revealed
2011.desc: The news of Whitebeard's death is already spreading all over the world. Silvers Rayleigh also hears the news.

2011.title: The Insatiable Akainu! Lava Fists Pummel Luffy!
2011.desc: Blackbeard expresses his desire to sink Marineford into the ocean after destroying the fortress, but Sengoku attacks him, saying that the island is a symbol of justice in the world.

2011.title: A Desperate Cry - Seconds of Valor that Change Destiny
2011.desc: The fight in Marineford still rages on, as Trafalgar Law arrives to rescue Luffy.

2011.title: Enter Shanks! The Ultimate War Ends at Last
2011.desc: Law and his crew take Jinbe and Luffy inside their submarine.

2011.title: Powerful Independent Rivals! The Beginning of the 'New Era'
2011.desc: As Luffy's fate hangs in the balance, word spreads that the war is over and people all over the world rejoice on the news of the Marines' victory.

2011.title: Arrival at the Island of Women - Cruel Reality Tortures Luffy
2011.desc: Brownbeard was seen taking over Foodvalten saying it was not a Whitebeard territory anymore, Iva said goodbye to Jinbe and the others.

2011.title: The Strongest Tag-Team! Luffy and Toriko's Hard Struggle!
2011.desc: After eating the Hungrila Bird that they captured, Luffy and Toriko team up again to save Nami and Komatsu who have been kidnapped by the Cocoalas.

2011.title: Luffy and Ace - The Story of the Brothers' Meeting!
2011.desc: Garp drops Luffy to live with the Dadan Family where he meets Ace - who immediately dislikes Luffy.

2011.title: Enter Sabo! The Boy From the Grey Terminal
2011.desc: Luffy discovers the end of the forest is a slum dumpster named Gray Terminal, a lawless area full of homeless people searching for valuables thrown out by the town's people.

2011.title: I Won't Run! Ace's Desperate Rescue Operation!
2011.desc: Ace and Sabo rescue Luffy from Porchemy by defeating him.

2011.title: One Day We'll Go Out to Sea! The Oath Cups of the Three Brats!
2011.desc: Sabo is seen by his father but Sabo pretends to not know him.

2011.title: Leaving the Dadan Family!? The Secret Base is Complete!
2011.desc: Luffy, Ace and Sabo were going about their usual mischief until Garp turned up, and attacked them for still wanting to be pirates.

2011.title: Luffy Becoming an Apprentice?! A Man Who Fought Against the King of the Pirates!
2011.desc: Ace, Sabo, and Luffy chase down a Danpa and succeeds to catch it, but a tiger steals it.

2011.title: The Battle Against the Big Tiger! Who Will Be the Captain?!
2011.desc: Ace, Sabo and Luffy help Naguri make a pirate ship.

2011.title: Stolen Freedom! The Nobles' Trap Draws Near the Three Brothers
2011.desc: Sabo, Luffy and Ace are caught by the Bluejam Pirates.

2011.title: The Flames Are Lit - The Gray Terminal's Crisis
2011.desc: Sabo is being chased by his father's men.

2011.title: Where Is Freedom? The Boy's Sad Departure
2011.desc: While Dadan and Ace stay behind to fight Bluejam, the rest of the Dadan Family and Luffy make a quick escape.

2011.title: I'm Counting On You! A Letter From a Brother!
2011.desc: Sabo's ship is destroyed by a World Noble.

2011.title: To Fulfill the Promise - Separate Departures!
2011.desc: After the death of Sabo, Ace and Luffy continue their training while the others discover the Revolutionaries' ship.

2011.title: I Want to See Them! Luffy's Tearful Scream
2011.desc: Luffy still distraught at the death of Ace, blames it on his weakness.

2011.title: Straw Hats In Shock! The Bad News Has Reached Them!
2011.desc: On Kuraigana Island, Zoro confronts several Humandrills and is nearly defeated, but then Mihawk appears and scares them away.

2011.title: Reunited with Dark King Rayleigh! Decision Time For Luffy!
2011.desc: On Maiden Island, Rayleigh kills a Sea King and arrives on the island in front of Law's crew.

2011.title: Back to Our Captain! A Jail Break at the Sky Island and the Incident on the Winter Island!
2011.desc: At Amazon Lily, Luffy tries to make up his mind regarding Rayleigh's offer, as he made a promise to his crew to meet in three days.

2011.title: Encounter! The Great Swordsman Mihawk! Zoro's Self-Willed Deadly Struggle!
2011.desc: Zoro tried to go back to the sea using the small boat given to him by Mihawk but he could not get past the humandrills.

2011.title: Sanji's Suffering - The Queen Returns to His Kingdom
2011.desc: Chopper leaves the Torino Kingdom, while riding one of the birds, hoping to be able to aid Luffy.

2011.title: An Unbelievable Return! Luffy at the Marine Headquarters!
2011.desc: The Marine Headquarters have started rebuilding, and the Marines had a meeting about Monkey D. Luffy.

2011.title: Delivered to Friends - The Big News Comes Through!
2011.desc: Some of Luffy's old friends from Impel Down and around the world read the news about Luffy's second appearance at Marineford.

2011.title: The Pirates Move Out! The Earth Shattering New World
2011.desc: Trafalgar Law and his crew talk about going to the New World.

2011.title: Live Through Hell - Sanji's Fight with Men at Stake
2011.desc: Nami tricks the old men into letting her stay on Weatheria. Franky stumbles upon Vegapunk's hidden laboratory and finds more blueprints and decides to study them.

2011.title: I Will Get Much, Much Stronger! Zoro's Pledge to his Captain!
2011.desc: While being put on display in a cage, Brook feels appreciative towards all that Luffy had done for him and decides that he will move on and continue to aid Luffy.

2011.title: Luffy's Training Begins - Meet Up at the Promised Place in Two Years
2011.desc: Jinbe leaves Luffy with Rayleigh. Rayleigh takes Luffy to an abandoned island to begin his training. Rayleigh introduces Luffy to the concept of Haki and then demonstrates the three different types of Haki.

2011.title: A New Chapter Opens: The Straw Hat Pirates Regather!
2011.desc: After two years of being separated, the Straw Hats return to Sabaody Archipelago.

2011.title: An Explosive Situation! Luffy vs Fake Luffy
2011.desc: Fake Luffy and the real Luffy come face-to-face, though the imposter is quickly beaten thanks to Luffy's use of Haki.

2011.title: The Navy Has Set Out! The Straw Hats In Danger!
2011.desc: Robin visits the Thousand Sunny and meets Franky there. Chopper goes to the Fake Straw Hat Pirates, mistaking them for his own crew.

2011.title: Big Guns Assembled! The Danger Of The Fake Straw Hats!
2011.desc: Brook finishes his concert, while deciding between the pirate life and rock-n-roll fame when the Marines arrive to capture him, but he escapes. Luffy walks into a very dodgy crowd.

2011.title: The Battle Is On! Show Them What You Got From Training!
2011.desc: Luffy shows off his new powers in a battle between pirates, navy soldiers, and deadly pacifists.

2011.title: Everyone Together! Luffy, Setting Out For The New World!
2011.desc: Luffy and his gang reunite, but before they can set sail, they'll need help from all their friends. Luffy along with Zoro and Sanji are heading to Grove #42.

2011.title: A Suprising Fact! The Man Who Guarded The Sunny!
2011.desc: As world of the Straw Hat resurrection spreads through the navy, Luffy and his crew get acclimated. Caribou is seen punishing the Fake Straw Hats for making him join them instead of the real Straw Hat Pirates.

2011.title: Deadly Combat Under The Sea! The Demon Of The Ocean Strikes!
2011.desc: The Caribou Pirates attack the Straw Hats. While Caribou manages to get on the Thousand Sunny, the rest of his crew gets pulled away by Mohmoo, who gets frightened when he recognizes the Straw Hats from his time in Arlong Park.

2011.title: Lost In The Deep Sea! The Straw Hats Get Seperated!
2011.desc: Luffy, Zoro and Sanji are facing the Kraken.

2011.title: Undersea Volcanic Eruption! Drifting To The Fishman Island!
2011.desc: The Flying Dutchman shows up and Vander Decken tells Wadatsumi to crush the Thousand Sunny, but then the Kraken beats Wadatsumi.

2011.title: Landing at The Fishman Island! Beautiful Mermaids!
2011.desc: The Straw Hat Pirates encounter Hammond, some sea-beasts and other fishmen from the New Fishman Pirates.

2011.title: Excitement Blow-Out! Sanji's Life Under Threat!
2011.desc: Sanji playing in a pool with the mermaids in Mermaid Cove, Luffy, soaking his feet on the side of the pool, comments on how nice it must be to swim, Camie suggests that Luffy could wear a bubble in order to do so.

2011.title: Fish-Man Island Collapses?! Shyarly's Prediction
2011.desc: As blood donors are finally found, the recovering Sanji stays at the Mermaid Cafe while Luffy, Usopp and Camie meet Pappag and Brook.

2012.title: The King of The Fishman Island!, Neptune, The God Of The Sea!
2012.desc: Straw Hat Pirates are in a town on Fishman Island and King Neptune and Megalo appear to invite the Straw Hats to Ryugu Palace.

2012.title: The Ryugu Palace! Taken By The Shark That They Saved!
2012.desc: Luffy, Nami, Usopp, Brook, Camie, and Pappag travel with King Neptune to Ryugu Palace.

2012.title: A Coward and a Crybaby! The Princess in the Hard Shell Tower
2012.desc: Vander Decken IX reveals that he plans to marry the princess, using his Mark-Mark Fruit curse to throw a giant axe at her.

2012.title: It's An Emergency! The Ryugu Palace Is Occupied!
2012.desc: The guards around Zoro and the others are preparing to pop their air bubble, however, Nami found some bubbly coral and made the whole room fill with air and Zoro prepares to fight Neptune.

2012.title: The Ryugu Palace In Shock! The Kidnapping Of Shirahoshi!
2012.desc: Luffy leads Shirahoshi out of her tower inside Megalo while Brook and the Minister of the Right tells them to stop.

2012.title: Hordy's Onslaught! The Retaliatory Plan Set into Motion!
2012.desc: Luffy is still on his way to the Sea Forest with Shirahoshi, when he notices something going to the Ryugu Palace, which is revealed to be Hody and Vander Decken IX.

2012.title: The Battle In The Ryugu Palace! Zoro Vs. Hordy!
2012.desc: Neptune begs someone to protect her daughter. Hody just comments on how weak he is and states he only joined his army for military strength and knowledge. He states he will revive the dream and ambition of Arlong.

2012.title: Keep Shirahoshi Safe! Decken Close Behind!
2012.desc: Chopper tries to persuade Sanji to not turn around, or else he will see Shirahoshi and die. But Sanji turns around and after seeing the princess, turns into stone.

2012.title: The Crew Falls?! Hody Conquers Ryuuguu Palace
2012.desc: Zoro cuts Hody and asks for Neptune's help to escape from Ryugu Palace. Unfortunately, Hody who was unconscious comes to his senses after taking an Energy Steroid and successfully stops Neptune and the Straw Hats from escaping.

2012.title: The Haunting Ties! Nami And The Fishmen Pirates!
2012.desc: Robin continues her search while the New Fishman Pirates begin to take over. People are also seen being forced to step on a photo, and if they do not, they are considered as enemies.

2012.title: A Hero Who Freed The Slaves! An Adventurer Tiger!
2012.desc: Otohime confronts a robber who was stealing money so he could buy food for his ten children. Otohime and Jinbe try to change Fishman island, and Jinbe leaves the Army to join the Sun Pirates.

2012.title: Kizaru Appears! A Trap To Catch Tiger!
2012.desc: Entering a flashback, Neptune holds a baby Shirahoshi commenting on Tiger's attack on Mary Geoise, stating he would not be able to attend a summit for a long time because of it.

2012.title: Toriko x One Piece Special: Team Formation! Save Chopper!
2012.desc: Toriko and Komatsu are seen fishing when Komatsu catches a Harusame. After defeating it, Luffy suddenly comes out of the Harusame's mouth and surprises Toriko and Komatsu.

2012.title: The Death Of The Hero! A Shocking Truth Of Tiger!
2012.desc: The Sun Pirates start making their way to Koala's hometown, while giving her a slight makeover, new clothes and cutting her hair. on their ship, Koala still acts like a slave would, doing chores without being asked and asking for orders.

2012.title: The Sun Pirates Split! Jimbe Vs. Arlong!
2012.desc: After Fisher Tiger's death, Arlong, enraged, betrays his last wishes and decides to attack and kill villagers of Koala's village for selling him out, upon trying he is easily beaten by Vice-Admiral Borsalino and taken into Marine custody.

2012.title: Shaking Fishman Island! A Celestial Dragon Drifts In!
2012.desc: With Jinbe having been accepted as a Shichibukai, the Sun Pirates return to Fishman Island.

2012.title: A Sudden Tragedy! A Gunshot Shuts Down The Future!
2012.desc: Vander Decken IX discovers about the Tamatebako and wishes to use it to age Shirahoshi after she grows up a little.

2012.title: Back To The Present! Hordy Makes A Move!
2012.desc: After Otohime passed away, Hody Jones had found and killed the suspected human assassin and showed him to the people.

2012.title: The Kingdom In Shock! An Order to Execute Neptune Issued!
2012.desc: Hody makes his announcement to take over the Ryugu Kingdom with the execution of King Neptune as the start of his new rule. Hody also announces that he will kill Straw Hats so that they will serve as example to all humans in the surface.

2012.title: A Rift Opens Up! Luffy Vs. Jimbei!
2012.desc: Luffy and Jinbe start their duel to see who gets to fight Hody, but their fight was cut short by Sanji's and Robin's interference.

2012.title: Something Has Happened To Hordy! The True Power Of The Evil Drug!
2012.desc: The New Fishman Pirates head to the Gyoncorde Plaza to execute King Neptune but before getting at the plaza, they demonstrate a little taste of their power by terrorizing and destroying everything in their path.

2012.title: The Battle Is On! At Conchcorde Plaza!
2012.desc: Neptune's army put up an attempt to stop Hody Jones and his pirates from reaching Gyoncorde Plaza but seeing the king held hostage prevents them from attacking.

2012.title: A Surprising Confession! The Truth Behind The Assassination Of Otohime!
2012.desc: Jinbe and Shirahoshi are captured by the New Fishman Pirates when they fall into a trap due to a balloon version of King Neptune which easily tricks Shirahoshi and Megalo.

2012.title: Shirahoshi's Tears! Luffy Finally Shows Up!
2012.desc: Shirahoshi reveals that Megalo witnessed Hody shooting Queen Otohime and told her in secret.

2012.title: A Big Clash! The Straw Hats Vs. A Hundered Thousand Enemies!
2012.desc: The citizens celebrate at the arrival of Luffy and his crew. Jinbe comments on how his plan with the Straw Hat Pirates crew worked. Luffy takes down half of Hody's forces with Haki.

2012.title: Deadly Attacks! Zoro And Sanji Join The Battle!
2012.desc: The Straw Hat Pirates begin their attack with Luffy, Zoro and Sanji taking the lead in the fight but mostly it is the latter two of the three who begin showing their new powers and abilities from their two year separation and training.

2012.title: Unveiled! The Secret Weapons Of The Sunny!
2012.desc: The battle rages on between the Straw Hats and the New Fishman Pirates. Sanji and Zoro are competing over who can take down the most fishmen.

2012.title: Iron Pirate! Here Comes General Franky!
2012.desc: The battle between the New Fishman Pirates and the Straw Hats continues, with the Straw Hats gaining the upper hand. Seeing this, Daruma decides to join the fight, targeting the Brachio Tank V and collapsing the ground underneath it.

2012.title: The Noah Closing In! The Fishman Island Facing Destruction!
2012.desc: Luffy and Hody continue their fight with Luffy getting the upper hand with Haki and Hody's attacks being ineffective against Luffy.

2012.title: Hurry Up Luffy! Shirahoshi's Life In Jeopardy!
2012.desc: Shirahoshi begins swimming out to sea in an attempt to lure the ark Noah away and save Fishman Island, while Luffy gets Sanji's help to allow him to reach the ship's chains and stop Hody.

2012.title: The Fierce Fight Begins! Luffy Vs. Hordy!
2012.desc: Hody takes his trident out of Vander Decken's body and, after a short fight, Decken is defeated. Then Hody goes after Shirahoshi, slicing through Ryuboshi and Manboshi, reaches her with his incomparable underwater speed, and grabs her hair.

2012.title: A Massive Confused Fight! The Straw Hats Vs. The New Fishmen Pirates!
2012.desc: Luffy along with the three princes try to protect Shirahoshi against Hody Jones.

2012.title: Luffy Loses The Fight! Hordy's Long-Awaited Revenge!
2012.desc: As the Noah falls onto the Fishman Island, Shirahoshi desperately tries to tell Decken to wake up only for Hody to attack her but Manboshi takes the blunt of the attack.

2012.title: A Shocking Fact! The True Identity Of Hordy!
2012.desc: The story goes back before the Noah started falling back to the island. Jinbe and Sanji continue to fight Wadatsumi and Wadatsumi becomes angry and inflates himself, crushing some of his allies unknowingly.

2012.title: Back To Zero! Ernest Wishes For Luffy!
2012.desc: As Fukaboshi begins to state who Hody really is, Hody's past is revealed as he recalls his hatred towards humans. The New Fish-Man Pirates officers were taught as kids that the humans are an inferior species and that they should be punished by heaven.

2012.title: Luffy's All Out Attack! Red Hawk Blasts!
2012.desc: Brook continues to fight Zeo and reveals his new control over his Yomi Yomi no Mi abilities. Usopp continues to fight Daruma and has set traps for him.

2012.title: Coming To An End! The Final Decisive Battle Against Hordy!
2012.desc: Hody recovers thanks to the Energy Steroids and manages to overwhelm Luffy and bite him again in the same spot.

2012.title: Stop Noah! Desperate Elephant Gatling!
2012.desc: All of the New Fishman Pirates lie down defeated while the Straw Hat Pirates are relaxing and waiting for Luffy.

2012.title: To The Future! The Path To The Sun!
2012.desc: With the Sea Kings having stopped and saved the great ship Noah, Shirahoshi learns a startling secret from the Sea Kings.

2012.title: The Secret Revealed! The Truth About The Ancient Weapon!
2012.desc: As the whole Fishman Island celebrates the capture and defeat of Hody and the New Fishman Pirates by the Straw Hats, who make their own plans to leave Fishman Island soon.

2012.title: The Straw Hat's Stunned! The New Fleet Admiral Of The Navy!
2012.desc: King Neptune talks about the Ancient Weapons with Shirahoshi and Nico Robin while Caribou listens and makes his way to Shirahoshi's room.

2012.title: She Loves Sweets! Big Mom Of The Four Emporers!
2012.desc: The rest of the Straw Hats are waiting for Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji to return the treasure from Caribou. They find Caribou easily with all the treasure.

2012.title: Many Problems Lie Ahead! A Trap Awaiting In The New World!
2012.desc: The Minister of the Right was thanking the Straw Hats for saving Fishman Island, when suddenly he got a report that the Tamate Box is gone and is in the hands of Baron Tamago and Pekoms.

2012.title: Finally Time To Go! Goodbye Fishman Island!
2012.desc: The mermaids and Keimi from the Mermaid Cafe ask Madam Shyarly if they can say good bye to the Straw Hats. Madam Shyarly says that her prediction that Luffy will destroy Fishman Island was wrong since they defeated Hody and his Pirates.

2012.title: To the New World! Heading For The Ultimate Sea!
2012.desc: The Straw Hats are Heading into the New World.

2012.title: Z's Ambition Arc - The Little Giant Lily!
2012.desc: The Straw Hats find themselves in a middle of an infamous sea in the New World known for its mirages and outrageous weather patterns.

2012.title: Z's Ambition Arc - Introduction of the Mystery of the Strongest Army Corps!
2012.desc: Nami creates a plan for the Straw Hats to rescue Lily's father, Panz Fry. Chopper, Robin, Brook, and Luffy are the diversion group while Usopp, Sanji, Zoro, and Lily are in the submarine.

2012.title: Z's Ambition Arc - A Desperate Big Escape Strategy!
2012.desc: Luffy and Zoro face off against Shuzo and Momonga. The Straw Hats, Lily, and her father manage to escape with a Coup de Burst and the anchor connected to the Thousand Sunny.

2012.title: Z's Ambition Arc - Luffy vs. Shuzo!
2012.desc: Shuzo orders his men to be launched at the island like torpedoes and sacrifice themselves for him.

2013.title: Arriving! A Burning Island - Punk Hazard!
2013.desc: The Straw Hats have arrived at a volcanic island that does not show on the New World Log Pose. Luffy in his enthusiasm votes to go to the island, though most of the crew were reluctant to go because of the sea of fire blocking their way.

2013.title: A Battle In The Heat! Luffy Vs. The Giant Dragon!
2013.desc: Luffy and Zoro start fighting the dragon, which is shown to be able to speak and breathe fire.

2013.title: The Straw Hats Stunned! Enter: A Samaura's Horrifying Severed Head!
2013.desc: Luffy, Zoro, Usopp, and Robin are standing near the dead dragon that Zoro killed and Luffy is trying to pull out the man who is stuck in the dragon's body.

2013.title: Startling! The Secret of the Island is Finally Revealed!
2013.desc: Franky, Sanji, Nami and Chopper are surprised that the samurai is still alive after being cut.

2013.title: Save the Children! The Straw Hats Start To Fight!
2013.desc: Nami's group escaped the prison cell and end up in the Biscuits Room, where they find giant children.

2013.title: A Swordplay Showdown! Brook Vs. The Mysterious Torso Samurai!
2013.desc: At the lake, Luffy's group have been attacked by Brownbeard and his centaur unit who's job was to intercept and eliminate any obvious intruders.

2013.title: The Warlord! Trafalgar Law!
2013.desc: Chopper and Nami, leading the children stumble upon a room with people frozen in it. Franky, Sanji and the samurai start to make their way towards Nami and Chopper. Luffy, Zoro, Usopp and Robin get attacked by the centaurs.

2013.title: In A Real Pinch! Luffy Sinks Into The Ice-Cold Lake!
2013.desc: Luffy, Zoro, Usopp and Robin try to get to the ice side of Punk Hazard but their ship gets capsized by Brownbeard. As Brownbeard's troop prepares attack them again, Zoro gets ready to destroy their bullets but gets dragged down by sharks.

2013.title: A Collision! Law vs. Vice Admiral Smoker!
2013.desc: Law was going to to cut up Tashigi into little pieces but Smoker saved her and started fighting against Law. Luffy, Zoro, Robin and Usopp are riding on top of Brownbeard after defeating him and his centaurs.

2013.title: Meeting Again After Two Years! Luffy and Law!
2013.desc: Tashigi tries to see what happened in the fight. Luffy's group sees the flying warship. Luffy sees Law and thanks him for saving him two years ago. Law says that they aren't friends and Luffy agrees since they were both after One Piece.

2013.title: The Worst In The World! A Scientist Of Terror - Caesar!
2013.desc: The G-5 Marines discussed if Caesar Clown was probably behind the unusual events at the island and that the child abduction cases in that area may have been real.

2013.title: History's Strongest Collaboration! Vs. Glutton of the Sea!
2013.desc: Featured characters of One Piece, Toriko, and Dragon Ball Z enter the IGO tournament in order to gain the Carat meat, which is said to be the most tasteful in the world. However, it leads in a tie between Goku, Toriko, and Luffy.

2013.title: Chopper's Fury! The Master's Inhumane Experiment!
2013.desc: The children and the Straw Hat Pirates are in a cave with Brownbeard tied up talking about the Master. Zoro, Sanji and Brook go to look for Kin'emon, who had gone to look for his torso.

2013.title: To Annihlate The Straw Hats! Legendary Assassins Descend!
2013.desc: Yeti Cool Brothers make their way to the destroyed lab where the Straw Hats and the children are. Monet tells Caesar Clown about Law having some relation to Luffy, which makes Caesar mistrust Law until Law reassures him.

2013.title: Save Nami! Luffy's Fight On The Snow-Capped Mountains!
2013.desc: Chopper tells the others that Nami in Franky's body was kidnapped by the Yeti Cool Brothers. Franky in Chopper's body takes a Rumble Ball. Luffy and Franky go after the Yeti Cool Brothers to save Nami and defeat them.

2013.title: Formation! The Pirate Alliance Luffy-Law!
2013.desc: Luffy and Law agree on an alliance; the rest of the Straw Hat Pirates disapprove while Nico Robin approves, even if she warns Luffy about a possible betrayal in a pirate alliance.

2013.title: Capture M! The Pirate Alliances's Operation Launches!
2013.desc: Zoro, Sanji and Brook are trying to find the samurai and remember what happened to them. They had been knocked out by the Yeti Cool Brothers, who used a gas that makes people drunk.

2013.title: On The Verge Of Annihilation! A Deadly Monster Comes Flying In!
2013.desc: Luffy declares that he will capture Caesar. Law will distract Monet while Chopper finds an antidote for drug.

2013.title: An Intense Battle! Caesar Exercises His True Power!
2013.desc: Sanji, Kin'emon, Brook and Zoro see Smiley. Brook talks about a story of a creature called Slime which melts the clothes of women, making everyone act perverted except for Zoro, who points out that the slime is killing the fish in the lake.

2013.title: A Samurai Who Can Cut Fire! Foxfire Kin'Emon!
2013.desc: Law's heart is crushed by the mysterious man named Vergo who was sent along with Monet to watch over Caesar.

2013.title: Shock! Identity of Vergo, the Mysterious Man
2013.desc: Law gets beaten up by Vergo. Yarisugi tells the parents of the missing children that they are dead. Caesar takes the children from Usopp and Nami.

2013.title: Save The Children! The Master's Evil Hands Close In!
2013.desc: As Luffy and Law remain captives in Caesar's lab along with the others who were captured, Caesar Clown goes to retrieve the children from the remaining Straw Hat Pirates.

2013.title: Shaking Up The New World! Caesar's Horrendous Experiment!
2013.desc: At the lab, the G-5 Marine soldiers are banging on the door, demanding entry. Meanwhile, the children were returned to the Lab where Caesar ordered his subordinates to make sure they don't escape again. However, Mocha begins to regain her senses, seeing Caesar's subordinates as monsters.

2013.title: The Deadliest Weapon of Mass Destruction in History! Land Of The Dead!
2013.desc: After Smiley swallows the over-sized candy, the candy coat dissolves revealing a special drug designed to convert the entire content of Smiley's body into a "perfect" weapon of destruction, Shinokuni.

2013.title: The Counterattack Begins! Luffy and Law's Great Escape
2013.desc: As the Underworld Brokers watched the video feed of the captive Straw Hats and Marines, Eustass Kid and Killer decided to ignore it for more important matters, such as forming an alliance between the Kid Pirates, On Air Pirates and the Hawkins Pirates.

2013.title: Get To Building R! The Pirate Alliance's Great Advance!
2013.desc: Though the Straw Hats and Brownbeard managed to escape into the lab, they left behind a gaping hole. But they soon realise that Shinokuni can now enter the lab.

2013.title: Tashigi's Tears! G5's Desperate Breakthrough Plan!
2013.desc: Caesar Clown, incensed with the humiliation that his prisoners escaped and are inside his lab, orders the passage between building A and B to be closed and Shinokuni to be let in to kill the intruders. Vergo, however decided to take care of them himself.

2013.title: The Treacherous Vice Admiral! Demon Bamboo Vergo!
2013.desc: Luffy races toward Caesar in the hopes of delivering a beating, Sanji saves a damsel in distress, and Chopper tries to prevent the children from eating the drugged candy!

2013.title: A Fierce Battle Gets Heated! Luffy vs. Caesar!
2013.desc: Sanji and Vergo slug it out in a cloud of toxic gas, Law finds the room that could ruin the New World, and Luffy hopes to bring Caesar`s reign of terror to a brutal end!

2013.title: The Mastermind in the Shadows! Doflamingo Moves!
2013.desc: Doflamingo orders Vergo to stop Law in his tracks, Luffy battles a deadly snowbird, and the rest of the Straw Hats attempt to survive the fiery breath of an angry dragon!

2013.title: Luffy Dies from Exposure?! The Spine-chilling Snow Woman Monet!
2013.desc: Luffy goes down fast after Monet puts a chill into him, and Trafalgar Law makes a desperate attempt to reclaim his heart during an electric battle with Vergo!

2013.title: Fist Fight! Two Vice Admirals Fight
2013.desc: Smoker attacks Vergo for assaulting his men, Luffy meets something strange in the trash heap, and a flashback reveals the true depths of Caesar`s madness!

2013.title: The Small Dragon! Momonosuke Appears
2013.desc: Luffy befriends a dragon that used to be a human boy, and Captain Smoker continues his brutal battle with the villainous Vergo!

2013.title: Deadly Combat in Snowstorm The Straw Hats vs. the Snow Woman
2013.desc: Luffy hitches a ride on a dragon, Mocha tries to keep the Master`s candy away from her friends, and Zoro pits his steel against snow in a battle with Monet!

2013.title: Showing Off His Techniques! Zoro's Formidable One-Sword Style!
2013.desc: To survive his battle with Monet, Zoro must overcome his unwillingness to cut a woman. Elsewhere, Luffy puts a hungry dragon on his back and tries to punch his way out of the basement!

2013.title: I'll Protect My Friends! Mocha's Desperate Escape
2013.desc: Chopper, Nami, and Robin watch in horror as Mocha makes a heartbreaking sacrifice in a courageous attempt to save the lives of her friends!

2013.title: Brownbeard's In Grief! Luffy Lands A Furious Blow!
2013.desc: Brownbeard heroically attempts to expose Caesar as a villain, the horrific truth about Punk Hazard is finally revealed, and Luffy puts the hurt on his gaseous enemy!

2013.title: A Surprising Outcome! White Hunter vs. Vergo!
2013.desc: Luffy makes Caesar pay for his crimes against the children, and Smoker risks his life for a chance to see Vergo fall in battle!

2013.title: Caesar Defeat! The Powerful Grizzly Magnum!
2013.desc: Law reaches the end of his epic battle with Vergo, and Luffy looks to land a devastating final blow on the murderous gasbag Caesar!

2013.title: Raid! An Assassin From Dressrosa!
2013.desc: Word of Luffy and Law`s alliance spreads throughout the world, Chopper and Brook race to stay ahead of the deadly gas, and Joker sends a team to rescue Caesar!

2013.title: Runninng Wild! Invincible General Franky!
2013.desc: Franky battles a lethal beauty, Caesar tries to strike a final blow against Smoker, and Monet detonates an explosive surprise that could spell doom for the Straw Hats!

2013.title: A Critical Situation! Punk Hazard Explodes!
2013.desc: As the Straw Hats and company flee the crumbling laboratory, Caesar`s desperate act of vengeance thwarts Joker`s plan to forever silence his enemies!

2013.title: Capture Caesar! General Cannon Blast's!
2013.desc: Franky continues his battle with Buffalo and Baby 5, Nami uses a mighty gust of wind to save the children from a deadly cloud of gas, and Usopp takes a shot at capturing Caesar!

2013.title: A Touching Reunion! Momonosuke and Kin'emon!
2013.desc: A dragon regains his boyish form, a noble warrior once feared dead makes a shocking resurrection, and bitter enemies set aside their differences to enjoy a well-deserved feast!

2013.title: It's Time To Say Goodbye! Leaving Punk Hazard!
2013.desc: The weary marines and the rescued children get teary-eyed as they say goodbye to the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Law enters into treacherous negotiations with Joker!

2013.title: The G-5 Wiped Out! Doflamingo's Sudden Attack!
2013.desc: The Straw Hats set a course for Dressrosa, Law explains his alliance with Luffy, and Smoker`s refusal to reveal a secret earns him a serious beating from Doflamingo!

2013.title: Intense! Aokiji Vs. Doflamingo!
2013.desc: Smoker`s life is spared by the arrival of an old friend. Law reveals some shocking news about Caesar`s partnership with Doflamingo, and Momonosuke uses his youth to get cozy with Robin and Nami!

2013.title: Caesar Goes Missing! The Pirate Alliance Makes A Sortie!
2013.desc: Smooth seas stretch out before the Straw Hats as they leave Punk Hazard far behind. While they fear Donflamingo`s return and prepare to face him, another powerful foe lies in wait - one whose power could be their downfall!

2014.title: Luffy Dies At Sea! The Pirate Alliance Comes Apart!
2014.desc: Breed uses his evil abilities to turn Chopper into a pet - and force Luffy and Law to fight to the death.

2014.title: A Major Turnaround! Luffy's Angry Iron Fist Strikes!
2014.desc: After Law discovers the secret to Breed`s power, Luffy and his old friend the Kung Fu Dugong give the animal-abusing madman a beasty beat down!

2014.title: Startling! The Big News Shakes Up The New World!
2014.desc: As the world reacts to Doflamingo`s shocking announcement, Law and the Straw Hats plot the next move in their daring alliance, and a face from the past returns!

2014.title: Explore! A Kingdom Of Love And Passion - Dresrosa!
2014.desc: The Straw Hats and their friends set out to explore Dressrosa, a land full of beautiful women, delicious food, and live toys that walk amongst the living.

2014.title: Full Of Enthusiasm! The Corrida Colosseum!
2014.desc: A blind warrior lays a beat down on a gang of masked thugs, Zorro chases the thief who stole his sword, and Luffy finds himself tempted by the promise of a fiery fruit!

2014.title: A Dangerous Love! The Dancer Girl - Violet!
2014.desc: Zoro continues his hunt for the fairy who stole his sword, Sanji is smitten by a beautiful dancer, and Luffy prepares to fight for the Devil Fruit that belonged to his brother!

2014.title: A Formidable, Unknown Warrior! Here Comes Lucy!
2014.desc: Sanji falls further under the spell of his new lady friend, and Luffy makes quite an impression as he gets to know the fighters competing for Ace`s Devil Fruit.

2014.title: A Pirate Noble! Cavendish!
2014.desc: A gorgeous gladiator tells Luffy the story of the world`s greatest warrior, a masked mauler literally destroys the competition, and the Navy makes its presence felt!

2014.title: The Fatefull Reunion! Bellamy the Hyena!
2014.desc: An old nemesis sees through Luffy`s disguise, Zoro finally catches up to the sword-stealing fairy, and Sanji`s skill at sniffing out snipers impresses his new lady friend!

2014.title: A Super Rookie! Bartolomeo the Cannibal!
2014.desc: Bartolomeo and Bellamy take center stage in the latest round of the battle royal, but a slugger with a serious punch threatens to steal their thunder. Meanwhile, Luffy is targeted by an angry behemoth!

2014.title: Big Names Duke It Out! The Heated Block B Battle!
2014.desc: An old enemy of Garp`s reveals Luffy`s true identity, landing the Straw Hat captain in hot water with one of his fellow competitors. Meanwhile, the battle in Block B gets supremely brutal!

2014.title: A Deadly Blow! The Astonishing King Punch!
2014.desc: Franky`s new robot friend promises to reveal the tragic secrets of Dressrosa, and a regal brawler prepares to throw a powerful punch that could destroy the entire colosseum!

2014.title: The Fighting Fish Strike! Across The Deadly Iron Bridge!
2014.desc: While Law, Robin, Usopp, and Caesar attempt to survive a Fighting Fish attack, Sanji learns the heartbreaking truth about the beautiful woman who stole his heart!

2014.title: Explore! Fairies' Island - Green Bit!
2014.desc: Luffy`s turn to fight in the epic colosseum battle draws near, Zoro has an interesting encounter with a surprisingly strong fairy, and the thoughts in Sanji`s head shock his lady captor!

2014.title: The Unknown World! The Tontatta Kingdom!
2014.desc: Sanji learns some disturbing news that could mean trouble for his friends, Luffy prepares for a fight, and Robin is captured by a village full of little people!

2014.title: The Stratagem Of The Century! Doflamingo Makes His Move!
2014.desc: Despite Sanji`s attempt to warn him, Law finds his life in danger after being ambushed by Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Luffy is unable to hide his true identity once the fists start flying!

2014.title: Shaking Heaven And Earth! Admiral Fujitora's Power!
2014.desc: After his plan falls apart, Law must fight for his life against two powerful opponents. Elsewhere, Sanji bids a touching goodbye to his special lady friend, and Luffy tangles with Brutal Bull!

2014.title: A Blow of Anger! A Giant vs. Lucy!
2014.desc: Nami, Chopper, and Brook are grotesquely transformed by a hideous woman who fancies herself an artist. Back at the colosseum, Luffy gets serious when his new friend falls victim to a giant attack!

2014.title: Destruction Cannon Blasts! Lucy In Trouble!
2014.desc: Zoro and his fairy friend argue over directions, Trafalgar Law finds himself outnumbered in his battle with Doflamingo, and Luffy`s latest opponent packs an explosive punch!

2014.title: The Legendary Pirate! Don Chin Jao!
2014.desc: While Nami, Chopper, and Brook attempt to take back the Sunny, Luffy and the monstrous mauler Don Chinjao take their brutal grudge match to a legendary level!

2014.title: Light and Shadow! Darkness Behind Dressrosa!
2014.desc: Luffy`s battle with Don Chinjao heats up, Franky learns the tragic truth behind Dressrosa`s mysterious toy population, and Robin and Usopp prepare to join their little friends in battle!

2014.title: Making A Sortie! The Legendary Hero Usoland
2014.desc: Luffy continues his battle with Don Chinjao, Franky and Zoro are reunited in the land of the little people, and Law is wounded in a revealing, face-to-face showdown with Doflamingo!

2014.title: The Fierce Battle Coming To The End! Lucy vs. Chin Jao!
2014.desc: A flashback reveals the story of how Garp changed Chinjao`s world forever. Back in the present, Luffy and his opponent trade ferocious blows that literally rock the colosseum!

2014.title: Luffy And The Gladiator Of Fate! Rebecca!
2014.desc: During a break between battles, Luffy is attacked by an angry rival, but a beautiful gladiator with mysterious motives offers him food - and a place to rest.

2014.title: Protect You To the End! Rebecca And The Toy Soldier!
2014.desc: In the moments before battle, the beautiful gladiator Rebecca flashes back to the tragic events of her childhood and the toy soldier who became her constant companion.

2014.title: The Last - And Bloodiest - Block! Block D Battle Begins!
2014.desc: The bloodthirsty crowd hurls insults at Rebecca as the battle of Block D begins. On the other side of the island, Law finds himself on the losing end of his battle with Doflamingo!

2014.title: A Decisive Battle! Giolla vs. The Straw Hats!
2014.desc: Brook`s trickery springs the Straw Hats from their artistic prison, but their failure to cuff the culprit means they`ll need help from a cola-powered cannon to emerge victorious!

2014.title: Beautiful Sword! Cavendish Of The White Horse!
2014.desc: Cavendish wins over the female fans during the Block D battle, Luffy keeps an eye on Rebecca, and Sanji heads toward a heated collision with Doflamingo!

2014.title: A Big Clash! Sanji vs. Doflamingo!
2014.desc: Sanji`s battle with Doflamingo is interrupted by Law`s sudden arrival, and Rebecca continues her impressive showing in the battle of Block D!

2014.title: Rebecca's Special Attack! Back - To - The Water Dance!
2014.desc: Law begins a deadly, face-to-face battle with Doflamingo, Zoro enlists the aid of a star struck gladiator, and Rebecca continues to impresses Luffy with her unique fighting style!

2014.title: The Most Violent Fighter! Logan vs. Rebecca!
2014.desc: Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!

2014.title: A Big Surprise! A True Identity Of The Toy Soldier!
2014.desc: Rebecca`s battle continues, a madman turns a gladiator into a play thing, and the brave little toy soldier reveals his painful past – and the tragic truth behind King Riku`s fall from power!

2014.title: A Horrible Past! The Secret Of Dressrosa!
2014.desc: Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!

2014.title: A Nightmare! The Tragic Night Of Dressrosa!
2014.desc: Rebecca continues her valiant stand in the arena of battle, Luffy is reunited with Zoro, and the heartbreaking story of how Doflamingo conquered Dressrosa continues!

2014.title: A Showdown Between the Warlords! Law vs. Doflamingo!
2014.desc: Law`s power begins to fade, making him an easy target for Doflamingo`s vicious attacks. Meanwhile, Franky begs Luffy to let him fight alongside Soldier and the little people!

2014.title: Two Great Rivals Meet Each Other! Straw Hat and Heavenly Demon!
2014.desc: Luffy sets his sights on a showdown with Doflamingo in a desperate attempt to save Law`s life. Sanji, Nami, Chopper, and Brook are attacked by a very deadly foe!

2014.title: Luffy Astonished! The Man Who Inherit's Ace's Will!
2014.desc: Soldier reveals his daring plan to return all the toys to their human forms, and Luffy has an emotional encounter with someone from his very distant past!

2014.title: Operation SOP Starts - Usoland Charges Forth
2014.desc: Usopp and Robin join the little people on their mission to turn the toys back into humans, Franky wreaks havoc at the toy house, and Rebecca continues her gladiator battle!

2014.title: A Burning Passion! Rebecca vs. Suleiman!
2014.desc: Zoro attracts unwanted attention by upsetting a child, Soldier risks his life to lead the attack on Doflamingo, and Rebecca struggles to survive the brutal battle of Block D!

2014.title: The End Of The Match?! A Surprising Result Of Block D!
2014.desc: Rebecca survives an encounter with an opponent`s deadly alter ego, Franky continues his battle with a man who dresses like a baby, and Violet offers to sneak Luffy into the palace!

2014.title: The Admiral's Decision! Fujitora vs. Doflamingo!
2014.desc: Franky has his hands full battling a host of enemies at the Toy House, Violet leads Luffy to a secret entrance into the palace, and Fujitora issues Doflamingo a grave warning!

2014.title: The Final Round Starts - Diamante the Hero Shows Up
2014.desc: Diamante`s unique abilities and the presence of special Fighting Fish add a deadly wrinkle to the tournament`s final round. Elsewhere, Luffy spoils any chance of sneaking up on Doflamingo!

2014.title: The Castle Moves! Elite Officer Pica Emerges
2014.desc: Luffy tangles with a monster made of stone, Franky bursts into flames after getting shot by a cannon, and the courageous little people hatch a plan to turn the toys back into humans!

2014.title: Dragon Claw Strikes! Lucy's Intimidating Attack!
2014.desc: Soldier takes a beating from a Doflamingo Family Executive, Lucy shows off a powerful new fighting style, and Zoro pushes his blades to the breaking point in a showdown with a man made of stone!

2014.title: Defeat Sugar! The Army Of The Little People Charges!
2014.desc: Zoro repeatedly slices his stone opponent into pieces, but he can`t find a way to make the bad guy stay down. Meanwhile, the bravery of the little people could get them turned into toys!

2014.title: The Last Light Of Hope! The Secret Of Our Commander!
2014.desc: The Tontattas are devastated by Trebol's furious attack, but as Usopp tries to convince Leo to abort the operation, Leo tells him about their commander Toy Soldier's stunning true identity! Meanwhile, with the help of another Tontatta group, the Toy Soldier finally shakes off Lao G and gets moving again!

2014.title: The Rupture Man! Gladius Blows Up Big Time!
2014.desc: Zoro continues his deadly duel with the nearly-indestructible Pica! While the Toy Soldier narrowly escapes Lao G only to come face to face with Gladius! Luffy continues his mad dash to the top of the palace to face Doflamingo!

2014.title: A Liar! Usoland on the Run!
2014.desc: With the Tontattas beaten, Robin turned into a toy, and Luffy, Franky, and the others all busy elsewhere, Usopp is the last hope for Operation SOP! But will he be able to muster the confidence and courage to face the terrible Trebol? Among the cries of the Tontattas, Usopp has a difficult decision to make - run and fight another day or face his own doom and challenge Trebol!

2014.title: A Fateful Encounter! Kyros And King Riku!
2014.desc: The deep and tragic story of Kyros is revealed! The legend of this invincible gladiator is tied up with the royal family of Dressrosa! Meanwhile, Trebol`s defeat at the hands of Usopp is not a sure thing yet!

2014.title: Operation Failed! Hero Usoland Dies!?
2014.desc: In the Royal Palace, Viola, Luffy, and the Toy Soldier have hidden themselves outside Doflamingo`s chamber, only to have more enemies approach from behind, leaving them surrounded! Meanwhile, Franky is knocked out cold by the Navy, and all hopes rest on Usopp to provide the miracle everyone needs!

2015.title: The Legend is Back! Kyros' All-Out Attack!
2015.desc: Usopp manages to knock Sugar out and Operation SOP is accomplished! The toys in Dressrosa start turning back to their original forms and the people are slowly realizing who Doflamingo really is! In the meantime, the legendary hero Kyros reverts to his true form - and this mighty champion of the Colosseum has a score to settle!

2015.title: The Fire Fist Strikes! - The Flare Flare Fruit Power Returns!
2015.desc: Kyros finally taking down Doflamingo leaves Doflamingo's clan shocked! Meanwhile at the Colosseum, Rebecca gets her memories of her loving father Kyros back, and Sabo makes a move to end the championship battle by blowing up the whole ring! Will he be able to snag the Flare-Flare Fruit?

2015.title: Dashing onto the Scene - The Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army, Sabo!
2015.desc: Luffy hurries to free Law, but with their pirate alliance dissolved, will Law still see Luffy as an ally? Meanwhile, Usopp has convinced his new-found followers to destroy the factory! Doflamingo`s defeat has thrown Dressrosa into chaos, but the Young Master may have a trick left up his sleeve...

2015.title: The Devil's Trap - Dressrosa Annihilation Plan
2015.desc: The mystery of Doflamingo`s return from the dead is revealed! But there isn`t much time to ponder how it happened, as his plan to silence the country of Dressrosa unfolds, spelling doom for the Straw Hats!

2015.title: The 500 Million Berry Man! Target: Usoland!
2015.desc: As the people of Dressrosa see their friends and loved ones slaughter each other under the manipulation of Doflamingo, memories of 10 years ago rush back, and the truth of that event becomes clear. Doflamingo announces the rules for his deadly game - targeting Luffy, King Riku, and Law, but with the highest bounty reserved for Usopp!

2015.title: Breakthrough the Enemy Lines - Luffy and Zoro's Counterattack!
2015.desc: Doflamingo and Fujitora`s agreement to not engage each other lasts for the moment - meaning all eyes are turned towards taking down the Straw Hats and claiming the rewards! And as Luffy starts heading to the Royal Palace along with Zoro and Law, Fujitora stands in his way!

2015.title: With a Rumbling of the Ground! The God of Destruction - Giant Pica Descends!
2015.desc: Robin, Usopp, the Tontatta`s and the others make moves to rejoin Luffy as Doflamingo`s deadly game rages on! Meanwhile, Kin`emon makes it to the trash heap in his search for his friend Kanjuro - just as Pica emerges in the town and changes the stakes of the game!

2015.title: Gathering into a Powerful Front! Luffy and a Group of Brutal Warriors!
2015.desc: With Luffy and the others recovering from Pica`s attack, the game is afoot! Luffy has just enough time to regroup and set out to find Doflamingo, only to find that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! A strange argument breaks out - to decide who gets to take down Doflamingo once and for all!

2015.title: Steady Progress! Luffy's Army vs. Pica!
2015.desc: Don Chin Jao and Elizabello successfully break Pica's giant arm but the rock giant is unfazed and starts throwing even more destructive punches at Luffy and his band of unwanted collaborators! Meanwhile, Navy Admiral Fujitora moves into action, summoning all the Navy soldiers on the island!

2015.title: A Shocking Confession! Law's Soulful Vow!
2015.desc: Luffy and Moocy fast approach the showdown with Doflamingo - while the others with a beef against him continue to tag along. Meanwhile, Violet finds the key to Law`s handcuffs, and Rebecca pledges to deliver it to him. Finally, Law`s reason for despising Doflamingo is revealed!

2015.title: A Big Collision! Chief of Staff Sabo vs. Admiral Fujitora
2015.desc: Luffy makes headway toward Doflamingo`s refuge, making his way through Doflamingo`s guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who has the power of the Fire Fist from eating the Flare-Flare Fruit! But with Fujitora`s ability to call down a meteor, will Sabo have to power to save himself?

2015.title: A Desperate Situation - Luffy Gets Caught in a Trap!
2015.desc: Luffy cuts a lucky break as Kelly Funk shows him a shortcut to the Palace! But all may not be as it seems... Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro are locked in one-on-one duels, while Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo enlist the help of the Tontattas to catch up with Luffy and Law!

2015.title: Great Escape! Luffy's Miraculous Elephant Gun!
2015.desc: Penned in at the bottom of a well, Luffy and Law are caught in a trap! But someone has come to save them who they least expect! Meanwhile, the Tontattas help Franky break in to the SMILE factory, and Bartolomeo resorts to tactics he used in the Colosseum to defend himself and protect Robin and Rebecca!

2015.title: A United Front – Luffy's Breakthrough to Victory
2015.desc: The Tontattas locate their captive comrades and seem to be able to get the message to them - the prison break is on! Meanwhile, heavy-hitters from the Colosseum turn from wringing each other`s necks towards a unified plan, which might just be enough to get Luffy the chance to make it to a final showdown with Doflamingo!

2015.title: The Second Samurai – Evening Shower Kanjuro Appears
2015.desc: Hidden far underground, Kin`emon finds his old friend Kanjuro, whose powers allow the two to, quickly, but not elegantly, escape to the surface! Meanwhile, Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along - and that the only way to win is to take the Warlord down!

2015.title: The Struggle with Pica – Zoro's One Finishing Move
2015.desc: The Tontattas are in full revolt! But can they keep their wits about them long enough to make it out? Meanwhile, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Señor Pink.

2015.title: The Little People's Princess - Captive Mansherry
2015.desc: Franky finally makes it into the factory and the Tontattas are reunited with their captive friends! But Princess Mansherry is nowhere to be found. Factory manager Kuween becomes irate when ignored and launches an attack on Franky while Señor Pink, wise to Frankie`s deception, arrives on the scene ready for a manly showdown!

2015.title: Invulnerable! The Terrifying Headcracker Doll Army
2015.desc: Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below - and directly into Luffy and the others` battle with the creepy Headcracker Dolls!

2015.title: Life-Risking! Luffy is the Trump Card to Victory
2015.desc: Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, but unfortunately finds company there that is less than friendly! Meanwhile, Bartolomeo pushes himself to the limit in order to help Luffy advance, but does he leave himself vulnerable in the process? Meanwhile, Sabo tastes Fujitora`s full might!

2015.title: A Tearful Reunion – Rebecca and Kyros!
2015.desc: Diamante has Rebecca pinned and completely overpowered. If only the Soldier-san of her youth were able to protect her! Meanwhile, Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo -- but Sugar stands in their way!

2015.title: One Shot One Kill - The Man Who Will Save Dressrosa
2015.desc: Usopp uses Viola`s Clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take Sugar out! But the slightest hesitation now will spell disaster -- and the end of Luffy! Luckily for the Straw Hats, Usopp`s ammunition has been specially designed for this specific situation!

2015.title: Anger Explosion - Luffy and Laws's Ultimate Secret Plan
2015.desc: The final showdown with Doflamingo begins, but the Warlord still has several tricks up his sleeve - including turning one of Luffy`s own friends against him! Meanwhile Franky and Señor Pink are in a standoff to find out who is the coolest.

2015.title: Noble Family - Doflamingo's True Identity!
2015.desc: All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; but the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora's true intention…

2015.title: Ultimate Power - The Secret of the Ope Ope no Mi!
2015.desc: With Fujitora`s stalemate arousing suspicion in the Navy ranks, Law and Luffy stand seconds away from execution at the hand of Doflamingo! But before he dispatches them both, he shares the secret of his sway over the Celestial Dragons!

2015.title: Sad Memories - Law the Boy from the White City!
2015.desc: The horrible secret of Flevance, the White Town, is revealed, giving clues to Law`s traumatic past! A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to kill Corazon!

2015.title: Celestial Dragon! Doffy's Stormy Past!
2015.desc: Law`s attack on Corazon looks less successful than he thought! And after he`s accepted into the Doflamingo Family, Corazon`s mysterious silence hides a fact that may save Law`s life - and a hidden danger Law must face in Doflamingo himself!
