2020.desc: As the clash between Kaido and Big Mom continues, Queen looks for a way to get out of Onigashima. Meanwhile in Udon, Old Man Hyo finds his former allies, four bosses from each region. At Bandit's Bridge, Hiyori and Kawamatsu finally see each other after a long time.

2020.title: Its Name is Enma! Oden's Great Swords!
2020.desc: Zoro runs after the warrior-monk who took his Shusui and Kawamatsu shares with Hiyori his memory of a fox that was guarding the graves in Ringo. As they catch up to Zoro, they find a room filled with swords. And Hiyori tells Zoro to give Shusui back to the Land of Wano.

2020.title: A New Alliance?! Kaido's Army Gathers!
2020.desc: As the day of the raid approaches, Law finds someone who might help him escape the prison and Kin'emon gathers up most of his main allies to discuss the raid plan. Meanwhile, at Onigashima, Kaido and Big Mom make a stunning declaration!

2020.title: Ticking Down to the Great Battle! The Straw Hats Go into Combat Mode!
2020.desc: Kin'emon, Momonosuke, and the others can't fight back tears when they hear that Hiyori is alive. Zoro is stunned by Enma's demonic power and its ties to him. And as the day of the Fire Festival is finally in sight, Kin'emon and the others head out for the rendezvous point.

2021.title: Big News! An Incident That Will Affect the Seven Warlords!
2021.desc: The resolution that passed the Reverie and the incidents surrounding the conference stun people all over the world and corner the Seven Warlords of the Sea. Meanwhile, a Navy captain Koby secretly contacts someone who is currently in the Land of Wano.

2021.title: A Legendary Battle! Garp and Roger!
2021.desc: Admiral Issho and Fleet Admiral Sakazuki argue over the abolition of the Seven Warlord system and the alliance of the two Emperors of the Sea. Meanwhile, ex-Fleet Admiral Sengoku teaches the young Navy soldiers about the legendary Rocks Pirates that Kaido and Big Mom once belonged to along with all the other big names.

2021.title: The Rendezvous Port! The Land of Wano Act Three Begins!
2021.desc: On the day of the Fire Festival, Orochi leaves the mainland of the Land of Wano heading for Onigashima where a big banquet will take place. Meanwhile, at Tokage Port, the rendezvous point for the rebel group, Kin'emon and the others are stunned by the fact that none of their allies are there.

2021.title: The Number-One Samurai in the Land of Wano! Here comes Kozuki Oden!
2021.desc: The night before the great battle, Orochi orders the destruction of the Sunny along with some bridges across the country to block Akazaya samurai's allies from their rendezvous. Disappointed, the group of samurai still sets out for Onigashima with the memory of their beloved lord, Oden, in their hearts. However, 41 years ago, Oden was not respected by everyone.

2021.title: Tearfully Swearing Allegiance! Oden and Kin'emon!
2021.desc: When the angry mountain god, the giant boar, almost kills Kin'emon, Oden steps in. Kin'emon is impressed when he sees Oden's strength and pledges his life to serve him. Disavowed by his father, Oden decides to go on a journey around the country and gathers more followers along the way.

2021.title: Changing Destiny - The Whitebeard Pirates Cast Ashore!
2021.desc: Oden transforms the wild land of Kuri into a habitable region and is made Daimyo over it. Then he meets Kawamatsu the Kappa and the two Minks, Dogstorm and Cat Viper, who become his followers like the others. Kin'emon and the other vassals are scolded by Yasuie when they try to steal money from him, and they begin reforming themselves for their lord Oden.

2021.title: Oden's Determination! Whitebeard's Test!
2021.desc: Whitebeard and his crew dock at one of the ports in the Land of Wano with their broken ship and the news excites Oden. He runs to the port and asks Whitebeard to let him get on board the ship but the request is rejected. When the ship's repairs are complete, Whitebeard tries to sneak out of the country, but he finds Oden tagging along.

2021.title: Whitebeard's Little Brother! Oden's Great Adventure!
2021.desc: Oden rescues Toki from the slavers and befriends her. She wants to travel to Wano, which unfortunately displeases him. With the appearance of Whitebeard on the coast, the course of their journey changes.

2021.title: Blades Crossed! Roger and Whitebeard!
2021.desc: While Oden is still traveling the world with Whitebeard, his father's health is increasingly deteriorating. Orochi is to fill in as shogun until Oden's return.

2021.title: Roger's Wish! A New Journey!
2021.desc: The Roger Pirates against the Whitebeard Pirates! Their battle extends over three days and nights. Which crew will emerge victorious?

2021.title: Devoting His Life! Roger's Adventure!
2021.desc: Roger's joint adventure with Oden continues. They travel to Sky Island, Water 7 and also Fish Man Island in search of the Porneglyph.

2021.title: The King of the Pirates is Born! Arriving at the Last Island!
2021.desc: After Roger and his crew have inspected all the Road Poneglyphs, they set off for the last island. What awaits them there leaves them speechless.

2021.title: To the Land of Wano! The Roger Pirates Disband!
2021.desc: After the Roger Pirates have been on Laugh Tale, they decide to disband. Captain Roger is the first man to disembark. After that, his remaining crew takes Oden back to Wano.

2021.title: Sad News! The Opening of the Great Pirate Era!
2021.desc: Oden learns that Orochi is tyrannizing Wano as the new shogun. When he hears that Toki has been injured in an attack on Momonosuke, he rushes to the capital to attack Orochi.

2021.title: Raid! Oden and the Akazaya Nine
2021.desc: Oden keeps dancing naked in the Flower Capital and losing all the trust of the people. His vassals wonder why he is doing this. One day, Orochi comes to Kuri and reveals his evil plan for the Land of Wano.

2021.title: The End of the Battle! Oden vs. Kaido!
2021.desc: It comes to the decisive battle between Kaido's army and Oden and his samurais. How will the battle end? What card does Kaido have up his sleeve against Oden?

2021.title: Boiled to Death! Oden's One-hour Struggle!
2021.desc: Oden proposes a bet to Kaido and Orochi. If he and his vassals manage to survive in the cauldron for a certain amount of time, they must release them. Kaido and Orochi accept his proposal.

2021.title: Oden Wouldn't Be Oden If It Wasn't Boiled!
2021.desc: Oden and his vassals must endure one hour in the cauldron of boiling oil. If they succeed, they will be free. However, Orochi is already forging the next devious plan.

2021.title: The Castle on Fire! The Fate of the Kozuki Clan!
2021.desc: Oden Kozuki was executed but thanks to him his vassals were able to escape. They run to Oden Castle to help Toki and her children who are attacked by Kaido.

2021.title: Back to the Present Day! 20 Years Later
2021.desc: Momonosuke, Raizo, Kanjuro and Kinemon were sent 20 years into the future by Toki. In the meantime, their remaining comrades wait for them and disguise themselves among the people of Wano.

2021.title: Pirates at Sea! Raid! Onward to Onigashima
2021.desc: Kinemon and the other Akazayas want to cross to Onigashima by boat! However, they are stopped by Kaido's fleet on the way. The spy who revealed their plan finally reveals himself.

2021.title: The Worst Generation Charges in! The Battle of the Stormy Sea!
2021.desc: Luffy, Law and Kid have come to the aid of Kinemon and the Akazayas. Before they can continue sailing towards Onigashima, they have to sink Kaido's battleships.

2021.title: Good Luck?! Leader Kin'emon's Plot!
2021.desc: Kyoshiro has come with his clan for support. But to everyone's surprise, he does not attack the Straw Hats or the Akazayas, but targets Kaido's fleet instead. How will the course of the battle develop?

2021.title: A Tearful Promise! The Kidnapped Momonosuke!
2021.desc: Kanjuro grabbed Momonsuke and is now on his way to Onigashima. Luffy and the others start heading there, but Kaido's army gets in their way again.

2021.title: A New Member! 'First Son of the Sea' Jimbei!
2021.desc: Jimbei has joined the Straw Hat Pirates and arrived in time to raid Onigashima. Now Kinemon is planning the invasion of the island.

2021.title: Kaido's Trump Card! The Tobi Roppo Appear!
2021.desc: While Luffy, Kinemon and all the other comrades are still on their way to Onigashima there's a big banquet on the island and Queen gives an unforgetable concert.

2021.title: The Samurai Warriors' Earnestness! The Straw Hats Land at Onigashima
2021.desc: As the alliance reaches Onigashima, Kinemon uses his sorcery to change everyone's clothes to blend in with the Beasts Pirates. He then gives a speech to the samurai to take advantage of their disguises and reach the castle for the final battle.

2021.title: Luffy Goes Out of Control?! Sneaking into Kaido's Banquet
2021.desc: As Kinemon and Denjiro's forces advance across the mountain paths, Luffy and his men charge through the main entrance. Luffy and Zoro get lost in the hustle and bustle of the banquet and strike up a conversation with Kaido's men.

2021.title: Thinking of Otama! Luffy's Furious Strike!
2021.desc: Luffy and Zoro pick a fight with the Beast Pirates for intentionally wasting food. Luffy's Elephant Gun causes even more chaos.

2021.title: Fighting Music! An Ability That Harms Luffy!
2021.desc: As the Kid Pirates head towards Kaidou, Luffy and Zoro are attacked by Scratchmen Apoo with his Tone-Tone abilities. Kid gets blinded by revenge and attacks Apoo for betraying him.

2021.title: His Dream Broken?! The Trap That Lures Sanji!
2021.desc: The Kid Pirates abandon their mission to join the fight against Apoo and the Beast Pirates to allow Luffy, Zoro, Kid and Killer continue searching for Kaido. Due to the commotion of the fight, the compound is emptying out, allowing Kinemon's forces to pass undetected.

2021.title: Reinforcements Arrive! The Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates!
2021.desc: The Big Mom Pirates are climbing up the waterfall of Wano again. However, this time it is not King who hinders them, but an unexpected opponent stands in their way.

2021.title: Oath of Man! Fierce Battle of the Brachio-Tank
2021.desc: Big Mom chases the Brachio Tank V driven by Chopper and Usopp. Meanwhile, Kanjuro takes Momonosuke to Kaido and Orochi and informs them about Oden's vassals.

2021.title: Thunder Bagua! Here Comes Kaido's Son!
2021.desc: Luffy runs into two members of the Tobi Roppo: Ulti and Page The brother and sister duo use their Devil Fruit powers and turn themselves into massive beasts. When Luffy is driven into a corner, someone wearing a demon mask appears and whisks him away.

2021.title: Enemy or Ally? Luffy and Yamato!
2021.desc: Luffy is kidnapped by the ominous Yamato, who claims to be Kaido's son. How will their encounter unfold? Meanwhile, Chopper and Usopp are still on the run from Big Mom.

2021.title: Desire to be Oden! Yamato's Dream!
2021.desc: Orochi announces the execution of Momonosuke and Kaido also has an important announcement to make. Meanwhile, Yamato tells Luffy a story.

2021.title: Explosive?! The Handcuffs that Shackle Yamato's Freedom!
2021.desc: The Akazaya have reached the back entrance of Onigashima and try to get through the gate, but they are stopped by the traitor Kanjuro. Meanwhile, Kaido reveals his grand plan.

2021.title: The Akazaya Face-off! Kikunojo vs. Kanjuro!
2021.desc: While Kaido and Big Mom proclaim their goal, Kikunojo faces Kanjuro at the back entrance of Onigashima and gets into an emotional fight with her former colleague.

2021.title: Raid! Inheriting Oden's Will
2021.desc: The Akazaya charge at Kaido from the back entrance of Onigashima and open the fierce battle.

2021.title: Onigashima in Tumult! Luffy's All-Out War Begins!
2021.desc: The Akazayas deliver a devastating blow to Kaido. Luffy and Yamato try to support them, but Ulti and Big Mom get in their way. Meanwhile, Nami and Carrot set out to retrieve Zeus.

2021.title: The Battle Under the Moon! The Berserker, Sulong the Moon Lion!
2021.desc: Kaido's men are amazed when they see thousands of samurai warriors storming into the castle. Kaido goes outside to fight the Akazayas in his dragon form.

2021.title: Zeus' Treason?! The Cornered Nami!
2021.desc: Shinobu tries to rescue Momonosuke but is discovered and attacked by King. Meanwhile, Nami is chased by Zeus who is ordered by Big Mom to kill her.

2021.title: The Fate That Protects You - Yamato and Momonosuke
2021.desc: Franky, Robin and Jimbei face Big Mom but the Numbers interrupt their fight. One of them holds the Brachio Tank containing Usopp and Chopper in his hand. Meanwhile, Yamato finally meets Momonosuke.

2021.title: Overwhelming Strength! The Straw Hats Come Together!
2021.desc: Luffy and Zoro try to get to the rooftop to help the Akazayas but Queen and King get in their way. The rest of the Straw Hats arrive, the whole crew assembles and Luffy vows to take down Kaido.

2021.title: A Risky Invitation! A Plot to Eliminate Queen
2021.desc: Who's-Who tries to bring Drake and Hawkins on board to kill Queen. Meanwhile, the Straw Hats are facing two large monsters that remind them of the Giant who they once struggled to take down.

2021.title: A New Rivalry! Nami and Ulti!
2021.desc: Drake vows to fight alongside Luffy's side, but Zoro becomes skeptical and challenges him to a fight. Meanwhile, Nami confronts Ulti, who is angered since her brother was attacked.

2021.title: A Heroic Blade! Akazaya vs. Kaido, Again Once More!
2021.desc: Queen uses a new version of the Plague Bullets which will turn the samurai into monsters. Meanwhile, the Minks keep pushing the fight against the Gifters and drive Jack into a corner.

2021.title: An Inherited Technique! Unleashing Oden's Secret Swordplay!
2021.desc: While Luffy rushes to the roof and Yamato tries to catch up with Momonosuke to protect him, the Akazayas finally confront Kaido. Hearing Kaido taunt them for their weakness, the samurais attack him relentlessly.

2022.title: The Power of Ice Oni! A New Version of the Plague Rounds!
2022.desc: Queen blazes away at Zoro and Drake with a special version of the Plague Rounds. Meanwhile, Luffy and Sanji run into another Headliner with a special ability on their way to the rooftop.

2022.title: I Won't Forgive Him! Chopper's Determination!
2022.desc: King orders his subordinates to go after Momonosuke. Meanwhile, seeing people suffering from Queen's Plague Rounds, Chopper is determined to save everyone.

2022.title: Zoro's Pursuit! Ice Oni Tag
2022.desc: Yamato fights Sasaki to protect Momonosuke. In the meantime, Zoro tries to get rid of the Gifters who have turned into Ice Oni, but Queen starts a horrible game that involves the antibody for the virus.

2022.title: Nami Surrenders?! Ulti's Fierce Headbutt!
2022.desc: Ulti and Page One chase Nami and Usopp. Cornered, Nami gives in and Ulti pushes her to say the unthinkable.

2022.title: Sasaki's Onslaught - Armored Division vs. Yamato
2022.desc: Carrot and Wanda help Marco, who is cornered by Big Mom and Perospero. In the meantime, Yamato fights against Sasaki in order to protect Shinobu and Momonosuke.

2022.title: Eliminate the Ice Oni! Chopper's Fire Trick!
2022.desc: Zoro and Drake continue to chase Apoo to get the antibody against Ice Oni. In the castle, Luffy, Jimbei and Sanji are climbing up the stairs to reach the rooftop.

2022.title: It's Not Okay! The Spider lures Sanji!
2022.desc: Sanji hears a woman's scream for help and rushes into the room the scream can be heard from. However, it's a trap set up by Black Maria of the Tobi Roppo. How will Sanji get out of this sticky situation?

2022.title: A Turnaround Move! The Flames of Marco the Phoenix!
2022.desc: While Kaido begins the New Onigashima Project and makes the island float, Marco appears in front of Chopper and the others, who are struggling with Ice Oni.

2022.title: Yamato's Past - The Man Who Came for an Emperor of the Sea
2022.desc: Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu that he once met Ace, who came to Onigashima looking to get Kaido's head. Yamato and Ace engaged in a fierce battle that eventually turned into an important friendship.

2022.title: Marco's Tears! The Bond of the Whitebeard Pirates!
2022.desc: Marco helps Zoro get to the rooftop where Kaido and Big Mom are waiting for their opponents.

2022.title: Straw Hat Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the King of the Pirates!
2022.desc: Yamato tells Momonosuke about how Ace gave him hope for the future. Meanwhile, Luffy and the other allied pirates from the Worst Generation make it to the rooftop to finally face off against Kaido and Big Mom.

2022.title: The Battle of the Monsters! The Three Stubborn Captains
2022.desc: Luffy's strong attack reminds Kaido of all the strong opponents he has faced. Meanwhile, Sanji is caught and interrogated by Black Maria.

2022.title: A Barrage of Powerful Techniques! The Fierce Attacks of the Worst Generation!
2022.desc: Luffy, Law, Kid, Zoro and Killer keep landing hard blows against Kaido in tandem despite the arguing. However, when Big Mom steps in and unleashes powerful lightning strikes, the tide turns for all except one of the rookies.

2022.title: Kaido Laughs! The Emperors of the Sea vs. the New Generation!
2022.desc: Luffy batters Kaido with his Kong Gatling and delivers a final blow using all his strength. Big Mom tries to fight back, but Law gets in her way.

2022.title: Otama's Secret Plan! Operation Kibi Dango!
2022.desc: Tama wondered if there was anything she could do to help the Straw Hats and the samurai. Now that she's here on Onigashima, it's time to execute her powerful plan – Operation Kibi Dango!

2022.title: Sanji's Scream! An SOS Echoes Over the Island!
2022.desc: Sanji is captured and tortured by the Black Maria. She wants him to hand over Robin to her. Meanwhile, Carrot and Wanda continue their fight against Perospero.

2022.title: Spank Strikes! Sanji's Woman-trouble!
2022.desc: Robin bursts in to rescue Sanji from the fangs of Black Maria. In the meantime, Yamato, Momonosuke and Shinobu are spotted hiding by the enemy and are forced to fight their pursuers.

2022.title: No Regrets! Luffy and Boss, a Master-Disciple Bond!
2022.desc: Chopper creates and tries the antidote for Ice Oni while Law, Kid, Zoro and Killer continue their battle against Big Mom and Kaido on the roof of the Skull Dome.

2022.title: All Set! Chopperphage Nebulizer!
2022.desc: While the captains of the Worst Generation still struggle against Kaido and Big Mom, Chopper finally manages to cure the samurai and Beast Pirates infected by Ice Oni.

2022.title: Oden Appears! The Confused Hearts of the Akazaya Members!
2022.desc: The wounded Akazaya members are surprised to see Kozuki Oden alive. They were disappointed by their failure to take down Kaido, but now with their lord, they are filled with hope to face their sworn enemy again.

2022.title: The Worst Generation Gets Wiped Out?! The Emperors' Deadly Attack!
2022.desc: The Akazaya try to save Momonosuke but Jack stands in their way. Meanwhile, Chopper and Marco team up to take down Queen and the fierce battle on the rooftop rages on.

2022.title: The Supernovas Strike Back! The Mission to Tear Apart the Emperors!
2022.desc: While the Akazaya take on Orochi, the members of the Worst Generation continue to fight against the Emperors. They try to separate Kaido and Big Mom to increase their chances of victory.

2022.title: Protect Luffy! Zoro and Law's Sword Technique
2022.desc: After Big Mom was pushed off of the island the furious battle against Kaido continues. When Kaido tries to beat up the unconscious Luffy, Zoro launches an all-out attack to protect his captain.

2022.title: Surpass the Emperor of the Sea! Luffy Strikes Back with an Iron Fist!
2022.desc: The Worst Generation and Emperors scatter across Onigashima, preparing for new fights. Kid prepares to battle Big Mom, Killer fights Hawkins, and Luffy decides to take on Kaido all by himself. Meanwhile, Nami, Tama, and Usopp return to the Live Floor, chased by Page One.

2022.title: A Faint Memory - Luffy and Red-Haired's Daughter Uta!
2022.desc: Luffy meets Shanks and his daughter Uta for the first time and the two children begin developing their friendship.

2022.title: A Pledge for the Next Genesis! Luffy and Uta!
2022.desc: After Uta travels with Shanks, she is not aboard when Shanks returns to Foosha Village. This shocks Luffy and he wonders what happened to her. At the same time, news spread that the island Elegia has been mysteriously destroyed.

2022.title: Nami Screams - A Deadly Death Race!
2022.desc: Luffy and Kaido, who are both using Conqueror's Haki, keep clashing! In the meantime, Usopp, Nami and Tama are being chased by Page One on their way to the Performance Floor.

2022.title: The Dawn of the Land of Wano - The All-Out Battle Heats Up!
2022.desc: The Akazaya are rushing to Momonosuke while Yamato tries to lure away the enemies. At the same time, Luffy lands a few punches on Kaido, Chopper struggles against Queen and Ulti faces off against Big Mom.

2022.title: The Conclusion! Luffy, Accelerating Fist of the Supreme King
2022.desc: Sanji is forced to carry Zoro to the Live Floor, while Nami, Usopp and Big Mom face off against Ulti. On the rooftop, the intense battle between Luffy and Kaido continues.

2022.title: Luffy Defeated! The Straw Hats in Jeopardy?!
2022.desc: Luffy falls into the sea after being pushed off the rooftop by Kaido. Meanwhile, Zeus intervenes in the fight between Big Mom and Nami's group and Chopper continues to stall Queen on the Live Floor.

2022.title: The Animal Kingdom Pirates Trample Down! The End of the Kozuki Clan!
2022.desc: The Straw Hats and their allies receive the news that Luffy lost his battle against Kaido. Meanwhile, Kanjuro disguises himself as Oden again and approaches Momonosuke to destroy the Kozuki lineage. However, Kin'emon amd Kiku stand in his way.

2022.title: Fight Against the Dark Night – The Commander-in-chief of the Land of Wano Sounds Off
2022.desc: Chopper is discouraged by the news of Luffy's loss and Queen doesn't miss the chance and tries to finish him off. However, Sanji comes to Choppers rescue. Meanwhile, Kin'emon fights for his life to save Momonosuke who makes a big anouncement after escaping!

2022.title: Believe in Luffy! The Alliance's Counterattack Begins!
2022.desc: Momonosuke and Shinobu run from Kaido while Law and Kid team up against Big Mom. Meanwhile, Nami and Usopp encounter an enemy they thought they had already defeated.

2022.title: Nami's Lethal Attack! Otama's Desperate Challenge!
2022.desc: Nami strikes a thunder blast against Ulti to clear their way to the Live Floor. After that Usopp catches one of the Marys and Otama stands up to give a command to the Gifters.

2022.title: A Dramatic Increase of Allies! Straw Hats Fight Back!
2022.desc: Hearing Otama's command, the Gifters side with the samurai. Chopper starts to take care of Zoro and Jinbe gets stunned by Who's-Who's story.

2022.title: The Pride of a Helmsman – The Enraged Jimbei!
2022.desc: When Who's-Who asks Jimbei a question, he tramples on the dignity of the Fish-Men, causing Jimbei's outrage.

2022.title: Showdown Battles of the Monsters! Yamato and Franky
2022.desc: Yamato unleashes his true power, Queen bombards Sanji with his cyborg-powers and Sasaki launches tricky attacks against Franky.

2022.title: The Predator's Trap - Black Maria's Temptation
2022.desc: Suddenly Nico Olvia, Professor Clover and the giant Jaguar D. Saul appear in front of Robin.

2022.title: Slash the Nightmare - Brook Draws His Freezing Sword!
2022.desc: In the dense mist, Brook is surprised to see his old friends, the Rumbar Pirates and Laboon. They reminisce about the old days and play music together, however, they suddenly attack Brook.

2022.title: Clutch! A Demon Incarnate, Robin!
2022.desc: After enduring Black Maria's physical and mental torture, Robin shows what she is truly capable of as a Demon Child.

2022.title: A Spell! Kid and Zoro Facing Threats!
2022.desc: While Kid and Law take on Big Mom, Killer battles Hawkins and Sanji stuggles against both King and Queen, who try to go after Zoro while he is still incapacitated.

2023.title: Taking a Chance! The Two Arms Go into Battle!
2023.desc: Zoro gets back on his feet after taking the instant recovery drug from Zou and confronts King and Queen along with Sanji.

2023.title: Ascend to the Dawn! A Pink Dragon Gets Agitated
2023.desc: Zoro and Sanji continue their clash against King and Queen. Meanwhile Inuarashi confronts his nemesis Jack, who destroyed his country and Nekomamushi confronts Perospero, who is responsible for Pedro's death.

2023.title: For the Future! Yamato and the Great Swordsmen's Pledge
2023.desc: Yamato remembers three great samurai who he met as a child. Their stunning choice for the future of Wano encourages Yamato to keep fighting.

2023.title: Luffy Soars! Revenge Against the King of the Beasts
2023.desc: Luffy flies on Momonosuke in his giant pink dragon form to get to Onigashima with him. Meanwhile, Yamato vows to survive until Luffy returns.

2023.title: Two Dragons Face Off! Momonosuke's Determination!
2023.desc: With Luffy's encouragement, Momonosuke bravely steps forward and faces Kaido in his dragon form.

2023.title: A Legend All Over Again! Luffy's Fist Roars in the Sky
2023.desc: Yamato and Momonosuke take on the important task of saving Onigashima. Meanwhile, Luffy and Kaido's clash shakes up the sky.

2023.title: The Situation Has Grown Tense! The End of Onigashima!
2023.desc: While Zoro and Sanji are in a battle against King a Queen, Yamato and Momonosuke launch a secret operation.

2023.title: Sanji's Mutation - The Two Arms in Crisis!
2023.desc: Queen uses a special technique which can break every bone in Sanji's body. On the verge of a crisis, Sanji feels something strange once more.

2023.title: Death to Your Partner! Killer's Deadly Gamble!
2023.desc: As Kid is dying not knowing where his damage is coming from, Killer takes a gamble in his fight with Hawkins.

2023.title: A Shadowy Figure Pulls the Strings! Onigashima in Flames
2023.desc: Kinemon hears an unexpected voice calling for Kanjuro. Orochi tries to stir up Kanjuro to make him perform one last time.

2023.title: Strike Back! Law and Kid's Counterattack Alliance
2023.desc: Law and Child are facing a formidable opponent in Big Mom. But they see a chance to defeat her when they cooperate and make use of their awakened Devil Fruit powers.

2023.title: For Luffy - Sanji and Zoro's Oath
2023.desc: Sanji is plagued by the thought of turning into a vicious Germa warrior like his siblings. When he makes up his mind, he asks Zoro the ultimate favor.

2023.title: The Onslaught of Kazenbo - Orochi's Evil Clutches Close in
2023.desc: Kanjuro's creation, Kazenbo, is wreaking havoc all throughout the Skull Dome, causing panic among Beasts Pirates and samurai, alike.

2023.title: Zoro's Hardship - A Monster! King the Wildfire
2023.desc: Zoro is up against an seemingly unbeatable opponent in King. Not even one of Zoro's most lethal attacks manages to injure him.

2023.title: Secrets of Enma! The Cursed Sword Entrusted to Zoro
2023.desc: As Zoro recalls his past, the clues from his memory help him realize the secret necessary to truly master Enma.

2023.title: Attack of the Devil! Sanji vs. Queen
2023.desc: Taking advantage of his scientific enhancements, Sanji discovers a new ability that could prove decisive in his fight with Queen.

2023.title: King of Hell Three Sword Style - Zoro vs. King
2023.desc: King recalls his first meeting with his captain and declares that Kaido is the one to become the King of the Pirates, which leads Zoro to set his swords alight with hellfire.

2023.title: Luffy Accelerates! The Turning Point of a New Era!
2023.desc: Usopp discovers the severely injured Kiku and the upper body of Kinemon. However, they are unable to escape, because they are surrounded by Gifters.

2023.title: Shuron Hakke! A Lawless Dragon Approaches Luffy!
2023.desc: The battle between Luffy and Kaido is becoming increasingly fierce. However, Kaido who is thrilled to have a strong opponent starts drinking too much.

2023.title: The Destruction of the Alliance?! Fire up, the Will of the New Generation!
2023.desc: With Law and the Kid worn out and deeply injured, Big Mom tries to get to the rooftop.

2023.title: The Main Attraction is Coming! Ultimate Attack of Shockwave and Magnetism
2023.desc: After Big Mom recovers from Kid's previous onslaught, she unleashes a potent counterattack that endangers both Law and Kid. Even though they are exhausted, the two rivals start their own desperate attempt to get Big Mom out of Onigashima.

2023.title: To the New Era! Settled! The Determination of the Brats
2023.desc: Big Mom is defeated by Law and Kid, whereupon she falls into the exposed magma chamber below.

2023.title: Moon Princess Echoes! Wano Country's Final Phase!
2023.desc: Kaido mourns Big Mom's defeat and remembers the day he first met her. Meanwhile, Orochi sees the true nature of Komurasaki, the woman he loves, and trembles with fear.

2023.title: There is Only One Winner - Luffy vs. Kaido
2023.desc: A CP0 agent tries to get to Luffy, but Drake gets in the way. Meanwhile, Luffy, who is running dangerously low on energy, uses his final Gear Four to free the people of Wano from Kaido.

2023.title: Luffy is Defeated?! The Determination of Those Left Behind
2023.desc: The battle between Luffy and Kaido comes to an unexpected end. After Kaido descends, he informs everyone that Luffy has lost.

2023.title: Luffy's Peak Attained! Gear 5
2023.desc: As Luffy's heart pounds in a funny way, the Five Elders reveal the secret behind the Gum-Gum Fruit. Meanwhile, Orochi tries to convince Komurasaki to escape with him, but when he sees Kanjuro, he makes a malicious decision.

2023.title: The Ridiculous Power! Gear Five in Full Play
2023.desc: While Luffy enjoys his new, bizarre power, Kaido is perplexed and can't make sense of it. As they wait for Luffy to win, Kid, Law, and the other allies carry on with the battle below.

2023.title: Nowhere to Run! Hell on Onigashima!
2023.desc: Raizo and Jimbei work together to put out the fire that has spread throughout Onigashima.

2023.title: Believe in Momo - Luffy's Final Powerful Technique!
2023.desc: Momonosuke struggles to create flame clouds to sustain Onigashima. To fulfill his promise tothe people of Wano, Luffy inflates his fist to strike Kaido.

2023.title: Twenty Years of Prayer! Reclaim Wano Country
2023.desc: As Luffy and Kaido prepare their final attack, Momonosuke is tasked with moving Onigashima out of the way of Luffy's attack.

2023.title: The World That Luffy Wants!
2023.desc: Kaido recalls being treated unfairly in the past and his vision of the ideal world. While his friends fight to survive on Onigashima, Luffy is asked by Kaido to imagine his ideal world.

2023.title: Closing the Curtain! Winner - Straw Hat Luffy!
2023.desc: The samurai and the Straw Hats shout for joy as they hear that Luffy defeated Kaido.

2023.title: Return! Shogun of Wano Country - Kozuki Momonosuke
2023.desc: When Kinemon and the other samurai who were thought to be dead emerge from the smoke, the residents of the Flower Capital become baffled. Momonosuke then announces to their victory and the return of the Kozuki Family to the citizens.

2023.title: Dawn Has Come! Luffy and Friends Rest
2023.desc: As the Five Elders learn of Wano's status, a festival is held to celebrate the alliance's victory. Meanwhile, an Admiral heads to Wano.

2023.title: The Festival Banquet! New Emperors of the Sea
2023.desc: The news of the defeat of the Emperors of the Sea spreads across the world. Luffy enjoys the banquet but just as he is about to make a toast, an enraged Kid comes in to strike him.

2023.title: The World in Flames! The Navy Admiral's Attack!
2023.desc: The Akazaya attempt to stop Admiral Ryokugyu as he approaches the Flower Capital, but he outclasses them with his Devil Fruit power.

2023.title: A New Era Arrives! The Fury of Red-Haired Yonko
2023.desc: Momonosuke and the Akazaya try to defend the Land of Wano against Admiral Ryokugyu, but they get driven into a corner.

2023.title: The World That Moves On! A New Organization, Cross Guild!
2023.desc: The Straw Hats are surprised when Robin tells them about the Ancient Weapon Pluton. Kid reveals that a new criminal organization, the Cross Guild, has emerged.

2023.title: The Time of Departure - The Land of Wano and the Straw Hat Pirates!
2023.desc: Zoro visits Yasuie's grave, where he encounters Hiyori, while Luffy visits the ruins of Oden Castle. Later, Luffy and Tama eat red-bean soup together for the last time

2023.title: The Last Curtain! Luffy and Momonosuke's Vow
2023.desc: The Straw Hat Pirates say their final goodbyes to Momonosuke, Kinemon, and Yamato, and formally declare Wano Country as one of their territories.

2023.title: A New Emperor! Buggy the Genius Jester!
2023.desc: The Straw Hat Pirates' new bounties are revealed. Meanwhile, Crocodile and Mihawk, visit Buggy to discuss their newly-established organization, Cross Guild.

2023.title: The War on the Island of Women! A Case Involving Koby the Hero
2023.desc: With the aid of their new Seraphim Pacifista, the Marines invade Amazon Lily with the intention of apprehending Pirate Empress Boa Hancock. But the Blackbeard Pirates make an appearance on Amazon Lily as well.

2023.title: Luffy's Dream
2023.desc: The three-way struggle between the Navy, the Blackbeard Pirates, and the Kuja Pirates comes to an end when an unexpected figure shows up. On the Sunny, the Straw Hats talk about the recent incidents around the world and Luffy's words surprise everyone.

2024.title: Entering a New Chapter! Luffy and Sabo's Paths!
2024.desc: Sabo, the Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army, contacts Koala and everyone in Kamabakka Queendom. He explains to them about the things that he is accused of, but someone who was eavesdropping on the call takes a stunning action.

2024.title: A New Island! Future Island Egghead
2024.desc: Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.

2024.title: Brimming with the Future! An Adventure on the Island of Science!
2024.desc: A young girl who came out of the big robot names herself Dr. Vegapunk and it surprises Franky and the rest of the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Luffy's group gets to the surface of the island where futuristic buildings stand and unknown giant creatures wander about.

2024.title: Bonney's Lamentation! Darkness Lurking on the Future Island
2024.desc: While Luffy and the others are enjoying the futuristic machines of Egghead, someone who resembles Bartholomew Kuma comes after them. When Luffy tries to fight back, Bonney stops him and reveals her shocking relationship with Kuma.

2024.title: The Winner Takes All! Law vs. Blackbeard!
2024.desc: The Blackbeard Pirates ambushed the Heart Pirates led by Law. The Blackbeard Pirates' top officers use a variety of formidable Devil Fruit powers and keep pushing the Heart Pirates in order to obtain the copies of the Road Ponegliffs.

2024.title: The Mystery Deepens! Egghead Labophase
2024.desc: The Straw Hats without Luffy, Chopper, and Jimbei are taken to the laboratory on the clouds far above the ground by Lilith. They get excited about the things they've never seen before. However, inside the laboratory, a new threat is waiting for them.

2024.title: The Brain of a Genius - Six Vegapunks!
2024.desc: Nami and the others are attacked by a Pacifista who resembles Jimbei and while they're in battle, some of Vegapunk's Satellites look on with excitement. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others find something extraordinary at the scrap heap.

2024.title: A Forbidden Piece of History! A Theory Concerning a Kingdom
2024.desc: Vegapunk Shaka shares with Robin and the others his theory about an ancient kingdom and the 100-Year Void. He even says that he visited Ohara after its destruction. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper try to activate the giant robot and something surprising happens.

2024.title: The Will of Ohara! The Inherited Research
2024.desc: Shaka reveals the secret behind the foundation of the Revolutionary Army and how the relationship between Vegapunk and Dragon affected it. Meanwhile, Vegapunk explains to Luffy and the others about his special power and how his clones work.

2024.title: The Eccentric Dream of a Genius!
2024.desc: Vegapunk reveals the shocking history of the ancient giant robot and asks Luffy to take him off Egghead. Rob Lucci and his fellow Cipher Pol agents arrive at the island and ask for permission to enter the port.

2024.title: Preparations for Interception! Rob Lucci Strikes!
2024.desc: CP-0 led by Rob Lucci makes a forced landing at Egghead and people on the Fabriophase are plunged into confusion while Shaka and the others prepare to fight back on the Labophase. The enraged Atlas stands up to defend the peace of the island.

2024.title: Powers on a Different Level! Luffy vs. Lucci!
2024.desc: Lucci is instructed not to confront Luffy until Kizaru arrives with reinforcements, but the two attack each other with their newly awakened Devil Fruit forms. Meanwhile, Vegapunk reveals the shocking truth about the Gum-Gum Fruit.

2024.title: The Strongest Form of Humanity! The Seraphim's Powers!
2024.desc: Vegapunk explains how he managed to grant the Seraphim Devil Fruit powers. Meanwhile, Luffy is still facing Lucci in his awakened form, as the rocket to the Labophase is about to leave.

2024.title: Sinister Schemes! The Operation to Escape Egghead
2024.desc: Lucci orders his troops to block off all Vegapunk's escape routes and looks to invade the Labophase. Elsewhere, at the Red Line, Kuma crashes into the Red Port.

2024.title: Turn Back My Father! Bonney's Futile Wish!
2024.desc: Rob Lucci, Stussy and Kaku start attacking the Thousand Sunny. Luffy reunites with Nami and the others. Meanwhile, Bonney is pressing Vegapunk to change back her father Kuma.

2024.title: A Desperate Situation! The Seraphim's All-out Attack!
2024.desc: After the Seraphim appear, Zoro and Brook now face seven powerful opponents. Sanji, Franky, Lilith and Edison head out to regain control of the Seraphim, while Lucci orders them to destroy the lab.

2024.title: A Beautiful Act of Treason! The Spy, Stussy
2024.desc: Stussy suddenly knocked out Lucci to the Straw Hats' surprise, and when Shaka reveals her true identity, they're stunned again. Meanwhile, a major incident occurs on an island called Sphinx where Whitebeard came from.

2024.title: Trouble Occurs! Seek Dr. Vegapunk!
2024.desc: The Straw Hats and Dr. Vegapunk's Satellites find out that Vegapunk has disappeared and begin searching for him. Meanwhile, Bonney begins exploring her father's memories.

2024.title: A Shudder! The Evil Hand Creeping Up on the Laboratory!
2024.desc: The search for Dr. Vegapunk continues and gets more complicated when the communications and surveillance goes down, causing Shaka to suspect an intruder.

2024.title: Incomprehensible! The Seraphim's Rebellion!
2024.desc: The Seraphim suddenly start attacking the Straw Hats and the Vegapunk Satellites. They are not stopping even when the Satellites order them to. When Luffy and Zoro are cornered, Lucci and Kaku wake up and make them a surprising offer.

2024.title: A Tough Decision! An Unusual United Front!
2024.desc: Rob Lucci and Kaku ask Luffy and Zoro to uncuff them so they can fight alongside them against the Seraphim, but the two pirates are reluctant to do so.

2024.title: Survive! Deadly Combat with the Strongest Form of Humanity!
2024.desc: Luffy, Zoro, Rob Lucci and Kaku relentlessly attack the Seraphim, but the they keep getting back up. Meanwhile, Shaka goes to check one place where he thinks Vegapunk might be.

2024.title: The Second Ohara! The Mastermind's Ambition!
2024.desc: Stussy and Sentomaru discuss how big the threat that closes in on Egghead is as Luffy and the others keep fighting the uncontrollable Seraphim. Meanwhile, in an underground lab, someone approaches Vegapunk, who is being held captive.

2024.title: Clash! Shanks vs. Eustass Kid
2024.desc: Kid gives his crew a pep talk before the battle with Shanks. And Shanks also prepares for the battle but learns how his own subordinates do as they like to protect their beloved boss. Finally, Kid has his Damned Punk ready to shoot.

2024.title: Run, Koby! A Desperate Escape Strategy!
2024.desc: Koby, who is being held captive on the pirate island of Beehive, has the chance to escape but decides to become a decoy to free slaves. Soon pirates from all over the island are after him, as there is a large bounty on his head.

2024.title: For the Beloved Pupil - The Fist of Vice Admiral Garp!
2024.desc: A massive warship comes flying towards the Pirate Island of Beehive and Vice Admiral Garp launches a crushing attack to save his pupil Koby.

2024.title: The Navy Surprised! The Navy Headquarters' Former Admiral, Kuzan
2024.desc: Kuzan stands in the way of Garp who came to rescue Koby. He was once Garp's pupil, but has now sided with Blackbeard.

2024.title: Let's Go Get It! Buggy's Big Declaration
2024.desc: While the Marines deal with the problems caused by the Cross Guild, Buggy gives a passionate speech to Crocodile, Mihawk, and his crew.

2024.title: Sabo Returns - The Shocking Truth to Be Told!
2024.desc: Sabo starts recounting what happened at Mary Geoise. During the Reverie he witnessed Kuma being the Celestial Dragons' slave.

2024.title: The Holy Land in Tumult! Sai and Leo's Full-Power Blow!
2024.desc: Sabo runs into Kuma's daughter Bonney. Meanwhile, King Cobra of the Kingdom of Alabasta begins asking the Five Elders questions that trouble them.

2024.title: The Entrusted Message! King Cobra's Resolve
2024.desc: King Cobra is surprised by seeing someone sitting on the Empty Throne. When he is subject to a deadly attack, Sabo cuts in to save him.

2024.title: The World Is Shaken! The Ruler's Judgment and the Five Elders' Actions!
2024.desc: Vivi and Wapol try to escape Mary Geoise while Sabo also looks for a way to leave to deliver King Cobra's message to Luffy and Vivi. Meanwhile, Imu orders the Five Elders to test a horrendous weapon.

2024.title: Garp and Kuzan - A Master and a Pupil's Beliefs Clash
2024.desc: At the Pirate Island of Beehive, Vice Admiral Garp deals with an overwhelming number of pirates alone. As he and his fellow Navy soldiers try to escape the island, the former Navy admiral Kuzan stands in their way.

2024.title: The Last Lesson! Impact Inherited
2024.desc: Avalo Pizarro, who merged with the Pirate Island, reaches his giant hand to crush the Navy ship with many soldiers and civilians on board. The wounded Garp gives orders to Koby, Helmeppo, and Prince Grus, and delivers a powerful blow to save the ship.

2025.title: The World Shakes! The Straw Hats' Hostage Situation
2025.desc: As the news about Garp's disappearance and Luffy's hostage situation spreads, a mysterious earthquake suddenly shakes the entire world. Meanwhile, a huge Navy fleet led by Admiral Kizaru surrounds Egghead and listens in as York contacts Mary Geoise to negotiate a deal.

2025.title: Completely Surrounded! The Operation to Escape Egghead
2025.desc: In the Labophase on Egghead, which is completely surrounded by the Navy, Luffy and the others devise a plan to escape the island. However, the Frontier Dome, the laser defense system, cannot be deactivated without York's secret passcode.

2025.title: A Clash of Two Men's Determination! Kizaru and Sentomaru
2025.desc: Navy Admiral Kizaru finally makes landfall on Egghead and Sentomaru, Vegapunk's bodyguard, stands in his way. The two men who were once close now clash violently. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others try their best to move the Sunny to the back side of the island to escape.

2025.title: Looming Despair! Admiral Kizaru's Depressing Mission
2025.desc: Kuma finally reaches Mary Geoise and keeps advancing even without free will or mind. But Fleet Admiral Akainu stands in his way. On Egghead, Kizaru enters the Labophase and delivers a powerful kick to Luffy who tries to stop him.

2025.title: Luffy vs. Kizaru! A Fierce Kaleidoscopic Battle
2025.desc: A bizarre battle between Luffy and Kizaru heats up. Meanwhile, in the Fabiriophase, Bonney is all alone and being chased by the Navy soldiers. Dr. Vegapunk sees this and can't help but leave the Labophase to rescue her, risking his life.

2025.title: The Nightmare Strikes - Godhead of Science & Defense, St. Saturn
2025.desc: Vegapunk successfully wrests back the Pacifistas from the Navy, but another party soon gains control of them. At the same time, Luffy, Zoro, and the others sense an unearthly presence just as a pentagram suddenly appears on Egghead.

2025.title: Kuma's Past - Better Off Dead in This World
2025.desc: Bonney gets captured by St. Saturn, whose enigmatic power keeps Sanji and Franky from saving her. In St. Saturn's clenched fist, she recalls the memories of her father, Kuma. 47 years ago, Kuma was born to a father of a race on the verge of extinction.

2025.title: A History Erased! God Valley of Despair
2025.desc: The human hunt begins and the Celestial Dragons start chasing locals of God Valley and slaves for prizes. Ivankov and Ginny share with Kuma and the others their surprising plan to survive the game. Meanwhile, ships full of infamous pirates start arriving on the island one after another.

2025.title: A Fleeting Moment of Happiness - Kumachi and Ginny
2025.desc: Kuma and Ginny live peacefully in the Sorbet Kingdom eight years after the God Valley Incident. However, their new king initiates a policy of enslaving the poor. Kuma tries to free those who were captured but ends up being imprisoned himself. But a familiar face comes to rescue him.

2025.title: A Pledge to Ginny - Kuma Becomes a Father
2025.desc: Two years after Ginny's abduction, the Revolutionary Army suddenly receives a call from her.

2025.title: To Save His Daughter - Kuma the Timid Pacifist
2025.desc: By fighting off King Bekori who is supported by the World Government, Kuma is put on the wanted list and decides to travel around the world in search of a cure for Bonney's disease. He reunites with Dragon and learns about the Government's eccentric scientist who might be able to cure Bonney.

2025.title: Cruel Fate - Kuma's Decision as a Father
2025.desc: Taking advantage of Kuma's love for his daughter Bonney, the World Government imposes three harsh conditions on him in exchange for her treatment. Kuma agrees to them and Bonney's treatment starts at Laboratory 8 in tandem with the clone development with which Kuma agrees to cooperate.

2025.title: To the Sea Where My Father is! The Future Bonney Chooses
2025.desc: Bonney has been waiting for a letter from her father Kuma who promised to write to her. But with no letters in sight, she turns nine and one day realizes her disease is cured. She then decides to go out to sea to search for her father.

2025.title: Kuma's Life
2025.desc: Bonney sails out to sea in search of her father and rises to prominence. At the same time, Luffy makes his name by defeating the Arlong Pirates and declaring war against the World Government. Watching his actions, Kuma begins to hold a certain belief.

2025.title: I'm Sorry, Dad - Bonney's Tears and Kuma's Fist
2025.desc: The present day on Egghead, Bonney is caught in St. Saturn's grasp, knowing he is responsible for her father's transformation into a cyborg. However, Saturn reveals an even more shocking truth that throws Bonney into despair.

2025.title: Thank You, Dad - Bonney and Kuma's Warm Embrace
2025.desc: Kuma, battered and without free will, approaches Bonney. Overcome with emotion, she tells him she saw all his memories and learned everything that he did for her. Watching the scene, Vegapunk wonders what compelled Kuma to come to Egghead.

2025.title: Destroy Egghead - The Buster Call is Invoked
2025.desc: As an order comes down to evacuate the island in preparation for bombardment, Navy soldiers rush to their ships. Meanwhile, Vegapunk pleads with Saturn to halt the attack, arguing how vital the island is for the future of humanity, but Saturn refuses to listen.

2025.title: An Admired Hero - The Warrior of Liberation Who Saves Bonney
2025.desc: Vegapunk reveals the secret he alone has been keeping regarding the Pacifistas. Meanwhile, Bonney, her back against the wall, hears a familiar rhythm. It's the rhythm that her father taught her along with the legend of the hero he admired.

2025.title: Reliable Reinforcements! Dorry and Brogy Arrive!
2025.desc: The Giant Pirate Crew led by Dorry and Brogy arrive at Egghead, which deeply moves Usopp and the others. Zoro keeps fighting Rob Lucci and the Pacifistas continues to torment the Navy while Luffy shows Bonney how to throw a real punch.

2025.title: Come In, World - Vegapunk's Message
2025.desc: Caribou begs Augur and Devon to let him meet Blackbeard. An order is given to the Navy vice admirals to kill Jewelry Bonney at all costs in order to take back control over the Pacifistas. Sanji flees with the injured Vegapunk while Luffy holds St. Saturn back.

2025.title: Vegapunk's Secret Plan - A Tense Worldwide Broadcast
2025.desc: Suddenly, Vegapunk's broadcast begins and the whole world is taken by surprise. As everyone rushes to set up Video Transponder Snails and screens to watch it, the Five Elders grow concerned and discuss countermeasures.

2025.title: The Worst Nightmare - The Five Elders Come Together
2025.desc: Just like when St. Saturn emerged on Egghead, black lightning strikes and pentagrams appear again. The Pacifistas are rendered immobile by an unknown shadow. Meanwhile, as the time for the Straw Hats to evacuate the island is drawing near, the fight between Zoro and Lucci intensifies.

2025.title: Friends Fight Together! Luffy and the Warriors of Elbaph
2025.desc: Dorry and Brogy finally reunite with Luffy. However, they are still facing St. Saturn and St. Warcury in their alternate forms. Dorry blows a horn to alert his people to prepare to escape, but St. Warcury unleashes a deafening roar.

2025.title: An Imminent Threat - Stussy and Edison's Resolve
2025.desc: Franky and Bonney clash with Navy vice admirals in front of the Elbaph ship. St. Mars tries to find the room from Vegapunk's broadcast. The heavily injured Stussy tells Kaku the reason she chose to stay behind while Edison takes desperate action to help the Straw Hats escape.

2025.title: A Stunning Conclusion - Vegapunk's Great Prediction
2025.desc: Vegapunk's broadcast resumes as people in various locations all over the world listen closely. St. Mars rushes to find the Transponder Snail that is the source of the broadcast while the Straw Hats and their allies clash with the other members of the Five Elders.

2025.title: The Lost History - Joyboy, the First Pirate
2025.desc: Vegapunk's revelation sends shockwaves around the world. St. Saturn abandons his fight with Nami and the others and rushes to stop the broadcast at all costs. Vegapunk goes on to expose another stunning truth, this time about Joyboy, the first pirate.

2025.title: The Void Century - A Revelation About a Sinking World
2025.desc: The severely injured Edison begs Stussy to escape, but she makes a stunning request in exchange. Meanwhile, Vegapunk presents another astonishing disclosure about a past cataclysm and the Ancient Weapons that will fundamentally challenge the beliefs of people everywhere.

2025.title: Get the Ship Moving! The Iron Giant Activates
2025.desc: Vegapunk's revelation shocks even Koby and his fellow SWORD members, leading them to discuss what to do next.

2025.title: Her and Her Father's Dream! Bonney's Free Future
2025.desc: Luffy finally hops on the Elbaph ship along with Dorry and Brogy, but the Five Elders catch up to them and begin their assault. Aboard the burning ship, Bonney hears a familiar sound and then finds a new strength in her memories of her father.

2025.title: Her Father and Mother's Legacy! Bonney's Nika Punch
2025.desc: Zoro and the others who are on the Sunny in the Labophase finally attempt to escape, but at the cost of an unexpected sacrifice. Meanwhile, as Vegapunk concludes his speech, Bonney once again faces St. Saturn, the object of her great hatred.

2025.title: The Upheaval of an Era! The Color of the Supreme King That Leads Luffy
2025.desc: Vegapunk's speech raises the spirits of the pirates across the world, infuriating the Navy and the civilians. However, the broadcast is suddenly cut off while Vegapunk is still speaking. Meanwhile, off the coast of Egghead, the Five Elders are about to deliver the Straw Hats and the Giants a deadly strike

2025.title: The Truth Behind the Secret Plan - Vegapunk Claims Victory
2025.desc: Two weeks before the battle erupted on Egghead, Vegapunk found out someone stole a portion of the Mother Flame. Along with Pythagoras and Shaka, he launched an investigation and identified the culprit, also learning their shocking motivation. Then, for the future of humanity, he resolved himself to make a bold decision.

2025.title: The Promised Horizon - Off to the Long-Awaited Elbaph
2025.desc: York wakes up to see Island Clouds rising, and to her surprise, something is about to be taken away. Meanwhile, at Mary Geoise, the Celestial Dragons realize their food stock is dwindling and become belligerent. Another one of Vegapunk's Satellites, Lilith wakes up and receives astonishing news.

2026.title: The Long-sought Elbaph! The Big Reunion Banquet!
2026.desc: After leaving Egghead, the Straw Hats and the Giant Pirate Crew celebrate their reunion with a big banquet.

2026.title: Nami in a Fix! An Adventure in Block Kingdom
2026.desc: Nami awakens to find herself in a completely unfamiliar place. Giant creatures attack one after another, driving her into a corner. At that moment, she hears a voice calling her name.

2026.title: A Quest in the Land of Mystery! The Secret of the Sun God
2026.desc: Luffy and the others come across a warrior riding a grasshopper.

2026.title: Destroy the Miniature Garden - Escape Block Kingdom!
2026.desc: Pursued by the Sun God, the Straw Hats flee across Block Kingdom at full speed. Amidst the chaos, the Sun God's true objective begins to surface. But as they run, another wall blocks their path. Their breakthrough rests on Luffy's fists.

2026.title: An Encounter on a Snowfield - Loki, the Accursed Prince
2026.desc: Leaving the Block Kingdom behind, Luffy and the others find themselves facing a vast snowy landscape and a massive suspension bridge. They resolve to move forward, only to be halted by approaching figures and a mysterious roar.

2026.title: A Dangerous Deal! Loki of the Underworld and Luffy
2026.desc: Luffy encounters Loki, the Accursed Prince, who offers him a deal. He hints at a connection to Shanks, all while savage beasts crowd around, staring Luffy down. Meanwhile, Zoro and the others on the suspension bridge realize someone is following them.

2026.title: A Gargantuan Wave of Emotion - The Dreamlike Scenery of Elbaph
2026.desc: As the Great Erik, carrying Robin and the others, reaches the island of Elbaph, a breathtaking rainbow stretches out before them. Yet even greater astonishment awaits them in the direction the ship is traveling.

2026.title: I Want You to Praise Me - The Reunion of Robin and Saul
2026.desc: Robin and the others finally arrive at the port of the Western Village in Elbaph.

2026.title: Saul's Resolve - The Inherited Will of Ohara
2026.desc: Robin formally introduces Luffy and the others to Saul. Then his assistant, Ange, shows them around the school, where Usopp is shocked by the education being provided there. Meanwhile, Robin is taken to the library by Saul, where she is met with an incredible sight.

2026.title: A Welcome with Friends' Cups and Intruders Seeking Loki
2026.desc: Robin, Chopper, Bonney, and Lilith enjoy the Owl Library.

2026.title: Encountering Loki - Gunko of the Knights of God
2026.desc: Amidst the roaring banquet with the Giants, Luffy hears the legend of the Sun God passed down in Elbaph and learns why Loki is being held captive. In the Underworld, two mysterious guests appear before Loki, expressing their desire to recruit him into their order of knights.

2026.title: Shamrock Appears - Commander of the Knights of God
2026.desc: Luffy and some of his companions snuck out of the banquet to explore the deceased king's castle.

2026.title: Ancient History - The Harley Passed Down by Elbaph
2026.desc: Leaving behind a brutal parting gift, Shamrock and Gunko of the Knights of God abandon Loki and move on to their next strategy. Meanwhile, Franky is shown old wall paintings, and Robin reads an important religious text passed down since ancient times in Elbaph.

2026.title: The Legend Lurking in Elbaph - The Identity of the Mountain-Eater
2026.desc: While exploring the abandoned castle, Luffy and the others find a strange mark on the floor of the throne room and hear a mysterious voice out of nowhere. At the banquet, Oimo tells Usopp the tale of a legendary man linked to the Pirate King.

2026.title: Get the Key! Luffy vs. Scopper Gaban
The Heinous Sinner - Loki of the Underworld Freed?!
2026.desc: While observing the Jewel Tree Adam along with Ripley, Franky learns of Elbaph's weak points. Meanwhile, in the Underworld, Luffy and Zoro find a heavily injured Loki. As they argue over whether to unchain him, an unexpected turn of events blindsides them.

2026.title: What I Fear Most
2026.desc: A massive snake suddenly attacks the Walrus School. Saul and the other teachers stand their ground to protect the children, but just then, another mystery strikes, plunging the school into pure panic.

2026.title: A Nightmarish Game - The Dark Plot of the Knights of God
2026.desc: Saul tries to stop the marching children, but as he reaches out to them, some unknown force gets in his way. Meanwhile, hearing the school's emergency call throws Dorry and the others at the Western Village into disarray, just as a monster appears before them as well.

2026.title: Save the Children! The Elbaph Warriors Rise Up
2026.desc: As monsters assault villages throughout Elbaph, the Giants scramble to hold them back. Meanwhile, as the sleeping children get closer to the fire, Saul tries everything to stop them, but suddenly, he finds his efforts stymied.

2026.title: Elbaph in Flames! Jinbe's Shoulder Throw Explodes!
2026.desc: In the Underworld, Loki talks about a pirate he idolized when he was young. Meanwhile, in the Sun World, the marching children get closer to the fire. The Elbaph Fire Brigade tries to extinguish the flames, while others beg the children to stop. When all hope seems lost, a lone savior arrives to turn the tide.

2026.title: The Threat of the Arrow-Arrow Fruit - Gunko vs. the Straw Hats
2026.desc: Gunko from the Knights of God shows up right in front of Nami and the others and reveals to them that their plan is to take the children to Mary Geoise. Enraged, the Straw Hats launch an attack, only to be completely overwhelmed by Gunko's extraordinary power.

2026.title: A Despicable Hostage Game - Sommers's Brazen Demands
2026.desc: Nami and the others are now captured by Gunko, and Brook receives a demand he never saw coming. Meanwhile, Sommers from the Knights of God begins speaking to all of Elbaph and reveals their true objective.

2026.title: Protect History and the Future - Robin and Gaban Go on the Attack
2026.desc: One of the marching children, Ronja, is suddenly separated from the group, and Sommers presses Jarul to make an impossible choice. As the Giants bicker over what to do, Robin launches into a reckless move.

2026.title: One Do-or-Die Second - Gaban vs. the Knights of God
2026.desc: Scopper Gaban, the Pirate King's Left Arm, appears before the captured and immobilized Straw Hats, launching a counteroffensive against the Knights of God. Gunko, however, uncovers his weakness.

2026.title: Episode 1180
Episode 1181

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
description: A family is attacked by demons and only two members survive - Tanjiro and his sister Nezuko, who is turning into a demon slowly. Tanjiro sets out to become a demon slayer to avenge his family and cure his sister.
cast: Natsuki Hanae, Akari Kitō, Hiro Shimono, Yoshitsugu Matsuoka
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Cruelty
1.desc: It is the Taisho Period. Tanjiro Kamado is living a modest but blissful life in the mountains with his family. One day, when he returns from selling charcoal in town, he finds his family slaughtered in pools of blood after a demon attack. Tanjiro rushes down the snowy mountain with the sole survivor, his sister Nezuko, on his back. But on the way, Nezuko suddenly snarls, turning on Tanjiro

1.title: Trainer Sakonji Urokodaki
1.desc: At Giyu Tomioka's urging, Tanjiro heads for Mt. Sagiri with his sister Nezuko who's been turned into a demon. During the night, Tanjiro catches the smell of blood from inside a temple. He enters, thinking that someone might be hurt, only to come upon a man-eating demon. When the demon attacks, Tanjiro manages to fight back with his hatchet, but the demon's strength is overwhelming. Just as the demon is about to finish him off, Tanjiro is saved by none other than...

1.title: Sabito and Makomo
1.desc: The Demon Slayer Corps... An organization that's been hunting down demons since ancient times. Sakonji Urokodaki starts training Tanjiro for Final Selection, the test for joining the unit. Navigating a mountain riddled with booby traps, dry sword swings, waterfall immersion and breathing techniques... A year later, Urokodaki informs Tanjiro that he has nothing more to teach him, and gives him one last hurdle to overcome in front of a giant boulder.

1.title: Final Selection
1.desc: To pass Final Selection, one must survive for seven days on Mt. Fujikasane where demons captured by the Demon Slayers have been imprisoned. So begins the battle for survival between the young swordsmen and the demons. Armed with the breathing techniques and stances he'd learned from Sakonji Urokodaki, Tanjiro slashes demon after demon. His two years of training have not gone to waste. But just then, a morphed demon appears out of nowhere.

1.title: My Own Steel
1.desc: When day breaks, there are only four swordsmen left standing after the seven-day battle. The guides who greet Tanjiro and the other survivors explain the Demon Slayer Corps system. All four are issued uniforms and Kasugai Crows as messengers, after which they must select the ore for their own Nichirin Swords. After gazing hard at each lump of ore and using his sense of smell, the one Tanjiro chooses is...

1.title: Swordsman Accompanying a Demon
1.desc: Tanjiro is now clad in the uniform of the Demon Slayer Corps. His Nichirin Sword on his hip, and Nezuko, now awake, in a special box made by Urokodaki on his back, he heads out for his first assignment. A town to the northwest where girls have been vanishing nightly. There, Tanjiro meets Kazumi, haggard with worry after his girlfriend's been abducted. Though he does catch the scent of a demon nearby, there's just no demon in sight. Tanjiro is sure that a demon is behind this sinister incident...

1.title: Muzan Kibutsuji
1.desc: Now split into three, the demons have driven Tanjiro into a corner. It is then that Nezuko attacks. Now that she's become a demon herself, she's no longer so weak that she needs protection. His mind made up, Tanjiro follows one of the demons into the swamp now spreading across the ground. Waiting for him there is...

1.title: The Smell of Enchanting Blood
1.desc: The next mission is in Asakusa, Tokyo. Tanjiro is taken aback by the opulent Taisho Era cityscape, but soon picks up the demon's scent there. His pursuit of the scent leads him to Muzan Kibutsuji. Tanjiro attempts to strike him down. But Kibutsuji transforms a passerby into demon, triggering a commotion. As Tanjiro desperately tries to get things under control, someone appears before him..

1.title: Temari Demon and Arrow Demon
1.desc: It was two demons named Tamayo and Yushiro who came to Tanjiro's rescue. Using the "Eyeblind" spell, Tamayo guides Tanjiro and Nezuko to her house. There, through his conversation with Tamayo, Tanjiro learns that there is a way to return demons to human form. Just then, two demons in pursuit of Tanjiro locate the house and unleash a furious assault...

1.title: Together Forever
1.desc: Tanjiro's crisis continues. He uses multiple forms of the Water Breathing technique to hold out against Yahaba's final Blood Demon Art, the "Kouketsu Arrow." Meanwhile, Nezuko and Susamaru are still battling it out. Worried about the outcome, Tamayo unleashes her own Blood Demon Art.

1.title: Tsuzumi Mansion
1.desc: Tanjiro's next destination, according to his Kasugai Crow, is to the south-southeast. On the way, Tanjiro runs into his fellow Final Selection survivor, the swordsman Zenitsu Agatsuma. Tanjiro has a hard time dealing with Zenitsu's passive attitude as they head deep into the mountains. They encounter two children whose older brother was taken away right in front of their house. There, Zenitsu hears the sound of a tsuzumi ringing out from somewhere.

1.title: The Boar Bares Its Fangs, Zenitsu Sleeps
1.desc: Inside the house, where the rooms spin each time the tsuzumi is played, Tanjiro gets separated from Zenitsu Agatsuma. Without Tanjiro by his side, Zenitsu is overcome by fear and despair as he takes Shoichi through the house. Meanwhile, Tanjiro meets the master of the house, the tsuzumi-playing demon, and an odd-looking man wearing a boar's head mask.

1.title: Something More Important Than Life
1.desc: Every time Kyogai, the master of house, plays his tsuzumi, the room spins and Tanjiro struggles. Debilitated by the fractured bones he sustained in his previous battle, Tanjiro tries to fire himself up as he desperately fights on, but he is overwhelmed by Kyogai's Blood Demon Art. Will he find a way to slice off Kyogai's head?

1.title: The House With the Wisteria Family Crest
1.desc: After a desperate fight to the death, Tanjiro prevails over Kyogai. He exits the house to find Zenitsu who had escaped earlier. But it is then that he sees the strange circumstances before him... The battered Zenitsu holding the box containing Nezuko in his arms while the man in the boar's head mask stands in the way with two Nichirin Swords drawn.

1.title: Mount Natagumo
1.desc: Their next destination is to the north-northwest. Tanjiro and Nezuko head towards Mount Natagumo with Zenitsu and Inosuke. This mountain is covered with spider webs and is swarming with innumerable spiders. Leaving the cowering Zenitsu behind, Tanjiro and Inosuke head up the mountain where they run into fellow Demon Slayers entangled in spider webs.

1.title: Letting Someone Else Go First
1.desc: Tanjiro and Inosuke battle the Demon Slayers trapped by spider webs. After slashing the threads and destroying the webs, they head deeper into the mountain. The farther they advance through the forest, the thicker the threads become, and those under their control start moving in ways impossible for a human being. Stopping the Demon Slayers without hurting them isn't going to be easy, but then Tanjiro makes a certain move...

1.title: You Must Master a Single Thing
1.desc: One of the Twelve Kizuki, a direct subordinate of Muzan Kibutsuji, is here somewhere. When Tanjiro slays the Mother Spider Demon of Mt. Natagumo, he learns that a demon who might hold the key to turning Nezuko back into a human is somewhere in this very forest. With the battered Inosuke in tow, he heads deeper into the forest. Meanwhile, Zenitsu trudges forlornly through the woods only to encounter a spider with a human face

1.title: A Forged Bond
1.desc: Tanjiro and Inosuke face off against the Father Spider Demon of Mt. Natagumo. Tanjiro unleashes an attack, only to get hurled away by the demon's overwhelming power. Landing near a river, he comes upon the young demon Rui torturing the Sister Spider Demon. When Rui calls their bond of terror and hatred "a family's bond," Tanjiro is enraged. So begins the battle between Rui and Tanjiro.

1.title: The Fire God
1.desc: Swordsmen in the Demon Slayer Corps known as Hashiras have arrived on Mt. Natagumo. Giyu Tomioka, the Water Hashira, slays the Father Spider Demon with a single strike. Inosuke, thrilled to see such a display of swordsmanship by someone in a totally different league from himself, challenges Giyu to a duel. Meanwhile, Zenitsu lies near death as the poison circulates throughout his body. Just then, the Insect Hashira, Shinobu Kocho appears before him.

1.title: Pretend Family
1.desc: When Rui assaults him with his Blood Demon Art, Tanjiro braces himself for certain death. As his life flashes before his eyes, he suddenly remembers his father's dance, the kagura, and unleashes a new, non-Water Breathing attack. Hinokami Kagura Dance. Knowing that he'll be receiving a simultaneous blow from the demon, he uses his new move to slice off Rui's head. As Tanjiro crawls towards Nezuko, who lies on the ground, riddled with wounds, someone appears before him.

1.title: Against Corps Rules
1.desc: Seeing Tanjiro try to protect Nezuko even as he collapses triggers memories of Rui's own past. Once a sickly boy, he became a demon after meeting Muzan Kibutsuji who gave him a share of his blood. But after he turns into a demon, his own parents try to kill him. Ever since then, he has been searching for a family. Seeking a bond that he can never hope to acquire..

1.title: Master of the Mansion
1.desc: After the battle is over, Tanjiro and Nezuko are taken to the Demon Slayer Corps headquarters. This is where the Hashira Meeting between the Corps leader, Ubuyashiki, and the Hashiras, the most powerful swordsmen in the Corps, is to be held. The Hashiras censure Tanjiro for violating the Demon Slayer Corps by protecting a demon. And then, the Wind Hashira, Sanemi Shinazugawa, raises his sword against Nezuko...

1.title: Hashira Meeting
1.desc: Ubuyashiki, the leader of the Demon Slayer Corps, finally appears before Tanjiro. He tells him that he will allow Tanjiro and Nezuko to join the Corps. But the Hashiras are unable to accept this decision right away. The Wind Hashira, Sanemi Shinazugawa, slashes his own arm and taunts Nezuko with his blood, trying to get her to show her true colors as a demon

1.title: Rehabilitation Training
1.desc: The injured Tanjiro, Zenitsu and Inosuke are sent to the home of the Insect Hashira, Shinobu Kocho, for treatment. Two weeks later, Tanjiro and Inosuke start rehabilitation training. But the drills are brutal, and they find themselves broken in spirit. Unaware of the grueling regimen, Zenitsu joins them late and is visibly enthusiastic in front of girls, but...

1.title: Tsuguko, Kanao Tsuyuri
1.desc: Tanjiro, who's undergoing rehabilitation training at the Butterfly Mansion, works hard to keep up his Total Concentration Breathing techniques all day long. Though at first, he's helpless against Kanao, a swordswoman in his class who's training him, he slowly but surely begins to make some headway. Seeing Tanjiro devote himself to training every single day, Zenitsu and Inosuke resume training as well, but..

1.title: New Mission
1.desc: As Tanjiro and the others are devoted to their rehabilitation training, the absolute master of the demons, Muzan Kibutsuji, gathers the Lower Ranks of the Twelve Kizuki. The demons, too, are preparing to make their next move. As training draws to a close, Tanjiro has improved to the point where he can fight on equal terms with Kanao. Just then, he receives word of a new mission from his Kasugai Crow.

2.title: Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku
2.desc: Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku receives new orders: Travel to the Mugen Train, where over forty people have gone missing, and conduct an investigation. Leaving the Demon Slayer Corps Headquarters, he sets off on this new mission.

2.title: Deep Sleep
2.desc: Kyojuro Rengoku heads to the Mugen Train to investigate the disappearance of over forty passengers and encounters a demon along the way. After saving the people attacked by the demon, he finally arrives at the Mugen Train. What lies ahead of him?

2.title: Should Have Been
2.desc: Trapped in Enmu's spell, Tanjiro, Zenitsu, Inosuke and Kyojuro fall closer and deeper into an eternal slumber. Faced with death, Tanjiro is forced to confront his demons to save them.

2.title: Insult
2.desc: With Tanjiro successfully awakening from his dream, he confronts the demon responsible, Lower One Enmu. But the situation challenges Tanjiro's resolve when Enmu proves more powerful that any demon he's ever faced.

2.title: Move Forward!
2.desc: The battle with Enmu continues as Inosuke, Zenitsu and Rengoku awaken from the spell. Tanjiro and Inosuke try to pinpoint the demon's weak spot, while the others focus on protecting the passengers in the train.

2.title: Akaza
2.desc: Tanjiro has finally slashed Enmu's neck with the help of Inosuke. The tremors from the train flipped it over the rails. As silence deepens a mysterious figure approaches from behind.

2.title: Set Your Heart Ablaze
2.desc: Akaza continues to offer Rengoku the chance to become a demon to improve his skills. Rengoku refuses his offer and is trying his best to keep up with him. The fire Hashira has one goal:to protect his comrades even if it costs his own life.

2.title: Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui
2.desc: After the Mugen Train incident, Akaza visits Muzan Kibutsuji. Guided by a crow, Tanjiro Kamado heads off to the Rengoku residence to convey Kyojuro Rengoku's last messages to his father and little brother. Tanjiro's group return to the Butterfly Mansion.

2.title: Infiltrating the Entertainment District
2.desc: One day, Tanjiro returns to the Butterfly Mansion and finds Sound Hashira, Tengen Uzui, attempting to take Aoi and Naho away on a mission against their will. Tanjiro, Zenitsu and Inosuke offer to go on that mission instead, and they head to their next destination - the Entertainment District.

2.title: What Are You?
2.desc: After arriving at the Entertainment District, Tanjiro and his comrades infiltrate each House where Uzui's wives, Suma, Makio and Hinatsuru, work. While working as apprentices and searching for their whereabouts, Inosuke hears that Makio has been shutting herself away from everyone in her room.

2.title: Tonight
2.desc: Realizing Zenitsu is now missing, Tanjiro and Inosuke re-arm and look for signs of the demon. Tanjiro goes in alone and is confronted by Upper Rank Six.

2.title: Things Are Gonna Get Real Flashy!!
2.desc: Facing Daki alone, Tanjiro tries to use Hinokami Kagura but is hampered by the extreme stress it causes his body. Inosuke and Tengen locate the demon's victims and meet the demon responsible for abducting Zenitsu and his wives.

2.title: Layered Memories
2.desc: Furious at Daki's disregard for lives, Tanjiro angrily confronts her, causing her to experience Muzan's memories of an old enemy. His excessive use of Hinokami Kagura soon brings him to his knees in pain.

2.title: Transformation
2.desc: As Nezuko rushes to aid Tanjiro during a critical moment, her appearance begins to gradually take on a demon form as she sustains Daki's attacks. Nezuko is able to overpower Daki as her demon form accelerates; however, she turns her attention to innocent bystanders injured during the battle and charges towards them. While Tanjiro attempts to restrain Nezuko, Daki draws near...

2.title: Gathering
2.desc: Uzui battles furiously, taking on both Daki and the other demon who emerged from her body, Gyutaro. But he's gradually losing strength due to the poison from Gyutaro's scythe. Just then, Inosuke, the sleeping Zenitsu, and Tanjiro, who's managed to get Nezuko to sleep, all come rushing to Uzui's aid...

2.title: Defeating an Upper Moon Demon
2.desc: Hinatsuru's use of wisteria poison leaves Gyutaro momentarily vulnerable, but Tanjiro and Uzui's attacks fall just short. Using his Blood Demon Art, Gyutaro vanishes from Uzui's sight only to reappear assaulting Hinatsuru. Tanjiro and Uzui attempt to save her, but they are thwarted by Daki's Belt.

2.title: Never Give Up
2.desc: Amid the wreckage from the buildings destroyed by the destructive attacks of Daki's Belt, Tanjiro awakens. Zenitsu is trapped under the rubble and Inosuke has been impaled by Gyutaro's scythe, while Uzui has lost an arm and his heart has stopped. As Gyutaro taunts Tanjiro by calling him a disgrace, all seems hopeless until...

2.title: No Matter How Many Lives
2.desc: As the fierce battle draws to an end, Tanjiro and Uzui behead Gyutaro just as Zenitsu and Inosuke behead Daki. But then, Gyutaro unleashes a devastating Blood Demon Art, burying the city in rubble. When Tanjiro awakens, he joins Nezuko and Zenitsu, only to find Inosuke and Uzui on the brink of death from Gyutaro's poison...

3.title: Someone's Dream
3.desc: After their battle with the Upper Rank Six siblings, Tanjiro, Zenitsu, Inosuke, and Nezuko are found by the Kakushi. In the Infinity Castle, Muzan Kibutsujisummons the remaining five Upper Rank demons – Akaza, Upper Five Gyokko, Upper Four Hantengu, Upper Two Doma and Upper One Kokushibo. He admonishes them for their failure to kill the Ubuyashikis and find the Blue Spider Lily. When Gyokko provides new information, he is sent on a joint mission with Hantengu. While Zenitsu and Inosuke are summoned to individual missions, Tanjiro continues his rehabilitation. When his swordsmith Hotaru Haganezuka refuses to forge him a new sword, Tanjiro is told to meet him at the Swordsmith Village to discu

3.title: Yoriichi Type Zero
3.desc: While eavesdropping, Tanjiro watches as Muichiro threatens the swordsmith he was arguing with. He tries to defend him but the indifferent Hashira knocks him out for interfering. After waking up, the boy, named Kotetsu, explains that the "man" he saw is actually an advanced mechanical training doll, built after a swordsman who lived over 300 years ago. He explains the doll was made by his ancestors, and as he lacks a family, it is all he has to pass on to the next generation. Tanjiro agrees to protect it, but Muichiro appears, having finished his training session and causing extensive damage. However, after Kotetsu discovers it is still functional, he tells Tanjiro to train with it in order t

3.title: A Sword from Over 300 Years Ago
3.desc: Tanjiro becomes disappointed after he discovers the sword rusted. However, a swole Hagenazuka appears, revealing he trained in solitude to be able to forge a better sword for Tanjiro. As such, he offers to restore the rusty sword, giving Tanjiro another one in the meantime. That night, while trying to befriend Genya, swordsmith Kanamori is brutally devoured by Gyokko who, alongside Hantengu, has found the village. After Muichiro is moved by Tanjiro's sense of kindness towards others, Hantengu enters their room, only to be quickly beheaded. However, two individual demons regenerate from the severed body parts, each with different, powerful abilities. After one of them blasts Muichiro far away

3.title: Thank You, Tokito
3.desc: Muichiro rescues Kotetsu who is being attacked by a goldfish demon; Nezuko and Genya face off against demons; Separated from the others, Tanjiro fights a battle with a demon marked with the word 'Joy'.

3.title: Bright Red Sword
