3.desc: Upon arriving, Mitsuri comes to Tecchin, the chief of the village, and finds out all of his guards have been defeated.

3.title: Aren't You Going to Become a Hashira?
3.desc: Muichiro is trapped in water by Gyokko's Blood Demon Art. Tanjiro and and his comrades have successfully severed the necks off the four demons, but they realize that they cannot be defeated this way.

3.title: Awful Villain
3.desc: As Tanjiro was just about to sever the neck of the fifth demon, another demon approaches from behind him. This demon turns out to be Zohakuten, a demon created by combining all four Emotion Demons into one body, marked with the word "Hatred." Tanjiro makes a narrow escape from the attack and fails to sever the neck of the fifth demon. After hearing Zohakuten calling him and his comrades "awful villains" for trying to sever the neck of the cowering demon, Tanjiro is enraged and decides to face him...

3.title: The Mu in Muichiro
3.desc: With Kotetsu's help, Muichiro finally manages to escape from Gyokko's Blood Demon Art, but he is close to reaching his limit with all of the damage he has sustained. As the goldfish demons draw closer to the battered Muichiro and Kotetsu, Muichiro's memory is awakened the very moment the demons attack. In this memory, he remembers his father, a lumberman, his mother, and his older twin brother, Yuichiro...

3.title: Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito
3.desc: After defeating the goldfish demons, Muichiro heads to the studio where Haganezuka and Kanamori are. There, in order to disrupt Haganezuka's focus on whetting the sword, Gyokko was attempting to take Kanamori for hostage. Muichiro arrives in the nick of time, receives the Nichirin Sword from Kanamori, and challenges Gyokko once again...

3.title: Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji
3.desc: After rescuing Tanjiro who was swallowed by one of the tree dragons, Mitsuri now faces off against Zohakuten in order to save Nezuko and Genya. Mitsuri skillfully fends off the fierce attacks from the tree dragons, but she is struck with a powerful attack from Zohakuten and loses consciousness right before she is able to land a decisive blow. As a killer blow is about to strike down on her, Mitsuri recalls a memory of her past self and her special constitution...

3.title: A Connected Bond: Daybreak and First Light
3.desc: As Mitsuri holds off Zohakuten, Tanjiro, Nezuko and Genya use this time to chase after Hantengu's main body. The three manage to find the tree ball that Hantengu is hiding in, but when they slice it open, they find that it is completely empty. Hantengu makes a run for it again, and Tanjiro and the others continue chasing him. Seeing Hantengu running about, Genya snaps and hurls a tree at him, and Nezuko jumps at him!

4.title: To Defeat Muzan Kibutsuji
4.desc: The Hashira, Sanemi and Iguro, along with their comrades head to an abandoned castle on top of a mountain for a mission, while Tanjiro is being treated at the Butterfly Mansion for the wounds he suffered at the Swordsmith Village. Later on, the Hashira gather at the Ubuyashiki Mansion to hold a Hashira meeting, where Muichiro reveals how the marks manifested. In an effort to strengthen the entire Demon Slayer Corps from the bottom up, the Hashira Training begins...

4.title: Water Hashira Giyu Tomioka's Pain
4.desc: Kagaya's Kasugai Crow suddenly appears in front of Tamayo and invites her to the Demon Slayer headquarters — even though she is a demon. Meanwhile, after receiving a letter from Kagaya at the Butterfly Mansion, Tanjiro pays a visit to Giyu, who is not participating in the Hashira Training. At first, Tanjiro is rejected by Giyu but patiently continues to try to talk to him. Giyu, who gives in to Tanjiro's persistence, begins to share the reason why he won't participate in the training.

4.title: Fully Recovered Tanjiro Joins the Hashira Training!!
4.desc: Tanjiro's wounds have healed, so he first visits the former Hashira, Uzui, to join the Hashira Training. Tanjiro's joy for the reunion with Uzui is short-lived, however, as he will now undergo basic training to boost his physical stamina.

4.title: To Bring a Smile to One's Face
4.desc: After completing training with Uzui, Tanjiro visits the Tokito residence next. The Demon Slayer swordsmen who have already started the training are dispirited by Muichiro's intense training and harsh words. Tanjiro hears the swordsmen discussing if there's anything they can do about it...

4.title: I Even Ate Demons...
4.desc: After completing Mitsuri's training, Tanjiro heads to train with Iguro. When he arrives at the training site, Iguro is waiting for him, visibly angry. Will he be able to complete this horrifying training where he'll have to fix his sword skills?

4.title: The Strongest of the Demon Slayer Corps
4.desc: Tanjiro and Zenitsu head to Himejima's training site deep in the mountains and reunite with Inosuke and Murata. Tanjiro first starts the training by being hit by a waterfall but struggles with the coldness and weight of the water.

4.title: Stone Hashira Gyomei Himejima
4.desc: During the boulder training, Tanjiro is able to move the boulder thanks to Genya's training advice. However, Tanjiro has used all of his power to do so and he is saved by Himejima after he collapses. Himejima, moved by Tanjiro's genuineness, begins to talk to him about his past...

4.title: The Hashira Unite
4.desc: During a silent night when the moon shines, Kagaya finally meets Muzan Kibutsuji, who appears at the Ubuyashiki Mansion. Kagaya is staying alive day-by-day through his steadfast desire to defeat Muzan, while Muzan dreams of eternity. What will these two, bound by a continuous thousand-year fate, talk about?

title: Jujutsu Kaisen
description: A boy swallows a cursed talisman - the finger of a demon - and becomes cursed himself. He enters a shaman's school to be able to locate the demon's other body parts and thus exorcise himself.
cast: Junya Enoki, Yūma Uchida, Yuichi Nakamura, Asami Seto, Nobunaga Shimazaki, Mikako Komatsu
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Ryomen Sukuna
1.desc: Mahito deftly uses Yoshino's admiration toward him to make him fight Itadori. Yoshino races toward vengeance and Itadori exchanges blows with him to try and make him explain his motive, which leads to him learning the cruel truth from Yoshino's lips. That's when Mahito creeps up beside them and--

1.title: For Myself
1.desc: Itadori wakes up in an unfamiliar room and before him rests Gojo Satoru, a teacher at Jujutsu High, who declares Itadori's secret execution has been decided upon. Gojo presents Itadori with two options. He can be executed immediately, or he can hunt down all 20 of Ryomen Sukuna's fingers and die after absorbing all of them...

1.title: Girl of Steel
1.desc: Itadori, Fushiguro, and Gojo head out to meet up with the third first year, Kugizaki Nobara. Thereafter they head to an abandoned building where Gojo tasks Itadori and Kugizaki with exorcising the curses lurking inside. Once inside the building Itadori and Kugizaki split up to look for the curses and Kugizaki faces off against a cunning curse that takes a child hostage.

1.title: Curse Womb Must Die
1.desc: An emergency breaks out at a juvenile detention center and Itadori, Fushiguro, and Kugisaki are dispatched to handle it. Their mission is to rescue any survivors left inside with the curse womb that could develop into a special grade cursed spirit.

1.title: Curse Womb Must Die -II-
1.desc: After retreating outside the juvenile detention center, Fushiguro notices the death of the special grade cursed spirit. The very next moment Ryomen Sukuna appears beside him, and rips Itadori's heart from his body to take him hostage. Fushiguro begins fighting Sukuna to prevent Itadori from dying when he regains control, but he becomes painfully aware of the difference in their strength.

1.title: After Rain
1.desc: Gojo stews in his frustration over Itadori's death. Both Fushiguro and Nobara are depressed by their teammate's death, but they begin their special training with the second year students to get stronger. Meanwhile, Geto and the others begin to make their move. And during all of that, the dead Itadori...

1.title: Assault
1.desc: While in transit Gojo is suddenly attacked by the special grade cursed spirit Jogo. After launching several attacks that never hit--Jogo comes face to face with Gojo's strength. In an instant Gojo returns to Jujutsu High and easily picks up mid-training Itadori which causes Jogo's anger to erupt. He takes his next move, to which Gojo--

1.title: Boredom
1.desc: While they're training for the exchange event, Kugisaki and Fushiguro come face to face with Kyoto's Jujutsu High second years - Zen'in Mai and Todo - who challenge them to a fight. Todo overwhelms Fushiguro with physical strength. Meanwhile, Kugisaki is disgusted by Mai's comments and says something to provoke her, but-

1.title: Small Fry and Reverse Retribution
1.desc: Yoshino Junpei skips school to go to a movie theater, but then he witnesses the classmates who bullied him getting their faces transfigured and dying. He chases after the culprit and calls out to them. Later, Itadori and the ex-salaryman first-grade jujutsu sorcerer, Nanami Kento, storm into the scene of the crime within the theater and encounter two cursed spirits.

1.title: Idle Transfiguration
1.desc: Itadori's plan to expose Yoshino takes a direct turn, while Nanami closes in on Mahito's base.

1.title: Narrow-minded
1.desc: Mahito corners Nanami, but he releases the limiter on his cursed energy, destroying the wall of the underground channel with Ratio Technique: Collapse, and causing rubble to rain down upon them. Meanwhile, Itadori makes contact with Yoshino and they hit it off after talking about movies. He meets Yoshino's mother, and after being invited into their home, more is revealed...

1.title: To You, Someday
1.desc: Mahito deftly uses Yoshino's admiration toward him to make him fight Itadori. Yoshino races toward vengeance and Itadori exchanges blows with him to try and make him explain his motive, which leads to him learning the cruel truth from Yoshino's lips. That's when Mahito creeps up beside them and--

1.title: Tomorrow
1.desc: Nanami steps in at the last second to save Itadori from Mahito's blow. Then Itadori and Nanami match their attacks together to ensure they can exorcise Mahito. Mahito pulls out his transfigured humans in an attempt to mentally drive Itadori into a corner, but Itadori manages to overcome them. As Mahito grows trapped under their rain of blows he senses his pending death and--

1.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 0 -
1.desc: After escaping from Itadori and Nanami, Mojito reunites with Geto and the others to try and move their plan forward. Meanwhile, Jujutsu High is about to host its Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event.

1.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 1 -
1.desc: The Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event's group battle begins. Kyoto's Todo rushes to attack the Tokyo students, but Itadori takes on the role of stopping him and faces off against him. Itadori's overwhelmed by Todo's power, but suddenly Todo asks him what kind of woman is his type--

1.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 2 -
1.desc: Itadori faces Todo's full might while Kugisaki and Panda engage in their own fierce battles.

1.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 3 -
1.desc: Maki's strength stuns Miwa in battle, while Kugisaki chases Nishimiya, who shares Mai's struggles.

1.title: Sage
1.desc: Fushiguro clashes with Kamo's Blood Manipulation, while Inumaki senses a sinister presence approaching.

1.title: Black Flash
1.desc: Outmatched by a cursed spirit, Fushiguro and allies fight to survive until unexpected help arrives.

1.title: Nonstandard
1.desc: Itadori and Todo join the battle against Hanami. Itadori lands his Black Flash, and his Todo unleashes his cursed technique as they keep up their combo attack. Alongside his "brother", Itadori, Todo overwhelms Hanami with his tricky cursed technique and his clever, (self-proclaimed) 530,000 IQ mental CPU, but--

1.title: Jujutsu Koshien
1.desc: Gojo has driven Hanami away with his overwhelming strength. Mahito reunites with Hanami, who's on the verge of death, after stealing Sukuna's fingers and the Special Grade Cursed Object, Death Painting Wombs 1 through 3.

1.title: The Origin of Blind Obedience
1.desc: Three men have died under similar circumstances from a cursed spirit. Investigators discover the victims all attended the same middle school, so Itadori, Fushiguro, and Kugisaki are dispatched to investigate.

1.title: The Origin of Blind Obedience - 2 -
1.desc: In addition to the curse of Yasohachi Bridge, Itadori, Fushiguro, and Kugisaki face off against Kechizu, one of the special grade cursed objects: Cursed Wombs: Death Paintings. The three start fighting within the barrier of Yasohachi Bridge's curse.

1.title: Accomplices
1.desc: Eso and Kechizu face off against Itadori and Kugisaki, but the two begin to rot after they're bathed in the blood of Eso and Kechizu. Driven into a corner, Kugisaki activates Resonance and starts a game of chicken with the brothers.

2.title: Hidden Inventory
2.desc: The jujutsu sorcerers, Utahime Iori and Mei Mei, are dispatched to an ominous manor where several people have gone missing. They infiltrate the manor and attempt to destroy the cursed spirit's barrier, but suddenly the building starts to crumble.

2.title: Hidden Inventory, Part 2
2.desc: Gojo and Geto are assigned to the mission of escorting and erasing the young girl compatible with the Tengen - the Star Plasma Vessel. Amanai Riko is being targeted by the Curse User Group Q, and the religious cult the Star Religious Group.

2.title: Hidden Inventory, Part 3
2.desc: Gojo and Geto beat back the curse users after the bounty placed on Amanai's head when her cell phone rings. A captured Kuroi is displayed on her phone. Gojo tries to bring Amanai back to Jujutsu High, but she insists on going to the negotiations herself.

2.title: Hidden Inventory, Part 4
2.desc: "Let's go home, Riko-chan." The moment Geto extends a hand to Amanai, the worst that could possibly happen does. Geto is left dumbstruck as Toji Fushiguro makes his appearance. Toji then declares that he killed Satoru Gojo.

2.title: Premature Death
2.desc: August 2007. Gojo starts to handle missions on his own, causing Geto to, as well. One day a certain individual appears before Geto. What's the conclusion that led to Gojo becoming the strongest jujutsu sorcerer, and Geto becoming the most evil curse user?

2.title: It's Like That
2.desc: 2018. After finishing a mission one day, Itadori decides to go to the movies, Kugisaki decides to go shopping, and Fushiguro tells them he's going home. After parting ways Kugisaki is approached by a woman who suddenly asks if she was with Itadori-kun.

2.title: Evening Festival
2.desc: The battle between Muta and Mahito continues and reaches its conclusion. Later, on October 31st, a veil is lowered over Shibuya and various jujutsu sorcerer teams assemble around the area.

2.title: The Shibuya Incident
2.desc: Team Mei Mei are reassigned to a veil that has been lowered over Meiji Shrine Station. The team splits up and Yuji encounters a grasshopper curse assigned to protecting the veil. Elsewhere Satoru Gojo encounters Jogo, Hanami, and Choso.

2.title: The Shibuya Incident - Gate Open
2.desc: The battle between Satoru Gojo, Jogo, Hanami and Choso begins. Gojo informs Hanami that they will die first. Yuji encounters a woman who tells him that everyone was turned into monsters and boarded a train. As Gojo's battle continues, the train arrives.

2.title: Pandemonium
2.desc: Now that Satoru Gojo has been sealed, Mechamaru works with Team Mei Mei to inform them about what is going on and has them work on enacting his plan on what to do now.

2.title: Summon
2.desc: Nanami, Fushiguro, and Ino meet up with Itadori, then Nanami issues new orders for the others to work together to lift the veil keeping sorcerers out.

2.title: Dull Knife
2.desc: Yuji and Megumi lift the veil that was keeping sorcerers from entering Shibuya. Nobara and Nitta encounter Shigemo and a battle ensues. Shigemo has the upperhand, but then Nanami arrives with the deaths of the assistant supervisors in mind.

2.title: Red Scale
2.desc: Yuji makes his way to Shibuya Station where he's confronted by Choso. Choso unleashes his Convergence and the battle between him and Yuji commences.

2.title: Fluctuations
2.desc: Mei Mei and Ui Ui fight the Special-Grade Disease Curse summoned by whatever is pretending to be Suguru Geto. Meanwhile, Nanami joins up with Maki and Naobito, but they encounter a cursed spirit with unknown powers.

2.title: Fluctuations II
2.desc: Nanami, Maki, and Naobito are driven to the edge after the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Dagon, activates his Domain Expansion, Horizon of the Captivating Skandha. Fushiguro gives them a glimpse of a way to escape death, then Toji intrudes upon the fight.

2.title: Thunderclap
2.desc: Sukuna refuses to heed Jogo's advice after waking up, instead displaying his overwhelming strength against the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Jogo. Meanwhile, Fushiguro faces off against the rampant Toji with neither being aware of the other's identity.

2.title: Thunderclap II
2.desc: After being severely injured in his fight against Toji, Fushiguro suffers a surprise attack from Shigemo. On the verge of death, Fushiguro desperately heads toward Dougenzaka crossing and summons a certain Shikigami with his Ten Shadows Technique.

2.title: Right and Wrong
2.desc: Itadori reawakens with grievous resolve as he bears witness to the aftermath Sukuna has wrought upon Shibuya. Meanwhile, Nanami continues to fight through packs of transfigured humans in an exhausted haze until Mahito appears before him.

2.title: Right and Wrong II
2.desc: Itadori launches into a back-and-forth battle against Mahito, but he struggles against Mahito's ploy of using average people against him. Meanwhile, Kugisaki encounters one of Mahito's separated bodies as she returns to the battlefield.

2.title: Right and Wrong III
2.desc: Itadori stands in a daze at the disaster before his eyes, his mind already well past its limit. As a curse, Mahito is elated at seeing his ideal sequence of events play out before him, and he prepares to further finish off Itadori.

2.title: Transformation
2.desc: After rescuing Itadori from his predicament, Todo bolsters his morale and encourages him to stand back up. As Mahito kicks things into higher gear, he begins using Soul Multiplicity and Body Repel to unleash omnidirectional attacks.

2.title: Transformation II
2.desc: The moment it appeared Itadori and Mahito's battle to the death was resolved, the being wearing Geto's body asked, "Shall I save you, Mahito?" Itadori immediately recognizes the man before him as the very same one who sealed away Gojo and leaps to attack.

2.title: The Shibuya Incident - Gate Closed
2.desc: Choso begins to realize the identity of the mastermind parasitizing Geto's corpse as sorcerers gather for the final moments of the Shibuya Incident. The special-grade sorcerer, Yuki Tsukumo, comes to the rescue when they're on the verge of death.

3.title: Execution
3.desc: While Yuji grapples with the weight of his sins, Naoya Zen'in and Yuta Okkotsu set out to execute him.

3.title: One More Time
3.desc: After fighting Yuta, Yuji learns his real objective. Megumi asks for Yuji's help to save his sister

3.title: About the Culling Game
3.desc: Itadori and his friends speak with Tengen about Kenjaku's objectives and their plans for the Culling Game.

3.title: Perfect Preparation
3.desc: After going to collect their Cursed Tools, Maki awakens her true potential & slaughters the whole Zen'in Clan.

3.title: Passion
3.desc: Yaga is executed. Yuji and Fushiguro go to Hakari's fight club hoping to meet him and recruit him.

3.title: Cog
3.desc: Fushiguro and Panda fight Kirara to try and persuade them while Yuji attempts to convince Hakari.

3.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1
3.desc: Yuji's group enters two of the colonies and fight the Culling Game's newbie hunters.

3.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1, Part 2
3.desc: Yuji meets Higuruma and tries to persuade him, while Fushiguro is falsely led to Reggie.

3.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1, Part 3
3.desc: Yuji Itadori fights Hiromi Higuruma.

3.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1, Part 4
3.desc: Takaba handles the minions while Fushiguro has his showdown with Reggie.

3.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1, Part 5
3.desc: Fushiguro deploys his Domain Expansion in his climatic fight against Reggie.

3.title: Sendai Colony
3.desc: Okkotsu fights three powerful sorcerers in Sendai Colony.

title: Attack on Titan
description: 100 years ago, titans suddenly appeared on Earth. Soon, human civilization veered on collapse due to the titans. Humans then built a giant wall to defend themselves. Within the giant walls, humans lived in peace, but, 100 years later, the giant wall is broken.
cast: Yui Ishikawa, Yûki Kaji, Marina Inoue
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: To You, in 2000 Years - The Fall of Shiganshina (1)
1.desc: For over a century, humans have been living in settlements surrounded by gigantic walls, which prevent the Titans, giant humanoid creatures who eat humans, from entering. Young Eren Yeager wishes to see the outside world by joining the Recon Corps, as he likens living in the cities to livestock. Despite this, his foster sister Mikasa Ackerman and their mother Carla are against him in joining the Corps. Even after seeing the Recon Corps returning home with large casualties, Eren expresses his interest to join.

1.title: That Day - The Fall of Shiganshina (2)
1.desc: Some of the Shiganshina townsfolk escape to the inner Wall Maria while the soldiers try to hold off the Titans. The soldiers try to close the gate, but one of the Titans rams the gate, breaching Wall Maria, and causing those inside to retreat even further to Wall Rose. During the next year, as a food shortage becomes apparent, the government orders the refugees to work at the farms or fight to reclaim Wall Maria.

1.title: A Dim Light Amid Despair - Humanity's Comeback (1)
1.desc: Eren begins his training with the Cadet Corps, but questions about his painful past overwhelm him. When he struggles with a maneuvering exercise, Berholt and Reiner offer kindly advice.

1.title: The Night of the Closing Ceremony - Humanity's Comeback (2)
1.desc: Annie proves her skill in a sparring session, Jan dreams of serving alongside the King, and graduation day brings shocking revelations - along with a sudden outbreak of violence.

1.title: First Battle - The Struggle for Trost (1)
1.desc: Eren faces off against the Colossal Titan after it appears out of nowhere and knocks a strategic hole in the Rose Wall gate. As Titans swarm the city, the newly graduated Cadets are called in to fight in brutal battle that won't be without casualties.

1.title: The World the Girl Saw - The Struggle for Trost (2)
1.desc: Armin tries to cope with the loss of his friends and allies after Titans massacre his squad. Elsewhere in the city, Mikasa manages to take out several of the monsters, which brings back tragic memories of her past and the first time she met Eren.

1.title: Small Blade - The Struggle for Trost (3)
1.desc: After the retreat bell sounds, many cadets find themselves without enough fuel to scale the wall back to safety. Mikasa begins to lose hope once she hears of the deaths in Armin's squad, but the appearance of a new type of Titan stokes her will to fight.

1.title: I Can Hear His Heartbeat - The Struggle for Trost (4)
1.desc: Armin comes up with a risky plan that pits Titan against Titan as the abandoned Cadets attempt to take back their headquarters. Getting into the building might be possible, but getting out alive and refueled will mean facing more of the giants.

1.title: Whereabouts of His Left Arm - The Struggle for Trost (5)
1.desc: A miraculous return is met with anger and fear. Cannons are fixed on Eren as he struggles to remember what happened to him inside the belly of a monster and how he ended up humankind's enemy. One question is all that matters: is Eren human or Titan?

1.title: Response - The Struggle for Trost (6)
1.desc: Cadets respond to Eren's terrifying transformation with doubt and fear as he struggles to understand it himself. If Armin can't talk the commander into using Eren's newfound powers for the good of humankind, all hope of stopping the Titans might be lost.

1.title: Idol - The Struggle for Trost (7)
1.desc: Plans are created to use Eren's Titan powers to seal the hole in the wall in an attempt reclaim Trost. But with the government's bloodstained history and vocal dissenters in the military ranks, the biggest threat to humankind may not be the Titans.

1.title: Wound - The Struggle for Trost (8)
1.desc: The plan to reclaim Trost falls apart when Eren's newfound powers turn him into a mindless giant. As Titans continue to swarm the city, it's up to Armin and Mikasa to make sure the cadets massacred during the mission haven't died in vain.

1.title: Primal Desire - The Struggle for Trost (9)
1.desc: After the skirmishes between the cadets and the Titans come to a close, the soldiers of Trost see Eren carrying the boulder to the breach and defend him with their lives.

1.title: Can't Look Into His Eyes - Eve of the Counterattack (1)
1.desc: A special military tribunal will decide Eren's fate. The Military Police calls for his execution while the Scout Regiment argues that he is a powerful resource for humankind, and Mikasa is put on the spot when asked about the events of the Trost mission.

1.title: Special Operations Squad - Eve of the Counterattack (2)
1.desc: The Scout Regiment moves Eren to an old abandoned castle where he will continue his training. Hanzi visits and reveals that she's been putting two captured Titans through a series of tests and trials - experiments that she wants Eren's help with.

1.title: What Needs to Be Done Now - Eve of the Counterattack (3)
1.desc: Everyone is a suspect in the investigation to find out who killed the two test-subject Titans. Meanwhile, the Cadets pick which corps they'll be joining, but after the harrowing events in the Trost attack, many are uncertain which branch to choose.

1.title: Female Titan - The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (1)
1.desc: As the Scout Regiment begins its push toward Shiganshina, they encounter an intelligent Female Titan unlike any they've seen before. When Armin hypothesizes that it's really a human that's been turned into a Titan, he, Jean, and Reiner attempt to stop it.

1.title: Forest of Giant Trees - The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (2)
1.desc: Armin, Reiner, and Jean are left stranded after their encounter with the Female Titan. Meanwhile, news reaches the centre group about their right flank being annihilated by the Female Titan as the latter continues to wreak havoc within the formation.

1.title: Bite - The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (3)
1.desc: Levi fires a noise round and tells the squad to keep moving forward. With more of the rearguard getting killed by the Female Titan, Eren begs his squad to let him fight but they tell him to trust Levi's decision. Eren starts remembering when Hange, Levi, and his squad had him try to transform into a Titan for experimental purposes.

1.title: Erwin Smith - The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (4)
1.desc: The Female Titan has been captured, and it's Erwin's goal to find out who the human is lurking inside it. Meanwhile, the Scouts realize that the reason Levi told no one about their true mission outside the wall is because there is a spy among their ranks.

1.title: Crushing Blow - The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (5)
1.desc: The mole transforms into the Female Titan. Eren wants to transform into his Titan form, but the squad tells him to trust in their skills and keep moving forward.

1.title: The Defeated - The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (6)
1.desc: Levi orders Mikasa to distract the Female Titan in order to get Eren back. As the Corps mourn, count their dead, and retrieve the bodies before returning home, Erwin orders that the fallen whose bodies were not retrieved be reported MIA.

1.title: Smile - Assault on Stohess (1)
1.desc: In the Stohess District of Wall Sina, the Military Police are ordered to escort the Recon Corps convoy once they enter the capital. After the convoy has entered Stohess, Annie is secretly called by Armin in the alleyways.

1.title: Mercy - Assault on Stohess (2)
1.desc: Days before Eren is escorted to the capital, Erwin and Armin reveal to him they have a plan to capture the person they believe is the Female Titan. Back in the present, Eren, Armin and Mikasa manage to escape a tunnel collapse while being hunted by the Female Titan.

1.title: Wall: Raid on Stohess District (3)
1.desc: The battle between Eren and the Female Titan brings devastation to Stohess, leading up to a final struggle between the Titans near a damaged Wall Sina.

2.title: Beast Titan
2.desc: Coupled with the military's coverup of a previous incident, the shocking discovery inside the wall causes a stir. Elsewhere, while the new scout recruits are held for observation, a surprising threat appears.

2.title: I'm Home
2.desc: The source of the Titan's strength is revealed.

2.title: Southwestward
2.desc: The Scouts search for a hole in the wall while Eren and the others learn that someone close may be hiding all the answers.

2.title: Soldier
2.desc: The Scouts depend on a secret as the castle is assaulted.

2.title: Historia
2.desc: Krista and Ymir become lost in the mountains as they attempt to save a fellow cadet who becomes lost in a blizzard during winter training.

2.title: Warrior
2.desc: Ymir is taken to receive medical help by the Scouts after the end of the battle.

2.title: Close Combat
2.desc: When a new enemy appears on the scene, Eren and the Scouts fight back.

2.title: The Hunters
2.desc: When the Titan's body hits the earth, heat and steam is released allowing the Armored Titans to free itself.

2.title: Opening
2.desc: Erwin leads the expedition away from Wall Rose and Hange demands a horse ride to visit a captured TItan.

2.title: Children
2.desc: The group finally flees and Ymir debates lying or staying true to herself.

2.title: Charge
2.desc: Commander Erwin charges forth to conquer the Armored Titan.

2.title: Scream
2.desc: Eren confronts a Titan, which results in doubts about his abilities.

3.title: Smoke Signal
3.desc: After barely surviving Eren's recovery, a rising threat from the shadows puts everyone's lives in danger again.

3.title: Pain
3.desc: The Scouts take a stand against a new enemy, but it's not just Titans they'll be fighting anymore.

3.title: Old Story
3.desc: Historia and Erwin look back on their past, revealing a shady government with a hidden agenda and inspiration for an uprising.

3.title: Trust
3.desc: On the run and running out of time, the Scouts must entrust their lives to others if they plan on surviving.

3.title: Reply
3.desc: Erwin pleads his case for the Scouts to be spared, but an unforeseen announcement puts the fate of humanity at risk.

3.title: Sin
3.desc: While sins of the past reveal new truths, both sides prepare for the upcoming showdown before they run out of time.

3.title: Wish
3.desc: As battle breaks out to prevent the ritual, Historia makes a shocking decision which leads to catastrophe.

3.title: Outside the Walls of Orvud District
3.desc: When everything falls apart, Eren must believe in himself to save his friends. But Eren alone may not be enough to stop the impending doom.

3.title: Ruler of the Walls
3.desc: The survey corps and the wall garrison must protect the Orvud District from the impending attack of Rod Reiss's titan.

3.title: Friends
3.desc: Kenny recalls the life which has brought him to death's door, but he gets to decide whether to live on or not.

3.title: Bystander
3.desc: Having seen a glimpse of his father's memories, Eren attempts to track down a man hoping they might shed some light on his father's secrets.

3.title: Night of the Battle to Retake the Wall
3.desc: The Scouts gather for a feisty feast before leaving to retake Wall Maria to uncover what's hidden in the basement once and for all.

3.title: The Town Where Everything Began
3.desc: The Scouts arrive in Shiganshina as part of the operation to retake Wall Maria, but while investigating the area, they stumble upon something suspicious.

3.title: Thunder Spears
3.desc: Against a rush of enemies, the Scouts scramble to defend their horses. But despite falling into a trap, they have their own surprise for the Armored Titan.

3.title: Descent
3.desc: Despite their efforts, the Scouts face impending disaster in Shiganshina.

3.title: Perfect Game
3.desc: While one front in the battle is rained on by flames, the other is battered by boulders. With no way out, the Scouts are forced to fight or die trying.

3.title: Hero
3.desc: As Erwin's heroic charge buys Levi time to confront the Beast Titan, Armin comes up with a plan of his own that lays it all on the line.

3.title: Midnight Sun
3.desc: While picking up the pieces from the costly battle, tensions rise when deciding which of the wounded Scouts to use the single syringe on.

3.title: The Basement
3.desc: The Scouts reflect on all they have gained and lost in their mission. With their enemies gone, Eren and the Scouts finally enter the basement to uncover the truth that will change everything.

3.title: That Day
3.desc: A look into Grisha's memories shows Eren the many secrets his father was hiding, including one which led to his mother's demise.

3.title: The Attack Titan
3.desc: Eren learns the truth about his Titan powers, his Father and himself. The Survey Corps have a meeting that discusses the future of Eldia with all their new information.

3.title: Beyond the Wall
3.desc: Scouts will be go outside the walls again and they will reach the same place where Grisha and The Owl were talking and Armin,Eren and Mikasa and other scouts will see the Sea for the first time.

4.title: Other Side of the Sea
4.desc: As Marley battles the Mid-East Alliance to end a four-year war, a group of Warrior candidates on the front lines compete to be the successor of the Armored Titan.

4.title: Midnight Train
4.desc: Though glad the war is over, both the Eldian Warriors and Marley brass realize that neither have a future unless they finish the job of retaking the Founding Titan.

4.title: The Door of Hope
4.desc: Reiner reflects on his past, remembering what pushed him to become a Warrior and keep moving forward when all hope was lost.

4.title: From One Hand to Another
4.desc: A sudden visit from the Tybur family shakes up the Marleyan military. Meanwhile, Falco smuggles letters for a friend and helps two old comrades reunite.

4.title: Declaration of War
4.desc: While Willy Tybur reveals the truth in a shocking speech to the world, tensions rise behind the stage as Eren and Reiner meet face to face.

4.title: The War Hammer Titan
4.desc: Eren's rampage is thwarted by the War Hammer Titan whose tenacity leaves him stumped. With Marley's military joining the fight, he'll be hard-pressed to survive on his own.

4.title: Assault
4.desc: The forces of Paradis begin their assault, but the Warriors stand their ground. As Marley troops close in around them, Eren struggles to break the War Hammer's defenses

4.title: Assassin's Bullet
4.desc: With no Titans left to threaten their escape, the Scouts retreat on the airship. Determined to make them pay for trampling on her home, Gabi chases after with gun in hand

4.title: Brave Volunteers
4.desc: As Paradis deals with the aftermath of the raid on Liberio, Armin looks back in the past to meeting the volunteer soldiers who reshaped their world.

4.title: A Sound Argument
4.desc: Two years ago, Paradis welcomed their first visitor who was surprised to see one of their own. Obtaining their help will be critical in a three-part plan to protect Paradis.

4.title: Impostors
4.desc: Trapped on the world's most dangerous island, Falco and Gabi will do anything to survive. Elsewhere, the public demands answers when they learn the savior of Paradis has been detained.

4.title: Guides
4.desc: While Hange and Pyxis piece together Zeke's true intentions, tension builds outside HQ where Armin and Mikasa plead for permission to speak with Eren.

4.title: Children of the Forest
4.desc: Gabi and Falco seek out a fellow Marleyan who's surprised to see Warrior candidates. The truth of what happened at Ragako may shed some light on Zeke's secret plans.

4.title: Violence
4.desc: Armin and Mikasa speak with Eren, but are astounded by what he says. In the forest, Levi considers feeding the Beast Titan to someone new, but Zeke has other plans in mind.

4.title: Sole Salvation
4.desc: A look into Zeke's past shows his struggle to become a Warrior. His plans to end the suffering of all Eldians stems from a chance friendship made in his youth.

4.title: Heaven and Earth
4.desc: With the Jaegerists now in charge, Zeke's master plan is revealed. But before it is put in motion, Eren recruits help to flush out any invaders in their midst.

4.title: Judgement
4.desc: Caught off guard by Marley's surprise attack, Eren fends off their Titans alone. As the battle rages on above, the Scouts consider Eren's motives from the underground dungeons.

4.title: Sneak Attack
4.desc: The Beast Titan joins the fray, but General Magath is determined to take him down. Meanwhile, with the city in flames, Colt and Gabi rush to rescue Falco who's held captive by the Jaegerists.

4.title: Two Brothers
4.desc: Colt pleads with Zeke to not use his scream and turn Falco into a Titan. All the while, soldiers and Titans clash in battle as Eren struggles to make contact with his brother.

4.title: Memories of the Future
4.desc: After Zeke makes contact with Eren, he shows him memories of Eren's and Grisha's past.

4.title: From You, 2,000 Years Ago
4.desc: Ymir, the founder, unveils her tragic past and deepest secrets within the walls.

4.title: Thaw
4.desc: As Eren and the Wall Titans march to trample the rest of the world, the Survey Corps defend the Shiganshina District against the Pure Titans.

4.title: Sunset
4.desc: Hitch Dreyse unexpectedly reunites with Annie and helps her escape the ruins of Trost District. Meanwhile, Armin and Gabi try catching up with Conny before he can sacrifice Falco to make his mother human again.

4.title: Pride
4.desc: Armin tries to save Falco from Conny's attempt to feed him to his mother's Titan in order to restore her humanity. Back in Shiganshina District, Floch Forster begins the execution proceedings for Yelena and Onyankopon.

4.title: Night of the End
4.desc: Deep in the forest, an unlikely rabble of Marley stragglers and island fugitives attempt to set their hatred aside and talk around a campfire without killing each other.

4.title: Traitor
4.desc: The flying boat is guarded by a port full of Jaegerists, but the Scouts are reluctant to kill their former friends. If they wish to avoid bloodshed, they can't afford their plan to go wrong

4.title: Retrospective
4.desc: For the flying boat to take off, the mechanics need half a day to service it. Knowing they'll never last that long with Jaegerist reinforcements on the way, the crew is forced to change their plans.

4.title: The Dawn of Humanity
4.desc: Regardless of where it all began, Eren commits to his path of destruction during the Scouts' first visit to the Marleyan mainland, leaving Mikasa to wonder if things could've been different.

4.title: Attack on Titan: The Final Chapters (Part One)
4.desc: Chapter 1 - The Rumbling : The Rumbling continues, with the Colossal Titans killing countless people, including Ramzi and his brother and Grisha's parents, and destroying civilizations all over the world. Meanwhile, the ship carrying the scouts and warriors arrive at Odiha. Thinking her father is already dead, Annie decides to stay behind on the ship with Gabi, Falco, Yelena, and the Azumabito, while the remaining warriors, scouts, and Onyankopon take the flying boat to stop Eren. The next day, just as the group are about to take off, Floch, having survived the battle at the port, damages the hull of the flying boat before being killed by Mikasa. However, before the flying boat can be proper

4.title: Attack on Titan: The Final Chapters (Part Two)
4.desc: Eren, as the Founding Titan, advances on Fort Salta with countless other Titans. Appearing before the refugees, who stand on the brink of despair, are Mikasa, Armin, Jean, Conny, Reiner, Pieck, and Levi, who narrowly escaped from the rumbling. The battle between former comrades and childhood friends with Eren concludes here.

title: My Hero Academia
description: Izuku has dreamt of being a hero all his life—a lofty goal for anyone, but especially challenging for a kid with no superpowers. That’s right, in a world where eighty percent of the population has some kind of super-powered "quirk," Izuku was unlucky enough to be born completely normal.
cast: Daiki Yamashita, Nobuhiko Okamoto, Yûki Kaji, Ayane Sakura, Kaito Ishikawa, Kenta Miyake
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Izuku Midoriya: Origin
1.desc: Izuku Midoriya desperately wants to be a hero, but he is one of the few in his generation born without a Quirk. Will meeting the number one hero, All Might, change his fate?

1.title: What It Takes to Be a Hero
1.desc: Izuku accidentally learns of All Might's secret, but there's trouble in town again before Izuku has time to process it. Will All Might be able to save the day again?

1.title: Roaring Muscles
1.desc: All Might reveals Izuku's quirk can transfer strength from person to person, then he designs a training course to prepare for the transfer.

1.title: Start Line
1.desc: After obtaining All Might's Quirk, the time has come for Izuku to attend the exams for the prestigious U.A's entrance exam.

1.title: What I Can Do for Now
1.desc: It is the first day at the U.A. High School and Izuku faces possible expulsion as his teacher decides to hold a physical test to see how students use their quirks.

1.title: Rage, You Damn Nerd
1.desc: The Quirk students form teams of good and bad to test their quirks and Izuku faces a challenge.

1.title: Deku vs. Kacchan
1.desc: Izuku and Bakugo continue their mock battle with Izuku trying to figure out how to deal with giving his body time to adjust to the strength of the Quirk.

1.title: Bakugo's Start Line
1.desc: After loosing to Izuku, Bakugo watches the rest of his classmates and broods about what he should have done during the training battle.

1.title: Yeah, Just Do Your Best, lida!
1.desc: Izuku gives away his position as class president to Iida after Iida preforms a selfless act, the students go to a new training ground.

1.title: Encounter with the Unknown
1.desc: Izuku Midoriya gets the superpower 'quirk' after he rescues his childhood bully from a villain.

1.title: Game Over
1.desc: The students combat the villains and Lida manages to escape with the help of his friend.

1.title: All Might
1.desc: All Might has finally shown up, but will he be able to defeat Nomu and save the day?!

1.title: In Each of Our Hearts
1.desc: The battle as USJ begins to wind down, raising questions about repercussions.

2.title: That's the Idea, Ochako
2.desc: After their face-off, Deku and the rest of his classmates are informed about the much awaited sports tournament.

2.title: Roaring Sports Festival
2.desc: Deku is under pressure because of expectations on him during the sports festival.

2.title: In Their Own Quirky Ways
2.desc: The sports festival takes off with the first event. Deku is in the lead in spite of not using his quirk.

2.title: Strategy, Strategy, Strategy
2.desc: Deku. Ochaco, Mei and Fumikage team up together as the second event of the sports festival is about to start.

2.title: Cavalry Battle Finale
2.desc: Thanks to his great observations skills, Deku's team manages to sail through the challenge.

2.title: The Boy Born with Everything
2.desc: Shoto has a talk with Deku regarding his own situation after he suspects that Deku and All Might may have a connection.

2.title: Victory or Defeat
2.desc: The face off between Deku and Shinso starts. Deku manages to tame Shinso and begins to walk toward the periphery.

2.title: Battle On, Challengers!
2.desc: The tournament goes on. Shoto's hatred for his father helps him beat his rival and he moves on to the next round.

2.title: Bakugo vs. Uraraka
2.desc: The battle between Bakugo and Ochaco begins, but Ochaco is not able to use her quirk on Bakugo.

2.title: Shoto Todoroki: Origin
2.desc: The Deku and Shoto fight begins. Deku throws safety to the winds by using his quirk on Shoto who in turn uses his ice quirk.

2.title: Fight On, Iida
2.desc: Shoto is struggling with the decision of whether or not to use the quirk from his fathers side.

2.title: Todoroki vs. Bakugo
2.desc: The final between Shoto and Bakugo begins. Shoto has had a dilemma ever since the end of his fight with Deku.

2.title: Time to Pick Some Names
2.desc: With the sports event finished, the students are asked to pick their Hero names once they attend their class.

2.title: Bizarre! Gran Torino Appears
2.desc: While everyone adjusts to their new tasks, Izuku starts training with Gran Torino, the same man who taught All Might.

2.title: Midoriya and Shigaraki
2.desc: The U.A. students are finally starting to get the hang of their internships, but Izuku has much more to learn about One For All.

2.title: Hero Killer: Stain vs U.A. Students
2.desc: Stain strikes again, and this time some U.A. students are around when it happens. Will they be able to hold him off until the pros come?

2.title: Climax
2.desc: It all comes to a head as Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki face off against Stain while the pro heroes in Hosu City fight against the Nomus.

2.title: The Aftermath of Hero Killer: Stain
2.desc: Stain is finally captured, but now the hero community must deal with the consequences of their actions.

2.title: Everyone's Internships
2.desc: As Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki recover from their fight with Stain, the other members of Class 1-A work hard at their own internships.

2.title: Listen Up!! A Tale from the Past
2.desc: The students return to their daily lives while All Might has a special history lesson for Izuku. It's time to learn about One For All!

2.title: Gear Up for Final Exams
2.desc: Finals are coming up, and Class 1-A is going to need more than a cram session. This year, the teachers are changing the practical exams.

2.title: Yaoyorozu: Rising
2.desc: The exams are turning out to be much more challenging than the students expected. Can any of the teams hold their own against a teacher?

2.title: Stripping the Varnish
2.desc: As the students of Class 1-A fight in their practical exams, their resolve to become heroes is put to the test.

2.title: Katsuki Bakugo: Origin

8.desc: Izuku dives deep into Shigaraki's mind, in search of the villain's origin: the tragic Tenko Shimura.

8.title: Izuku Midoriya: Rising
8.desc: After All For One takes over Shigaraki's body, the heroes must fight as one big team to defeat him.

8.title: Epilogue / The Hellish Todoroki Family: Final
8.desc: With the long conflict over at last, the time has come to rebuild. Both on a societal and personal level.

8.title: The Girl Who Loves Smiles
8.desc: The struggle against the villains may be over, but Izuku and Ochaco both still have internal demons to face.

8.title: My Hero Academia
8.desc: How has the world changed in the eight years since Izuku and the heroes defeated All For One and Shigaraki?

title: Hunter x Hunter
description: Gon, a young boy who lives on Whale Island, dreams of becoming a Hunter like his father, who left when Gon was still young.
cast: Megumi Han, Mariya Ise, Miyuki Sawashiro, Keiji Fujiwara, Daisuke Namikawa
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Departure × and × Friends
1.desc: Gon must fulfill a promis to Mito-san to take the hunter exam, the hunter candidates encounter problems during the sea voyage to the hunter test site.

1.title: Test × of × Tests
1.desc: Gon searches for a ship to take him to Dolle Island; Leorio saves Gon from falling prey to a trickster.

1.title: Rivals × in × Survival
1.desc: Gon, Kurapika and Leorio arrive at the exam site.

1.title: Hope × and × Ambition
1.desc: In the first phase of the exam the participants have to follow the first examinert hrough a tunnel. Gon befriends Killua on his run to the exit.

1.desc: The participants in the exam emerge from the long tunnel to find themselves in a foggy wetland.

1.title: A × Surprising × Challenge
1.desc: The Gourmet Hunters Menchi and Buhara task the applicants to cook a pork dish for the Second Phase.

1.title: Showdown × on × The Airship
1.desc: Chairman Netero challenges Gon and Killua to a game of skill, which Gon refuses to lose.

1.title: Beware × of × Prisoners
1.desc: Gon faces off against Sedokan and Majtani faces off against Kurapika who reveals a startling and scary secret.

1.title: Trick × to × The Trick
1.desc: A technicality complicates the end of Majitani and Kurapika's fight; Togari confronts Hisoka.

1.title: Trouble × with × The Gamble
1.desc: Leorio bets away all of his team's hours; Killua demonstrates his skills in the next match.

1.title: Last Test × of × Resolve
1.desc: The participants must endure a extended waiting period.

1.title: Letter × from × Gon
1.desc: Aunt Mito receives a letter from Gon summarizing his journey so far.

1.title: Hit × the × Target
1.desc: As the fourth phase of the exam begins, participants draw random numbers to determine their targets.

1.title: Explosion × of × Deception
1.desc: Gon uses the Bloodcrazy Butterflies to track Hisoka; Leorio tries to steal back his own tag.

1.title: Defeat × and × Disgrace
1.desc: New partners Kurapika and Leorio encounter Hisoka and try to avoid fighting; Gon uses his fishing skills to steal Hisoka's tag at a crucial moment.

1.desc: Killua deals with the hunter tailing him; Gon, Leorio and Kurapika team up to take Ponzu's tag.

1.title: タイセツ×ナ×メンセツ
1.desc: Gon and his fellow hunters must escape from a cave full of snakes; Netero holds interviews.

1.title: カテナイ×ガ×マケナイ
1.desc: Gon and the other participants begin a one-on-one tournament that has a strange scoring system. Gon fights Hanzo in the first match.

1.title: フカカイ×ナ×テンカイ
1.desc: Gon passes the Hunter Exam, much to his own astonishment; Gittarackur goes on the warpath.

1.title: キョウダイ×ノ×モンダイ
1.desc: After Iilumi's actions force Killua to kill, Gon vows to make things right; the group heads toward Kukuroo Mountain to save Killua from his family.

1.title: キケン×ナ×バンケン
1.desc: Gon, Kurapika and Leorio arrive at Kukuroo Mountain and are welcomed by its servants and watchdog.

1.title: バンニン×ノ×セキニン
1.desc: Gon and his friends pass through the gate; a new challenge is encountered and Killua's circumstance is revealed.

1.title: ゾルディック×ノ×カゾク
1.desc: While Gon and his friends get closer to the mansion, Killua faces his father.

1.title: ミエナイ×ト×アエナイ
1.desc: While Gon waits to finally see his friend, the butler gives him one final test.

1.title: アレカラ×ト×ソレカラ
1.desc: Gon writes a letter to Aunt Mito detailing the Hunter exams final phase.

1.title: トウギジョウ×ニ×トウジョウ
1.desc: Gon and Killua arrive at Heaven's Area and meet Zushi. Killua thinks that he may have discovered his brothers power type.

1.title: ネン×ト×ネン
1.desc: Wing explains the four basic principles of Nen to Gon, Killua and Zushi.

1.title: カクセイ×ト×カノウセイ
1.desc: Wing's training helps open Gon and Killua's aura nodes so they can pass through the barrier.

1.title: ゲキトウ×ト×カットウ
1.desc: Gon learns the nature of Gido's techniques, but still faces a tough fight; Kurapika gets rejected.

1.title: インネン×ト×シュウネン
1.desc: After Wing bans Gon from practicing Nen, Sky Arena hosts a revenge match between Hisoka and Kastro.

1.title: ドッキリ×ナ×ショウリ
1.desc: Kastro's Nen double puts Hisoka at a disadvantage and he ends up loosing both of his arms in the fight.

1.title: ケイハク×ナ×キョウハク
1.desc: Gon, now recovered, continues his Nen training; Zushi gets kidnapped; Killlua fights Sadaso.

1.title: ジツリョク×デ×セツジョク
1.desc: Gon and Killua fight Riehvelt and Gido; Hisoka praises Gon and offers to fight him.

1.title: セイカク×ナ×ゴウカク
1.desc: Gon finally gets his fight with Hisoka.

1.title: オオキナカリ×ト×チイサナケリ
1.desc: Gon successfully lands a punch as the match with Hisoka reaches its conclusion.

1.title: ジン×ト×ゴン
1.desc: Gon arrives at Whale Island and receives a box from his father containing three gifts.

1.title: オヤジ×ノ×ヘンジ
1.desc: Gon listens to his father's message through the cassette tape; Gon and Killua grab some information about the memory card from the item box.

1.title: ネガイ×ト×チカイ
1.desc: Kurapika learns about Nen from his teacher and then leaves his master Mizuken in order to get a job; He finds himself in an interview for someone who has a lead on the Phantom.

1.title: ノウリョクシャ×ハ×キョウリョクシャ？
1.desc: Kurapika and the other applicants fight the assailants in order for them to escape the mansion.

1.title: ゴウケツ×ノ×シュウケツ
1.desc: After receiving information from Milluki, Gon and Killua research Greed Island. At the Nostrade Manor, the new employees meet their boss for the first time.

1.title: マモル×ト×セメル
1.desc: Gon and Killua meet back up with Leorio and continue to try and make some money. The Phantom Troupe moves out.

1.title: ショウゲキ×ノ×サンゲキ
1.desc: The Phantom Troupe attacks the underground auction, but their prize eludes them.

1.title: ゲキセン×ノ×フクセン
1.desc: Uvogin's actions prompt the mafia to release their secret weapon, the Shadow Beasts.

1.title: コウソク×ト×ヤクソク
1.desc: Kurapika can't capture Uvogin, and he has trouble containing his rage as Uvogin issues demands.

1.title: オウモノ×ト×マツモノ
1.desc: In a random deceased persons apartment, Uvogin drinks beer after beer to get the poison out of his system while Shalnark searches the Hunter's website in an effort to discover where Uvogin was being held prisoner.

1.title: セイヤク×ト×セイヤク
1.desc: Kurapika encounters Uvogin, a member of the Phantom Troupe who eliminated his Kurta clan.

1.title: メキキ×ノ×キキメ
1.desc: Gon, Killua and Leorio want to buy Greed Island, but first have to raise enough money to make the purchase.

1.title: ツイセキ×デ×ブンセキ
1.desc: The Phantom Troupe captures Gon and Killua, who are questioned about the chain user that the Troupe seeks.

1.title: ナカマ×ト×カタナ
1.desc: After being brought to the Phantom Troupe's hideout, Gon and Killua are held captive by Nobunaga.

1.title: ヒジョウ×ノ×センジョウ
1.desc: The auction gets rescheduled; the Mafia think the Phantom Troupe will attack again.

1.title: シュウゲキ×ト×ショウゲキ
1.desc: The Troupe mount a massive, powerful attack at the auction, and the Ten Dons' hired assassins struggle to keep up.

1.title: フェイク×デ×サイク
1.desc: Kurapilia is surprised to find out that the leader of the Phantom Troupe has been killed, and wants to get a glimpse of the body.

1.title: ウラナイ×ガ×アタラナイ？
1.desc: Gon, Killua, Kurapika and Leorio reunite, and Kurapika informs the others of his nen powers.

1.title: ナカマ×ト×イカサマ
1.desc: Chrollo does some fortune-telling for all the Troupe members, and they begin to suspect Hisoka of betrayal.

1.title: サイアイ×ト×サイアク
1.desc: Chrollo is able to identify the whereabouts of the chain user by using the info he has on Neon.

1.title: センテ×ト×オキテ
1.desc: The Phantom Troupe discover that Kurapika is responsible for Uvogin's death; Gon and Killua go to the hotels lobby...

1.title: ヒキギワ×ノ×ヒキガネ
1.desc: Chrollo is captured by Kurapika, who will release him when Gon and Killua are brought to him by Pakunoda.

1.title: セリ×ト×アセリ
1.desc: The game Greed Island, which holds a clue to finding Ging, goes up for auction; Gon and Killua ask the winning buyer to hire them as players, but they must work on strengthening their Nen to make themselves eligible.

1.title: キマリ×ト×ハジマリ
1.desc: Gon and Killua attempt to be chosen as Greed Island players, but it is a highly selective process.

1.title: カンユウ×ト×シンユウ
1.desc: Gon and Killua get inside the world of Greed Island, but they discover a message from Ging to Gon there.

1.title: ゲンジツ？×ト×ゲンセキ
1.desc: Gon and Killua look for spell cards in Masadora, and they encounter a variety of monsters on their journey.

1.title: シショウ×ハ×ヒジョウ？
1.desc: Bisky wants to train Gon and Killua. and their first test is to defeat a bounty hunt within two weeks.

1.title: キョウカ×ト×キョウカツ
1.desc: Bisky oversees gradually improving Nen by Gon and Killua, who now have the ability to capture previously unbeatable opponents.

1.title: ジャケン×ト×ジャンケン
1.desc: Bisky's lecture on rock-paper-scissors inspires Gon to work on a special technique.

1.title: コウリャク×ト×サクリャク
1.desc: A reunited Gon, Killua and Bisky start collecting cards to gain an advantage.

1.title: 15×ト×15
1.desc: Gon and Killua are invited by the other players to join forces in order to stop Genthru from beating the game.

1.title: カイゾク×ト×スイソク
1.desc: Gon and his pals must chase 15 pirates out of town in order to obtain Patch Of Shore.

1.title: タイケツ×デ×ネッケツ
1.desc: Gon and his pals join Hisoka and Goreinu to challenge Razor again, and Team Tsezgerra also helps them.

1.title: コンジョウ×ト×ユウジョウ
1.desc: Gon can't hold onto Razor's throw and gets sent to the outfield. Later Gon uses Back to return.

1.title: カケヒキ×ト×トリヒキ
1.desc: Gon, Killua and Hisoka join forces to catch Razor's biggest throw. Gon later musters all his strength.

1.title: チェイス×デ×チャンス
1.desc: The players have to battle Genthru in order to beat the game, so Tsegerra offers to keep Genthru busy.

1.title: キョウキ×ト×ショウキ
1.desc: Team Gon faces off against Genthru's team.

1.title: ショウシャ×ト×ハイシャ
1.desc: Gon won't back down even though he can not match Genthru's strength, but he is severely injured during the fight with his opponent.

1.title: ジンノトモ×ト×シンノトモ
1.desc: After beating Genthru and obtaining 99 restricted cards, Gon and his pals take part in the final event.

1.title: サイカイ×ト×リカイ
1.desc: Gon and Killua use the cards they obtained to warp to Nigg, who they think is Ging.

1.title: フアン×ト×シュツゲン
1.desc: Gon and Killiua sign up with Kite's team to probe the dangerous Chimera Ants.

1.title: キュウソク×ナ×ゾウショク
1.desc: Kite tries to determine the whereabouts of the actual Chimera Ant by studying the location of the Chimera Ant farm.

1.title: NG×ナ×NGL
1.desc: Gon and his pals get through a difficult checkpoint and enter NGL, hoping to find the Chimera Queen Ant.

1.title: ゴクアク×ト×サイアク
1.desc: Ponzu's bees deliver messages asking the Hunter Association to help eradicate the Chimera Ants.

1.title: タタカイ×ノ×カイシ
1.desc: After finding whats left of a destroyed village, Gon, Killua and Kite have their first encounter with a Chimera Ant.

1.title: カイト×ノ×スロット
1.desc: Some of the more combative Chimera Ants decide to eat the villains who ran the NGL underground.

1.title: カンカ×シテ×シンカ
1.desc: The Hunter Association plan to eliminate the Chimera Ants, who are busy targeting Gon and his friends.

1.title: サダメ×ノ×メザメ
1.desc: Hagya has his soldiers hunt Gon, Killua and Kite; Gon and his friends have a tough time when the Chimera Ants attack.

1.title: ヒカリ×ト×カゲ
1.desc: Kite, Gon and Killua follow Hagya as the look for the Chimera Ant nest with the Queen.

1.title: チカイ×ト×サイカイ
1.desc: Kite acts as a decoy so Gon and Killua can free themselves; the two boys then promise to save Kite.

1.title: ケットウ×シテ×トウソウ
1.desc: Gon and Killua learn how to take tokens from their targets, and then Bisky sends them to battle Knuckle.

1.title: ジャンケン×ト×ジャクテン
1.desc: A tired Gon and Killua return to their lodging after a battle with Knuckle but they are in for a surprise.

1.title: ヤサシサ×ト×ツヨサ
1.desc: Gon makes Knuckle utilize his full strength, but Knuckle is able to identify the weakness in Gon's special attack.

1.title: リソク×ト×ジュバク
1.desc: Gon and Knuckle duel again.

1.title: キョウシャ×ト×ジャクシャ
1.desc: The Queen finally fives birth to the King, whose intimidating aura cows the rest of the Chimera Ants.

1.title: ヒトツノネガイ×ト×フタツノチカイ
1.desc: The dying Queen of the Chimera Ants names the chosen King.

1.title: パーム×ト×デート
1.desc: The King goes on the move, and his powers magnify after he invades the Republic of East Gorteau and eats a Nen user.

1.title: トモダチ×ト×タビダチ
1.desc: Killua runs across Rammot in the forest while Gon and Palm are on a date, and Killua tries to protect Gon.

1.title: ウラミ×ト×スゴミ
1.desc: The huge difference in physical strength between Chimera Ants and humans become apparent.

1.title: ムホウ×ナ×ホーム
1.desc: Kalluto, Feitan, Shalnark, Phinks, Shizuku and Bonolenov get to Meteor City after hearing the news about it.

1.title: ゲキトウ×デ×ゲキメツ
1.desc: Zazan erects a new Chimera Ant nest in Meteor City, and the Phantom Troupe members go inside the nest to battle Zazan.

1.title: センニュウ×ト×センベツ
1.desc: Gon and Killua arrive at the Republic of East Gorteau to halt stop the selection process, and make a discovery.

1.title: コンビネーション×ト×エボリューション
1.desc: Killua and Gon go separate ways to halt the selection process, but Gon runs into trouble when he is blocked from reaching his goal.

1.title: ツイセキ×ニハ×ツイゲキ
1.desc: Cheetu disappears just as Knuckle and Shoot are about to ambush him.

1.title: イカルゴ×ト×イカズチ
1.desc: Killua confronts Ikalgo, but is forced to save him from his own subordinates.

1.title: ノウリョク×ト×タイキョク
1.desc: Meleoron reveals his real motives on joining Gon and shows him his Nen abilities.

1.title: ツミ×ト×ヨミ
1.desc: Meruem and Komugi the Gungi Champion start to play Gungi. Morel faces Cheetu in a fight.

1.title: マヨイ×ト×トマドイ
1.desc: Morel sets a trap for Cheetu.

1.title: カクゴ×ト×カクセイ
1.desc: Meruem proposes a wager in the next game. Knov and Palm search for a way to sneak into the king's palace.

1.title: ノヴ×ト×モラウ
1.desc: Knov reaches the palace, opening exits with his ability at several locations. Morel confronts a Chimera ant who thrives on leverage.

1.title: リターン×ト×リタイア
1.desc: Morel and Leol battle in a underground church. Killua rejoins Gon along with his new friend, Ikalgo.

1.title: コムギ×ノ×グンギ
1.desc: Gon and the Hunters prepare to infiltrate the palace.

1.title: コウシンカイシ×デ×コウドウカイシ
1.desc: The preparation to break into the palace continues.

1.title: コンワク×ト×オモワク
1.desc: The Chimera ant king becomes more reclusive as the sorting gets closer, meanwhile the wolf-like chimera ant Welfin finds a intruder in the palace.

1.title: トツニュウ×シテ×シンニュウ
1.desc: The assault on the royal palace begins as Gon and his friends break inside.

1.title: カイブツ×ト×カイブツ
1.desc: Gon and the others appear at the main staircase but their progress is momentarily halted when Dragon Dive finally hits the palace.

1.title: ムシ×ダケド×カシ
1.desc: The Extermination Team gets separated after the central staircase gets destroyed.

1.title: ブンダン×ト×ゴサン
1.desc: The King confronts Netero and Zeno.

1.title: ギム×ト×ギモン
1.desc: Knuckle takes his fight with Menthuthuyoupi outside the central staircase as Gon and Killua finally come face to face against Neferpitou.

1.title: フクシュウ×ト×シュウフク
1.desc: Upon entering the tower Gon and Killua find Pitou in a vulnerable position while operating on Komugi. Gon has trouble controlling his anger and demands to fight Pitou to avenge Kite.

1.title: ブジョク×ニハ×セツジョク
1.desc: Zeno is stopped by Cheetu after leaving the palace and Cheetu is desperate to test his new ability on Zeno. Zeno warns Cheetu to watch his back, meanwhile Knuckle is trying to escape Youpi with a seriously injured Shoot.

1.title: イツワリ×ノ×イカリ
1.desc: Youpi pretends to become irritated with Loanboy.

1.title: ツヨ×イカ×ヨワ×イカ
1.desc: Youpi finds himself admiring the strength of his opponents; Ikalgo takes advantage of the Palace's security system to escape the Chimera Ants.

1.title: ニセモノ×ト×ホンモノ
1.desc: Knuckle is upset when he finds out that the seriously injured Shoot is missing, Morel vigil outside the cocoon comes to an end.

1.title: ハイボク×ト×メンボク
1.desc: As Neferpitou heals Komugi, Gon waits impatiently. The battle between Morel and Youpi advances to it's final stage.

1.title: タテマエ×ト×ナマエ
1.desc: Zeno's Dragon head flies to deliver it's cargo to the battlefield, The Ant King, Mereum and Netero travel with it. Pouf continues with his plan to find the King.

1.title: ムカデ×ト×オモイデ
1.desc: While the fight between the King and Netero starts, Ikalgo is underground reflecting on his inability to finish off Brovads. Ikalgo finally recalls his mission.

1.title: ケッカイ×ト×カクセイ
1.desc: Palm awakens and exits her cocoon after her capture by the Chimera Ants and then encounters Killua and begins a hard battle.

1.title: ブノツヨミ×ト×ブノキワミ
1.desc: King Meruem and Netero continue their battle while Gon and Neferpitou go into the final ten minutes of Komugi's recovery.

1.title: ゼロ×ト×ローズ
1.desc: As Netero fights the King, he uses his ultimate technique. The King tries to counter Netero's attacks.

1.title: テキイ×ト×ケツイ
1.desc: Neferpitou's time to heal Komugi is up, and Gon demands for their fight. Knuckle and Killua are tasked to watch over Komugi while the battle rages.

1.title: ムジョウノヨロコビ×ト×ムショウノアイ
1.desc: Pouf and Youpi use part of their own bodies to heal King Meruem, who revives stronger than he was before.

1.title: ヒョウテキ×ト×モクテキ
1.desc: The King appears to have lost a lot of his memories. He returns to the palace with Shaiapouf and Menthuthuyoupi with him to help regain his memories.

1.title: マホウ×デ×ゼツボウ
1.desc: The King returns to the palace with hopes of recovering his lost memories. Gon has a request to make of Pitou.

1.title: イカリ×ト×ヒカリ
1.desc: Gon has made his request to Pitou about Kite and pays a terrible price when things go awry.

1.title: センコウ×ト×ハツドウ
1.desc: The King struggles in his efforts to recover his memories then knocks out Mereoron and Knuckle Bine.

1.title: セイゾン×ノ×キゲン
1.desc: While on his way to a hostage exchange, Welfin encounters Youpi.

1.title: ヒトコト×ハ×ソノヒト
1.desc: When Meruem has a conversation with Welfin, it stirs up memories of Komugi which sends him off on a new objective.

1.title: コノヒ×ト×コノシュンカン
1.desc: Meruem takes on Komugi in Gungi once more.

1.title: キキョウ×ト×ホンミョウ
1.desc: Reina is seeking her mother, while Colt reveals a intriguing secert. Killua is in fear that she will loose Gon.

1.title: ジュウニシン×デ×ギロン
1.desc: When it is time to choose Netero's successor, Ging starts to set up the rules for the election. The first round presents to clear winner. Illumi tries to keep Gon and Killua safe.

1.title: オネダリ×ト×オネガイ
1.desc: When the election reaches a stalemate, Pariston takes advantage of the situation and attempts to bend the rules in his favor. Killua hopes that family will be able to come up with a solution that will help Gon.

1.title: アルカ×ト×ナニカ
1.desc: Killua is reunited with his sibling while his older brother tries to get assistance from Hisoka.

1.title: サンセン×ト×カイセン
1.desc: Multiple butlers from the Zoldyck Estate are ordered to follow and keep tabs on Killua. If he breaks any rules he'll be brought back home. Leorio who arrives at the election conference, asks Ging why he hasn't gone to see his son yet.

1.title: テジナシ×ト×シツジ
1.desc: Leorio rises to the third place in the election. Illumi plans on killing Alluka. After being separated from Killua, Gotoh is confronted by Hisoka.

1.title: ハリ×ト×カリ
1.desc: Tsubone, Amane, and Canary continue to chase after Killua. Killua sends a group of Hunters to capture Illumi.

1.title: ツミ×ト×ツメ
1.desc: Illumi and Hisoka easily defeat all the Hunters sent after them. Finally cornered by Illumi, Killua is forced to reveal another rule to Alluka's abilities.

1.title: ケッサイ×ト×カッサイ
1.desc: After Leorio gives his speech he is shocked with a roar of applause. With Leorio seemingly about to win the election, Pariston steps in with a speech of his own.

1.title: カンパイ×ト×サイカイ
1.desc: Leorio is about to win the election, but loses all motivation to continue after a fully healed Gon appears before him. Surrounded by his friends and the other Hunters who celebrate his recovery, Gon meets his father at last.

1.title: カイチョウ×ト×カイジョ
1.desc: Gon apologizes to Ging for failing to save Kite and his father instructs him to apologize to Kite himself instead, affirming that he will wait for him to return. Meanwhile, Killua seals Nanika away, to ensure that Alluka can live a normal life beside him.

1.title: スクイ×ト×ミライ
1.desc: Gon, Killua, and Alluka journey to the World Tree where Killua reveals Alluka's powers to Gon. Killua vows to protect his sister and says farewell to Gon, promising they'll meet again.

1.title: コレマデ×ト×コレカラ
1.desc: Gon climbs to the top of the World Tree where Ging is expecting him, and the two finally have a heart to heart talk. Throughout this conversation, Ging reveals his intentions to explore the world beyond the current boundaries known to mankind and Gon tells him of all his adventures.

title: One Punch Man
description: The story of Saitama, a hero that does it just for fun & can defeat his enemies with a single punch.
cast: Makoto Furukawa, Kaito Ishikawa
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: The Strongest Man
1.desc: Saitama is a guy who's a hero for fun. After saving a child from certain death, he decided to become a hero and trained hard for three years. Though he's now so strong he can defeat any opponent with a single punch, lately he feels as if, in exchange for overwhelming power, he's lost something even more important.

1.title: The Lone Cyborg
1.desc: A monster is moving toward City Z, one that has been created by the mysterious organization known as The House of Evolution. Genos, a young cyborg, attempts to stop it, but gets in over his head before Saitama happens along.

1.title: The Obsessive Scientist
1.desc: Saitama and Genos track down an evil scientist who wants to know the secret to Saitama's power.

1.title: The Modern Ninja
1.desc: A group of battlesuit-clad terrorists called "The Paradisers" appears in City F, led by an enormous man known as Hammerhead. Calling for the redistribution of wealth, the group targets the fat-cat Zeniru, who in turn dispatches his bodyguard to defeat them. Unfortunately, Saitama is on the same errand.

1.title: The Ultimate Master
1.desc: Saitama and Genos find out about the hero registration and both take the tests to certify. Genos gets "S(Special)" and Saitama gets a "C" grade. Meanwhile, Genos became the disciple of Saitama and learned about the power of saitama's punch on a training session.

1.title: The Terrifying City
1.desc: It's been five days since Saitama became a professional hero and he has yet to do anything heroic. When Genos informs him that C-class heroes who don't fight bad guys are dropped from the hero registry after a week of inaction, Saitama heads out on patrol, yet can't find any criminals or monsters to stop.

1.title: The Ultimate Disciple
1.desc: An enormous meteor hurtles toward City Z, forcing the Hero Association to ask its S Class heroes to respond. When all their efforts prove in vain, Genos decides it's up to him to protect the home of his master and stop the meteor, no matter what the cost.

1.title: The Deep Sea King
1.desc: A pack of monsters calling themselves the "Clan of the Seafolk" arrive on the shores of City J intent on invading the land. When the hero sent to fight them is defeated easily by the Deep Sea King himself, Saitama and Genos head for the city to help.

1.title: Unyielding Justice
1.desc: The Deep Sea King has defeated every hero who opposed him with ease. Genos is preparing to attack while Licenseless-Rider and Saitama rush to the evacuation shelter, where the battle continues.

1.title: Unparalleled Peril
1.desc: Saitama tags along to an emergency meeting of Class S heroes and discovers that a seer has foretold a serious danger threatening the Earth. Though the crisis could occur anytime in the next six months, the heroes are surprised to hear the roar of explosions that very hour!

1.title: The Dominator of the Universe
1.desc: As a colossal spaceship floats in the skies above City A, a member of its monstrous crew battles on the ground against a group of S Class heroes. Despite their powers, they can't seem to finish it off. Meanwhile, Saitama has boarded the enemy ship on his own.

1.title: The Strongest Hero
1.desc: The inconceivably powerful Lord Boros has traveled untold distances in search of someone who can cure his boredom: Saitama! With the fate of humanity in the balance, will the two champions at last find in each other the worthy opponent they've been searching for?

2.title: Return of the Hero
2.desc: Saitama and Genos are out shopping when they come across G4, a demonic robot on a mission to eliminate King. Meanwhile, Sitch attempts to recruit various assassins and villains.

2.title: Human Monster
2.desc: Garou issues a declaration of war on the Hero Association through terrifying means, Hellish Blizzard gives Saitama an ultimatum, and Genos decides to eliminate his master's stalker, Speed-o'.

2.title: The Hunt Begins
2.desc: Garou, out hunting heroes, can barely contain his excitement when he gets the chance to battle the S Class hero Tank-top Master. Meanwhile, Silverfang shutters his dojo to begin his own hunt of his former disciple.

2.title: Metal Bat
2.desc: Assigned to guard a VIP and his son, Metal Bat couldn't be less thrilled. But when the group is suddenly attacked all hell breaks loose. Meanwhile, Saitama has disguised himself as Charanko in order to enter the "Super Fight" martial arts tournament.

2.title: Martial Arts Tournament
2.desc: Monsters from the Monster Association launch simultaneous attacks on all the human cities, attempting to overwhelm the forces of the Hero Association. Meanwhile, the "Super Fight" martial arts tournament kicks off.

2.title: The Uprising of the Monsters
2.desc: The Super Fight tournament kicks off while Genos takes on multiple monsters who have appeared in City C. Elsewhere, countless monsters are wreaking havoc in multiple areas, but the Hero Association is being overwhelmed by the sheer number of threats.

2.title: The Class S Heroes
2.desc: As the Super Fight tournament heads for its grand finale, the Class S heroes battle to hold back the tide of monster incursions. Meanwhile, Atomic Samurai is setting in motion a plan of his own.

2.title: The Resistance of the Strong
2.desc: Goketsu, the first Super Fight Tournament champion, arrives in the stadium. Having now become a monster, he's aiming to force the Super Fight competitors to turn into monsters themselves. When several do, it's up to Suiryu to take them on alone.

2.title: The Troubles of the Strongest
2.desc: Saitama returns to the battle, but is starting to get through a gloomy state because of an obvious reason.

2.title: Justice Under Siege
2.desc: The Monster Association invited all of the S-Class heroes to their hideout in City Z. Meanwhile, Garo encounters a serious threat.

2.title: The Varieties of Pride
2.desc: Garou is at last surrounded by multiple heroes and forced to fight, even though he's covered in wounds and nearly at his limit. The hero hunter still has his incredible ability to read opponents' fighting styles, but there are surprises in store for all.

2.title: The Wiping of the Disciple's Butt
2.desc: As the fight continues between Garou and his former master, Bang, a prominent threat from the Monster Association reappears.

3.title: The Strategy Meeting
3.desc: The heroes plan a rescue of a child kidnapped by monsters, while Garou awakens deep underground.

3.title: Monster King
3.desc: As monsters attack Garou, an overgrown beast sends him crashing down deep underground, where he finds Monster King Orochi adn Gyro-Gyro waiting.

title: Vinland Saga
description: For a thousand years, the Vikings have made quite a name and reputation for themselves as the strongest families with a thirst for violence.
cast: Yūto Uemura, Naoya Uchida, Kensho Ono, Shunsuke Takeuchi, Kenichirou Matsuda
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Somewhere Not Here
1.desc: Thorfinn, a boy living in Iceland, longs for adventure and is eager to know more about the world. He dreams of a land of paradise called Vinland that he hears about from the adventurer Leif, while he leads his peaceful life with this father Thors, a former warrior. One day, Thors saves a runaway slave and sets a series of events in motion. This is the story of a true warrior in an age of turmoil.

1.title: Sword
1.desc: In the year 1002, the war between England and Denmark was intensifying. One day, the Jomsvikings pay a visit to Thorfinn's village in order to bring back Thors, their former commander, to prepare for the impending battle. Thors is forced to join the war in order to protect the villagers from being taken hostage, and must face his accursed past in order to save his family and his village.

1.title: Troll
1.desc: Askeladd, the leader of a Viking army of a hundred men, receives orders from Floki of the Jomsvikings to kill Thors, who was once known as the Troll of Jom. However, the villagers, completely unaware of the order, buzz with excitement as they prepare for their first battle. Thorfinn also joins in the excitement. Thors and his men are about to embark on a difficult sea journey to England.

1.title: A True Warrior
1.desc: Thors and his men fall for Askeladd's trap and faces a dangerous situation, but Thors defeats many of Askeladd's men with his overpowering strength. However, Thors knows that it will be difficult to save everyone, including his son, who've been living in a peaceful village their entire lives, and makes a tough decision.

1.title: The Troll's Son
1.desc: After Askeladd kills Thorfinn's father Thors, Thorfinn hides inside Thor's ship and bides his time until the opportunity to take revenge. However, life on the ship is harsh without any food or water, and Thorfinn grows weaker day by day. One day, Thorfinn, armed with his sword, attempt to attack Askeladd in his sleep...

1.title: The Journey Begins
1.desc: Thorfinn kills his first man. As more time goes on Thorfinn kills more men and becomes more skilled. One day when Thorfinn is in battle he gets shot with an arrow and ends up unconscious. An English woman and her daughter help him recover.

1.title: Normanni
1.desc: Askeladd withdraws temporarily from the war against England. While searching for a new source of income, he encounters a skirmish among the Franks and hatches a plot to steal their treasure. Askeladd sends 16 years old Thorfinn, who has grown up into a cold-hearted Viking, ahead as a messenger.

1.title: Beyond the Edge of the Sea
1.desc: After capturing the treasure from the Franks, Askeladd's men return to the village of Gorm on the Jutland Peninsula in Denmark to pass the winter. Thorfinn challenges Askeladd to a duel as a reward for bringing him the head of the captain of the clan of Franks. Even though Thorfinn has grown in skill through his experience in battle, he is still no match for Askeladd.

1.title: The Battle of London Bridge
1.desc: In October 1013, King Sweyn leads a fleet of Danish and Viking ships in an attempt to take London Bridge of England. Askeladd's army, hired by the army of Denmark, was among them. However, after the betrayal of Thorkell the Tall, a Viking known for his overpowering strength, London Bridge has become impregnable. Askeladd tells Thorfinn he'll reward him with a duel if he's able to kill Thorkell.

1.title: Ragnarok
1.desc: Askeladd's army separates from the army of Denmark and attacks a village 100 km to the west.
