Thorfinn leaves the soldiers behind in disgust and climbs up a hill overlooking the village, where he pledges revenge for his father. However, he encounters Askeladd sitting in the darkness, who tells him about "Britannia", the aging of the world, and Ragnarok, the final battle.

1.title: A Gamble
1.desc: Thorkell takes Canute hostage and follows after the main army of Denmark. Ragnar objects to Thorkell's plan to take on the entire army of Denmark, boasting 16,000 soldiers, with only 500 men. Thorkell then begins to tell Ragnar the story of Valhalla, the pride of Normans, a place where only those who die in battle can go.

1.title: The Land on the Far Bank
1.desc: Askeladd and his men continue their march to escape from Thorkell. However, their march comes to a halt at the Severn River. Askeladd hands a letter to an old man operating a ferry across the river and tells him to deliver the letter to the other side immediately. As soon as he hears the addressee's name, the old man sets off in his boat.

1.title: Child of a Hero
1.desc: Askeladd crosses the river and escapes from Thorkell into Wales with Canute. However, Askeladd's men are ambushed by a group of soldiers hiding behind the boulders at the border of the kingdom of Brycheiniog. Askeladd attempts to negotiate with their messenger, and reveals his plan.

1.title: The Light of Dawn
1.desc: Askeladd and his men change course and decide to return to Gainsborough, by crossing through the Earldom of Mercia in the midst of a harsh snowstorm, where the main army of Denmark awaits. The men spot a small village in the blizzard, and make their move.

1.title: After Yule
1.desc: After losing Canute, Thorkell decides to halt his advance in central England. Thorkell hears that the end of the war between Denmark and England is near, and bemoans the end of the war. However, he later gets wind of an interesting piece of news.

1.title: History of Beasts
1.desc: Askeladd and his men are attacked by the English army in the village where they had planned to camp during the winter. Askeladd captures their captain and interrogates him to find out how the English knew where they were, and discovers that Thorkell is fast approaching. The news of Thorkell's arrival sends waves of shock among Askeladd's followers.

1.title: Servant
1.desc: Askeladd's men continued their march to escape Thorkell. However, Torgrim and his friends were hatching a plot to switch sides and join Thorkell, taking Canute with them. Torgrim finally launches his rebellion and corners Askeladd, negotiating with him to hand over Canute, then Thorkell arrives in the midst of the confusion.

1.title: Out of the Cradle
1.desc: Thorfinn and Thorkell agree to have a duel over the fate of Askeladd. Thorkell looks forward to facing off against Thors's son, Thorfinn, and asks him what a true warrior really is. Meanwhile, Canute is suddenly ambushed while he attempts to escape, and has a dream about a certain individual.

1.title: United Front
1.desc: Thorfinn is told to think about what he has to do to beat Thorkell. Askeladd treats Thorfinn's wounds so that he may fight again someday, and proposes a joint strategy to help the two of them survive longer.

1.title: Crown
1.desc: After the fighting dies down, Canute takes in Askeladd and Thorkell as his followers, and returns to Gainsborough. Canute goes through an awakening when he realizes the meaning of love in the aftermath of Ragnar's death.

1.title: Reunion
1.desc: Canute's party arrives in York to attend the Imperial Council. Although Canute had wanted to strike out against King Sweyn.

1.title: Lone Wolf
1.desc: Thorfinn begins his duel against Askeladd with Canute and Thorkell as witnesses. However, Thorfinn is unable to strike as he stands overwhelmed by the extraordinary mood that overtakes Askeladd after Bjorn's departure.

1.title: Miscalculation
1.desc: After the assassination attempt on Canute's life, rumors spread through York saying that the king is trying to kill Canute. As a result, the king is unable to issue any orders that would put Canute in harm, and Askeladd is pleased that everything is proceeding as planned. However, the tables turn when King Sweyn speaks. Meanwhile, Thorfinn is sent to prison as punishment for disturbing the peace.

1.title: End of the Prologue
1.desc: As the Imperial Council proceeds, Askeladd is shocked by the news of Wales. As he gets called by the king, he makes a last stand.

2.title: Slave
2.desc: Einar, a young man from northern England lives with his mother and younger sister in a quiet farming village. One day the village is destroyed in a Viking attack, and Einar's life changes dramatically.

2.title: Ketil's Farm
2.desc: Entering a life of slavery, Einar and Thorfinn begin their work, while encountering the various figures who inhabit Ketil's farm.

2.title: Snake
2.desc: Thorfinn and Einar find themselves in a sticky situation with some vicious men claiming to be "warriors". Thorfinn is put in major danger as one of the men finds newfound excitement in making him beg for his life.

2.title: Awakening
2.desc: Following Fox's demonstration and Snake interfering, Einar makes ties in Thorfinn's actions and words, and confronts him on his past.

2.title: Path of Blood
2.desc: After a sudden turn of events, young Canute must rise up to claim the throne of a Kingdom much reduced and under attack.

2.title: We Need a Horse
2.desc: Realizing they need a horse to remove tree trunks, Thorfinn and Einar go to the stables. When the workers deny them a horse, they decide they must find another way to get one.

2.title: Iron Fist Ketil
2.desc: Thieves have been taking food secretly from Ketil's farm. Meanwhile, Ketil's eldest son Thorgil returns home.

2.title: An Empty Man
2.desc: Thorfinn has nightmares almost every night, but he can never remember what he dreamed about, a fact that bothers him.

2.title: Oath
2.desc: Thorfinn is caught off guard and knocked unconscious in a fight with the servants. In the midst of this, he had a dream in which he sees his father and his arch-enemy. How will they respond to the current state of Thorfinn?

2.title: Cursed Head
2.desc: Finally, after three long years, Einar and Thorfinn chop down the final tree in the forest. At the same time, Canute, who became the conqueror of England, is visiting Jelling, the royal capital of Denmark.

2.title: King and Sword
2.desc: With Canute's newfound additional throne and the land of Denmark, he aims to fund his armies with drastic means. Ketil meets with Lief Ericson who finds out he has a slave named Thorfinn. Ketil pays tribute to the new king Canute.

2.title: For Lost Love
2.desc: Olmar recieves some upsetting news, causing him to reach his breaking point. Meawhile, tensions arise as Canute sets his sights on Ketil's farm.

2.title: Dark Clouds
2.desc: A slave kills his master and all his sons, as a result, a bounty amounting to three horses is placed on his head. The old master collapses tending the field and must be taken care of due to his poor health.

2.title: Freedom
2.desc: Gardar, the runaway slave who killed his master has come to Ketil's farmstead to free Arnheid, his wife. Snake aims to subdue Gardar while Einar wishes to aid Gardar by violent means, Thorfinn, however, pursues a diplomatic solution.

2.title: Storm
2.desc: Arnheid goes to the fortress where Gardar is imprisoned and asks to see her husband to treat his wounds.

2.title: Cause
2.desc: Having realized Gardar is escaped, Einar and Thorfinn make their way to the old master's home to find Arnheid. The two find her and both decide to help her and her husband escape, with the three colluding in a plan to help save Gardar.

2.title: The Road Home
2.desc: Thorfinn, after being left with no other choice, must break a sworn oath to defend Gardar from Snake.

2.title: The First Method
2.desc: As Canute and his men are approaching the farm, Ketil returns home and learns about the events that occurred while he was gone.

2.title: The Battle of Ketil's Farm
2.desc: Ketil gathers men to fight and defend his farm from the King's forces. Meanwhile, Thorfinn and his friends try to escape with Arnheid before the battle ends.

2.title: Pain
2.desc: As Thorfinn and Einar head for their escape, Arnheid regains consciousness and asks where they are going and if there are slaves and wars there, too.

2.title: Courage
2.desc: The battle has left heartbreaking casualties in its wake. Though Thorgil and Ketil's wife want to continue the fight, Canute demands their surrender.

2.title: The King of Rebellion
2.desc: Thorfinn is determined to face the brutal challenge of having to endure one hundred punches in order to speak with Canute. His father's words resonate with him as he undergoes this brutal but necessary task.

2.title: Two Paths
2.desc: Thorfinn and Canute attempt to begin to engage in peace discussions for Ketil's farmland.

2.title: Home
2.desc: After negotiating peace, upon his return to Iceland, Thorfinn reunites with his long-lost family after a 16-year separation, and the encounter sparks within him a bigger inspiration to establish a nation in the bountiful lands of Vinland.

title: Tokyo Revengers
description: An unemployed man learns that his ex-girlfriend was murdered. He suddenly finds himself travelling through time to his middle school years and has chance to change the future and save the girl. He aims to rise to the top of the most brutal delinquent gang.
cast: Yūki Shin, Yuu Hayashi, Tatsuhisa Suzuki, Shô Karino, Shotaro Morikubo, Azumi Waki
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Reborn
1.desc: Takemichi Hanagaki is a worthless part-time worker who's down in the dumps. One day, he learns that his girlfriend from junior high school, Hinata Tachibana, was killed from being a victim of the conflict between the Tokyo Manji Gang. Takemichi is shocked by the sudden news but goes about his daily life when he is suddenly pushed off the station platform onto the railroad tracks. He is prepared to die as he sees the train coming right for him, but the next thing he knows, he's reliving his life from 12 years ago.

1.title: Resist
1.desc: Takemichi returns to the present after shaking hands with Naoto and is reunited with Naoto who is now a police officier. Naoto asks Takemichi to go back in time and prevent the two leaders of the Tokyo Manji Gang, Sano Manjiro and Kisaki Tetta from meeting so that they can save Hinata. But what awaited Takemichi when he went back into the past 12 years were days spent as a slave to Kiyomasa, a member of the Tokyo Manji Gang

1.title: Resolve
1.desc: In order to protect his friend Takuya Yamamoto who's a bit frail, Takemichi challenges Kiyomasa to a fight. Despite being beaten to a pulp, Takemichi doesn't back down, which starts to make Kiyomasa panic. Then, the commander and vice commander of the Tokyo Manji Gang, Manjiro Sano, AKA Mikey, and Ken Ryuguji, AKA Draken show up.

1.title: Return
1.desc: Takemichi gets to enjoy some happy times with Hinata back during their middle school days but then he is suddenly sent back to the present. After seeing how Mikey was, he tells Naoto that he can't imagine that it was Mikey that turned the Tokyo Manji Gang into the evil organization it is today. He wants to talk to Mikey in the present day but even Naoto doesn't know where he is. While trying to find a connection to get them to Mikey, they find out that Akkun was now in the upper echelon of the Tokyo Manji Gang...

1.title: Releap
1.desc: Naoto finds out that 12 years ago, the Tokyo Manji Gang had split into the Mikey Faction and the Draken Faction and due to one of their disputes, Draken ends up dying. Despite Naoto telling him this, Takemichi refuses to believe that Mikey and Draken would ever fight and goes back into the past to find out what caused the dispute and to save Draken. Takemichi renews his determination as he goes back in time yet again, but when he opens his eyes, he finds a girl he doesn't know wearing just her underwear looking down on him.

1.title: Regret
1.desc: Because Pah-chin's friend was brutally attacked by Moebius, the Tokyo Manji Gang decides they're going to fight Moebius. According to Naoto, Draken doesn't die because of the conflict with Moebius, but rather, an internal conflict between the Tokyo Manji Gang. Takemichi returns to the present to talk to Osanai, the leader of Moebius, to find out what really happened that day.

1.title: Revive
1.desc: Takemichi goes back to the past and tries to stop the upcoming conflict between the Tokyo Manji Gang and Moebius, but Mikey and Pah-chin refuse to change their minds. Meanwhile, Osanai barges in with members of Moebius to launch a surprise attack. Pah-chin challenges Osanai to a one-on-one, but Osanai is two years older than him and beats him to a pulp. Despite this, Mikey doesn't interfere and just keeps watching it happen...

1.title: Rechange
1.desc: After the attack initiated by the head of Moebius, Mikey and Draken end up at odds with each other and then go visit Takemichi, who was injured. Takemichi is infuriated when the two of them end up fighting and destroying a bunch of his precious belongings. Akkun and the others try to stop him, but Takemichi ends up in tears, saying how much Toman means to him. His words get to Mikey and Draken and it seems like the mission was a success because of their reconciliation, but...

1.title: Revolt
1.desc: After receiving some information from Naoto, Takemichi goes to the parking lot where Draken is supposed to die. He finds Draken taking on Moebius all on his own. Takemichi and Mitsuya try to help Draken, but they are overwhelmed by the number of Moebius members. It was then the person behind the "Draken hunting" showed himself.

1.title: Rerise
1.desc: While the battle between Toman and Moebius led by their current leader, Shuji Hanma, is raging on, Draken ends up being stabbed by Kiyomasa. Mikey tries to get to Draken who is gravely injured, but Shuji keep getting in his way. Mikey then asks Takemichi to take care of him instead. While they're waiting for an ambulance, Kiyomasa and his thugs get in their way. In order to protect Draken, Takemichi challenges Kiyomasa one on one to settle things with him once and for all.

1.title: Respect
1.desc: Takemichi manages to defeat Kiyomasa in their one-on-one by sheer tenacity and with the help of Akkun and the others, they're able to protect Draken until they can get him to the ambulance. However, Draken is still unconscious. Meanwhile, The fight between Toman and Moebius came to an end. As he leaves, Hanma warns Mikey of the creation of Valhalla and the fact that he's the vice commander of this new gang.

1.title: Revenge
1.desc: After saving Ken's life, Takemichi returns to the future to find that Atsushi made his dreams to become a hairstylist come true and the accident caused by Toman that killed Hinata never happened. After reuniting with Naoto, he finds out that Hinata is alive, and they go to see her. Right before they're supposed to see her, Takemichi starts having some doubts because he's embarrassed at the fact that he hadn't changed at all and suddenly says he doesn't want to see her.

1.title: Odds and Ends
1.desc: After Hinata's funeral, Takemichi tells a grieving Naoto what he plans to do next. Why did the same future happen even though Ken remained by Manjiro's side? Takemichi decides he wants to go see Ken and ask him himself, but they find out that he's no longer in Toman in this world and is on death row.

1.title: Break up
1.desc: Mikey and the rest of Toman have gathered to nominate the Third Captain, with Kisaki being appointed. Meanwhile, Baji leaves Toman as he goes to join Valhalla. Mikey appoints Takemichi joining towards Mitsuya's squad and commands Takemichi to retrieve Baji back from Valhalla.

1.title: No Pain, no gain
1.desc: Manjiro asks Takemichi to bring the former First Division Captain Keisuke Baji from Valhalla. Manjiro agrees to make Tetta Kisaki leave Toman if Takemichi is successful in this mission, but he also threatens to kill him if he fails. As Takemichi receives a lecture about Valhalla from Kazushi Yamagishi who is knowledgeable about delinquents, Valhalla's No. 3 Kazutora Hanemiya appears before them.

1.title: Once upon a time
1.desc: 2 years ago, Manjiro, Ken, Keisuke, Takashi, Pah-chin, and Kazutora had their gang uniforms made and they all took a trip to Kanagawa on their motorcycles. Meanwhile, their commander Manjiro rode his moped, Street Hawk. They get surrounded by a local biker gang, but Manjiro shows no fear and tells the older gang members that he'll kill them if they lay a finger on his Street Hawk.

1.title: No way
1.desc: Takemichi finds out about Keisuke and Kazutora's past and realizes how hard it's going to be to bring Keisuke back to Toman. The next day, Takemichi was trying to figure out what to do about his promise to Manjiro when Keisuke's second in command, Chifuyu Matsuno appears before him. Chifuyu seems to believe that Keisuke joined Valhalla not to crush Toman, but to infiltrate Valhalla and expose Tetta Kisaki.

1.title: Open Fire
1.desc: Back in present day, Ken tells Takemichi that Kazutora ends up killing Keisuke at the Bloody Halloween, the fight against Toman and Valhalla, and Manjiro ends up killing Kazutora. Because of that, Manjiro falls into darkness, and Toman is taken over by Valhalla, which leads to the evil organization that it currently is now, led by Kisaki. Takemichi goes back to the past with a new mission: to protect Keisuke so that this tragedy doesn't happen.

1.title: Turn around
1.desc: The Bloody Halloween conflict that results in Toman being taken over by Valhalla has finally begun. Shuji and his army of delinquents overwhelm Toman as Ken does his best to try to protect the other Toman members, putting him at a disadvantage. However, the Toman members see how desperately Takemichi is trying to save Keisuke and Manjiro, lighting their fighting spirits once more.

1.title: Dead or Alive
1.desc: During the Bloody Halloween, Manjiro ended up in a 1v3 fight against Kazutora with his limbs bound. After Kazutora hits him in the head with a pipe, Manjiro ends up on his knees. The Valhalla members see this as a chance to finish off the Invincible Manjiro and try to get to him. Ken and Takemichi try to save Manjiro, but they're too far away. But then, a rather surprising person came to Manjiro's aid.

1.title: One and only
1.desc: Baji had infiltrated Valhalla so that he could get to Kisaki. And after a fierce battle, he manages to get to Kisaki, but coughs up blood and falls to the ground. Mikey sees this and takes Hanma out in a second and starts mercilessly punching Kazutora over and over. This was the scene that the future Draken had told Takemichi about. At this rate, Mikey will end up killing Kazutora, Kisaki will take over Toman, and the tragic future will still occur. Takemichi tries to stop him, but Mikey's rage is just too great, and...

1.title: One for all
1.desc: Two years ago, Manjiro learns that Kazutora is beefing with the motorcycle gang, the Black Dragons, and decides he'd fight them as well. But he wanted a valid sense of purpose to take on a motorcycle gang. Keisuke then suggests they make their own motorcycle gang. They want to create a gang where they can all put their lives down on the line for each other. Keisuke had been fighting all alone to protect the promise they made the day they created their gang and put their money together to buy a traffic safety charm.

1.title: End of war
1.desc: The conflict between Toman and Valhalla dubbed the Bloody Halloween ends in Toman's victory, but Baji is killed and Kazutora is arrested. Takemichi is regretful about the fact that he wasn't able to do much, but they managed to avoid Mikey killing Kazutora. After going with Draken to visit Kazutora, they head over to Draken's home.

1.title: A Cry baby
1.desc: Takemichi heads to his first Toman meeting wearing his jacket and is surprised to see the vice commander of Valhalla, Hanma, and Chifuyu standing next to Mikey. Not only that, but he finds out that it was Kisaki Tetta who arranged all of this. Takemichi falls into despair when he realizes he wasn`t able to change the future again despite Baji sacrificing his own life to protect Toman.

1.title: It Is What It Is
1.desc: Back in the present, Takemichi, now an officer in Toman, is duped by Kisaki who points a gun at him.

1.title: Gotta Go
1.desc: Back in the past, Takemichi befriends Hakkai Shiba, and has a violent run-in with Black Dragon.

1.title: Stand Alone
1.desc: Takemichi is beaten to a pulp by Taiju Shiba. To save him, Hakkai proposes a bargain to Taiju.

1.title: Family Bonds
1.desc: Hakkai decides to join Black Dragon to save Takemichi, but Mitsuya opposes it and confronts Taiju.

1.title: Christmas Eve
1.desc: Takemichi and Chifuyu make a decision after some conflict about working with Kisaki.

1.title: Whip Up Morale
1.desc: Propelled by each their own motives, the alliance members head to the church on Christmas night.

1.title: Sibling Rivalry
1.desc: Takemichi gets back in the fight to protect Yuzuha, who is key to changing the future.

1.title: Strive Together
1.desc: After making a bold declaration, Takemichi keeps rising up from Taiju's beatdowns.

1.title: Dawning of a New Era
1.desc: Amidst overwhelming odds, a familiar bike engine heralds Mikey's arrival, but he is acting off.

1.title: The Light of My Life
1.desc: Takemichi faces Hina, the girl he broke up with just the day before.

1.title: On My Way Home
1.desc: Mikey makes an unexpected announcement at Toman's first meeting of the year.

1.title: Last Order
1.desc: Takemichi returns to the present, but finds the timeline to be the worst one yet.

1.title: When It Rains, It Pours
1.desc: Takemichi returns to the past and realizes what he must do after meeting Chifuyu.

1.title: The Longest Day
1.desc: Set on crushing Toman, Yokohama gang Tenjiku ambushes Takemichi and his friends in Shibuya.

1.title: Mortal Enemy
1.desc: At Tenjiku's hideout, Takemichi encounters a childhood friend who gives him disturbing information.

1.title: Run Out of Patience
1.desc: Back in the present, Takemichi and Naoto come under threat while gathering information.

1.title: Come Back to Life
1.desc: Just when Takemichi's resolve is rekindled, a wrench is thrown into his plans.

1.title: A Bad Hunch
1.desc: Battered and bloody, Takemichi faces an S-62 Generation member to protect Koko.

1.title: Rise Against
1.desc: Mikey falls into despair after a tragic incident, leaving Toman leaderless.

1.title: Turn the Tide
1.desc: While Tenjiku awaits the coming battle, Toman's members flinch at entering into a hopeless fight.

1.title: I Know in My Head
1.desc: As the brawl begins, First Division tries to clear a path to Kisaki for Takemichi.

1.title: The Blue Ogre
1.desc: Hakkai and Angry must figure out how to overcome the formidable combination of the Haitani Brothers.

1.title: Brave Heart
1.desc: With a seesawing battle that may never end, Kisaki steps in, but Takemichi does not flinch.

1.title: Nothing is left
1.desc: Mikey and Draken show up at the pier and the battle between Mikey and Izana begins.

1.title: Paradise Lost
1.desc: Out of desperation, Izana takes rash measures and the situation gets out of control.

1.title: Meet his fate
1.desc: With things coming to a close, Hanma and Kisaki escape with Takemichi and Draken in pursuit.

title: Dr. Stone
description: One fateful day, all of humanity was petrified by a blinding flash of light. After several millennia, high schooler Taiju awakens and finds himself lost in a world of statues. However, he’s not alone!
cast: Yusuke Kobayashi, Manami Numakura, Kengo Kawanishi, Gen Satou, Ayumu Murase, Karin Takahashi
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Stone World
1.desc: Thousands of years after a mysterious phenomenon turned all of humanity to stone, the super-intelligent, science-driven boy Senku Ishigami awakens. Facing a world of stone and the total collapse of civilization, Senku decides to use science to rebuild the world. Together with his childhood friend Taiju Oki, they begin to rebuild civilization from scratch.

1.title: King of The Stone World
1.desc: Senku and Taiju prepare to make Yuzuriha as the first person they revive with their completed water, only to suddenly be chased by lions. In order to fight them off, the duo decide to instead revive the strongest fighter in their school, Tsukasa Shishio, who proves to be a valuable hunter. As the group begin harvesting seashells to grind into calcium carbonate for further advances in civilization, Tsukasa, who is against reviving the corrupt adults of human society, clashes with Senku, who remains determined to save everyone.

1.title: Weapons of Science
1.desc: Senku does not trust the motivation of Shishio, so he will try to hide his plans from a new and unforeseen enemy for his plan to revive civilization.

1.title: Fire the Smoke Signal
1.desc: The group embarks on a hunt for gunpowder making supplies; an accidental explosion leads to a fight.

1.title: Stone World the Beginning
1.desc: Taiju and Yuzuriha flee from Tsukasa while taking Senku with them. It is discovered how Senku survived his first days after being freed from petrifaction.

1.title: Two Nations of the Stone World
1.desc: Senku awakens after being nearly killed by Tsukasa and suggests splitting up with Yuzuriha and Taiju so they can spy on Tsukasa. A girl fights Tsukasa but is defeated and trapped under a tree. Senku finds the same girl and helps her.

1.title: Where Two Million Years Have Gone
1.desc: Senku helps Kohaku bring hot water back to her village for her ill sister. Kohaku tells Senku about her village and that it has forty people. Senku is told he cannot enter the village. Senku explains to Chrome about the history of mankind.

1.title: Stone Road
1.desc: Senku wants to make antibiotics and he explains how to Chrome and Kohaku. Senku decides to use magnets to collect iron. A child named Suika offers to help Senku. Senku decides to make ramen to appease the villagers and use their manpower.

1.title: Let There Be the Light of Science
1.desc: Senku feeds the villagers ramen so they can help him make iron. Senku meets Asagiri Gen a man who's been unpetrified and is working for Tsukasa. Asagiri decides to help Senku. Senku wants to make a generator with the help of lightning.

1.title: A Flimsy Alliance
1.desc: After Gen is brutally beaten in a surprise attack, Kohaku devises a plan to bring down the attacker once and for all.

1.title: Clear World
1.desc: Suika never wants to show her face for some reason that only a few know. Fortunately, Senku knows the solution to his annoying problem.

1.title: Buddies Back to Back
1.desc: To recover the most problematic ingredient in order to create sulfonamides, Ginro, Chrome, Kohaku and Senku will head to a zone of maximum danger. What kind of enemy will stand before them?

1.title: Masked Warrior
1.desc: All that's needed to make antibiotics is alcohol. The best way to get some is to win the Grand Bout, which the Senku and his kingdom will also need to do in order to keep Magma away from Ruri and give her the drug.

1.title: Master of Flame
1.desc: After Magma's series of tricks to reach the final match, Chrome reveals a trick of his own. With a little extra help from Gen, Chrome just may be able to pull this one off.

1.title: The Culmination of Two Million Years
1.desc: After Senku's unlikely victory, quick marriage, and even hastier divorce, the kingdom of science is back to work to finally finish Ruri's medicine.

1.title: A Tale for the Ages
1.desc: Ruri reveals the origin of the village's name and Senku learns of his father's fate.

1.title: A Hundred Nights and a Thousand Skies
1.desc: Byakuya and the astronauts' story continues, and Senku's connection to Ishigami Village and the Hundred Tales is finally revealed.

1.title: Stone Wars
1.desc: Tsukasa's army is coming. Kinro struggles to hold the bridge against the deadly spearman Hyoga and his shock troops, but Senku and the villagers are ready with deadly new weapons of science.

1.title: To Modernity
1.desc: Hyoga is disarmed, but the kingdom of science is still in danger - Ishigami village is in flames. And Tsukasa will soon know that Senku is still alive - How will the villagers fight off the coming invasion?

1.title: The Age of Energy
1.desc: Work begins on creating the components for Senku's cell phone, but spinning gold wire is proving to be quite the task! Luckily, Chrome and Kaseki "invent" the water wheel and drastically improve the process!

1.title: Spartan Crafts Club
1.desc: With Chrome and Kaseki's water wheel finished, Ishigami Village moves into the age of electricity! But with the primitive materials available to him, will Senku be able to create a filament that can withstand the intense heat of operating a vacuum tube?

1.title: The Treasure
1.desc: Senku, Chrome, and Magma venture into a cave in search of Tungsten, but there's a suspicious accident that leaves Senku and Chrome trapped at the bottom of a pit! What is Magma up to?!

1.title: Wave of Science
1.desc: Senku and the rest of the village get to work on making the components for the cell phone. It's hard work but everyone is pumped!

1.title: Voices Over Infinite Distance
1.desc: In a flashback, Byakuya decides to leave a glass record for Senku containing a message from him. In the present, Senku and his group create a record player. Senku unveils the record player to the village and plays it. To their amazement, Byakuya's voice is heard as he introduces himself. He then stops with the formalities as he addresses Senku, knowing full well that he is free by now and is hearing the message. Byakuya wants to voice confidence in him before stopping, since he knows his son wouldn't go for sappy father-son moments. Senku laughs that Byakuya truly gets him, as Kohaku notes that Senku is cold to his father while Kokuyo sadly notes she is no better. Byakuya then has Lillian pe

2.title: Stone Wars Beginning
2.desc: Senku continues in trying to advance the stone world, this time he makes "space food", it is in actuality cup noodles. After Senku finishes his project, Gen has an epiphany and devises a plan to take down Tsukasa's army without violence.

2.title: Hot Line
2.desc: While Senku's diversion buys Gen and others some time, soon Homura realizes something is not right.

2.title: Call From the Dead
2.desc: Taiju and Yuzuriha are on the verge of tears after they hear Senku's voice, and Senku informs them of his plan to win the war without any bloodshed.

2.title: Full Assault
2.desc: Chrome and Magnum struggles with Urkyo, while Senku, however, gets his hands busy with building up an invention; a new hope.

2.title: Steam Gorilla
2.desc: The final touches to the automobile are made and it is used to transport the science supplies to a fortified cliffside that's close to the Tsukasa empire. From there the automobile is upgraded into a tank, but unbeknownst to the rescue group preparations by the empire have been made to counter any vehicular attack.

2.title: Prison Break
2.desc: Desperate to escape his prisone confine, Chrome tries to stratergize a plan that will allow him to escape. However, surrounding his prison are traps and his new head jailer Yo is a former loose cannon police officer.

2.title: Secret Mission
2.desc: With Chrome safe and sound, Senku and Gen start work on the plan to convert people to their side with the Lilian Weinberg recording. They just have to avoid Ukyo and his incredible hearing.

2.title: Final Battle
2.desc: The Final Battle for the miracle cave starts as Senku and the Kingdom of Science conduct a frontal assault on the cave.

2.title: To Destroy and to Save
2.desc: Tsukasa and Hyoga are coming to capture the miracle cave. The Kingdom of Science must buy Senku and Chrome some time to turn the tide, or it is all over.

2.title: Humanity's Strongest Tag Team
2.desc: A truce is called between the Kingdom of Science and Tsukasa Empire. All appears to be well, but some of the Kingdom's dynamite is missing.

2.title: Prologue of Dr. Stone
2.desc: The Kingdom of Science is victorious, however it is not over for Senku. Senku must use all of his knowledge to cure Tsukasa who is severly injured.

3.title: New World Map
3.desc: Ishigami village takes up agriculture.

3.title: Greed Equals Justice
3.desc: The Kingdom of Science needs rations for the planned voyage of discovery.

3.title: First Contact
3.desc: Senku looks for the Sagara oil fields.

3.title: Eyes of Science
3.desc: The Kingdom of Science creates radar and sonar to determine the source of the morse code.

3.title: Science Vessel Perseus
3.desc: Kaseki's efforts to build the Perseus hits a roadblock.

3.title: Treasure Box
3.desc: The ship Perseus is completed, then the Perseus sets sail to the Treasure Island with a select Ishigami crew on board. Dr. Stone and the others goal is a island where the ISS space station crew landed years in the past.

3.title: Ray of Despair, Ray of Hope
3.desc: The Perseus arrives at the Treasure Island.

3.title: The Trump Card Aboard the Vessel of Science
3.desc: Amaryllis explains how she avoided being petrified and how she decided to sneak into the palace.

3.title: Beautiful Science
3.desc: Suika and Ginro strive to rescue the mobile lab from the Perseus.

3.title: Science Wars
3.desc: Amaryllis, Ginro and Kohaku are chosen to join the inner palace. The science team will need a way to communicate with them in secret, and, eventually, a way for them with the science team.

3.title: With This Fist, a Miracle
3.desc: Kohaku has located the treasure left behind by Byakuya and the others, but it's encased in concrete. Senku has to devise a plan to quietly get at the contents inside, so as to not alert the guards.

3.title: The Kingdom of Science Strikes Back
3.desc: Kohaku is forced to destroy Ryusui's statue to prove that she isn't a spy.

3.title: Medusa's True Face
3.desc: The team revives Kaseki to work on the drone. Meanwhile, Ginro is called to see the Master.

3.title: Deal Game, Test of Wit
3.desc: More of the Kingdom of Science is brought back from petrification, but they are discovered in the cave by Moz.

3.title: Three-Dimensional Battle
3.desc: Moz and the Kingdom of Science form a tenuous, temporary alliance against Ibara. How long it will last is a question they can't afford to concern themselves with just yet.

3.title: Total War
3.desc: The Kingdom of Science attacks and tries to execute their plan to steal the petrification device. Moz convinces Kirisame to use the device, but Ryusui's instincts tell him something is off about the situation.

3.title: Joker
3.desc: The Kingdom of Science members launch an attack on the islanders aboard the Perseus, but Moz isn't far behind and Senku and the others are forced to retreat inside the vessel. Ibara has them cornered, but Senku unleashes his Joker card.

3.title: Flicker of Doom
3.desc: Yo and the Kingdom of Science capture the petrification device, but Ibara isn't going down without a fight.

3.title: Last Man Standing
3.desc: Much to Ibara's shock and dismay, Senku devised a plan and managed to escape petrification. Now the two enter into a head-to-head battle for control of the Medusa device.

3.title: First Dream
3.desc: Senku stands victorious. He then works on reviving the others and fixing their communications device, but while they are talking with Ruri they encounter a strong interference with the signal.

3.title: Treasure Island
3.desc: To the moon! That's the plan, at least. Senku and the Kingdom of Science need to devise a means with which to go to the moon and deal with Why-Man. The first step is allying with the people of Treasure Island and enlisting their help with some new crafts.

3.title: Beyond the New World
3.desc: With the petrification device in the Kingdom's hands, it's time to revive Tsukasa. But there's just one problem: the device is out of batteries.

4.title: RYUSUI VS. SENKU
4.desc: Senku and his companions finally set off for America in search of corn. However, a dispute arises between Ryusui and Senku shortly after they depart

4.title: SCIENCE JOURNEY
4.desc: Maintaining morale will be critical on the long journey to the Americas. Knowing where on the ocean you are is pretty important, too. The crew of the Perseus discuss.

4.title: Light Trap in the Darkness
4.desc: The Perseus lands in the Americas. They first head to Northern California in search of yellow dent corn, but discover a lot more than that.

4.title: Dr. X
4.desc: The search party narrowly escaped enemy machine gun fire. Unfortunately, the respite was short-lived.

4.title: DOCTOR VS. DOCTOR
4.desc: Tensions rise as Dr. Xeno makes his introductions to the Perseus.

4.title: SCIENCE IS ELEGANT
4.desc: Stanley orders Luna to infiltrate the Perseus and identify Doctor Taiju. Things go sideways when it turns out to be a little too easy.

4.title: The Two Scientists
4.desc: Senku had gotten his start in rocket building through an email exchange with Doctor Xeno. Their approaches to science soon diverged.

4.title: LOCK ON
4.desc: NASA scientist Dr. Xeno attempts to pick off the leader of the Kingdom of Science.

4.title: Light of Science
4.desc: With the crew on board tending to a severely injured Senku, Chrome's team and Tsukasa's team must join forces to devise a way to infiltrate the enemy's lair.

4.title: Dirty Roads
4.desc: With Senku still confined to the bed, Chrome's team begins work on the tunnel to Xeno's base.

4.title: Those Who Know the Rules; Those Who Make Them
4.desc: Ryusui and Senku take to the skies in a science versus science dogfight while Xeno's forces mount a ground counterattack.

4.title: Reunion
4.desc: Xeno's army attacks and when all seems lost, Chrome and his friends finish the tunnel and capture Xeno.

4.title: Watching the Same Moon
4.desc: The team head to the source of the petrification beam in South America as they flee from Stanley's ship.

4.title: EARTH RACE
4.desc: Senku and company must flee from Stanley's ship, but they have to make stops to refuel.

4.title: The Escape
4.desc: After falling for a decoy, Stanley's team finally catches up to the crew, who must now outwit them while racing through the desert.

4.title: Medusa Mechanism
4.desc: The team is going to need a weapon for when Stanley inevitably catches up to them.

4.title: Sickening Yet Beautiful
4.desc: Senku and his team have lost Stanley for now, but they aren't out of -- or rather, in -- the woods just yet.

4.title: Diamond Heart
4.desc: The team discovers a giant pile of petrification devices. They take them apart to see what makes them tick.

4.title: Stone Sanctuary
4.desc: The team begins making, digging for, and polishing diamonds to replace the burnt-out ones inside the devices.

4.title: What I Once Sought to Destroy
4.desc: Suika is in charge of making sure Senku's plan works, but her kindness becomes an obstacle.

4.title: Our Dr. Stone
4.desc: With the revival team captured, it's up to Luna and Chelsea to revive everyone when the time comes.

4.title: Until We Meet Again
4.desc: With the petrification beam approaching, who will get their hands on the revival fluid?

4.title: Scientist, All Alone
4.desc: Suika gathers the team's statues, sets up camp and gets to work doing science.

4.title: Whole New World
4.desc: With Senku back, it's only a matter of time before the rest of the Kingdom of Science is revived.

4.title: Future Engine
4.desc: Senku and Dr. Xeno team up to gather the materials needed to make a rocket engine.

4.title: Fire
4.desc: The crew arrives in Spain, where they collect fluorite, olive oil and some treats.

4.title: The Universe Is Written in the Language of Mathematics
4.desc: The New Perseus sets out to India to recruit mathematicians for the space program.

4.title: The Dawn of Computers
4.desc: The computer that the team is building is a series of toroidal tubes. Senku explains.

4.title: The Truth About Rockets
4.desc: The team gets to work wiring up several megabits' worth of memory donuts for their computer.

4.title: Stone to Space
4.desc: The team will need a stupidly insane amount of electricity to turn their bauxite into an aluminum rocket body.

4.title: Unknown Known
4.desc: With the computer completed, the team will need a user interface: a TV.

4.title: Challengers of Science
4.desc: The Kingdom of Science's rocket launches are mired by a string of rapid unscheduled disassemblies.

4.title: Wanting Everything
4.desc: The team is too small to build a round-trip rocket. They'll need to enlist help from around the world.

title: Death Note
description: Light Yagami is an ace student with great prospects—and he’s bored out of his mind. But all that changes when he finds the Death Note, a notebook dropped by a rogue Shinigami death god.
cast: Mamoru Miyano, Shidō Nakamura, Kappei Yamaguchi, Aya Hirano, Noriko Hidaka
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Rebirth
1.desc: Brilliant but bored high school student Light Yagami suddenly finds himself holding the power of life and death in his hands.

1.title: Confrontation
1.desc: While the world's criminals continue to drop dead, L meets by computer with representatives from various nations.

1.title: Dealings
1.desc: Ryuk, the Shinigami, or god of death, who dropped the Death Note into the human world, warns Light that someone is on his trail.

1.title: Pursuit
1.desc: Light--now known to the world as Kira--tests the Death Note to understand the scope of its powers by killing off six convicts in various ways...

1.title: Tactics
1.desc: Soichiro Yagami demands to meet with L in person when he finds out that L has secretly brought FBI agents into Japan.

1.title: Unraveling
1.desc: Light meets a woman at the Police Department with an urgent message for the Kira task force.

1.title: Overcast
1.desc: Light uses the Death Note to try to get rid of the woman who could get him captured, and is shocked when it doesn't work.

1.title: Glare
1.desc: L insists on setting up bugs and cameras in the homes of Chief Yagami and Deputy Director Kitamura...

1.title: Encounter
1.desc: The murders continue, and L grows suspicious of Light's too-perfect behavior and decides to investigate him on his own.

1.title: Doubt
1.desc: L's suspicion of Light deepens, compelling him to invite Light into the investigation.

1.title: Assault
1.desc: As predicted on the tapes sent to Sakura TV, news anchors and commentators who expressed doubt about Kira die one by one.

1.title: Love
1.desc: With a second Kira now on the loose, L asks Light to join the task force and pose as the real Kira in order to catch the copycat.

1.title: Confession
1.desc: Light goes to Aoyama to discover the identity of the second Kira before L becomes more suspicious.

1.title: Friend
1.desc: Light and Misa show each other their Death Notes, and Light asks Misa to have her shinigami Rem get rid of L.

1.title: Wager
1.desc: Evidence turns up that points to Misa Amane as the second Kira.

1.title: Decision
1.desc: Misa is in confinement, though her memories of the Death Note have been completely wiped away.

1.title: Execution
1.desc: After fifty days of confinement the killings continue, and Misa and Light are released.

1.title: Ally
1.desc: Though L is still suspicious, Light and Misa, their memories of being Kira wiped clean, return to headquarters...

1.title: Matsuda
1.desc: Matsuda, the task force member assigned to watch Misa, is eager to distinguish himself...

1.title: Makeshift
1.desc: L's team discovers that the Yotsuba Group meet in secret to discuss the elimination of individuals who are troublesome to their company...

1.title: Performance
1.desc: The Yotsuba Group hires Eraldo Coil to uncover L's identity.

1.title: Guidance
1.desc: Misa succeeds in narrowing down the Kira suspects in the Yotsuba Group to one: Higuchi.

1.title: Frenzy
1.desc: Higuchi of the Yotsuba Group attempts to kill Matsuda of the task force, and is surprised when he doesn't die after 40 seconds.

1.title: Revival
1.desc: Higuchi is captured and tells the investigators about the Death Note.

1.title: Silence
1.desc: Light, his memory recovered, orders Misa to begin killing after Higuchi dies.

1.title: Renewal
1.desc: Light has removed everyone in his way and is closer to achieving his perfect world.

1.title: Abduction
1.desc: A new investigator steps forward--Near, a central figure in the SPK, an organization that is trying to catch Kira without relying on L.

1.title: Impatience
1.desc: Light, acting as L, reveals to Near that his sister Sayu has been kidnapped by someone wanting to trade her for the Death Note.

1.title: Father
1.desc: Light tries to discover where Mello and his Mafia associates are hiding and uses Misa's eyes to find the Death Note's current owner.

1.title: Justice
1.desc: Mello busts into SPK headquarters to retrieve a photograph of himself to make sure he won't be killed by Kira.

1.title: Transfer
1.desc: Near contacts the Japanese task force and determines that Kira is among their members.

1.title: Selection
1.desc: Star newscaster Kiyomi Takada becomes Kira's spokesperson to the world...

1.title: Scorn
1.desc: Light pretends to investigate Kiyomi...

1.title: Vigilance
1.desc: Aizawa figures out what's going on and tells Near, who already knows about the notes.

1.title: Malice
1.desc: Light gives Kiyomi the order to finish off Near.
Near, along with the SPK, meets Light and the task force at a warehouse for the final showdown.

1.title: New World
1.desc: Though Mikami has written all the investigators' names in the Death Note, 40 seconds pass and everyone is still alive.

title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
description: Japan has been invaded and conquered by the Britannian Empire. Japan is now known as Area 11 and its citizens known as Elevens. The Britannian Empire takes away Japan's autonomous power and imposes its rule through the use of Knightmares.
cast: Jun Fukuyama, Takahiro Sakurai, Yukana, Ami Koshimizu, Kaori Nazuka, Norio Wakamoto
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Stage 1: The Day a New Demon was Born
1.desc: Lelouch Lamperouge finds himself caught in a clash between an anti-government terrorist group and the Britannian army. When things take a turn from bad to worse, a mysterious green-haired girl bestows a dangerous power upon him, changing his life forever.

1.title: Stage 2: The White Knight Awakens
1.desc: Lelouch teams up with the terrorist group to take down the army as they destroy Shinjuku Ghetto. But when Suzaku is put in control of the army's newest Knightmare model, will Lelouch's plan fall apart? Or can he still move the pieces in his favor?

1.title: Stage 3: The False Classmate
1.desc: After confronting Prince Clovis, Lelouch learns information about his mother's murder. Back at school, he is surprised to find that one of the terrorists he worked with is a fellow classmate. But when he confronts her, he finds the limits of his new power.

1.title: Stage 4: His Name Is Zero
1.desc: Suzaku is accused of the murder of Prince Clovis, and Lelouch must save him. But to do so could mean revealing himself to the army. With a new alter ego and the help of Kallen and her comrade, they must try to pull off a daring and public rescue.

1.title: Stage 5: The Princess and the Witch
1.desc: The mysterious green-haired girl known as C.C. is alive and intent on hanging around Lelouch as he accepted the contract and the Geass Power. Meanwhile, Suzaku is set free and encounters a strange girl who calls herself Euphie.

1.title: Stage 6: The Stolen Mask
1.desc: Suzaku enrolls in Lelouch's class at Ashford Academy and is avoided by everyone. While Suzaku struggles to fit in at the school, Lelouch loses his Zero mask to…a cat? Milly turns the cat hunt into a game for the student body, much to Lelouch's dismay.

1.title: Stage 7: Attack Cornelia
1.desc: Viceroy Cornelia sets a trap to lure Zero out. C.C. tries to stop him, but Lelouch plans on making an appearance despite the Viceroy's plot. But will the "Goddess of Victory" prove to be a more cunning opponent?

1.title: Stage 8: The Black Knights
1.desc: While Lelouch forms his knights of justice, the Japan Liberation Front takes tourists hostage including Lelouch's friends and the Princess Euphemia. Will their rescue require Lelouch to work on the same side as Cornelia, or does he have other plans?

1.title: Stage 9: Refrain
1.desc: A drug known as ‘Refrain' is rampant on the street and being pushed on the Japanese citizens. The Black Knights become involved, and Kallen's biological mother turns out to be a victim of the drug.

1.title: Stage 10: Guren Dances
1.desc: As the Black Knights grow in numbers they gain more resources and new weapons. Lelouch devises a plan to trap Cornelia when she stages an attack against the Japan Liberation Front in Narita. Will their new weapons prove their worth?

1.title: Stage 11: Battle for Narita
1.desc: After taking out the majority of Cornelia's troops, the Black Knights work towards cornering her. Right when Lelouch thinks he can declare checkmate, Suzaku appears to protect the Viceroy. And when C.C. comes to his aid, her powers reveal more about her.

1.title: Stage 12: The Messenger from Kyoto
1.desc: Impressed by the Black Knights' performance, the Kyoto suppliers seek council with them. If the meeting goes well, it could mean better resources and weapons. But when the leader demands to see Zero's face or no deal, will Lelouch make that sacrifice?

1.title: Stage 13: Shirley at Gunpoint
1.desc: The Black Knights set out to work with the J.L.F., supposedly siding with them, but Lelouch has something else up his sleeve. When the plan begins to go awry, Lelouch may have his secret revealed in front of the last person he expects.

1.title: Stage 14: Geass vs. Geass
1.desc: Lelouch has to figure out who saw him before his identity is revealed to others, but when it turns out to be someone close to him, is he prepared for the consequences? When a second Geass user shows up, his situation becomes even more complicated.

1.title: Stage 15: Cheering Mao
1.desc: C.C. reveals the truth behind Mao's Geass and his intentions to take her back. But what truths about the Geass and Mao is she leaving out? Lelouch could have yet another enemy to watch out for.

1.title: Stage 16: Nunnally Held Hostage
1.desc: Nunnally is taken hostage, but Lelouch has little time to save her and no idea where she could be. Can he accept help from Suzaku, or will he risk exposing everything?

1.title: Stage 17: Knight
1.desc: Lelouch has the chance to gain more allies: Tohdoh from the J.L.F. and more importantly, Suzaku. But when Lelouch learns the truth behind the pilot of the white Knightmare, his plans could fall to pieces.

1.title: Stage 18: I Order You, Suzaku Kururugi
1.desc: Suzaku is appointed to be the princess' royal knight, leaving Lelouch to struggle with the decision of what to do about him. He wants Suzaku on his side, but will using the Geass on another loved one be the choice he has to make?

1.title: Stage 19: Island of the Gods
1.desc: Suzaku and Lelouch wake up on an island with no memory of what happened to them after the Avalon's appearance. But Lelouch has more to worry about when Princess Euphemia reveals she knows Zero's identity.

1.title: Stage 20: Battle at Kyushu
1.desc: The Chinese Federation makes their move, claiming to support the J.L.F. The Black Knights refuse to be tied to them while the Britannian Empire plans to push back the attack. When given little choice, Suzaku must decide to work with Zero or give up.

1.title: Stage 21: The School Festival Declaration!
1.desc: Instead of getting time to work on his coup d'état, Lelouch is stuck working the school festival with the student council. Things get chaotic when the event attracts everyone, including Britannian soldiers and Euphemia, who makes a startling announcement.

1.title: Stage 22: Bloodstained Euphy
1.desc: With the Nippon special zone plans going forward, it seems there will be no need for a group like the Black Knights. Lelouch has a plan to make it work in his favor, but when things don't go as planned, it could lead to something much worse.

1.title: Stage 23: At Least with Sorrow
1.desc: Lelouch takes advantage of the ceremony's tragedy to finally declare the independence of Japan. With the change to his Geass, he'll have to make more sacrifices or else it could lead to more misfortune. For the revenge he seeks, it may be what he needs.

1.title: Stage 24: The Collapsing Stage
1.desc: As the Black Knights gain control, Lelouch presses forward towards the army. A mysterious boy named V.V. informs Suzaku of Zero's powers, which enrages the young man, sending him on a tear to get his revenge for Euphemia. Revenge Cornelia seeks as well.

1.title: Stage 25: Zero
1.desc: With Cornelia at his mercy, Lelouch seeks answers about his mother's death. Suddenly, C.C. tells him that Nunnally has been kidnapped and that he must leave. Without Zero in the battle, can the Black Knights survive? Or will it all end with Suzaku's vengeance?

2.title: Turn 1: The Day a Demon Awakens
2.desc: It's a year after the battle between the Black Knights and the Britannian army. Zero is dead, and only a handful of Black Knights remain. But Lelouch is alive with no memory of the last year. Is it a trick or all part of a greater plan?

2.title: Turn 2: Plan for Independent Japan
2.desc: With his memories back, Lelouch brings Zero to life once more. But there's a year's worth of work to rebuild and still many unknown variables. What new advantages will the Britannian army have against them, and is Zero up to the task to face them again?

2.title: Turn 3: Imprisoned in Campus
2.desc: Lelouch tries to get clues about Nunnally's whereabouts, but no one around him remembers her. To find her, he'll have to figure out his mysterious new brother, Rolo. But he'll have to do it while maintaining the guise that his memory hasn't returned.

2.title: Turn 4: Counterattack at the Gallows
2.desc: Lelouch only has a short time to save the imprisoned Black Knights and regain his followers. But he also needs to figure out Rolo and his role in Britannian's game. Will this boy and his Geass keep Lelouch from bringing back the Black Knights?

2.title: Turn 5: Knights of the Round
2.desc: Suzaku returns to Ashford Academy to monitor Lelouch, determined to see if the other has regained his memories. Lelouch must take more care around the Britannian soldier. But when Suzaku plays an unexpected card, Lelouch's guard may fall to pieces.

2.title: Turn 6: Surprise Attack over the Pacific
2.desc: Nunnally is set to be the new Viceroy of Area 11, and Lelouch will take every chance to get her back. But the reunion he wants may not go quite as planned. Has Nunnally chosen Suzaku over her beloved brother?

2.title: Turn 7: The Abandoned Mask
2.desc: When Nunnally reveals her plans on starting the Nippon special zone again, Lelouch realizes that he may no longer be needed at her side. Has Zero's purpose been lost? Has the time come to drop the mask and stop his game?

2.title: Turn 8: One Million Miracles
2.desc: Zero agrees to join the Nippon special zone, much to the surprise of the Black Knights. He makes a deal with the Britannian army that will lead to his exile. But exile is the same as running away; has Zero forsaken the Japanese and his plans?

2.title: Turn 9: A Bride in the Vermillion Forbidden City
2.desc: A wedding is set to occur between the empress of the Chinese Federation and the first prince of Britannia. If the Chinese Federation turns on the Black Knights, everything they've work towards could come to an end. Will Zero dare to crash a royal wedding?

2.title: Turn 10: When Shen Hu Wins Glory
2.desc: Zero absconds with the empress, taking her out of the Vermilion City. Before he can get far, they are stopped by an unknown Knightmare. The Chinese Federation gains the advantage, taking one of the Black Knights hostage. Can the Knights afford the loss?

2.title: Turn 11: Power of Passion
2.desc: The Black Knights continue their fight against the Chinese, but the battle takes a turn for the worse when the Britannians back the Eunuchs. They no longer care about the empress' wellbeing, meaning Zero may have lost his bargaining chip…and the battle.

2.title: Turn 12: Love Attack!
2.desc: The Knights of Round have become students at Ashford Academy right as Lelouch has returned. But he has other worries, like the countless dates his stand-in set up while he was away. Lelouch must take on his next challenge—Cupid Day!

2.title: Turn 13: Assassin from the Past
2.desc: Jeremiah seeks out Lelouch to end their dance once and for all. With his ability to cancel Lelouch's Geass power, Jeremiah may be more of a threat than expected. Or will an unexpected connection change their dynamic?

2.title: Turn 14: Geass Hunt
2.desc: With Shirley's death hanging over him, Lelouch directs his anger towards the Geass power. He makes his first contact with the mysterious V.V. and declares war. Meanwhile, Suzaku plans to take drastic measures to force answers about Lelouch out of Kallen.

2.title: Turn 15: The C's World
2.desc: Finally, Lelouch comes face to face with his father. Everything he's planned and schemed has led to this confrontation. But when C.C. shows up, suddenly the truth about his contract and her past change everything he thought he understood.

2.title: Turn 16: United Federation of Nations Resolution Number One
2.desc: The emperor is missing, and Zero takes the chance to ratify the United Federation of Nations. With the 47 nations involved, they will have enough backing to declare war on the Britannian Empire, finally freeing their countries. But nothing is ever so easy…

2.title: Turn 17: The Taste of Humiliation
2.desc: While the war rages on, Lelouch begs for Suzaku's help in making sure Nunnally will be safe. But with the death of Euphemia and Shirley still heavy in his heart, will Suzaku be able to do this for Zero, the murderer, or is it for Lelouch, his oldest friend?

2.title: Turn 18: Final Battle Tokyo II
2.desc: The battle for Tokyo fills the sky. The Black Knights take out the power gaining temporary advantage, but when Suzaku appears, he threatens to use Britannian's most terrifying weapon: the F.L.E.I.J.A. But to fire such a devastating weapon…is it worth it?

2.title: Turn 19: Betrayal
2.desc: Nunnally is gone. Lelouch cannot deal with the grief, and as he locks himself away, Prince Schneizel calls a temporary ceasefire to reveal the truth behind Zero to his Black Knights. When they learn of his Geass, will this be the end of the Black Knights?

2.title: Turn 20: Emperor Dismissed
2.desc: Lelouch has lost everything and knows the only thing left is to take out his father, the Emperor. But he's not the only one bent on seeking him out. Suzaku, on Schneizel's orders, plans to assassinate the Emperor. What awaits the two on Kamine Island?

2.title: Turn 21: The Ragnarök Connection
2.desc: Having trapped himself and his father, Lelouch finally demands the truth behind his mother's death. When Marianne herself appears, everything that Lelouch thought he knew crumbles around him. It's time to face the truth from the beginning.

2.title: Turn 22: Emperor Lelouch
2.desc: Lelouch has overtaken the empire, establishing himself as Emperor. He starts by abolishing the aristocracy and announcing Suzaku as the Knight of Zero. Lelouch announces that Britannia will join the U.F.N., but Schneizel makes an unexpected move.

2.title: Turn 23: Schneizel's Guise
2.desc: Nunnally has declared Lelouch and Suzaku as her enemies. By siding with Schneizel she is allowing the use of the F.L.E.I.J.A., but she has been led to believe the destructive weapon would be used only when necessary. However, Schneizel has other plans

2.title: Turn 24: The Grip of Damocles
2.desc: The Black Knights fight a close battle with Schneizel, neither side giving way. Before the F.L.E.I.J.A.'s can destroy them all, Lelouch must outsmart the brother he has never beaten and face the sister he has spent his life protecting.

2.title: Final Turn: Re;
2.desc: Lelouch makes his final move; Zero Requiem takes action.

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion
description: At the turn of the century, the Angels returned to Earth, seeking to wipe out humanity in an apocalyptic fury. Devastated, mankind's last remnants moved underground to wait for the day when the Angels would come back to finish the job. Fifteen years later, that day has come...
cast: Spike Spencer, Megumi Ogata, Allison Keith, Kotono Mitsuishi, Amanda Winn Lee, Megumi Hayashibara
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Angel Attack
1.desc: In the year 2015, an Angel returns to attack Tokyo-3. Misato Katsuragi transports Shinji to the NERV base overseen by his estranged father, Gendo.

1.title: The Beast
1.desc: After piloting the Eva Unit 01, Shinji wakes up in the hospital with no memory of the battle. Feeling sorry for him, Misato lets him move in with her.

1.title: A Transfer
1.desc: Word gets around school that Shinji is the Eva pilot; his classmate Toji resents him for it. An Angel appears and Shinji must pilot in combat again.

1.title: Hedgehog's Dilemma
1.desc: Stressed out following his last battle, Shinji runs away from home and meets Kensuke. After NERV brings him back in, Misato offers him a choice.

1.title: Rei I
1.desc: Unit 00's pilot Rei Ayanami appears to have recovered, but she has no friends, no records of her past, and no interest in getting to know Shinji.

1.title: Rei II
1.desc: As the Fifth Angel drills toward NERV, Misato leads Operation Yashima: All of Japan's power will be diverted to take out Ramiel with a positron rifle.

1.title: A Human Work
1.desc: Ritsuko tells Shinji about the classified true cause of the Second Impact. Then she and Misato attend the field test for an Eva competitor mecha.

1.title: Asuka Strikes!
1.desc: Shinji and his friends accompany Misato to meet Eva Unit 02 and its pilot Asuka at sea. Misato's old friend Ryoji Kaji is aboard with his own agenda.

1.title: Both of You, Dance Like You Want to Win!
1.desc: Asuka and Shinji face another Angel but it gets the upper hand. They now have six days to learn synchronized moves to destroy it completely.

1.title: Magma Diver
1.desc: NERV learns of an Angel in dormant embryonic form inside a volcano. Using equipment designed for magma, Asuka is sent to retrieve it with Unit 02.

1.title: The Day Tokyo-3 Stood Still
1.desc: Tokyo-3 loses power just as another Angel is detected. The Eva pilots must enter the base from the surface while NERV preps the Units manually.

1.title: She said, "Don't Make Others Suffer for Your Personal Hatred"
1.desc: With Gendo and Fuyutsuki in Antarctica, a newly promoted Misato is in charge when a new Angel appears above the Earth, aiming to bomb Tokyo-3.

1.title: Lilliputian Hitcher
1.desc: An Angel infiltrates NERV, quickly taking over the MAGI supercomputer. Ritsuko proposes writing a program to forcibly evolve Ireul to its extinction.

1.title: Weaving a Story
1.desc: As Seele reviews NERV and Gendo's actions with the Third through Eleventh Angels, Ritsuko conducts a test in which the Eva pilots switch Units.

1.title: Those Women Longed for the Touch of Others' Lips, and Thus Invited Their Kisses
1.desc: For the first time in years, Shinji meets his father at his mother's grave. Ritsuko, Misato and Ryoji attend a wedding and Asuka goes on a date.

1.title: Splitting of the Breast
1.desc: While in battle, Shinji and Unit 01 are engulfed in the spreading shadow of an Angel. As NERV fears them both lost, Shinji has a strange experience.

1.title: Fourth Children
1.desc: NERV-02 in Nevada vanishes, along with the Eva Unit 04. With Unit 03 on the way, Gendo orders Ritsuko to assign a pilot to it.

1.title: Ambivalence
1.desc: Unit 03 arrives from the United States, but Shinji still doesn't know who its pilot is. During testing, NERV learns Unit 03 is possessed by an Angel.

1.title: Introjection
1.desc: Distraught after the battle, Shinji vows to never pilot an Eva again and quits NERV once more. Just as he's about to leave, another Angel attacks.

1.title: Weaving a Story II: Oral Stage
1.desc: After achieving an unheard of synchronization rate, Shinji merges with Unit 01. While he has an out of body experience, NERV works to salvage him.

1.title: He Was Aware That He Was Still a Child
1.desc: Seele kidnaps Fuyutsuki and interrogates him about NERV and Gendo's true intentions, revealing events from the past. Ryoji goes missing.

1.title: Don't Be
1.desc: Asuka's synchronization ratio continues to drop, undermining her self-confidence. Determined to show her worth, she ignores orders during battle.

1.title: Rei III
1.desc: Despite her struggles, Asuka is ordered to assist Rei in battle against Armisael. When she fails, Rei makes a desperate move in order to save Shinji.

1.title: The Beginning and the End, or "Knockin' on Heaven's Door"
1.desc: Kaworu Nagisa, the Fifth Child, comes to NERV to pilot Unit 02 in Asuka's place. He's friendly to Shinji, but he's shrouded in mystery.

1.title: Do You Love Me?
1.desc: The Human Instrumentality Project begins, and the souls of humanity merge. The Eva pilots confront the nature of their existence as reality dissolves.

1.title: Take Care of Yourself
1.desc: The Human Instrumentality Project continues. Shinji must decide whether to accept a world alone, or embrace connections with others.

title: Castlevania
description: A dark medieval fantasy following the last surviving member of the disgraced Belmont clan, trying to save Eastern Europe from extinction at the hand of Vlad Dracula Tepe himself. Inspired by the classic video game series.
cast: Richard Armitage, Alejandra Reynoso, James Callis, Theo James, Adetokumboh M'Cormack, Jaime Murray
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Witchbottle
1.desc: A headstrong young woman seeks out forbidden knowledge, and a corrupt bishop courts disaster by enraging a legend.

1.title: Necropolis
1.desc: Trevor Belmont drifts into the panicked city of Gresit, where he learns of an ancient evil and makes a surprising vow.

1.title: Labyrinth
1.desc: Belmont explores the catacombs of Gresit and makes a disturbing discovery. As night falls on the city, the beasts return for blood.

1.title: Monument
1.desc: Belmont strives to save Gresit from certain doom and comes face to face with a shocking truth.

2.title: War Council
2.desc: Dracula entrusts a deadly -- and personal -- mission with two humans who truly hate humanity, not knowing that he himself has become a target.

2.title: Old Homes
2.desc: As Belmont shares a bold strategy with Alucard and Sypha, Dracula addresses a conflict within his ranks. Isaac recalls a painful encounter.

2.title: Shadow Battles
2.desc: Belmont travels to his family's archives, along with Sypha and a cynical Alucard. Godbrand voices a suspicion about Dracula's motives.

2.title: Broken Mast
2.desc: As Godbrand's thirst grows stronger, Carmilla tries to recruit Hector. Isaac shows his loyalty, and Belmont shares a family story with Sypha.

2.title: Last Spell
2.desc: Carmilla presses forward with her plan despite Godbrand's disappearance. Sypha makes a startling discovery while combing the archives.

2.title: The River
2.desc: Does he really have what it takes to live up to his family's reputation? It's time for Belmont to pick his fate. Also, Dracula prepares for the fight.

2.title: For Love
2.desc: With nothing less than the future of humanity at stake, Belmont, Alucard and Sypha do battle with their immortal enemy: Dracula.

2.title: End Times
2.desc: With the war between humans and vampires seemingly settled, the survivors -- both good and evil -- look toward the future.

3.title: Bless Your Dead Little Hearts
3.desc: Alucard adjusts to his lonely new life, Belmont and Sypha pay a visit to an eerie and unusual town, and Carmilla returns home with a prize.

3.title: The Reparation of My Heart
3.desc: Isaac gets some unexpected help in his search for Hector. Meanwhile, Carmilla plots a land grab and Alucard meets some fans.

3.title: Investigators
3.desc: Belmont and Sypha's plan to leave Lindenfeld hits a snag. Isaac and the Captain debate the merits of humanity. Hector tries to get a read on Lenore.

3.title: I Have a Scheme
3.desc: Zumi and Taka share their history with Alucard. Also, Saint Germain gains entrance to the priory, and Isaac receives an icy welcome in Genoa.

3.title: A Seat of Civilisation and Refinement
3.desc: Belmont and the Judge discover an ominous symbol, Saint Germain's treasure hunt is cut short, and Alucard's bond with Zumi and Taka continues to grow.

3.title: The Good Dream
3.desc: Lenore continues to spend time with Hector, slowly earning his trust. Saint Germain experiences a telling nightmare about the Infinite Corridor.

3.title: Worse Things Than Betrayal
3.desc: As Saint Germain makes unsettling discoveries, Isaac marches toward a showdown. Meanwhile, Belmont and Sypha question a monk — aggressively.

3.title: What the Night Brings
3.desc: Something is alive in the priory's basement, and for Belmont and Sypha, time is of the essence. Lenore opens up to Hector about Carmilla's plans.

3.title: The Harvest
3.desc: Night falls on Lindenfeld and all manner of hell breaks loose. Also, Isaac meets the Magician, Hector makes a pledge, and Zumi and Taka make a move.

3.title: Abandon All Hope
3.desc: With the portal to hell open, Trevor and Sypha must battle an onslaught. Meanwhile, the Judge shares a disturbing legacy, and Hector learns his fate.

4.title: Murder Wakes It Up
4.desc: Belmont and Sypha continue to battle beasts loyal to Dracula, but it's getting a little old. Meanwhile, Alucard receives a guest.

4.title: Having the World
4.desc: Lenore urges Hector to not test Carmilla's patience. Belmont and Sypha cross paths with Zamfir, a fearsome guard with a suspicious mind.

4.title: Walk Away
4.desc: Isaac gets under Varney's skin. Vampires Morana and Striga receive an urgent message from Carmilla. Belmont and Sypha get a look at Targoviste.

4.title: You Must Sacrifice
4.desc: Alucard travels to Danesti, where he makes a dramatic entrance in the nick of time. Also, the scholar Saint Germain reflects on his own twisted path.

4.title: Back in the World
4.desc: With Greta's help, Alucard sets out to guide the villagers to his castle for protection. Sypha pushes back on Zamfir's leadership. Isaac makes a move.

4.title: You Don't Deserve My Blood
4.desc: As Isaac and his army of night creatures descend on Carmilla's castle, Hector rushes to finish his preparations before the bloody reunion begins.

4.title: The Great Work
4.desc: Varney and Ratko discover their plan is working — but who gets the credit? Also, Zamfir finally takes Belmont and Sypha underground.

4.title: Death Magic
4.desc: Belmont, Sypha and Zamfir battle Varney, Ratko and their unholy army. Alucard's castle falls under attack, and Saint Germain shares his scheme.

4.title: The Endings
4.desc: Belmont and Sypha join forces with their old friend Alucard — and not a moment too soon. As the battle rages, Varney reveals his true form.

4.title: It's Been a Strange Ride
4.desc: Not content to live in a cage, Lenore chooses another fate. Alucard opens his castle. Sypha wonders if she's lost Belmont for good.

title: Blood of Zeus
description: In a brewing war between the gods of Olympus and the titans, Heron, a commoner living on the outskirts of ancient Greece, becomes mankind's best hope of surviving an evil demon army, when he discovers the secrets of his past.
cast: Derek Phillips, Elias Toufexis, Jessica Henwick, Claudia Christian, Jason O'Mara, Fred Tatasciore
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: A Call to Arms
1.desc: Demons attack the polis near the home of the outcast Heron, who finds allies in the wise elder Elias and the fierce Amazonian warrior Alexia.

1.title: Past is Prologue
1.desc: After he completes a quest for adamantine ore, Heron learns the truth about his birth from his mother Electra, as well as the identity of his father.

1.title: The Raid
1.desc: The goddess Hera discovers the existence of Zeus's bastard son Heron and vows revenge. The polis falls to the forces of the malevolent Seraphim.

1.title: A Monster is Born
1.desc: Heron is taken captive by the army of Seraphim, who chases Alexia but instead encounters Hera. The goddess informs the demon leader of his true past.

1.title: Escape or Die
1.desc: Hera directs Seraphim to the powerful sword Zeus once forged for Heron, who is enslaved aboard a galley. Alexia seeks counsel from her mentor, Chiron.

1.title: Back to Olympus
1.desc: Zeus brings Heron to Olympus for training, angering the other gods. Alexia embarks on a mission to Melidoni with Heron's companions, Evios and Kofi.

1.title: The Fields of the Dead
1.desc: Seraphim's loyalties are tested when Zeus reveals Hera's deceptions. Alexia's company crosses the Fields of the Dead. War breaks out between the gods.

1.title: War for Olympus
1.desc: Hera resurrects the giants of the sea and assails Olympus, leading to an earth-shattering battle for the ages and the rise of a new demigod: Heron.

2.title: A Shadow Emerges
2.desc: Hades plots to steal a powerful stone from Zeus's temple while the battle for Olympus rages. Gaia sets Heron on a quest to save a former adversary.

2.title: Weights & Measures
2.desc: Seraphim faces harsh judgment in the Underworld and receives an unexpected offer from Hades, who reveals the true origin of the Eleusinian Stone.

2.title: Winter is Born
2.desc: Heron seeks guidance from the smithing god Hephaestus. To win Seraphim's allegiance, Hades tempts him with a promise to bring peace to a lost love.

2.title: Funeral Games
2.desc: While mourning their fallen king, the immortals honor Zeus with celebratory games. But the competition between Ares and Heron grows brutally violent.

2.title: Judgement Day
2.desc: Zeus is sentenced to his fate in the Underworld while Heron visits the land of his birth. Fueled by vengeance, Seraphim unleashes wrath upon an enemy.

2.title: Crossing Paths
2.desc: Heron and his companions fight a vicious swarm of Keres and encounter a surprising traveler along their journey. Demeter makes a bold play for power.

2.title: The Hidden Realm
2.desc: Aided by an Amazon fleet, Heron, Alexia and Kofi face the giant automaton Talos. To enter the Hidden Realm, Seraphim must first outsmart the Curetes.

2.title: The Three Trials
2.desc: With the crown of Olympus at stake, the gods clash swords in an epic battle for the Eleusinian Stone and the power it grants to whomever possesses it.

3.title: A Breath Before Dying
3.desc: Heron and Seraphim set forth on a mission of mercy while the heavens tremble with the rage of Typhon, who rains destruction down on the gods of Olympus.

3.title: Hades' Choice
3.desc: To protect those she holds dear, a selfless immortal confronts a towering terror. Freed from bondage, Cronos vows to teach the gods the meaning of fear.

3.title: Hellebore
3.desc: In the Underworld, the vengeful king of the Titans puts Hades' love to the ultimate test. Seraphim reveals his perilous plan to save Gorgo from torment.

3.title: Brothers' Journey
3.desc: Cronos schemes to weaken Zeus as the Olympians bid farewell to their fallen brethren. Old allies lend their swords in a clash against a colossal foe.

3.title: The Head of the Maenads
3.desc: While seeking an oracle to help guide them on their quest, Heron and his companions intrude upon a mysterious cult and their gruesome blood sacrifice.

3.title: The Tower of the Winds
3.desc: A humbled Hera pleads for aid on Zeus' behalf. In the home of the wind gods, Heron's search party fights a dark force that pits friend against friend.

3.title: Land of the Dead
3.desc: Two star-crossed soulmates reunite on the bank of the River Styx. Facing insurmountable odds, the last remaining Olympians square off against Cronos.

3.title: A Champion's Challenge
3.desc: With the fate of the gods at stake, the immortals and the Titans invoke the ways of old and settle their dispute through an epic battle of champions.

title: The Seven Deadly Sins
description: The story of the Seven Deadly Sins, a group of warriors who were wrongly accused of a crime they didn't commit and went on a quest to vindicate themselves.
cast: Yûki Kaji, Sora Amamiya, Jun Fukuyama, Aoi Yūki, Misaki Kuno, Tatsuhisa Suzuki
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: The Seven Deadly Sins
1.desc: The third princess of the Kingdom of Liones, Elizabeth, finds Meliodas, who is the owner of the Boar Hat bar and is also one of the Seven Deadly Sins. With her identity exposed, she is pursued by Twigo whom Meliodas quickly defeats. The princess joins him on his journey to find the other Deadly Sins in order to defeat the Holy Knights, who have orchestrated a coup d'état and have overthrown the king.

1.title: The Sword of the Holy Knight
1.desc: Gilthunder, thus preventing the village from making the Bernia ale, which was their prime source of income. After innumerable unsuccessful attempts of the villagers to remove the sword with which the source was blocked, Meliodas easily removes the object. A celebration is held at the Boar Hat, and Meliodas was hailed as a savior by Bernia's villagers. Gilthunder, wanting to confirm whether the removal of his sword was an accident, threw a spear imbued with his power toward the town. Meliodas, however, easily stops and throws the spear back, destroying Fort Solgales.

1.title: Sin of the Sleeping Forest
1.desc: Meliodas, Hawk and Elizabeth travel to the Forest of White Dreams that even Holy Knights avoid. There, the Prankster Imps that inhabit the Forest of White Dreams attempt to confuse them by impersonating Hawk and Elizabeth in order to lead them away. After defeating them, they follow them and find the Serpent's Sin of Envy, Diane sleeping in the forest. Gilthunder suddenly arrives and binds all of them with his lightning magic. Meliodas battles Gilthunder, purposely allows the Holy Knight to slash him, and under the pretense of dying due to the grave wound, acquires information about the whereabouts of two members of the Seven Deadly Sins, King and Ban, as his apparent last wish.

1.title: A Little Girl's Dream
1.desc: Having discovered the whereabouts of Ban and King, Diane throws Gilthunder out of the forest, and Meliodas, Hawk and Elizabeth, now joined by Diane, head toward the Baste Dungeon, where Ban is imprisoned. They later arrive at Dalmary Town where Meliodas is treated by Dana. Diane and Elizabeth begin to argue and discuss about the aspects in which they envy each other. They are suddenly attacked by the Holy Knight Friesia, who tries to destroy the entire town along with the Deadly Sins, but Diane quickly destroys all of her insects. Concurrently, Ban escapes from his cell in the Baste Dungeon, and is stopped by Jericho, who tries to subdue him. Dana unexpectedly reveals that the medicine Melio

1.title: Even If You Should Die
1.desc: Golgius appears and attempts to take Elizabeth and Meliodas' sword back to Liones. Whilst attempting to take the sword, Meliodas awakens, with no effect of the poison showing, proceeding to blast an aura that causes Golgius to make a hasty retreat.
