Meliodas and Elizabeth set off to Baste Dungeon afterwards, however, they are stopped by a confused Diane, who after hearing the sound of a bell, attacks the group. They try to run away from the berserk Diane, involving a pair of shepherds along the way, however Meliodas soon succumbs to the same bell, and begins to fight Diane. Meanwhile in Baste Dungeon, Ban is shown wandering around after having dealt with Jericho. It is not long before he is f

1.title: The Poem of Beginnings
1.desc: Elizabeth and Meliodas need the holy knights Friesia and Ruin sorted to get the dungeon. A harbinger indicates that a disaster on its way.

1.title: A Touching Reunion
1.desc: Meliodas picks the ggroup's next destination to be the rumored location of the King, the Capital of the Dead.

1.title: The Fearsome Pursuer
1.desc: King has a final confrontation with Ban, finishing him off with Ban being frozen, with Elaine making an appearance, never showing herself to King. A holy knight Guila battles it out against Meliodas, Diane and Elizabeth. Ban continues his flashbacks with Elaine and the Fairy forest, at the foutain of youth.

1.title: Dark Pulse
1.desc: The battle with the King comes to a close as he overpowers Guila with Chastiefol. Their time in the Capital of the Dead now over, Ban and Elaine have one more close moment, before being bid a farewell by Ellen and Luigi, who are revealed to have been ghosts this entire time...

1.title: The Vaizel Fighting Festival
1.desc: The Byzel fighting festival commences! After the initial brawl only leaves 8 people standing. The three first rounds unravel with some interesting displays of power and a few surprises.

1.title: Pent-up Feelings
1.desc: It's Meriodas vs. Ban in a a fight that shakes the ground beneath their feet. The semifinal rounds end up with the sins gaining one new friend and remembering an old one. Everything is ready for the final match while a storm starts brewing in the horizon.

1.title: Bloodcurdling Cannon
1.desc: The final round draws to a close. The Holy Knights descend upon the sins giving them some new powers and improved equipment. The Deadly Sins are pushed against the ropes.

1.title: The Angel of Destruction
1.desc: Meliodas is freed and the power of the Captain sin makes its debut. Possessed by a strange darkness, Meliodas assaults both enemies and allies until he clashes against Hellbram, the two of them fight mercilessly.

1.title: A Reader of Books
1.desc: News of an armored giant walking around the mountains reach the holy knights and they quickly send an assassination squad to deal with it. In the meantime, Meliodas's group also finds out about the mysterious giant. The holy knight team, the sins, and the giant clash in three-way battle with a very interesting outcome…

1.title: Unholy Knight
1.desc: The sins confront a strange demonic being. Meliodas is about to deal the final blow when he loses heart and stops attacking. In the meantime, Elisabeth discovers some facts about Meliodas's past. In the end, Elizabeth rushes to the battleground and her words give Meliodas the courage to fight to his full potential. When the sins inspect the dead body of the monster they find out it was some kind of hybrid between human and demon.

1.title: The Legends, Provoked
1.desc: Hendriksen and Hellbram make their first attempt to bring back the demon clan using the handle of Meliodas's sword, but the experiment fails and they appear to be missing one ingredient. Far away from there, Meliodas's group is taking a break from all the fighting…

1.title: The First Sacrifice
1.desc: Hendriksen and some of his guards welcome Arthur and his companion, a short person covered with a cloak. Meanwhile King finds a way to transport Diane and him to the city of Liones.

1.title: Even If It Costs Me My Life
1.desc: After a fight starts, Howzer and Guila combine their powers to protect Diane and Guila's little brother from the combined forces of Githunder, Helbram, Dreyfus, and Jericho.

1.title: The Fairy King Waits in Vain
1.desc: The King reminisces over some old memories of a time Diane and King spent together when Diane was still a giant child. Back to the present, King fights Hellbram, while in a different location Hendriksen fights Arthur.

1.title: The Courage Charm
1.desc: Gilthunder arrives to support Hendriksen against Meliodas, Arthur tries to keep Hendriksen busy while Meliodas fights Gilthunder, but has to withdraw leading to a three way fight...

1.title: The Looming Threat
1.desc: Ban explores the catacombs under the city. Merlin and the other sins go to the chamber where the king Baltra and Elizabeth are being held captive. Dreyfus has a confession.

1.title: What I Can Do for You
1.desc: Ban attempts to kill Meliodas, but is stopped by Hawk. Meliodas and the sins corner Hendriksen and prepare to take him down.

1.title: Despair Descends
1.desc: Hendriksen turns into an incredibly powerful monster. As Hendriksen overpowers both the sins and the holy knights only Meliodas is still standing...

1.title: The Heroes
1.desc: The group combines forces to defeat Hendriksen while Meliodas uses his ultimate technique. Following Hendriksen's defeat, the citizens of Liones saw a strange bird-like creature flying north. The sins and Elizabeth leave for their next adventure!

2.title: Revival of the Demon Clan
2.desc: After the defeat of demonized Hendrickson, The Seven Deadly Sins are commended for their bravery and courage by King Bartra. However, just before the ceremony, Ban and King leave. Earlier, Ban had told Meliodas that he is quitting the Seven Deadly Sins. As Ban leaves the Boar Hat Bar, King sees him and asks where he is going. Ban tells King that he wants to go to the Fairy King Forest. King then accompanies Ban on his journey. Meanwhile, it is reveals that Hendrickson has survived the assault from the Sins and he is shocked upon seeing Dreyfus alive. Dreyfus then summons the Commandments, ten demonized warriors who intend to destroy the Sins.

2.title: Existence and Proof
2.desc: The Ten Commandments are in the process of recovering their magical powers and fly to the Kingdom of Edinburgh in the east. Meanwhile, Jericho is discovered following Ban and King on the journey to the Fairy King's Forest. In the forest, the fairy people call King a traitor because he left the Fairy King's Forest 700 years ago, his absence allowing the forest to be almost entirely destroyed, while Ban is called the new Fairy King because he planted the last Sacred Tree seed that Elaine entrusted to him. Diane and Elizabeth admit to each other their love for King and Meliodas respectively. Meanwhile Gowther, believing he needs to experience love, alters Guila's memories so she forgets Zeal is

2.title: Sacred Treasure Lostvayne
2.desc: Diane confronts Gowther after he manipulates Guila and Zeal's memories. with the return of the Demon Clan, new threats descend upon allied clans.

2.title: The Ten Commandments on the Move
2.desc: King struggles to fend off the giant Albion sent to destroy the Fairy King's forest. Galand of the ten commandments appears before Meliodas.

2.title: Overwhelming Violence
2.desc: Galand, the truth of the ten commandments gets teleported to The Seven Deadly Sins. After his overwhelming power is revealed, Merlin realizes how terrifying the situation is.

2.title: The Great Holy Knight Atones for His Sins
2.desc: Hendrickson thought to have been defeated in a battle against Meliodas, aids Gilthunder and the Holy Knights against a powerful Gray Demon.

2.title: Where Memories Lead
2.desc: An injured Diane awakens, having trouble remembering her comrades. with her memories fading she heads for Magedoza, home of the Giant Clan.

2.title: The Druids' Holy Land
2.desc: Meliodas and others head to Megadozer in hopes of finding Diane. Meanwhile, a confused Diane encounters Galand of the Ten commandments once again.

2.title: The Promise with the Loved One
2.desc: Acknowledging his lack of strength to face the Ten Commandments, Meliodas vigorously trains with the Druids of Istar to regain his sealed powers back.

2.title: What We Lacked
2.desc: Ban reflects on his past after returning to his childhood home in Ravens. Meliodas's allies train for their inevitable war with the ten commandments.

2.title: Father and Son
2.desc: A frail Zhivago reunites with Ban, his long lost adopted son. Meanwhile, a wary King confronts Meliodas about his true intentions.

2.title: Where Love is Found
2.desc: After a brief encounter with Meliodas, the ten commandments begin their attack on Britannia. A resurrected Elaine appears before Ban.

2.title: Farewell, My Beloved Thief
2.desc: A revived but possessed Elaine attacks Ban, as Melascula and Galand of the ten commandments emerge to destroy those in their path.

2.title: Master of the Sun
2.desc: Jericho carries severely injured Ban and Elaine on her back while escaping from Galand and Melascula before stumbling into a bar deep inside a cave.

2.title: A Horrifying Confession
2.desc: Gloxinia and Drole of the ten commandments lure strong fighters to Vaizel by offering to grant any wish to the winner of their Great Fight Festival.

2.title: Death Trap Labyrinth
2.desc: An elaborate trap-laden deadly maze constructed by Drole begins to weed out the weaker challengers that have gathered for the great fight festival.

2.title: Legendary Figures
2.desc: The surviving challengers of the great fight festival are split into pairs and made to face each other in a tag team battle.

2.title: For Whom Does That Light Shine?
2.desc: King and Diane continue their battle against opponents summoned by Gloxinia and Drole. Escanor refuses to fight against his fellow ally Gowther.

2.title: Meliodas vs. The Ten Commandments
2.desc: The awakening of the ten commandments and beginning of the end of the kingdom of Britannia and the outbreak of the holy war. Now how will our heroes save Britannia from the hands of the ten commandments and from the demon lord.

2.title: In Search of Hope
2.desc: With Meliodas rendered powerless, Ban asks to be transported back so he can aid him in his fight against Estarossa and the other ten commandments.

2.title: Certain Warmth
2.desc: While caring for Meliodas, Elizabeth encounters a former Great Holy Knight thought to have perished long ago by the hands of Dreyfus and Hendrickson.

2.title: Return of the Sins
2.desc: With Ban and the holy knights paralyzed by Estarossa's powers, Escanor shows up to thwart the fall of Liones at the hands of the ten commandments.

2.title: The Hero Rises!
2.desc: As the situation inside Liones castle becomes even more dire, Merlin freed from Galand's commandment of truth, reappears in her former form.

2.title: As Long as You Are Here
2.desc: Determined to kill his former leader for betraying their clan 3,000 years ago, Fraudrin takes on a newly resurrected darker, more powerful Meliodas.

3.title: The Light That Disperses Darkness
3.desc: The demons are collecting human souls, whilst Estarossa is recovering from the battle with Escanor. Pelio discovers that humans are being given to the demons, who are defeated by Meliodas. The King chooses the next Great Holy Knight.

3.title: Memories of the Holy War
3.desc: King and Diane take refuge in the Fairy King's Forest to escape the Ten Commandments. But Gloxinia and Drole find them after a peaceful interlude.

3.title: Those Without Light
3.desc: Looking like Gloxinia and Drole, King and Diane are transported back to Britannia 3,000 years ago. There they meet Meliodas, who's fighting for Stigma.

3.title: The Ten Commandments vs. The Four Archangels
3.desc: Enraged by the events demons attack but Seriel and Tarmiel shows up and wipes out a large number of them in an instant. But as Ludociel joins the battle they are overpowered.Gowther and Melascula enters the stigma headquarters and takes over Nerobasta.

3.title: Emotional Maelstrom
3.desc: As Elizabeth succeeds in pushing back the indura form Gowther and Melascula are upto something in stigma headquarters, amidst of that Round and other humans attacks and kills everyone in stigma. As the gates open a person appears and gowther starts behaving differently..

3.title: We Call That Love
3.desc: Diane learns of the back-story of Gowther and makes a promise. King faces his final test in the realm and must make a crucial choice that Gloxinia faced 3000 years ago.

3.title: Deadly Sins Unite!
3.desc: Diane in the form of Drone goes against Zeldris the executioner but soon she realises his magnitude of power. After passing the test Diane and King unite with the rest of the sins.

3.title: The Doll Seeks Love
3.desc: Gowther's past memories resurface as he is reminded by the magical heart given to him by his master. Desperate to forget them, Gowther flees and tries to erase his memories, but The Seven Deadly Sins won't make it easy for him to do so.

3.title: The Cursed Lovers
3.desc: Merlin starts looking for Arthur but is trapped by Zeldris. Sins celebrate to their reunion but Elizabeth seems to be worried when Diane tells her about goddess Elizabeth. Merlin's condition is worsened but Elizabeth cures her and in that brief time she meets Zeldris who tells her something which in turn makes Meliodas extremely worried.

3.title: That is Our Way of Life
3.desc: Sins come to know about the tragic lives of Meliodas and Elizabeth. They decide to go to the walled city of Coland where none other than Zeldris shows up...

3.title: The Hateful Cannot Rest
3.desc: The party heads to the city of Coland to dispel the distortion protecting Camelot. When Meliodas is trapped in darkness, they must fight without him.

3.title: Love is a Maiden's Power
3.desc: Trapped in Melascula's magic, Meliodas breaks the magic at the cost of his emotions. Out of cocoon comes a very different Meliodas who will be confronted by the mightiest of the sin.

3.title: The Almighty vs. The Greatest Evil
3.desc: As things have escalated quickly this will be the final showdown among the strongest to prove who is better WRATH or PRIDE...

3.title: A New Threat
3.desc: Meliodas still unconscious after the fight with escanor, while Chandler proceeds to claim back his old student..

3.title: To Our Captain
3.desc: Chandler, Meliodas' former mentor, aids Zendris. He infiltrates the Boar Hat to capture Meliodas, but the Deadly Sins stand in his way.

3.title: Seven Deadly Sins End
3.desc: King prepares to face Chandler, who's returned in his demonic form. Gloxinia and Drole appear, risking their lives so the Deadly Sins can escape.

3.title: Our Choices
3.desc: Meliodas disbands the Deadly Sins and departs with Elizabeth. But his companions aren't going to let him go without a fight, and Hawk holds the key.

3.title: March of the Saints
3.desc: Merlin faces Zeldris, whom Meliodas has ordered to gather the Commandments. Margaret, Hendrickson and Dreyfus continue their search for Gilthunder.

3.title: The Holy War Accord
3.desc: Having taken over Margaret's body, Ludociel appears in Liones and declares a holy war against the Demon Clan. Chandler searches for Elizabeth.

3.title: Child of Hope
3.desc: In Camelot, Arthur searches for the Holy Sword Excalibur alone. Ludociel warns Escanor to give up his Grace of Sunshine, on pain of death.

3.title: Beginning of the Holy War
3.desc: Inside Camelot, Arthur makes his last stand against Meliodas and the others. Merlin comes to his rescue, but not before he falls under Cusack's spell.

3.title: War-torn Britannia
3.desc: The new Holy War commences as the allied forces of Stigma face off against the Demon Clan. Derieri decides to surrender her Commandment to Zeldris.

3.title: The One Twisted by Darkness
3.desc: Sensing Elizabeth's magic, Derieri appears before the Stigma army. Estarossa follows her, but Sariel and Tarmiel have other plans for him.

3.title: Rampaging Love
3.desc: Estarossa professes his love for Elizabeth. When he loses control after absorbing three of the Commandments, Stigma's army faces him in a final battle.

4.title: From Purgatory
4.desc: Ban searches in Purgatory for his best friend and captain emotions meanwhile in Camelot the assault force tries to stop Meliodas from becoming the new Demon King and the rescue team finds Elizabeth´s life is at stake.

4.title: A Meeting with the Unknown
4.desc: Reunited once again, Ban and Meliodas prepare to face the Demon King, who they suspect holds the key to their escape from purgatory.

4.title: A Single-Minded Love
4.desc: With Wild now an ally, Meliodas brings Zeldris` tragic past to light as the newly formed trio make their way towards the Demon King.

4.title: The Victims of the Holy War
4.desc: Meliodas grapples with suddenly losing his memories of Estarossa. Zeldris, Chandler and Cusack threaten to overpower Marlin and the others.

4.title: The Tragic Strike
4.desc: Gowther reveals that his creator, the real Gowther, cast a forbidden spell on Mael and all those who knew him to end the Holy War 3,000 years ago.

4.title: Confront Despair!!
4.desc: Mael defeated Derieri and took her commandment, giving Mael access to four commandments, but he isn`t done yet and seeks to take all ten. Gowther challenges Mael in order to protect his companions. Diane too arrives to fight Mael, but Mael`s final form is overwhelming. Thus Diane, King, and Gowther begin their special technique.

4.title: Hope, Conflict, and Despair
4.desc: Mael has become a strange figure by fusing with four commandments. King was temporarily cornered in front of Mael`s mighty power, but he awakens as "Fairy King Harlequin" and wields his true power. King, who can now activate multiple spirit spears at the same time, finally corners Mael. However, Gowther regrets his actions and seeks a chance to save Mael. Gowther then chose to "invade" and confront Mael`s spiritual world.

4.title: The Doorway to Hope
4.desc: Meliodas, Ban, and Wild finally confront the Demon King in purgatory. To escape from purgatory they must get past the Demon King who guards the gate. However, they struggle in their effort, for the Demon King has the ability to steal their attacks.

4.title: That Which Gathers
4.desc: Chandler and Cusack merge to form the all-powerful Original Demon. Merlin gives up any hope of victory, but Mael and King soon come to her aid.

4.title: The Salvation of the Sun
4.desc: As Meliodas absorbs every last one of the Ten Commandments, Merlin attempts a forbidden spell to stop the birth of the new Demon King.

4.title: The One Who Stands Against a God
4.desc: Merlin`s spell thwarts Meliodas` transformation. The Holy War seems to be over, but Elizabeth senses something is still terribly wrong.

4.title: We'll All Be Your Strength
4.desc: Escaping purgatory, Ban faces the Demon King, who now possesses Meliodas' body. Elizabeth and the others make their way into the spirit world.

4.title: The End of a Long Journey
4.desc: Peace returns to the Kingdom of Liones. Although Elizabeth is still under a curse, Meliodas assures her there is a way to break it.

4.title: Farewell, Seven Deadly Sins
4.desc: The world was trying to eliminate Meliodas, who became the new Demon King and became too powerful. Meliodas didn't tell anyone about the looming deadline.

4.title: Fated Brothers
4.desc: The curse on Elizabeth and Meliodas is still here. Which means the demon lord is still here.

4.title: The Final Battle
4.desc: The demon king, who revived using Zeldris as a substitute, and the demon beast Indura summoned by the demon king.

4.title: The Voice Calling Your Name
4.desc: Zeldris becomes even more powerful as the demon king. Then Escanor appeared to the "Seven Deadly Sins" in a difficult situation. Meliodas and Gowther invade the spiritual world of Zeldris, taking advantage of the good fight.

4.title: The King Sings Alone
4.desc: Diane`s technique "Mother Creation" finally succeeded in extinguishing the "Magic Lake" that was the source of the magical power of the Demon King. At the same time, it turns noon. The strongest minute for Escanor is here...!

4.title: The Struggle
4.desc: Escanor, who fights by converting all his vitality into magical power, approaches the Demon King. However, Meliodas stands in front of the deadly Escanor. It is because he realizes that he could lose his life.

4.title: Mortal Enemies
4.desc: The Demon King separates from the body of Zeldris and uses the land of Britannia as a new substitute, and undergoes a horrifying evolution. But they were convinced of their victory. Seven Deadly Sins believes in the bond with their friends and launches attacks all at once with a special move.

4.title: What the Witch Had Always Wanted
4.desc: "When the balance between light and darkness is lost, the age of the gods is over and the chaos revives. And the world will be reborn. "

4.title: A Taste of Chaos
4.desc: A secret feeling for Meliodas, and a resurgence of chaos to satisfy the hunger of the heart ... Merlin's aim revealed. In addition, the magical lake "Chaotic Priestess" begins to support Merlin's actions.

4.title: An Everlasting Kingdom
4.desc: Merlin, who has been separated from the "Seven Deadly Sins", confronts Cass alone to protect Arthur. Arthur also pulls out his sword and confronts Cass.

4.title: Heirs
4.desc: Series Finale

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
description: Disregard for alchemy’s laws ripped half of Edward Elric’s limbs from his body and left his brother Alphonse’s soul clinging to a suit of armor. To restore what was lost, the brothers seek the Philosopher’s Stone.
cast: Romi Park, Rie Kugimiya, Shinichiro Miki, Kenta Miyake, Mai Goto, Megumi Takamoto
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Fullmetal Alchemist
1.desc: The Elric brothers adjust to military life and take part in a manhunt for Isaac the Freezer, a former State Alchemist bent on ending the reign of Fuhrer Bradley.

1.title: The First Day
1.desc: A glimpse into the past reveals the pain and desperation that drove the Elric boys to break alchemy's greatest taboo - human transmutation - and their reasons for becoming dogs of the military.

1.title: City of Heresy
1.desc: Science and faith collide when the Elrics confront Father Cornello. He claims to work miracles, but the brothers suspect him of abusing a Philosopher's Stone to manipulate his flock.

1.title: An Alchemist's Anguish
1.desc: The Elrics meet Shou Tucker, a leading researcher in the field of chimeras. He has much to teach Ed and Al about alchemy - and the horrible cruelty that sometimes accompanies it.

1.title: Rain of Sorrows
1.desc: Edward and Alphonse are attacked by Scar, a mysterious killer wanted for a string of gruesome murders. His powers are incredible - and his obsession with slaying State Alchemists might be justified.

1.title: Road of Hope
1.desc: Before arriving at the Rockbell home for repairs, the Elrics meet Dr. Marcoh, a State Alchemist running from past sins. The information he gives Ed and Al could put the Philosopher's Stone within reach.

1.title: Hidden Truths
1.desc: The Elrics discover the horrific ingredient needed to create a Philosopher's Stone. When night falls, they prowl the grounds of a secret laboratory in search of more facts - but the brothers find only danger.

1.title: The Fifth Laboratory
1.desc: Ed and Al furiously battle the Fifth Laboratory's psychotic guards. In the chaos, the truth behind the Philosopher's Stone is buried beneath rubble - and disturbing new questions are unearthed.

1.title: Created Feelings
1.desc: Al is haunted by the notion his entire existence was simply created by his brother. When the youngest Elric angrily reveals these suspicions, only Winry can convince him just how wrong he is about Ed.

1.title: Separate Destinations
1.desc: When the conspiracy surrounding the Philosopher's Stone closes in on the highest ranks of the military, one of Mustang's most trusted and cherished allies is murdered.

1.title: Miracle at Rush Valley
1.desc: The Elrics, realizing alchemy has yet to unlock the mysteries of creating life, feel powerless when a new friend goes into labor. Winry, however, jumps into action with a young thief named Paninya.

1.title: One is All, All is One
1.desc: While visiting Izumi, their childhood teacher, the Elrics recall the early difficulties of grasping equivalent exchange. They also discover she shares their intimate knowledge of alchemy's greatest taboo.

1.title: Beasts of Dublith
1.desc: Al is abducted by chimeras led by the seemingly indestructible Homunculus known as Greed. When Ed's rescue attempt falls short, Izumi proves once more that she's got the brothers' best interests in mind.

1.title: Those Who Lurk Underground
1.desc: In a violent clash with Greed, King Bradley proves to be a brutal opponent. But the man who finally destroys the Ultimate Shield is more powerful than even the Fuhrer himself.

1.title: Envoy from the East
1.desc: The Elrics scuffle with Ling Yao and his attendants, Lan Fan and Fu, visitors from Xing seeking the Philosopher's Stone. Ed may not like him, but Ling Yao's not leaving until he gets what he wants.

1.title: Footsteps of a Comrade-in-Arms
1.desc: After learning of Hughes's fate, Ed and Al are ravaged by sadness and guilt. Envy still hides in plain sight among the State Alchemists, and another Homunculus is on the verge of infiltrating their ranks as well.

1.title: Cold Flame
1.desc: Freed by an unlikely liberator, Ross's escape is interrupted by Mustang. Even those most loyal to the Flame Alchemist are shaken by the controversial action he takes against the accused killer of Maes Hughes.

1.title: The Arrogant Palm of a Small Human
1.desc: Ed's journey to a distant land of legend offers surprising new details behind Mustang's alleyway encounter with Ross. After a fateful encounter of his own, Elric learns a stunning secret about Winry's parents.

1.title: Death of the Undying
1.desc: Mustang, Alphonse, Havoc, and Hawkeye split up to search a military laboratory. If Lust has her way, none of them will ever see each other again.

1.title: Father Before the Grave
1.desc: Hohenheim's visit ends with a grave warning to Pinako, but Ed finds hope among the charred ruins of his childhood. Now more than ever, he has confidence that Al can be returned to his body.

1.title: Advance of the Fool
1.desc: Hoping to learn more about the Homunculi, Ed and Al devise a risky strategy to lure the creatures out of hiding. Step one of the brothers' plan: risk death at the hands of their most dangerous enemy - Scar.

1.title: Backs in the Distance
1.desc: Scar's mission to destroy those who slaughtered his people is fueled by justifiable rage. Upon learning the role Scar played in her parents' deaths, Winry claims those murderous feelings as her own.

1.title: Girl on the Battlefield
1.desc: Cooperation between Mustang's cabal and Ling Yao's band leads to the capture of a Homunculus. Unfortunately, their actions also capture the eye of the Homunculus hiding atop the military's ranks.

1.title: Inside the Belly
1.desc: Gluttony's twisted powers overwhelm the Elrics - and the creature's appetite is satisfied by battle's end. Meanwhile, Mustang acts on his suspicions of Bradley and finds himself in the belly of the beast.

1.title: Doorway of Darkness
1.desc: The Homunculi are winning. Ed and Ling face a horrific enemy within the hellish expanse of Gluttony's gut. In Central, Mustang can only watch as his loyal band of soldiers is divided by Bradley.

1.title: Reunion
1.desc: Truths are exposed when Al finds the one called Father, and Mustang hears the tale of Bradley's creation - but the most amazing revelation is reserved for Ed after he once again breaks alchemy's greatest taboo.

1.title: Interlude Party
1.desc: Visions of the past play out as Hohenheim reflects on the follies of man; the pain that comes with family, the truths of Alchemy and the roots of war.

1.title: Father
1.desc: The Elrics come face to face with Father - and his face is familiar indeed. Powerless and amazed, Ed and Al can only watch as Father creates a new Homunculus with alchemy that should be impossible.

1.title: Struggle of the Fool
1.desc: The Elrics are at Bradley's mercy; if the brothers make one wrong move, those dearest to them will pay. As Mustang quietly gathers allies at his side, Ed discovers there may be no need to find a Philosopher's Stone.

1.title: The Ishvalan War of Extermination
1.desc: As Edward hears Hawkeye's tale of a time when idealistic young soldiers were tasked with genocide, the horrors of the Ishvalan battlefield are revealed.

1.title: The 520 Cens Promise
1.desc: Even as his subordinates are scattered, Mustang finds he still has allies - unfortunately, so do his enemies. The Homunculi unleash one of the Ishvalan War's most notorious killers to deal with Scar and Marcoh.

1.title: The Führer's Son
1.desc: A secret encounter allows Mustang to spark new ambitions in an old friend - an ally with loyal troops at his command. Meanwhile, Edward and Alphonse share a chance meeting with their biggest fan - young Selim Bradley.

1.title: The Northern Wall of Briggs
1.desc: The frigid northern borderlands become a battlefield when Kimblee finally closes in on Scar. Deeper into the frozen wasteland, Ed and Al's fight is against the bitter elements as they struggle to reach Fort Briggs.

1.title: Ice Queen
1.desc: The soldiers at Fort Briggs remain ever vigilant against the threat of spies from Drachma. The massive compound may seem impenetrable - but a violent intruder offers destructive proof to the contrary.

1.title: The Shape of This Country
1.desc: Edward uncovers a conspiracy of staggering scope: a plot that has already claimed countless victims. Clues suggest that Fort Briggs will soon know bloodshed - and an entire nation will suffer.

1.title: Family Portrait
1.desc: As Raven tries to corrupt Armstrong, Ed and Al can only wait in their cell. Long ago, their father faced his own captivity, confined to an eternity of regret in an undying body. To escape the pain, he said goodbye.

1.title: The First Homunculus
1.desc: The first Homunculus reveals itself; Edward is surprised by an offer from Kimblee: Fullmetal can have all he has searched for - in exchange for becoming a mass murderer.

1.title: Conflict at Baschool
1.desc: When Scar is cornered by a pair of gruesome chimera, the Elrics must enter the fray as his unlikely allies. Later, Winry's attempt to confront Scar over his role in her parents' death ends in disaster.

1.title: Daydream
1.desc: The ruse of Winry's abduction by Scar is revealed, but a plan of rescue must still be hatched. A brutal storm is coming - one which only Alphonse Elric can brave.

1.title: Homunculus
1.desc: Long ago, the blood of a simple slave was used in an experiment which created a strange, shapeless being. In exchange for the gift of existence, the being gave the slave a name - and cursed him with immortality.

1.title: The Abyss
1.desc: Bound by more than blood, the Elrics have long shared joy and pain. Now, with Al wandering the frigid void - and Ed losing blood by Kimblee's hand - the mystical connection of their souls could prove fatal.

1.title: Signs of a Counteroffensive
1.desc: May and Marcoh's efforts to decode the research of Scar's brother yield progress, but it might be too late to prevent catastrophe. Violence is spreading across the land, and it will soon reach the northern border.

1.title: Bite of the Ant
1.desc: In the snowy north, the soldiers of Fort Briggs engage an invading army and Marcoh leads an attack against monstrous Envy. In Central, an ominous and shocking secret is revealed to Olivier Armstrong.

1.title: Revving at Full Throttle
1.desc: Hohenheim and Alphonse enjoy a chance to get reacquainted. Their bond is restored with ease, inspiring the father to share his secrets with his sons - but one of them is far away and on the run.

1.title: The Promised Day
1.desc: The Promised Day is approaching. While most will face the coming chaos with their own kind, Edward forms a new group comprised of human, chimera and Homunculus

1.title: Looming Shadows
1.desc: Those who have prepared to reclaim a nation find their plans exposed. The chaos multiplies after an assassin strikes down a mighty leader in broad daylight, and Alphonse falls prey to monsters in the dark.

1.title: Emissary of Darkness
1.desc: A sinister voice rings out from the shell of Al's armor, and Ed and Greed find themselves under attack. As the Homunculi use the darkness to their advantage, a face from the past arrives to join the battle.

1.title: The Oath in the Tunnel
1.desc: After investigating the twisted roots of the Bradley family tree, Mustang gathers his most loyal troops. Meanwhile, Ed and his allies continue fighting Selim, who shocks everyone by turning on his own kind.

1.title: Filial Affection
1.desc: With his father's help, Al takes incredible steps to contain the monstrous Pride. As the sun begins to rise on the Promised Day, the youngest Elric listens while the Homunculus ponders his very human mother.

1.title: Upheaval in Central
1.desc: Mustang leads a ragtag assault force of hardy northern troops - and welcome faces from the past - against Central's defenses. Victory seems certain until the military's most horrifying secret is revealed.

1.title: The Immortal Legion
1.desc: Ed's crew faces a horde of ravenous mannequins, abominations powered by human souls. The twisted creatures aren't the only unstoppable force on the battlefield - Pride, Sloth, and Envy are on the move.

1.title: Combined Strength
1.desc: With the philosopher stone in his possession, Alphonse fearlessly takes on pride and Kimble. Elsewhere, the Armstrongs find themselves trapped between Sloth's onslaught and the guns of Central's troops.

1.title: Flame of Vengeance
1.desc: After a startling radio broadcast grants Mustang's forces the advantage over Central's troops, the Flame Alchemist unleashes the brutal power of burning hatred in the battle against the killer of Maes Hughes.

1.title: Beyond the Inferno
1.desc: As Envy writhes within the firestorm unleashed by Mustang's vengeful rage, Hawkeye must take drastic measures to prevent the Flame Alchemist's hatred from going out of control.

1.title: The Adults' Way of Life
1.desc: A rebel victory is imminent and hope takes hold among Mustang and Armstrong's troops. Central's forces teeter on the brink of collapse - until their fallen leader returns to take control.

1.title: The Return of the Führer
1.desc: Central's forces fight with renewed vigor following Bradley's return, and the Führer himself enters the battle. His first opponent is an armored tank. His second foe is even tougher.

1.title: Eternal Leave
1.desc: The battle for a nation's soul descends into chaos. Bradley unleashes death on those who dare engage him. Beneath Central, the one responsible for the Führer's creation unleashes something far, far worse.

1.title: Sacrifices
1.desc: Mustang must make a difficult choice: will he break alchemy's greatest taboo? Or will he watch the person dearest to him die? Meanwhile, it grows ever more difficult to discern where Ling ends and Greed begins.

1.title: Lost Light
1.desc: As the light of the sun vanishes, Mustang learns the loss which comes from seeing the other side of the Gateway - and five sacrifices gather in the dark presence of the Father.

1.title: Eye of Heaven, Gateway of Earth
1.desc: The light is gone. Shadows swallow everything. As the planet quakes and the heavens tremble, the souls of heroes and villains alike vanish into darkness. The circle is complete.

1.title: He Who Would Swallow God
1.desc: Millions of lifeless bodies litter the landscape of Amestris, and a being with the power to create suns is unleashed upon the world. Unless Hohenheim has something amazing up his sleeve, all is surely lost.

1.title: A Fierce Counterattack
1.desc: A truly epic battle erupts when Edward, Mustang, Hawkeye, Greed, Izumi, and Armstrong attack the god-like Father. The odds are against the forces of good - until one brave boy makes a shocking sacrifice.

1.title: The Other Side of the Gateway
1.desc: Ed fights the original homunculus known as 'The father' trying to defeat him in order to get his and Al's body back.

1.title: Journey's End
1.desc: Ed and Al start a new adventure in searching for new and innovative ways of alchemy.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
description: Elf mage Frieren and her fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land. But Frieren will long outlive the rest of her former party. How will she come to understand what life means to the people around her?
cast: Atsumi Tanezaki, Kana Ichinose, Chiaki Kobayashi
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: The Journey's End
1.desc: The world celebrates the Demon King's defeat at the hands of the Hero and his companions. Now that their great adventure is over, what will Frieren the mage do next?

1.title: It Didn't Have to Be Magic...
1.desc: Frieren instructs Fern in the use of magic while deciphering a grimoire for Heiter.

1.title: Killing Magic
1.desc: While retracing the path she took on her adventure with her former traveling companions, Frieren confronts an old enemy.

1.title: The Land Where Souls Rest
1.desc: Frieren and Fern pay a visit to Eisen, who requests their help in finding the notes of Flamme the Legendary Mage.

1.title: Phantoms of the Dead
1.desc: Frieren and Fern investigate ghost sightings at a village where people have started going missing.

1.title: The Hero of the Village
1.desc: Frieren and Fern enlist Stark's help to fight the solar dragon - but is he up to the task?

1.title: Like a Fairy Tale
1.desc: After reflecting on the transient nature of the past as it exists in people's collective memories, Frieren unexpectedly runs into a sworn enemy.

1.title: Frieren the Slayer
1.desc: As tensions in Graf Granat's domain reach a breaking point, Fern and Stark find their own resolve - and Frieren resumes an old duty.

1.title: Aura the Guillotine
1.desc: While Fern and Stark make a temporary retreat with Graf Granat, Frieren's true foe awaits her outside the city.

1.title: A Powerful Mage
1.desc: Frieren's many years of training under her teacher Flamme are tested in her confrontation with Aura the Guillotine. Will Aura's scales find her wanting?

1.title: Winter in the Northern Lands
1.desc: Frieren and her companions continue their journey through the northern lands, but obstacles both natural and manmade still stand in their way.

1.title: A Real Hero
1.desc: Deep in the mountains of the northern lands, Frieren and her party arrive at the Village of the Sword, where they have another job to do.

1.title: Aversion to One's Own Kind
1.desc: While passing by a village in the woods of the northern lands, Frieren and party meet Sein, a gifted priest who is nonetheless corrupt enough to give even Heiter a run for his money. But what happened in his past?

1.title: Privilege of the Young
1.desc: The party arrives in a large and lively town with a bustling shopping district that Frieren once visited with Himmel, but something seems to have come up between Fern and Stark.

1.title: Smells Like Trouble
1.desc: When the party happens upon a town whose inhabitants are all mysteriously asleep, it's time for their newest traveling companion to prove his mettle.

1.title: Long-Lived Friends
1.desc: Frieren pays a visit to Old Man Voll, a long-lived friend of hers, with traveling companions in tow.

1.title: Take Care
1.desc: Now that Sein finally has a lead on the whereabouts of his long-lost friend, is it time for him and Frieren's party to part ways?

1.title: First-Class Mage Exam
1.desc: Frieren and party finally arrive in Äußerst, ready to undergo the first-class mage exam, and meet a number of colorful characters who are there to do the same.

1.title: Well-Laid Plans
1.desc: Frieren and her new teammates hatch a plan to capture a Stille - but are the other teams just going to stand by and let it happen?

1.title: Necessary Killing
1.desc: The first-class mage exam intensifies as fighting breaks out between the participants - and what's at stake might even be worth killing for.

1.title: The World of Magic
1.desc: Frieren, Kanne, and Lawine struggle with the 13th party over possession of the Stille, but there'll be more surprises in store before their battle, and the first test, reach their conclusion.

1.title: Future Enemies
1.desc: After the conclusion of the first test, the exam participants have some time to kill in town. What do mages get up to on their days off?

1.title: Conquering the Labyrinth
1.desc: The aspiring first-class mages now face their second test: conquering the Ruins of the King's Tomb. A simple task, or so the proctor claims, but there's a reason this particular dungeon remains unexplored.

1.title: Perfect Replicas
1.desc: Due to the Spiegel, a legendary monster that can create perfect replicas of others, the test-takers who would conquer the Ruins of the King's Tomb must first face the ultimate enemy: themselves.

1.title: A Fatal Vulnerability
1.desc: A perfect imitation of Frieren stands between the test-takers and victory, but Fern believes she knows how to win. Is it time for the student to surpass the master?

1.title: An Era of Humans
1.desc: With the second test behind them, only one remains - but first, Frieren and Fern need to settle an important matter in town. What awaits them in the third test?

1.title: It Would Be Embarrassing When We Met Again
1.desc: As the first-class mage exam concludes and the test-takers go their separate ways, farewell leads to departure - but the next stage of Frieren's journey has only just begun.

2.title: Shall We Go, Then?
2.desc: Frieren, Fern, and Stark leave the magic city of Äußerst behind and travel along a road in the northern lands.

2.title: The Hero of the South
2.desc: In a village in the northern lands, Frieren's party are hired to polish a statue of a hero.

2.title: Somewhere She'd Like
2.desc: Frieren's party dream of hot springs as they reach Etwas, but the village is abandoned.

2.title: Other People's Homes
2.desc: Stark only asked Fern out as a joke, but the two end up going on a date.

2.title: Logistics in the Northern Plateau
2.desc: Frieren is reunited with Fass the dwarf, who has been searching for the Boshaft liquor for over 200 years.

2.title: A Demon-Slaying Request
2.desc: A village on the Northern Plateau is wiped out, and the victims' distinctive wounds point to a certain demon.

2.title: The Divine Revolte
2.desc: Frieren, Fern, and Methode enter the woods to look for the four-armed Divine Revolte.

2.title: A Magnificent End
2.desc: The Divine Revolte appears at the village, while Frieren, Fern, and Methode battle Solide and Hemmung.

2.title: Himmel's Memoirs
2.desc: When Frieren's party cannot afford the fare to cross Lake Korridor, the captain proposes a trade.

2.title: A Beautiful Sight
2.desc: Hidden within the massive bridge spanning the Great Canyon Tor is a secret story of Himmel and Gehen.

title: Erased
description: Satoru Fujinuma is a struggling manga artist who has the ability to turn back time and prevent deaths. When his mother is killed he turns back time to solve the mystery, but ends up back in elementary school, just before the disappearance of his classmate Kayo.
cast: Shin'nosuke Mitsushima, Tao Tsuchiya, Aoi Yūki
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Flashing Before My Eyes
1.desc: A sullen manga artist with special powers becomes immersed in a mystery he once thought was solved. When the unthinkable happens it is up to him to change the course of history.

1.title: Palm of the Hand
1.desc: Satoru must quickly adjust to resuming his life in the past and finding out just how he can stop his life from being turned upside down.

1.title: Birthmark
1.desc: Satoru accidentally alienates two classmates with one mistake. Later he gets a horrifying look into Kayo's home life and tries to make her happy after she tells him a sad story about her past.

1.title: Accomplishment
1.desc: Satoru enlists Sachiko to help him invite Kayo out to a local science center. But while they enjoy themselves, Satoru starts having some intense déjà vu, which causes him to worry that he's trapped in some kind of time loop.

1.title: Getaway
1.desc: After learning his efforts were in vain Satoru is transported back to 2006 in the midst of the manhunt for him and ends up placing his closest ally in danger.

1.title: Grim Reaper
1.desc: Satoru follows the only clue left behind by his mother , while it does prove useful Satoru struggles to stay one step ahead of the police.

1.title: Out of Control
1.desc: Satoru has an amazing breakthrough which results in a third chance of sorts. This time he is determined to revamp his game plan and change the course of time.

1.title: Spiral
1.desc: The killer finds the hiding site, though Kayo luckily manages to avoid being seen. Realizing she's still in mortal danger, Satoru tries to find a way to save her life, but worries about whether it will actually work.

1.title: Closure
1.desc: Satoru and Sachiko try to secure Kayo's safety by exposing her mother's abuse to the consultants. However, she passes her breaking point and goes berserk.

1.title: Joy
1.desc: After saving Kayo, Satoru is trying to get close to the next victim that the killer is going to be targeting. As he is going after a lead, new information about the killer is discovered.

1.title: Future
1.desc: Satoru wakes up in the year 2003, having been in a coma for fifteen years following Yashiro's attempt to kill him, and discovers that he has lost most of his memories, including the killer's identity.

1.title: Treasure
1.desc: Satoru remembers everything and Sensei will have to decide if he has to kill him or if he needs him too much to do it.

title: Devilman Crybaby
description: With demons reawakened and humanity in turmoil, a sensitive demon-boy is led into a brutal, degenerate war against evil by his mysterious friend, Ryo.
cast: Kouki Uchiyama, Ayumu Murase, Megumi Han
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: I Need You
1.desc: Ryo, a young professor returning from research abroad, takes his pure-hearted, crybaby friend Akira to a decadent party, where things turn demonic.

1.title: One Hand Is Enough
1.desc: Akira has become a completely different man -- he's stronger and hungrier than ever before. He seeks out Ryo for answers.

1.title: Believe Me!
1.desc: After getting shut down by his editor, paparazzo Nagasaki gets desperate. Silene and Kaim learn what happened to their missing fellow demon, Amon.

1.title: Come, Akira
1.desc: Akira's mother calls and says she'll be home soon. Everyone is looking forward to seeing her, but Ryo warns Akira not to trust any human.

1.title: Beautiful Silene
1.desc: Silene tracks down Amon, hoping to reawaken his demonic side. But in the ensuing battle, the human soul of Akira remains powerful.

1.title: Neither Demon Nor Human
1.desc: At a widely broadcast track meet, Ryo plans to expose high school athlete Koda as a demon, thereby spreading fear and distrust throughout society.

1.title: Weak Humans, Wise Demons
1.desc: With the fear of demons gripping the world, humanity devolves into paranoia and violence. Akira tries to save other demon-human hybrids like himself.

1.title: I Must Know Myself
1.desc: Ryo's actions and motives remain a mystery to himself, so he revisits his past for answers. Miki's father searches for his missing wife and son.

1.title: Go to Hell, You Mortals
1.desc: Betrayed and exposed, Akira becomes a target. After Miki takes to social media to defend his human soul, she and Miko find themselves under attack.

1.title: Crybaby
1.desc: Confronted by Akira, Ryo reveals the truth about demonkind and himself. Humans, demons and devilmen gather for an ultimate battle for the world.

title: The Way of the Househusband
description: After disappearing from the underworld, the legendary yakuza known as the "Immortal Dragon" resurfaces — as a fiercely devoted stay-at-home husband.
cast: Kenjiro Tsuda
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Episode 1
1.desc: Miku rushes off to work but forgets her bento. Tatsu tracks down a Policure Blu-ray for Miku's birthday. Gin takes a walk around the neighborhood.

1.title: Episode 2
1.desc: Masa realizes that housewives — and househusbands — have a lot in common with the yakuza. Tatsu takes a yoga class and thoroughly enjoys himself.

1.title: Episode 3
1.desc: Tatsu and Masa bump into Torajiro, a fellow ex-gangster now running a crepe truck. The cops grow suspicious of Tatsu's balcony herb garden.

1.title: Episode 4
1.desc: Miku's dad tries to bond with Tatsu over a game of catch. A cockroach infiltrates the apartment. The Immortal Claus stops by a kids' Christmas party.

1.title: Episode 5
1.desc: Tatsu takes a part-time job at a cafe. Then he bumps into a deceased yakuza boss's wife, who's now working at the supermarket. It's Tatsu's birthday!

1.title: Episode 6
1.desc: While at the mall, Tatsu catches a live Policure show. Later, he goes on a date with Miku to an amusement park, then takes a trip to the beach.

1.title: Episode 7
1.desc: Torajiro hits up Tatsu for some street-level information on the latest craze: bubble tea. Tatsu takes Masa on a confusing trip to the 100-yen shop.

1.title: Episode 8
1.desc: Tatsu gets pulled into a rap battle, then enters a Halloween costume contest with Miku. Things get intense during a trip to a buffet restaurant.

1.title: Episode 9
1.desc: A battle ensues inside Tatsu's body when he catches a fever. Masa stops by for New Year's. In a baking class, Tatsu drives home the value of heart.

1.title: Episode 10
1.desc: To buy Miku a limited edition Policure DVD, Tatsu has to memorize a confusing discount code catchphrase. Tatsu and Miku dogsit; Gin takes another walk.

2.title: Episode 1
2.desc: Miku needs to eat her way through a huge pile of pastries. Tatsu's no match for the typhoon. Then, Tatsu, Miku and Masa go camping.

2.title: Episode 2
2.desc: Tatsu gets intimidated at a meeting of women's group leaders. Gokudon visits a little girl in the hospital. Miku finds Tatsu collapsed on the floor!

2.title: Episode 3
2.desc: Torajiro gets a formidable rival — his sister. It's snowing! The popcorn is popped, but Tatsu, Miku and Masa can't decide on what DVD to watch.

2.title: Episode 4
2.desc: Tatsu gives Miku pointers on how to play golf. A group of scary looking guys walk into the woods. Tatsu, Miku and Masa can't take the heat.

2.title: Episode 5
2.desc: Little Suzu refuses to eat her veggies. To really get rid of weeds, you've got to pull them up by the roots. Tatsu and Torajiro have a bug fight.

title: Great Pretender
description: Supposedly Japan's greatest swindler, Makoto Edamura gets more than he bargained for when he tries to con Laurent Thierry, a real world-class crook.
cast: Chiaki Kobayashi, Junichi Suwabe, Mie Sonozaki, Natsumi Fujiwara
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Los Angeles Connection (Case 1.1)
1.desc: Makoto and his partner make their living conning the innocent. But when a simple scam on a tourist goes awry, he's soon out of his depth in Los Angeles.

1.title: Los Angeles Connection (Case 1.2)
1.desc: Dangling from the Hollywood sign, Makoto recalls his path from salesman to a life of crime. Back on the ground, he learns more about "confidence men."

1.title: Los Angeles Connection (Case 1.3)
1.desc: Makoto tells Laurent how he got into Eddie's good graces, but keeping up the con isn't easy, and the LAPD is monitoring the situation closely.

1.title: Los Angeles Connection (Case 1.4)
1.desc: With construction proceeding on the new lab, Makoto enjoys LA in the company of Eddie's enforcer, and Pola Dickens sets her sights on him.

1.title: Los Angeles Connection (Case 1.5)
1.desc: The pressure is on as everyone watches Makoto make the first batch of Sakura Magic, but with Agent Dickens in his ear, things take a very serious turn.

1.title: Singapore Sky (Case 2.1)
1.desc: Two years later, Makoto gets an honest job as a mechanic once he gets out, while Laurent and the crew reunite for a job in Las Vegas.

1.title: Singapore Sky (Case 2.2)
1.desc: The crew heads to Singapore to begin the con on the two princes and the fixed Path Finder Air Race, but Makoto has concerns about Abbie's mental state.

1.title: Singapore Sky (Case 2.3)
1.desc: When their first strategy fails, Laurent recruits some extra help, using Makoto's skills as a mechanic to deal with the stubborn elder prince.

1.title: Singapore Sky (Case 2.4)
1.desc: Not realizing who the bookies are, the greedy prince places a series of eye-popping wagers. Abbie's harrowing past begins to affect her focus.

1.title: Singapore Sky (Case 2.5)
1.desc: With the air race finals on the horizon, all the pieces move into place. Makoto has a serious talk with each pilot before making a wager of his own.

1.title: Snow of London (Case 3.1)
1.desc: Working as a sushi chef while living in France, Makoto attempts to plan a con without Laurent's help after a pompous Englishman terrorizes the locals.

1.title: Snow of London (Case 3.2)
1.desc: In London, Laurent and the team put their payback con against the "007 of the art world" into action. Cynthia reminisces about art and love.

1.title: Snow of London (Case 3.3)
1.desc: Makoto searches for Thomas, the art forger connected to Cynthia, to create a fake version of "Snow in London." Laurent and Abbie's plan continues.

1.title: Snow of London (Case 3.4)
1.desc: Laurent's fake dark auction begins with outrageous prices. Among the bidders, Coleman and Cynthia vie over "Snow in London."

1.title: Wizard of Far East (Case 4.1)
1.desc: Determined to rebuild his life, Makoto parts ways with the team and returns to Japan. He lands a job, but doesn't know what he's gotten himself into.

1.title: Wizard of Far East (Case 4.2)
1.desc: Cynthia and Shi Ohn arrive in Japan to start the con on Scarlet Company. Makoto and his boss accompany them to the UAE to witness a kidnapping.

1.title: Wizard of Far East (Case 4.3)
1.desc: A delegation from the Shanghai branch of the Suzaku Group arrives in Tokyo. Summoned to translate, Makoto realizes the interpreter looks familiar.

1.title: Wizard of Far East (Case 4.4)
1.desc: Two months after the end of the con, Makoto still works for Akemi. One night he receives a visit from a man he thought he saw die in front of him.

1.title: Wizard of Far East (Case 4.5)
1.desc: A younger Laurent joins a group of con artists including Oz after unknowingly aiding them in Paris. As they travel around the world, he falls in love.

1.title: Wizard of Far East (Case 4.6)
1.desc: On their last job, the team passes Dorothy off as an Ethiopian princess and stages her kidnapping for the Shanghai group. Then it all goes wrong.

1.title: Wizard of Far East (Case 4.7)
1.desc: The final phase of the con on the Shanghai group starts when Laurent returns to the city. The stakes are higher than ever, with no margin for error.

1.title: Wizard of Far East (Case 4.8)
1.desc: Both sides prepare for a fateful meeting in Tokyo, with Laurent and Makoto acting as translators. Everything depends on Makoto's choice.

1.title: Wizard of Far East (Case 4.9)
1.desc: The Wizard of the Far East pulls off one final magic trick, and some people finally get what's coming to them.

title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
description: Bullied by his boss, worked around the clock, he's nothing more than a corporate drone. All it takes is a zombie outbreak for him to finally feel alive!
cast: Shūichirō Umeda, Tomori Kusunoki, Makoto Furukawa, Minami Takahashi
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Akira of the Dead
1.desc: Akira finds himself being chased by hordes of undead when a zombie pandemic breaks out.

1.title: Bucket List of the Dead
1.desc: Seeking to reclaim 3 years worth of unused vacation time, Akira spends his days being lazy, day drinking and ignoring the chaos happening in the word; unfortunately he's down to his last beer.

1.title: Best Friend of the Dead
1.desc: Akira makes his way to Shinjuku to see Kencho, the only friend he's still in touch with.

1.title: Flight Attendant of the Dead
1.desc: Akira and Kencho flee into the basement of a department store and meet a trio of flight attendants, checking one more item off the bucket list.

1.title: Hero of the Dead
1.desc: Remembering his childhood dream, Akira goes into the aquarium to grab a certain item, only to run into a group of survivors running for their lives.

1.title: RV of the Dead
1.desc: Akira bids farewell to Tokyo and starts the journey back to his hometown, Gunma; but first, he stops by a showroom in Saitama to get an RV.

1.title: Truck Stop of the Dead
1.desc: Akira finds himself sucked back in to his old, corporate drone mindset. Seeing him in that state triggers bad memories for Shizuka

1.title: Sushi & Hot Springs of the Dead
1.desc: With only a little farther to go until they reach Akira's hometown in Gunma, the gang runs into a German college student named Beatrix. Despite the zombie pandemic, she says that she is determined to make her dream come true while she's in Japan.

1.title: Treehouse of the Dead
1.desc: With the only tunnel to the village sealed off, Akira and the others decide to cut through the forest and cross the mountain; along the way, they run into a man named Kumano, who is constructing a treehouse in the forest.

1.title: Hometown Of The Dead I
1.desc: Together with the villagers and the people who escaped from Tokyo, Akira and his friends help each other out while enjoying a brief moment of happiness; Meanwhile, Higurashi has been preparing to take his revenge on society.

1.title: Hometown of the Dead II
1.desc: Akira and his friends split up to save the villagers from the massive swarm of zombies; but zombies aren't their only concern as Higurashi and his gang stand in their way; Teruo manages to stop the zombies by himself, but he is captured by Higurashi.

1.title: Hometown of the Dead III
1.desc: Akira's time may have finally run out, but his bucket list was still half full.

title: Dandadan
description: When Momo and Okarun's beliefs clash, they're thrown into a world of ghosts, aliens and awakened powers.
cast: Natsuki Hanae, Shion Wakayama
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: That's How Love Starts, Ya Know?
1.desc: Momo is a high school girl born to a family of spirit mediums, and Okarun is an occult fanatic. To settle an argument, Momo heads to an abandoned hospital famous for UFO sightings while Okarun heads to a tunnel famous as a spiritual hotspot.

1.title: That's A Space Alien, Ain't It?!
1.desc: Okarun is cursed by Turbo Granny, and Momo uses her newly found psychic powers to curb Turbo Granny from running out of control. Dawn breaks, and the two of them temporarily find shelter in Momo's house.

1.title: It's A Granny Vs. Granny Clash!
1.desc: After Momo's grandmother temporarily suppresses the evil spirit within Okarun, she says that a game of tag may be the key to defeating it for good.

1.title: Kicking Turbo Granny's Ass
1.desc: To settle the score with Turbo Granny, Momo and Okarun show up at the promised tunnel. They start the game of tag to pull the location-bound spirit away, and they managed to capture Turbo Granny using Momo's psychic powers.

1.title: Like, Where Are Your Balls?!
1.desc: Victorious against Turbo Granny, Momo and Okarun regain peace. They have gotten closer through the traumatic experience, but they find their relationship to be awkward. That is when Okarun discloses something important to Momo.

1.title: A Dangerous Woman Arrives
1.desc: Momo, Okarun, and Turbo Granny search for the missing golden ball. They search all over the school and find out that a pretty girl named Aira is in possession of a ball. Perhaps the effects of the ball, but Aira can now see "invisible things" now.

1.title: To a Kinder World
1.desc: Momo and Okarun manage to pull Acrobatic Silky away from Aira after a fierce battle. However, Aira herself had lost her life as a side-effect of being eaten by a yokai monster. Facing Aira in such a crisis, Acrobatic Silky has a surprising proposal…

1.title: I've Got This Funny Feeling
1.desc: The battle against Acrobatic Silky is over, Aira harbors romantic feelings stemming from how Okarun had saved her. As Momo, Okarun, and Aira's feelings intertwine, Serpoians make another appearance, and the three of them are trapped in void space.

1.title: Merge! Serpo Dover Demon Nessie!
1.desc: Aira has awakened the powers of Acrobatic Silky within her and proceeds to have a seesaw battle against the Serpoians and the Dover Demon. Momo and Okarun join the fray, intensifying the battle.

1.title: Have You Ever Seen a Cattle Mutilation?
1.desc: Okarun and the girls try to clear up some misunderstandings with their classmates. Later, the aquatic creature reappears before Momo and Aira.

1.title: First Love
1.desc: Momo's childhood friend, Jiji, appears and begins living in Momo's house. Jiji has been worrying about apparitions in the house he moved into. Okarun is clearly disturbed hearing that Jiji is Momo's first love and tries to distance himself from Momo.

1.title: Let's Go to the Cursed House
1.desc: Momo and Okarun head to Jiji's house in a hot springs district to investigate the case of Jiji's family. Okarun feels gloomy looking at how close Momo and Jiji are. Arriving at Jiji's house, there are several shadows watching them as they enter...

2.title: Like, This Is the Legend of the Giant Snake
2.desc: As Momo fends off an attack in the outdoor hot spring, Okarun and Jiji panic over how to handle the mysterious room. Just then, the doorbell rings.

2.title: The Evil Eye
2.desc: Jiji tries to stop Momo and Okarun, who are being controlled by telepathic waves, from committing suicide.

2.title: You Won't Get Away With This!
2.desc: Jiji's body becomes possessed by the Evil Eye.

2.title: That's, Like, Way Deadly!
2.desc: Momo succeeds in bringing the Mongolian Death Worm to the surface.

2.title: We Can All Stay There Together!
2.desc: Momo succeeds in rescuing Okarun. They return safely to their home, but Jiji is still possessed by Evil Eye.

2.title: We Became a Family
2.desc: Jiji's transformation into Evil Eye intensifies. The group tries to exorcize Evil Eye from Jiji's body with a Hayashi performance. They invite the Hayashi and almost succeed in pushing Evil Eye out, but Jiji pleads with them to not kill Evil Eye...

2.title: Feeling Kinda Gloomy
2.desc: Seiko teaches Jiji how to hold back the Evil Eye. However, Jiji struggles keeping him at bay. Jiji turns into Evil Eye and assaults Momo. With some quick thinking, Momo somehow manages to get through the situation, while Okarun is determined to get stronger so he can send Evil Eye packing.

2.title: You Can Do It, Okarun!
2.desc: Okarun and Aira end up fighting against classical composers lurking in the school music room for training. Aira gradually gets the hang of it, but Okarun is unable to dodge the composers' flying musical note bomb attacks. Turbo Granny gives Okarun some advice, telling him to move his body to the rhythm.

2.title: I Want to Rebuild the House
2.desc: The battle between Okarun and Evil Eye-fied Jiji has begun. Showing the results of his training, Okarun fights toe-to-toe against Evil Eye, going "full throttle." However, he can't fully defeat Evil Eye. And then, Okarun's transformation is undone…

2.title: The Secret Art of Being Attractive
2.desc: Momo gets information about a "golden ball" from Miko and Muko. She immediately heads over to Okarun's class to tell him and notices that he is talking to a slightly chubby male student. After school, Momo and Okarun head over to the apartment building rumored to be the site of the golden ball sightings. The chubby boy, Kinta, is following them...

2.title: Hey, it's a Kaiju
2.desc: The sky darkens as Momo, Okarun and Kinta try to evade the giant space monster. They soon run into Aira and Jiji, who give them some much-needed help.

2.title: Clash! Space Kaiju vs. Giant Robot!

title: Ranma 1/2
description: Akane Tendo meets her new fiancé, Ranma Saotome, a martial arts prodigy with a twist: he magically transforms into a girl upon touching cold water.
cast: Kappei Yamaguchi, Megumi Hayashibara, Noriko Hidaka, Minami Takayama, Kikuko Inoue, Akio Ohtsuka
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Here's Ranma
1.desc: Tendo Dojo master Soun eagerly awaits the arrival of his old friend Genma Saotome and Genma's son Ranma. Instead, a teen girl and a giant panda show up.

1.title: I Hate Men!
1.desc: On Ranma's first day at Furinkan High School, a group of boys — including the sophomore Kuno — ambushes Akane at the school's entrance.

1.title: Because Thereʼs Someone He Likes
1.desc: To Ranma's horror, Kuno falls head-over-heels for Ranma's female form and starts a relentless pursuit. Meanwhile, Akane deals with unrequited feelings.

1.title: The Hunter
1.desc: A mysterious martial artist arrives at Furinkan High looking to settle a score with Ranma. Later, the school becomes a battlefield.

1.title: Who Says You're Cute
1.desc: Akane gets caught up in Ryoga and Ranma's fight and ends up with a shocking new appearance. Ranma, worried, abandons the battle and goes after her.

1.title: Kodachi, The Black Rose
1.desc: When the Furinkan High rhythmic gymnastics team is injured by a rival school's captain, its members beg Akane to take their place in an upcoming match.

1.title: Hot Competition
1.desc: With Akane injured, Ranma takes her place and stays up all night practicing. The next day, the match begins with Kodachi's usual underhanded tricks.

1.title: Darling Charlotte
1.desc: P-chan goes missing and shows up in the arms of a famous martial skater, who refuses to return him. Enraged, Akane challenges Azusa to a battle.

1.title: I'll Never Let Go
1.desc: A fierce match between Ranma and Akane versus the golden couple Mikado and Azusa begins! Mikado is eager to steal a kiss from Akane, worrying Ranma.

1.title: Kiss of Death
1.desc: Chaos ensues when the match continues with Ryoga and an injured female Ranma. Later, a Chinese Amazon appears, bent on killing Ranma's female form.

1.title: You I Love
1.desc: Ranma learns that defeating a Chinese Amazon has messy consequences. P-chan gets served up for dinner, triggering a fight between Shampoo and Akane.

1.title: Shampoo Cleans Up
1.desc: Shampoo's shiatsu technique and magic hair wash have erased Akane's memory of Ranma. The Chinese Amazon offers a cure - but she has an impossible request.

2.title: Ranma's Weakness
2.desc: Another of Akane's suitors, the quiet Gosunkugi, begins stalking Ranma to find the martial artist's weakness. Will he unearth Ranma's secret?

2.title: Attack of the Wild Mousse
2.desc: Ranma's problems continue as he deals with the aftermath of his trance, Shampoo's new secret, her meddlesome great-grandmother and a jealous rival.

2.title: Chestnuts Roasting on an Open Fire
2.desc: After a heated battle with Mousse, Ranma remains stuck in his female form and must master a difficult technique to obtain the antidote for his condition.

2.title: Naval Engagement
2.desc: Ranma follows the Cat Café to the beach, where a Martial Arts Watermelon Splitting Race stands in his way of finally retrieving the real Phoenix Pill.

2.title: It's Fast or It's Free
2.desc: Cologne learns about the annual Martial Arts Delivery Race and signs Shampoo up to compete against Akane and Ranma. Who will reach the final goal first?

2.title: The Evil Wakes
2.desc: When the lecherous Happosai escapes to Nerima, seeking the disciples who imprisoned him, Akane and Ranma team up to deal with his perverted antics.

2.title: Instant Spring
2.desc: Shampoo receives a mysterious package. Meanwhile, Soun and Genma's plan to bring Ranma and Akane closer backfires when the real dojo destroyer shows up.

2.title: "Okonomiyaki" Means "I Love You"
2.desc: Ranma finds himself in a bind when he learns that the new transfer student is the person who attacked his father — and his long-lost childhood friend!

2.title: Love Letters in the Sauce
2.desc: In order to be with Ranma, Ukyo hatches a scheme to help Ryoga get a date with Akane. Unfortunately, things don't go according to plan...

2.title: Not Your Typical Juliet
2.desc: After years cast in boyish roles, Akane finally gets to play her dream role: Juliet! But will the prospective Romeos' antics ruin her precious chance?

2.title: Abduction of ...Akane?
2.desc: Determined to win Shampoo back, Mousse challenges Ranma. He attacks using Spring of Drowned Duck water and traps Akane in a water tank.

2.title: Fowl Play
2.desc: Despite Ranma's efforts to protect the audience from the cursed spring water, Akane gets doused instead. What emerges is not his fiancée, but a duck.

3.desc: Shirogane accidentally steps on a female student who had collapsed on campus, she then takes care of her in the Student Council room.

title: Horimiya

1.title: You Wear More Than One Face
1.desc: When her mother asks about Miyamura, Hori comes to a frightening realization. Later, the Student Council ropes Hori into extra work, but when conflict arises, it's up to Miyamura to smooth things over.

1.title: That's Why It's Okay
1.desc: Miyamura reflects on his past and present. Hori responds to Remi's selfish demand. A heated conversation between Ishikawa and Miyamura ends with a fistfight.

1.title: Everybody Loves Somebody

1.title: I Can't Say It Out Loud
1.desc: A rumor complicates Hori and Miyamura's budding relationship. Kyosuke comes home to roost and instantly takes a liking to Miyamura. Sakura evaluates her friendship with Remi.

1.desc: Miyamura ends up staying the night. Rumors spread like wildfire at school. Shindo calls the couple over to share a bag of candy. A second-year girl begins to stalk Miyamura.

1.title: It's Hard, but Not Impossible
1.desc: Miyamura runs into some unfriendly faces. Hori tries to get Miyamura to fulfill her darkest desires. Mizouchi's love is unrequited. Tanihara confronts his past with Miyamura.

1.title: Until the Snow Melts
1.desc: Hori has an unexpected demand of Miyamura. When Yoshikawa learns her fake relationship with Ishikawa might be coming to an end, she's forced to reflect on her own feelings.

1.title: It May Seem Like Hate
1.desc: The gang tries to get Yanagi to loosen up. Iura is clueless as to how much he terrifies Sawada. When Iura's sister Motoko is struggling with entrance exams, Iura asks Hori to help.

1.title: Hitherto, and Forevermore
1.desc: Yoshikawa heads over to Ishikawa's house. Christmas brings romantic holiday cheer to all. Hori and Miyamura discuss their future.

1.title: I Would Gift You the Sky
1.desc: As graduation approaches, Miyamura reflects on the past year, an uncertain future, and the new life he's found.

title: Toradora!
