title: Record of Ragnarok
description: Before eradicating humankind from the world, the gods give them one last chance to prove themselves worthy of survival. Let the Ragnarok battles begin.
cast: Miyuki Sawashiro, Tomokazu Sugita
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Ragnarok
1.desc: At the Council of Valhalla, the gods vote unanimously for humankind's extinction. But Brünnhilde, eldest of the Valkyrie sisters, raises her objection.

1.title: Worthy Opponent
1.desc: In the first round of the Ragnarok battle, Han dynasty warlord Lü Bu puts up a good fight against Norse god Thor, surprising the gods in attendance.

1.title: Killer Move
1.desc: To give Lü Bu the upper hand against Thor, Brünnhilde summons her sister Randgriz and asks her to transform into a sacred weapon — the Shield Breaker.

1.title: Joy
1.desc: Lü Bu's legs are crushed by the mighty Geirröd Thor's Hammer attack, but just when all hope seems lost, the warlord's trusty horse Red Hare rides in.

1.title: FILE No.00000000001
1.desc: Chosen for the next round is the father of humankind and the man bearing more hatred towards the gods than anyone else: Adam himself.

1.title: Great Emulation
1.desc: Zeus insists on going up against Adam, who joins forces with Valkyrie Reginleif to obtain a most peculiar weapon: a knuckleduster.

1.title: Expelled from Paradise
1.desc: Just when it looks like Adam will earn humankind the victory they long for, Zeus gathers his strength to ask Adam why he's really fighting.

1.title: Grace Abounding
1.desc: Zeus has transformed into his final most powerful form, but after the beating he's suffered, he may not last much longer in the fight.

1.title: Tyrant of the Ocean
1.desc: Humankind is desperate to win the next bout, but the god they're going up against is one of the mightiest of them all: Poseidon.

1.title: Greatest Loser
1.desc: Kojiro Sasaki uses his mighty Tsubame Gaeshi move to finish off Poseidon, but the god of the sea won't be sunk so easily.

1.title: The Swallow Gazes into the Abyss
1.desc: Through the power of Valkyrie Hrist, Kojiro's broken blade is transformed into dual swords, allowing him to tap into the depths of his inner strength.

1.title: And Ragnarok Goes On
1.desc: Despite Kojiro's Niten Ganryu duel blade method, Poseidon's powerful attacks continue to wear him down. But the battle isn't over yet.

2.title: Good vs. Evil
2.desc: The gods have no intention of letting the humans win the next round; for their next fighter, they present none other than the great hero, Hercules.

2.title: The Indomitable War God
2.desc: The spectators notice that the tattoos on Hercules have grown significantly — and if they continue to grow, the hero will suffer a painful death.

2.title: Birth of a Monster
2.desc: In late 19th century London, the young son of a prostitute has a special ability that helps him survive the poverty he was born into.

2.title: The Final Labor
2.desc: Although he's lost his left arm, Hercules remains steadfast, easily summoning the strength to unleash his ultimate move: the Twelfth Labor.

2.title: Requiem
2.desc: The brutal fourth round has pushed both fighters beyond their breaking point; when the winner is finally announced, there is no joy or celebration.

2.title: Conflicting Motives
2.desc: To capitalize on humanity's momentum, Brünnhilde pays a visit to the colossal Tameemon Raiden, the most powerful sumo wrestler in history.

2.title: Hundred Seals
2.desc: Stepping into the sumo ring to take on Tameemon Raiden is the God of Destruction, the Destroyer himself: Supreme Lord Shiva.

2.title: The Pinnacle of 1116
2.desc: Years ago, Shiva spent many happy days with his best friend Rudra. Then one day, Rudra asks Shiva to join him on a journey to the top.

2.title: Resonance
2.desc: As a child, Raiden had to suppress his full strength so he wouldn't hurt other people. But now, to win this battle, he's not holding anything back.

2.title: The Brink
2.desc: The match comes to a moving end. Even Zeus is impressed by humanity's powerful spirit; but he's going to make sure the gods get the ultimate victory.

3.title: Prologue: Recollections
3.desc: While humanity celebrates, the sixth round's result rattles the gods. Brunhilde and Hermes reflect on the previous battles and humanity's resilience.

3.title: King vs. King
3.desc: With the gods desperate for a win, Hades steps up to avenge his brother. Humanity sends Qin Shi Huang, setting the stage for a monumental clash of kings.

3.title: Chi You
3.desc: After uniting China, Qin Shi Huang ascends Mount Tai alone to prove himself before the demon god Chi You. There, he masters the ultimate martial art.

3.title: A Promise and an Oath
3.desc: As a child, Qin Shi Huang's daily life is filled with hostility. Yet over time, he finds happiness in the close bond he forms with his strict caretaker.

3.title: Pride of the King of Helheim
3.desc: As the seventh round heats up, Hades gouges his own chest, humming as blood pours out and empowers his divine weapon with new strength.

3.title: Return of the King
3.desc: On the brink of death, Qin Shi Huang draws strength from Alvitr, unleashing the Force of the Phoenix again. Hades readies his spear for the final blow.

3.title: Satan
3.desc: For the eighth round, the gods choose Beelzebub, the god cursed by Satan. Though shunned by all, he once had three close friends who shaped his destiny.

3.title: Light vs. Shadow
3.desc: While struggling with Beelzebub's vibration-based powers, Tesla recognizes them as a form of science and counters with the full force of human ingenuity.

3.title: A Curse and a Prayer
3.desc: Tesla traps Beelzebub in the Gematria Zone and unleashes the Tesla Step, but Beelzebub learns to nullify the onslaught. The gods expect victory, but...

3.title: The Torch Passed On
3.desc: Even after Beelzebub unleashes Helheim's forbidden technique, Tesla stands firm. As the battle peaks, he recalls childhood memories of his brother.

3.title: Progress
3.desc: Though battered, Tesla is relentless, pushing Beelzebub on the defensive and to his limits. The showdown between science versus myth reaches its climax.

3.title: The Sun God and the Rebellious Hero
3.desc: The gods' next fighter is Apollo, the radiant sun god. Representing humanity is King Leonidas of Sparta. As round nine begins, neither will back down.

3.title: Pride vs. Pride
3.desc: In the past, King Leonidas of Sparta defies Apollo's prophecies and goes to war. Now, with his pride on the line, he delivers a decisive strike at Apollo.

3.title: Know Thyself
3.desc: Fueled by unyielding resolve, Leonidas slams Apollo down. As the bloodied god rises, most gods scorn his pride, but Zeus and Ares see the truth.

3.title: A Clash of Souls
3.desc: Both fighters near death but stand tall, honoring each other's valor. Leonidas transforms his shield and advances as Apollo draws his mythical bow.

title: Pluto
description: When the world's seven most advanced robots and their human allies are murdered one by one, Inspector Gesicht soon discovers that he's also in danger.
cast: Shinshu Fuji, Yōko Hikasa, Minoru Suzuki, Toshihiko Seki, Toshio Furukawa, Romi Park
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Episode 1
1.desc: A beloved Swiss robot is found blown into in pieces. Meanwhile, Europol robot inspector Gesicht investigates another eerily related murder.

1.title: Episode 2
1.desc: Another horned corpse is found. Gesicht reaches out to Atom, the most advanced of the seven robots, to help analyze the serial murders.

1.title: Episode 3
1.desc: Abullah gets summoned by police superintendent Tawashi regarding Tazaki's murder. Gesicht starts to suspect that his data may be compromised.

1.title: Episode 4
1.desc: Professor Ochanomizu brings a battered robot dog home and attempts to fix it. Soon after, a mysterious man claiming to be the owner visits his house.

1.title: Episode 5
1.desc: After delivering Adolf Haas to a safe house, Gesicht looks into his past. Meanwhile, Hercules and Epsilon sense a mysterious threat approaching them.

1.title: Episode 6
1.desc: Gesicht meets Abullah in Persia to further investigate the case, but detects a lie. He inches closer to the truth when he encounters a robot child.

1.title: Episode 7
1.desc: Dr. Tenma attempts to bring Atom back at all costs. A government official advises a distressed Epsilon to evacuate since he's the next target.

1.title: Episode 8
1.desc: Professor Ochanomizu closely monitors Atom's erratic behavior. Dr. Tenma confronts his past and the truth unravels, triggering a world destroying threat.

title: Beastars
description: In a world where beasts of all kinds coexist, a gentle wolf awakens to his own predatory urges as his school deals with a murder within its midst.
cast: Chikahiro Kobayashi, Yūki Ono
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Their Determination
1.desc: An herbivore's murder unsettles Cherryton Academy, with some suspecting grey wolf Legoshi. Dwarf rabbit Hal struggles with her classmates' bullying.

1.title: The Heart of the School is in the Garden
1.desc: Legoshi ponders his own ferocious impulses; an altercation at breakfast unsettles him further. The theater students prepare for their play.

1.title: A Wolf Male is Born
1.desc: Hal and Legoshi's interaction ends extremely awkwardly. With two days to the performance, the school newspaper is sniffing out what Rouis is hiding.

1.title: Let the Holy Grail Soak
1.desc: The drama club switches up parts after the last performance. Tapped to appear onstage, Legoshi confronts the new lead actor about a dangerous issue.

1.title: Two Sides to the Story
1.desc: Legoshi deals with misplaced notoriety after the chaotic but successful play, with Jack's support. Hal and Rouis have a clandestine encounter.

1.title: Blurred Vision - Dream or Reality?
1.desc: After another murder, herbivores are confined to campus. Out in town, the theater club carnivores enter a shady district for adult meat eaters.

1.title: Beneath the Fur Coat
1.desc: The mystery of Legoshi's favorite lunch is solved. Hal recalls her first encounter with a vulnerable Rouis, who has a fiancée.

1.title: Like a Thread on the Canine
1.desc: Legoshi offers to escort Hal home; on the way she attempts to become better friends with him, unaware of his guilt. Juno has a revelation.

1.title: Into the Lion's Den
1.desc: Rouis recalls his harrowing past, and Legoshi makes a personal vow despite conflicting feelings. Meanwhile, Hal is kidnapped for ransom by carnivores.

1.title: A Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
1.desc: Legoshi risks his life to find the Shishi-Gumi. A friend helps him channel and control his inner beast so that he can save Hal.

1.title: To the Neon District
1.desc: A ferocious Legoshi wreaks havoc to save Hal, while an unknown ally assists in their escape. Awkward timing causes some awkward situations afterwards.

1.title: In the Storm's Wake
1.desc: Hal and Legoshi return to school after their strange night. As the festival gets underway, Juno challenges Hal for Legoshi's affections.

2.title: A Teen's Never-Ending Alarm
2.desc: Things are somewhat calm again, but with Tem's murder unsolved and Louis missing, the school is filled with rumors of hauntings and strange occurrences.

2.title: The Gray Police Hound Runs
2.desc: Rokume, a giant rattlesnake claiming to be the only security guard in the school, approaches Legoshi and asks him to track down the murderer.

2.title: Changes
2.desc: After taking a drastic step against the Shishi-Gumi, Louis faces an impossible choice. The drama club gets a new, very confident member.

2.title: Entangled
2.desc: Legoshi is attacked by a powerful carnivore. As Louis earns the trust of the Shishi-Gumi, he loses his own health and peace of mind.

2.title: Call it Like it is
2.desc: While attending school during the day, Legoshi spends his nights in intense training sessions with Gohin.

2.title: Fly, O Corrupt One
2.desc: Louis wants to officially quit school to make a break with his past, but his father refuses to allow it. Haru and Legoshi talk things out.

2.title: Unforgettable Sweetness
2.desc: Tao — a black panther — accidentally injures another student. After Legoshi confronts them, the killer thinks back on how and why they murdered Tem.

2.title: Laughing at the Shadows We Cast
2.desc: After clapping a muzzle on Legoshi, Gohin orders him to capture a beast in the throes of a flesh addiction. Juno ends up spending some time with Haru.

2.title: A Busted Electric Fan
2.desc: Legoshi is shocked when he meets Louis in the Black Market district. At school, he's disgusted to hear Riz say he'll visit Kibi in the hospital.

2.title: The Chef's Suspense
2.desc: After Pina makes it clear he won't be intimidated by Riz, Legoshi gets into a bloody bare-knuckled fight with the bear.

2.title: Scatter Your Scales
2.desc: To grow stronger for his New Year's Day confrontation with Riz, Legoshi tries ingesting a moth larva and has an intense hallucination.

2.title: The Taste of Rebellion
2.desc: While getting pummeled by Riz, Legoshi realizes that they're not so different: he could easily have succumbed to his carnivorous instincts, too.

3.title: An Itchy Collar
3.desc: While Legoshi adjusts to a new life outside Cherryton, the school announces a new segregation policy. The current BEASTAR takes an interest in Legoshi.

3.title: The Shiny Black Nose Before Me
3.desc: Legoshi's meat withdrawal causes trouble with his new neighbor. The Shishi-Gumi's enigmatic new leader plans to distribute a dangerous energy drink.

3.title: An Old Dragon's Wrath
3.desc: Recalling Louis's words, Legoshi beats up the energy drink pushers. As the drama club makes a tough decision, the wolf finds a familiar face waiting.

3.title: The Gravity of Being a Land Dweller
3.desc: Gosha shocks his grandson with his fighting prowess. Yahya remembers his history with Gosha. Later, a kind seal teaches Legoshi about the marine world.

3.title: In the Food Chain
3.desc: After catching up with his old drama club friends, Legoshi meets with Yahya. Meanwhile, a cunning civet forces the Shishi-Gumi to work with him.

3.title: The Guy Born in Spring
3.desc: As Legoshi recovers under Gohin's care, Yahya investigates Melon, a gazelle therapist. Haru reaches a sobering conclusion on interspecies relationships.

3.title: Eat My Vow
3.desc: On a birthday date, Legoshi confesses everything to Haru. Determined to take their relationship seriously, she makes a daring and dangerous request.

3.title: What Lies at the End of the Melon Patch
3.desc: While the Black Market is abuzz with shocking rumors, Yahya makes plans to catch Melon. The 500 Cornered Rats continue their underground surveillance.

3.title: The Rotten Egg Hatches
3.desc: The drama club members chafe against the interspecies restrictions. Enticed by Yahya's promise, Legoshi infiltrates Melon's underground party.

3.title: Bambi is Alive and Well
3.desc: Louis's investigations into the spiked energy drink take him back to the Black Market, where he runs into his old comrades — and their new leader.

3.title: Peeling Back the Layers
3.desc: Eager to learn more about the effects of Kines, Louis goes undercover and meets Deshico. Legoshi continues his investigation into Melon alone.

3.title: Tragedy on the Waves
3.desc: Unable to get a meeting with Yahya, Louis sneaks in. Meanwhile, Legoshi follows the clues from the tattoo parlor. Will he be able to find Melon?

3.title: A Threefold Dilemma
3.desc: After his showdown with Melon, Legoshi finds himself at the mercy of the ocean. Meanwhile, Haru encounters an unfortunate scene that rouses her suspicion.

3.title: Six Tails in a Row
3.desc: While the drama club tries to get their interspecies script approved, Melon's interest in Haru grows. Later, Legoshi reunites with his canine friends.

3.title: In a Dusty Universe
3.desc: Jack confides in Legoshi about his struggles in school, while Yahya visits Deshico for a lead. Melon's fascination with Haru takes a dangerous turn.

3.title: The Red In Our Lives
3.desc: Legoshi awakens with a start to find Haru missing. The mayor approaches Louis with a meaty proposition. Pina stirs up trouble during rehearsal.

3.title: Sweet Hunger
3.desc: Struggling to understand a herbivore's perspective, Juno seeks acting advice from Louis. Meanwhile, trouble brews in the Black Market alleys.

3.title: Upon a Nest of Dried Noodles
3.desc: A quick meal turns into a moral conflict for Bill. Meanwhile, a string of unexplained interspecies attacks erupt around the city. Louis and Haru catch up.

3.title: Feline Fall
3.desc: On the night of the Odd Soul Festival, Legoshi meets Melon in Haru's place, determined to stop him once and for all — but the villain pulls a gun on him.

3.title: Gotta Buy a Step Stool
3.desc: With Melon on the loose, Legoshi arms Haru with self-defense gear — but he has bigger things to worry about. There's a warrant out for his arrest!

3.title: The Demon King of Beasts
3.desc: After a charged encounter, Haru bonds with Gosha. Louis reveals his true feelings to his fiancée. Melon asserts his dominance over the Shishi-Gumi.

3.title: Words That Slipped Out
3.desc: Set on challenging Melon, Legoshi enters the Turf War, but must first pass a deadly quiz. Meanwhile, Deshico makes a critical discovery in his lab.

3.title: Blood In the Disco Ball
3.desc: Louis's butler reveals the truth behind Ogma's behavior. Meanwhile, Melon incites the crowd and a riot breaks out. Can Legoshi survive the night?

3.title: Interspecies Exchange
3.desc: Despite winning the Doku-Gumi's approval, Legoshi must still face the Inari-Gumi's foxy boss. The mayor drops a bombshell that blindsides Louis.

title: Blue Period
description: Bored with life, popular high schooler Yatora Yaguchi jumps into the beautiful yet unrelenting world of art after finding inspiration in a painting.
cast: Hiromu Mineta, Aoi Koga, Daiki Yamashita, Fumi Hirano, Ikumi Hasegawa, Kengo Kawanishi
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Awakening to the Joy of Painting
1.desc: Life and priorities change for listless high schooler Yatora when he sees his classmate's painting and discovers an appreciation and talent for art.

1.title: He's Not Tanned at All
1.desc: Yatora enters the art club. Over summer break he takes part in special training to improve his skills after switching his college choice to art school.

1.title: Prep School Debut of the Dead
1.desc: Yatora joins Yuka for extra lessons at Tokyo Art Institute. He has an artistic breakthrough when visiting a museum with his strange new classmates.

1.title: Where Are We Headed?
1.desc: TAI's night students join the intimidating afternoon classes to gear up for the next competition as the stress of art exams weigh on Yatora's friends.

1.title: Helpless Even If I Know What to Do
1.desc: As exams near, Oba intensifies training. Yatora struggles to articulate abstract concepts, so Saeki encourages him to use a larger canvas for fun.

1.title: Serious Mental Breakdown
1.desc: Yatora experiments with various tools to find a secret weapon that will boost his art while exam stress begins to wear on the students' health.

1.title: The Start of the First Exam
1.desc: Oba tells Yatora his weakness, which sends him spiraling. But a heart-to-heart with a close friend reignites his confidence as the first exam begins!

1.title: Brain-Racking
1.desc: The first exam subject is "self-portrait." A mishap gives Yatora the hint he needs; Oba takes the class to a museum before exam results are announced.

1.title: Wandering Knife
1.desc: Three move on to the second exam, including Yatora, who must master "color." Yatora worries after Yuka gets a seedy job and refuses to go to art school.

1.title: Our Color Blue
1.desc: Yuka and Yatora head to Odawara and bare their souls and bodies, hoping to overcome their personal challenges with art and their surrounding fears.

1.title: The Start of the Second Exam
1.desc: After drawing his own body, Yatora is ready for the second exam: a nude model. But when his health declines from stress, Oba offers a secret weapon.

1.title: When I Started to Be Dyed in Color
1.desc: The second exam is in full swing. Yatora struggles with illness and an unclear theme when sudden inspiration delivers answers and a final secret weapon.

title: Violet Evergarden
description: The war is over, and Violet Evergarden needs a job. Scarred and emotionless, she takes a job as a letter writer to understand herself and her past.
cast: Yui Ishikawa, Daisuke Namikawa, Aya Endo
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: 'I Love You' and Auto Memoir Dolls
1.desc: Hodgins retrieves Violet from the hospital, as Major Gilbert asked him to look out for her. After they meet Gilbert's relatives, he offers her a job.

1.title: Never Coming Back
1.desc: Violet tries to adjust to her new job: she needs to learn typing, and her coworkers question whether she has the right demeanor for letter writing.

1.title: May You Be an Exemplary Auto Memoir Doll
1.desc: Violet enrolls in a Doll training course. Her classmate Luculia befriends her, though she has her own problems with her war veteran brother.

1.title: You Won't be a Tool, but a Person Worthy of that Name
1.desc: When Iris goes to her home village on an assignment, Violet accompanies her. Iris's birthday party sparks a disagreement with her family.

1.title: You Write Letters That Bring People Together?
1.desc: Princess Charlotte is to have a public correspondence with her betrothed, and Violet is entrusted with writing the letters on her highness's behalf.

1.title: Somewhere Under the Starry Sky
1.desc: Violet travels to the country of Astrea to work with transcribers copying damaged manuscripts. Her partner Leon has a past not unlike hers.

1.title: Nameless
1.desc: A playwright with writer's block and a tragic past summons Violet to the country of Genetrix to help him finish a script. They both learn about grief.

1.title: Episode 8
1.desc: Violet learns that Major Gilbert is listed as missing in action, but his family members think he is dead. Unable to cope, she remembers the war.

1.title: Violet Evergarden
1.desc: Heartbroken, Violet withdraws from her job and questions whether she even has the right to be an Auto Memory Doll. Then, she receives a letter.

1.title: Loved Ones Will Always Watch Over You
1.desc: Violet travels to a countryside mansion to write letters for a war widow, but her young daughter Ann resents her presence.

1.title: 'I Don't Want Anybody Else to Die'
1.desc: Against Hodgins' wishes, Violet takes a job from a soldier at a military base in Ctrigall, a former enemy nation now engulfed in civil war.

1.title: Episode 12
1.desc: The Major's older brother is ordered to defend the signing ceremony from former Gardarik forces opposed to peace.

1.title: Auto Memoir Doll and "I Love You"
1.desc: The signing ceremony concludes, officially bringing an end to the war. While writing letters for an air show, Violet composes a letter to the Major.

title: Aggretsuko
description: Frustrated with her thankless office job, Retsuko the Red Panda copes with her daily struggles by belting out death metal karaoke after work.
cast: Rarecho Kaolip, Shingo Kato, Rina Inoue, Komegumi Koiwasaki, Sota Arai, Maki Tsuruta
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: A Day in the Life of Retsuko
1.desc: As Retsuko enters her fifth year at a prestigious trading firm, she struggles to motivate herself everyday as the daily stress from work takes a toll.

1.title: A Good, Hard-Working Girl
1.desc: Tired of her wholesome good-girl persona at work, Retsuko is drawn to the free-spirited lifestyle of her former high school classmate, Puko.

1.title: Short-Timer
1.desc: Retsuko loses the will to tackle the daily grind after Puko asks her to join a new business venture. A fed up Retsuko talks back to her supervisor.

1.title: Walking Down the Aisle
1.desc: When plans to leave her thankless job fall through, Retsuko continues to work in hopes of some day marrying and becoming a full-time house wife.

1.title: Exposed
1.desc: The solitary life Retsuko leads is about to change when Director Gori and Washimi take her to a karaoke bar after yoga class.

1.title: Stoking Rebellion
1.desc: Washimi acknowledges Retsuko's efforts to make things right with Director Ton, using her position as assistant to the president as leverage to help.

1.title: The Duel
1.desc: After the president cautions Director Ton on his abrasive behavior, his unusually polite demeanor puzzles and frightens his direct reports.

1.title: The Out of Pocket Prince
1.desc: Persuaded by her colleagues Director Gori and Washimi, a reluctant Retsuko agrees to join a company singles mixer hosted by Tsunoda.

1.title: A Rosy World
1.desc: Supervisor Tsubone sends Retsuko on an errand to the sales department where she falls for a fellow colleague, Resasuke, whom she met the night before.

1.title: The Dream Ends
1.desc: A happy but frustrated Retsuko increasingly makes mistakes at work. Meanwhile, a busy quarterly reporting period looms ahead for the accounting team.

2.title: Time to Grow Up
2.desc: Retsuko becomes increasingly frustrated with her mother's overbearing ways. Director Ton demands the team be tough on their incoming new hire.

2.title: The New Hire Named Anai
2.desc: Without Retsuko's approval, her mother sets up an arranged marriage meeting. At first glance, new hire Anai seems like a nice and eager employee.

2.title: Double Moratorium
2.desc: Director Ton berates Retsuko for Anai's lack of progress on the job. Meanwhile, Anai continues to react very badly to any feedback from Retsuko.

2.title: Unavoidable Impact
2.desc: Retsuko and Anai have to host a food stall for the company's Family Appreciation Day event, but Retsuko does all the work herself to avoid conflict.

2.title: United Front
2.desc: Everybody hates Retsuko's badly-prepared yakisoba. Anai doesn't lift a finger to help, until Kabae gives him some words of encouragement.

2.title: Unknown Future
2.desc: Hearing that Shirota has officially moved on, Retsuko lets herself be talked into attending a matchmaking event -- where she runs into Director Gori.

2.title: Growing Affection
2.desc: Now with a driver's license, Retsuko takes Gori and Washimi on a road trip, but things go south when the two ladies get into a heated argument.

2.title: He Lives Above the Clouds
2.desc: The unassuming Tadano turns out to be a rising tech mogul. He offers to take Retsuko out for ramen, but it's nothing like she imagined.

2.title: She's Dreaming
2.desc: Retsuko begins to dream of a happy future with Tadano. She joins him on a business-related golf outing, and is horrified when Director Ton shows up.

2.title: Wonderful Life
2.desc: The world learns all about Retsuko's high profile relationship and Tadano declares that he wants to be with her forever -- without getting married.

3.title: The Blessings of Life
3.desc: With her romance over, Retsuko fills the void with a virtual boyfriend. Her savings take a massive hit when she spends recklessly on in-game purchases.

3.title: Deep in the Hole
3.desc: Retsuko inadvertently backs into a parked car, damaging the other vehicle. Desperate for repair money, she reaches out to Gori for a loan.

3.title: A Sheltered Life
3.desc: To repay her debt, Retsuko starts working as the accounting manager for an underground idol group. In reality, she's at their beck and call.

3.title: Winds of Change
3.desc: The OTMGirls turn a profit for the first time thanks to Retsuko's business acumen. Haida hits it off with Inui after an unexpected encounter.

3.title: An Urchin in the Desert
3.desc: After seeing Retsuko sing, Hyodo proposes that Retsuko become the lead vocalist, demoting Manaka in the process.

3.title: Crossroads
3.desc: The group's popularity soars after a blogger's favorable review. Concerned by Retsuko's recent odd behavior, Haida secretly tails her to Hokkaido.

3.title: An Impenetrable Wall
3.desc: The OTMGirls receive an offer to perform at a rock festival. Hyodo rebrands the idols as a band, and the members must now learn to play instruments.

3.title: Bursting Her Bubble
3.desc: Manaka's devotion to instrumental mastery inspires others to step up. Haida agrees to teach Retsuko guitar, but he invites Inui over on the same day.

3.title: The End of the Moratorium
3.desc: Inui opens up to Haida about her feelings, but he's unable to respond. Director Ton lectures Retsuko when he learns she has a side gig.

3.title: When You Count to Ten
3.desc: She's shaken, but Retsuko acts normal in front of her bandmates after a deranged fan accosts her. Haida struggles to choose between Retsuko and Inui.

4.title: Someone from Work
4.desc: With a new apartment and a collection of weapons, Retsuko moves forward after her attack, but her relationship with Haida remains at a standstill.

4.title: The New Boss
4.desc: Haida helps the company president to the hospital after avoiding Retsuko. Changes come to the office when Himuro is chosen as the company new lead.

4.title: Dirty Work
4.desc: Retsuko and Haida's relationship worsens, and Fenneko panics. Himuro orders Ton to lay off several workers to save costs, but Ton refuses.

4.title: Unkept Promises
4.desc: Retsuko and Fenneko blab to Himuro about Ton's past work harassment during a night of drinking. Retsuko tells Haida she only wants to be friends.

4.title: Options
4.desc: Ton despairs about his demotion while Yagyu becomes the new director. Haida gains a confidence boost after Retsuko reaches out to him.

4.title: Struggle for Survival
4.desc: Ton resigns without telling his family. Yagyu nags Kabae after she leaves early to care for her son. Retsuko and her friends worry about more changes.

4.title: Moving Up
4.desc: Himuro praises Haida's work; Retsuko learns about Ton's new job. Feeling guilty, she tries to talk to Haida, but he's too busy doing Himuro's bidding.

4.title: Headhunting
4.desc: Encouraged by Tadano, Retsuko tries to get Ton to manage her Death-Voice channel. Haida accepts a nefarious task from Himuro.

4.title: Unauthorized Access
4.desc: Retsuko uncovers Haida's actions after he gets his own office and seeks advice from Ton. Finally, Retsuko decides to confront Haida.

4.title: Rendezvous
4.desc: Retsuko's friends join up to gather evidence of fraud. After Haida admits his involvement and Retsuko berates him, he makes one last critical decision.

5.title: A Prison Called Freedom
5.desc: Haida still doesn't have a job, and doesn't seem interested in getting another one any time soon – which makes Retsuko feel uneasy.

5.title: Spooky Shikabane
5.desc: With no job, no home and no girlfriend, Haida hunkers down in an internet cafe and, mortifyingly, bumps into an online friend in real life.

5.title: ANAGURA and Reality
5.desc: Under the avatar "Fennelope," Fenneko befriends Haida and Shikabane in the online game and sets up a meeting with them in real life.

5.title: Restart
5.desc: Haida now has to visit Retsuko's parents in two weeks. He'll have to tell them that he's unemployed — unless he can find a job before then.

5.title: A Mysterious Messenger
5.desc: A suspicious looking man comes up to Manaka after an OTM Girls' show and asks her about "Aggressive Retsuko." Haida meets up with Tadano.

5.title: A Family Emergency
5.desc: Haida tells her she doesn't have to come, but Retsuko insists on going with him to visit his family home — and it's nothing like what she expected.

5.title: Rage Mission
5.desc: Retsuko gets approached by a suspicious, but somewhat familiar-looking man who really, really wants her to run for office.

5.title: Rising to the Challenge
5.desc: The day after taking to the stage with Ikari, Retsuko is filled with stress and regret. Time for an epic karaoke session!

5.title: A Disconnected World
5.desc: Running for office isn't for the faint hearted — or the empty pocketed. They need to come up with a 3 million yen deposit fast.

5.title: The Other Side of Rage
5.desc: The pressure almost gets the better of her, but after a quick interaction with Ton, Retsuko picks up the microphone to speak to her potential voters.

title: Komi Can't Communicate
description: An elite and aloof schoolgirl is in fact severely withdrawn and anxious about communicating with others. An ordinary schoolboy befriends her and helps her to open up and talk with people.
cast: Aoi Koga, Gakuto Kajiwara
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: It's just, I wish I could speak.
1.desc: It's Tadano's first day of high school and all he wants to do is blend into the background. He starts to get to know Komi, a quiet girl in his class.

1.title: It's just a childhood friend. / I'm not a killer. / It's just my first errand.
1.desc: To help Komi make more friends, Tadano tries to enlist the help of a talkative classmate who's friends with everyone, but they promptly turn him down.

1.title: It's just stage fright. / It's just a cell phone. / It's just a student election. / It's just an accidental call. / It's just a game.
1.desc: A nervous girl named Himiko Agari's anxiety levels go through the roof when Komi starts silently staring at her in a very intense way.

1.title: It's just a physical. / It's just a crush.
1.desc: During the school health checkup, competitive classmate Yadano is determined to clock better results than Komi, whom she sees as her ultimate rival.

1.title: It's just my summer uniform. / It's just a fitness test. / It's just veggies. Garlic. Lots of lard. Soy sauce. / It's just a blood pact.
1.desc: Komi wonders why everyone starts staring at her when, like the rest of the student body, she switches from her winter to her summer school uniform.

1.title: It's just a joke. / It's just shopping. / It's just the hair salon. / It's just an unsettling feeling. / It's just a study group. / It's just summer break.
1.desc: When Tadano gets to school, he finds Komi waiting for him in the classroom. She then nervously hands him a letter.

1.title: It's just the pool. / It's just shaved ice. / It's just a library. / It's just a park.
1.desc: Komi spends a lot of time getting ready for her trip to the local pool with Tadano and Najimi. Once they're there, they bump into even more friends.

1.title: It's just Obon. / It's just a festival. / It's just the end of summer.
1.desc: It's the Obon holidays, and Komi is visiting her grandma's house. She can't help but feel a little awkward around her extended family.

1.title: It's just a country kid. / It's just a video game. / It's just a part-time job. / It's just... something on your face.
1.desc: It's the first day of the new semester and everyone is happy to see Komi again, but then a student named Inaka starts to follow her around.

1.title: It's just sports day. / It's just emotional pangs. / It's just photo stickers.
1.desc: On the school sports day, Komi isn't sure how to properly cheer for her classmates, but she does her best. Then, it's her turn to run the relay race.

1.title: It's just a performance for the culture festival. / It's just festival preparations. / It's just flyers distribution. / It's just the culture festival eve. / It's just maids.
1.desc: The students of class 1-1 have to decide what they're going to do for the culture festival — a task they're all taking way too seriously.

1.title: It's just the culture festival. / It's just the post-festival. / It's just the after-party.
1.desc: At the culture festival, Najimi is up to something. They try to rope Komi and Tadano into their scheme.

2.title: It's just the arrival of winter. / It's just a delinquent. / It's just studying at Nakanaka's. / It's just a final exam.
It's just a typhoon. / It's just a fantasy. / It's just a cat cafe. / It's just the 'I love you game'.
It's just a feeling. / It's just a fantasy, part 2. / It's just an invitation to lunch. / It's just roasted sweet potatoes.
It's just a snowman. / It's just a snowball fight. / It's just the end of the year. / It's just New Year's.
It's just everyone's New Years. / It's just ice skating. / It's just a cold.
It's just a misunderstanding. / It's just a hallucination. / It's just a narcissist. / It's just a group decision for the school trip.
It's just the school field trip.
It's just day 2 of the field trip.
It's just ripped tights. / It's just an oni and her club. / It's just a pushover. / It's just a fight.
It's just White Day. / It has just been one year.

title: Kotaro Lives Alone
description: A lonely little boy moves into a ramshackle apartment building all on his own and makes friends with the broke manga artist who lives next door.
cast: Rie Kugimiya, Toshiki Masuda
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Episode 1
1.desc: A strange four-year-old boy named Kotaro moves into Shimizu Apartment all on his own. He doesn't seem to have any parents or family around.

1.title: Episode 2
1.desc: Karino figures out why Kotaro talks the way he does: he's copying Tonosaman, his favorite cartoon character from a show that's about to end.

1.title: Episode 3
1.desc: When he sees someone handing out free balloons, Kotaro tries to collect as many as he can. But there's a reason he wants so many balloons.

1.title: Episode 4
1.desc: Kotaro's friend Kakeru has a maid who takes care of everything for him, so Kotaro decides to show Kakeru how to do things for himself.

1.title: Episode 5
1.desc: For some reason, Kotaro is very particular about his tissues. He wants expensive, soft ones because they're "sweet." Later, Karino figures out why.

1.title: Episode 6
1.desc: A man named Aota moves into the building for a month. When he asks Kotaro to be his friend, Karino gets suspicious — and a little jealous.

1.title: Episode 7
1.desc: A girl named Kana starts coming over to Kotaro's house to play everyday after kindergarten, but she never seems to have fun.

1.title: Episode 8
1.desc: Karino brings Kotaro and all his friends to the movies. Kotaro wants to see the new Tonosaman film, but the other kids want to watch something else.

1.title: Episode 9
1.desc: Whenever Kotaro goes to see the neighborhood dentist, Dr. Ohba always takes the time to talk to him and ask him lots of questions.

1.title: Episode 10
1.desc: One day, a woman Kotaro doesn't recognize comes to pick him up from kindergarten. She says she's Karino's ex-girlfriend.

title: Dexter
description: Dexter Morgan, a blood spatter pattern analyst for the Miami Metro Police also leads a secret life as a serial killer, hunting down criminals who have slipped through the cracks of justice.
cast: Michael C. Hall, Jennifer Carpenter, David Zayas, Lauren Vélez, James Remar, C.S. Lee
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Dexter
1.desc: Dexter takes part in the investigation of a serial killer who drains his victims of blood. He also kills two criminals, and his romantic relationship may be going to the next level.

1.title: Crocodile
1.desc: While preparing for his next victim, Dexter finds out that the Ice Truck Killer is aware of Dexter's dirty little secret.

1.title: Popping Cherry
1.desc: Dexter's on the trail of a recently released murderer who plans to kill again when he's sidetracked by the Ice Truck Killer's latest crime - a cut-up hooker found in a hockey ice rink.

1.title: Let's Give the Boy a Hand
1.desc: Body parts from the Ice Truck Killer's latest victim begin appearing all over Miami in locations Dexter realizes are related to his own childhood.

1.title: Love American Style
1.desc: While the rest of the police department are focused on finding the Ice Truck Killer, Dexter is busy gathering evidence for his next victim. It turns out he will also discover more about relationships, love and how to make a success of it all. In doing so he gets some hilarious advice from unlikely sources and we see the first time that he actually kills two people at one time.

1.title: Return to Sender
1.desc: Dexter is called to the scene of the crime at the Castillo junkyard. The Ice Truck Killer has returned Valerie Castillo's body putting Dexter in danger of being caught. A boy is found who witnessed the crime.

1.title: Circle of Friends
1.desc: The police think they've uncovered the identity of the Ice Truck Killer, but Dexter is not sure they're right.

1.title: Shrink Wrap
1.desc: Several wealthy women have apparently died of suicide, but Dexter suspects they were really murdered by their psychologist.

1.title: Father Knows Best
1.desc: Dexter travels to the house of his biological father, who just passed away, to rekindle forgotten memories.

1.title: Seeing Red
1.desc: When Dexter is sent to investigate a bloody crime scene, deeply suppressed memories from his childhood begin to resurface.

1.title: Truth Be Told
1.desc: Just days before Christmas, the Ice Truck Killer leaves the body of a dead prostitute outside Santa's Cottage.

1.title: Born Free
1.desc: While avoiding the misguided Sgt. Doakes, Dexter searches for the real Ice Truck Killer and his hostage before it's too late.

2.title: It's Alive!
2.desc: As a cool forensics expert with killer instincts, Dexter's got it made -- but he may be getting more recognition than he ever hoped for.

2.title: Waiting to Exhale
2.desc: A still-shaken Dexter continues stalking the monstrous Little Chino, while Debra struggles with her lingering demons.

2.title: An Inconvenient Lie
2.desc: Dexter's mysterious late-night activities attract the wrong kind of attention from Rita, who's convinced his vice of choice must be drugs.

2.title: See-Through
2.desc: To appease Rita, Dex gets a drug sponsor -- who proves too attractive for Rita's comfort. Meanwhile, he tries shaking off the tenacious Lundy.

2.title: The Dark Defender
2.desc: Dexter learns that one of the three men who murdered his mother is still alive and, thanks to the Witness Protection Program, running a pub in Naples, FL.

2.title: Dex, Lies, and Videotape
2.desc: The Bay Harbor Butcher now has a copycat, and Dexter must stop him before Agent Lundy puts the Butcher case entirely into the hands of the FBI.

2.title: That Night, a Forest Grew
2.desc: Dexter sends the Miami Tribune a 32-page manifesto designed purely to baffle and mislead the police. His scheming continues as he finally fights back against Sgt. Doakes.

2.title: Morning Comes
2.desc: Thanks to some deliberately bad blood work, Agent Lundy comes closer to uncovering the Bay Harbor Butcher.

2.title: Resistance is Futile
2.desc: Dexter is in shock when he realizes that his blood slides are gone. It seems that Agent Lundy really has him now; but there's more going on than he knows.

2.title: There's Something About Harry
2.desc: As Dexter keeps Doakes caged in Jimenez's cabin, Doakes reveals that he knows something about the death of Dexter's father. This clue leads Dexter to discover a shocking truth.

2.title: Left Turn Ahead
2.desc: Dexter decides that he needs to turn himself in, but gives himself a day to get his life together. Meanwhile, he leaves Doakes in his cage.

2.title: The British Invasion
2.desc: Lila makes a shocking discovery about Dexter and takes advantage of it in a desperate ploy to win him back, or rather, force him back.

3.title: Our Father
3.desc: Dexter begins to question his blind loyalty to his father's memory. In an act of spontaneity, he wonders whether the code of Harry is a necessity anymore.

3.title: Finding Freebo
3.desc: Dexter catches up with Freebo, but once again the kill goes terribly wrong.

3.title: The Lion Sleeps Tonight
3.desc: Miguel continues to press his unwanted friendship on Dexter, who has other things to worry about - primarily a child molester who has his eye on Astor.

3.title: All in the Family
3.desc: Dexter botches his first marriage proposal to Rita, but a shocked and grieving fiancée's display of emotions provides him with clues on how to show the proper feelings himself.

3.title: Turning Biminese
3.desc: Through Miguel, Dexter learns of a wife-killer who has gone free - the perfect person for his next kill.

3.title: Sí Se Puede
3.desc: Miguel surprises Dexter by agreeing to his unreasonable request: access to a white supremacist already in custody.

3.title: Easy as Pie
3.desc: Dexter, who once chose his own victims, is now receiving requests - one from Miguel and another from Camilla.

3.title: The Damage a Man Can Do
3.desc: Dexter's friendship with Miguel grows closer - dangerously closer - when Miguel declares that he wants to make the next kill himself.

3.title: About Last Night
3.desc: Dexter and Miguel's friendship becomes uneasy just as Rita confronts Miguel about being unfaithful toward his wife.

3.title: Go Your Own Way
3.desc: Dexter needs leverage against Miguel and goes looking for it - specifically the ring Miguel took from Ellen Wolf as a trophy.

3.title: I Had a Dream
3.desc: Maria suspects Miguel of Ellen Wolf's murder, and Dexter knows she suspects it. Dexter will have to make his move before Miguel goes after Maria.

3.title: Do You Take Dexter Morgan?
3.desc: As the wedding day approaches, Dexter still has Ramon to deal with. Meanwhile, the Skinner is still loose, and Dexter is his next intended victim.

4.title: Living the Dream
4.desc: Dexter's sleep deprivation puts both his day job and his nighttime hunting in jeopardy. Lundy is back in town to capture the Trinity Killer - someone he can't even prove exists.

4.title: Remains to Be Seen
4.desc: A sleep-deprived Dexter desperately tries to remember where he hid the body parts of his latest victim.

4.title: Blinded by the Light
4.desc: When a local vandal begins stirring up trouble, Dexter's neighborhood becomes vigilant and wary, two things Dexter doesn't need.

4.title: Dex Takes a Holiday
4.desc: While Rita and the kids are out of town for a wedding, a police officer comes onto Dexter's radar.

4.title: Dirty Harry
4.desc: Recent events spur Dexter into his own investigation of the Trinity Killer.

4.title: If I Had a Hammer
4.desc: Dexter knows it's only a matter of time before police discover the Trinity Killer's latest act.

4.title: Slack Tide
4.desc: With family and work taking its toll, Dexter accidentally makes a serious mistake. Meanwhile, Quinn starts digging into Dexter's past.

4.title: Road Kill
4.desc: Dexter has always known his father's code was meant to protect him from exposure; but after committing a serious mistake, he wonders if it could have been designed to protect him from something even more dangerous - human emotion.

4.title: Hungry Man
4.desc: Dexter uses Thanksgiving as an opportunity to get closer to his most dangerous adversary yet.

4.title: Lost Boys
4.desc: Dexter makes a startling discovery while stalking the Trinity Killer.

4.title: Hello, Dexter Morgan
4.desc: Dexter's worst fears are finally realized. Meanwhile, Debra is on the verge of uncovering the identity of the Trinity Killer.

4.title: The Getaway
4.desc: Dexter is obsessed with getting the Trinity Killer himself, especially after Arthur has tracked him to Metro Homicide and learns his real identity.

5.title: My Bad
5.desc: Rita's death has left Dexter feeling responsible and guilty for not being there to save her from the Trinity Killer.

5.title: Hello, Bandit
5.desc: In his new role as single father, an anxious Dexter tries to get his family's routine back on track, to begin the process of moving on from Rita's death.

5.title: Practically Perfect
5.desc: Dexter finds it hard to adapt to a life without Rita. Quinn notices strange similarities between Trinity Killer associate "Kyle Butler" and Dexter.

5.title: Beauty and the Beast
5.desc: Dexter finds himself in a strange situation when, instead of taking a life, he has to save one when he must decide what to do with a frightened young woman named Lumen.

5.title: First Blood
5.desc: When Dexter is burdened by an unwanted conspirator, he is forced to make some hard decisions.

5.title: Everything Is Illumenated
5.desc: Striving to bring some normalcy back into his shattered life, Dexter begins plotting to take down a serial killer, but his plans get thrown off course when Lumen requires his help.

5.title: Circle Us
5.desc: By aiding Lumen, who has shot one of her attackers in an old warehouse, Dexter puts himself on a collision course with Debra, and risks being found out.

5.title: Take It!
5.desc: Dexter and Lumen take the opportunity to track a vicious murderer while attending a self-help seminar from Jordan Chase.

5.title: Teenage Wasteland
5.desc: Dexter and Lumen are on the hunt for a new victim but get sidetracked by the arrival of a surprise visitor. Meanwhile, Debra digs up new evidence.

5.title: In the Beginning
5.desc: Just as Dexter discovers a possibly ally in the pursuit of Lumen's former captors, he and Lumen are forced to step down after some key evidence linked to one of their prior victims is discovered.

5.title: Hop a Freighter
5.desc: Dexter and Lumen's plans are momentarily thwarted when they come under scrutiny.

5.title: The Big One
5.desc: Dexter's situation grows desperate when he discovers that Lumen's been set up.

6.title: Those Kinds of Things
6.desc: Dexter uses his 20 year high school reunion as a chance to hunt the prom king. It's going fine until he is called to the scene of a vicious faith-based murder leaving him with questions about what he wants to pass on to Harrison. Debra who is finally in a good place with her relationship with Quinn and her job becomes an unexpected hero.

6.title: Once Upon a Time...
6.desc: In order to solve the mysterious murders, Homicide asks for the help of Brother Sam, who Dexter knows used to be a serial killer. Debra has two proposals, one personal and one job-related.

6.title: Smokey and the Bandit
6.desc: Dexter faces a serial killer from his past; Debra has problems with her new position and Travis with Gellar think of their next move.

6.title: A Horse of a Different Color
6.desc: The team investigates murders that have a religious undertone to them.

6.title: The Angel of Death
6.desc: With the help of his newfound friend Brother Sam, Dexter wonders if there is light within him to counter the darkness, while the search for the Doomsday Killers takes him in a new direction; Batista and Quinn pay a visit to the university where Professor Gellar taught; due to departmental regulations following the shooting, Debra is forced to begin therapy.

6.title: Just Let Go
6.desc: Dexter investigates who shot Brother Sam. Meanwhile, Homicide interrogates the woman who Quinn slept with who is involved in the Doomsday Killer case.

6.title: Nebraska
6.desc: Miami Metro gets closer to Gellar and Travis thanks to the new intern. Meanwhile Dexter deals with faces from the past. Travis tries to move on from Gellar.

6.title: Sin of Omission
6.desc: Dexter, using what he's learned from Brother Sam, comes a step closer to the Doomsday killers, specifically Travis; Deb and LaGuerta go head-to-head after a call girl ends up dead.

6.title: Get Gellar
6.desc: Dexter tries to stay one step ahead of the Homicide Division concerning the Doomsday Killers, while he finds help from an unlikely source; Debra uncovers something unexpected about herself during her therapy sessions.

6.title: Ricochet Rabbit
6.desc: Now realizing the error he has made, Dexter redoubles his efforts to track down the doomsday killer and eliminate him. He plants evidence in the church to keep the police off the scent and sets out to find DDK. He manages to track down Holly, the woman Travis freed, but too late. From the evidence at the crime scene, Dexter believes he knows what DDK will strike with next, though he has no idea where. With Quinn hung over and not at work, Batista sets off to interview a person of interest which may have major ramifications for him. Meanwhile, Deb goes through the evidence from the dead call girl case and now knows who was with her and who Laguerta is protecting. Louis the crime lab intern is

6.title: Talk to the Hand
6.desc: Dexter finds himself at the yacht where Travis and his accomplices were preparing the next tableau, "Wormwood". They quickly realize that Travis is planning a gas attack. Worried that Batista has not been seen since the previous day, Quinn sets off to find him. Travis meanwhile sends Beth Dorsey to Miami Metro homicide with a canister of deadly gas and orders her to meet with Lt. Morgan. Deb has dinner with Deputy Chief Matthews and discusses the case of the dead call girl. The next day Deb realizes that Laguerta is very adept at office politics.

6.title: This Is the Way the World Ends
6.desc: Stuck in the ocean miles from shore, Dexter is rescued by an old boat carrying illegal immigrants to the US. Once ashore, he heads home hoping to figure out where and when Travis next move. Travis has holed up in a small house and has killed the occupants. While he's away, the police show up and Dexter has something of a surprise waiting for him. Dexter makes it to son Harrison's school recital only to have Travis take the child. Meanwhile, Debra has a plan to catch Travis and gets LaGuerta's support for her plan. Debra also comes to terms with her feelings for Dexter . In his final confrontation with Travis, Dexter has him tied down on his execution table. Someone walks in just as he's comm

7.title: Are You...?
7.desc: Having been caught in the act of eliminating Travis Marshall by his sister Deb, Dexter has to scramble to come up with an explanation. title: Breaking Bad
description: Walter White, a New Mexico chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with Stage III cancer and given a prognosis of only two years left to live.
cast: Bryan Cranston, Aaron Paul, Anna Gunn, RJ Mitte, Dean Norris, Betsy Brandt
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Pilot
1.desc: A high-school chemistry teacher (Bryan Cranston) is diagnosed with a deadly cancer, so he puts his expertise to use and teams with an ex-student (Aaron Paul) to manufacture top-grade crystal meth in hopes of providing for his family after he's gone.

1.title: Cat's in the Bag...
1.desc: After the accident in the desert, Walter and Jesse need to dispose of the unfortunate mess in their rolling lab of an RV, and Skyler begins to suspect that Walter and Jesse are involved in some mysterious goings-on.

1.title: ...and the Bag's in the River
1.desc: Walter and Jesse fight about the latter's drug use, so he leaves, forcing Walter to deal with their captive, Krazy-8 (Max Arciniega); Hank uses scared-straight tactics with Walter Jr. when his aunt suspects he's smoking pot; Skyler is furious when Walter stays away from home.

1.title: Cancer Man
1.desc: Walter announces to the family that he has cancer; the DEA believes there is a new big-time player in the Albuquerque drug business; a depressed Walter takes his anger out on a worthy recipient; Jesse pays a surprise visit to his parents' house.

1.title: Gray Matter
1.desc: At a birthday party for a successful former science colleague, Walter is offered a job; Jesse tries gaining legitimate employment but winds up back cooking meth, and an inferior kind at that; Skyler assembles the family for an intervention to get Walter to agree to chemotherapy, but he's concerned about quality-of-life issues and their financial difficulties.

1.title: Crazy Handful of Nothin'
1.desc: Walter, in the throes of his chemotherapy treatment and needing money more than ever, agrees to cook more crystal meth with Jesse; Skinny Pete hooks Jesse up with an important new contact, while the DEA intensifies its investigation of Albuquerque's new drug kingpin.

1.title: A No-Rough-Stuff-Type Deal
1.desc: Walter and Jesse do business with a new partner-in-crime, but immediately run into "production problems," which necessitates a nearly impossible mission to knock off a chemical-supply house. Meanwhile, Marie throws a baby shower for Skyler and presents her with an unusual gift that shows a different side of the aunt-to-be.

2.title: Seven Thirty-Seven
2.desc: Season 2 kicks off with Walt and Jesse once again bearing witness to Tuco's incendiary disposition, which leads them to the conclusion that it's time to put an end to their business dealings with him. But the question is how. Meanwhile, Hank serves as a go-between for estranged sisters Skyler and Marie.

2.title: Grilled
2.desc: Trying to dissociate themselves from the volatile Tuco takes a bad turn when Walt and Jesse get trapped with the dealer, and Skyler, worried about her missing husband, receives comfort from her sister and brother-in-law. Hank, meanwhile, pays a business call on Jesse's mother.

2.title: Bit by a Dead Bee
2.desc: Walt and Jesse attempt to cover their tracks and distance themselves from Tuco, but they soon find that business is taking a hit along with their financial situation. Meanwhile, Hank and his DEA investigation into the meth ring get a major break that just might put Walt and Jesse in their crosshairs.

2.title: Down
2.desc: Despite Walt's attempt to reconnect with the family, a suspicious Skyler keeps him at arm's length and worries about what he's been up to while he's been away from the house; Jesse finds himself on the streets once again and struggles to improve his lot in life.

2.title: Breakage
2.desc: Hank deals with some lingering aftereffects from his confrontation with Tuco; bills are piling up at the White house and tensions are beginning to run high; Jesse organizes a crew of dealers to take their product to the streets.

2.title: Peekaboo
2.desc: Walt returns to teaching at the high school; when Skinny Pete gets taken advantage of and ripped off, Jesse steps in, but bites off more than he can chew; Skyler takes the opportunity to show her appreciation for Gretchen's kindness in picking up the tab for Walt's treatments.

2.title: Negro Y Azul
2.desc: Walt and Jesse contemplate an expansion of their business; Hank experiences a hassle in El Paso as he tries to adapt to his new coworkers; Skyler's new job opportunity leads to her reconnecting with an ex-colleague; and Jesse interacts with his new landlady.

2.title: Better Call Saul
2.desc: Badger's brush with the law leads Walt and Jesse to call in a shady lawyer; the DEA believes it has a line on the mysterious and elusive "Heisenberg"; Hank's stint in El Paso is up and he returns to Albuquerque, but his mental makeup causes concern for Marie.

2.title: 4 Days Out
2.desc: After undergoing a PET-CAT scan and fearing the worst, Walt takes lawyer Saul's advice and hunkers down for a marathon session of cooking product; Jesse's romance with his landlady is heating up, but must cool off quickly when he and Walt head for the desert to take care of business.

2.title: Over
2.desc: The Whites throw a party to thank family and friends for their support through Walt's trying time, but it turns ugly when he and Hank get into a bitter argument; later, a pent-up and fed-up Walt tries to occupy his time with home-improvement projects. Worried about Walt's physical and emotional states, Skyler confides in her boss; Jane keeps her relationship with Jesse a secret from her father.

2.title: Mandala
2.desc: Saul suggests a new business partner for Walt and Jesse after they begin to lose their dealers to some unforeseen circumstances. At work, Skyler confronts Ted after she uncovers some unnerving information; and Jesse opens up to Jane about what he does for a living, with disastrous results.

2.title: Phoenix
2.desc: A new addition joins the White family as Walter Jr. attempts to help out his struggling family by launching a new Web site. Elsewhere, Jesse's addiction worsens and his relationship with Jane begins to negatively impact Walt and her father.

2.title: ABQ
2.desc: In the Season 2 finale, Skyler's frustration with Walt's secrecy boils over; Jesse is dealt a devastating blow that leads him down a path of self-destruction, and only Walt is willing to help him; and a grief-stricken Donald experiences more tragedy.

3.desc: In the third-season premiere, Walt faces a new threat on a new front and deals with an increasingly angry Skyler, who must consider what to do next with her life and the kids'. Meanwhile, Jesse comes face-to-face with some startling self-revelations.

3.title: Caballo sin Nombre
3.desc: Despite ever-increasing tension between Walt and Skyler, he pulls out all the stops in an effort to reconcile with the family. Elsewhere, Saul is instrumental in getting Jesse involved in a most-unusual investment opportunity.

3.desc: Walt disregards Skyler's demands and the rift between them widens dramatically, pushing her to take even more drastic steps. Meanwhile, continuing anxiety and panic attacks plague Hank, which leads to a serious situation at the Drug Enforcement Agency.

3.desc: Skyler's latest bit of bad news proves to be a blow to Walt, and his loss of control endangers his job and his business relationships with Saul and Jesse. Hank goes full-speed ahead into the agency's investigation of the blue-meth case, while Jesse cooks up a new plan.

3.title: Más
3.desc: When Gus intensifies efforts to persuade Walt to get back in the meth business, Jesse takes exception and a rift appears in his and Walt's personal relationship. Meanwhile, Skyler's new relationship isn't turning out as she'd like; and Marie tells Skyler about her concerns for the increasingly troubled Hank and his well-being.

3.desc: Walt moves into new digs and a distraught Walter Jr. demands to know just where his parents' relationship stands. Meanwhile, Hank's investigation is beginning to hit too close to home for Walt, causing serious concerns for him and Jesse.

3.title: One Minute
3.desc: Hank's behavior becomes increasingly more unpredictable and volatile, which leads to a confrontation with Jesse and problems at the DEA; Skyler wants Walt to make a deal; and Gus' decisions result in some serious consequences.

3.desc: The White and Schrader families anxiously await word on Hank's condition. Meanwhile, Jesse takes care of business at the lab while Walt tries to make peace with Gus, but after witnessing a terrifying flash of anger, Walt starts to fear for his and his family's lives.

3.title: Kafkaesque
3.desc: Hank's stay in the hospital is accompanied by some daunting bills, but Skyler thinks she has a way of dealing with them. Meanwhile, some of the problems between Walt and Gus are ameliorated; and Jesse seeks more independence and grabs a profitable opportunity that presents itself.

3.title: Fly
3.desc: When Walt becomes driven to distraction by a contaminant in the lab, he refuses to cook meth until they are able to get rid of it.

3.title: Abiquiu
3.desc: Skyler's increased involvement in Walt's business causes him concern; Hank's recovery is plagued by setbacks; and Jesse makes a surprising discovery as he gets more involved in his new enterprise.

3.desc: Jesse ignores Walt's advice and finds himself in a dangerous situation. Fearing for Jesse's safety, Walt takes drastic measures to try to put things right. And tragedy strikes following an unexpected confrontation.

3.title: Full Measure
3.desc: Jesse goes on the lam in the third-season finale. But Mike is right on his heels, so Walt works a deal with Gus and comes up with an unsettling plan that might help guarantee both his and Jesse's safety.

4.title: Box Cutter
4.desc: In the Season 4 opener, Walt and Jesse are confronted by the life-threatening consequences of their actions. Meanwhile, Skyler contends with a puzzling disappearance, and Marie finds it difficult to help a recovering Hank.

4.title: Thirty-Eight Snub
4.desc: Walt tries to establish a new alliance as he plots his next move. Meanwhile, Skyler urges Walt to consider a business opportunity that could keep the family safe.

4.title: Open House
4.desc: Goings-on at Jesse's place start to get out of control; Skyler reluctantly turns to Saul for help; Marie settles back into an old habit; and Hank hears from an old friend who needs assistance.

4.title: Bullet Points
4.desc: The Cartel makes a power move; Skyler and Walt reveal something embarrassing to the family; and Jesse's misdeeds bring some unwanted attention.

4.title: Shotgun
4.desc: Jesse's disappearance leaves Walt fearing the worst; Skyler has a surprising reunion; and Hank gives Det. Roberts bad news.

4.title: Cornered
4.desc: A shocking discovery unsettles Skyler; Walter Jr. leans on his father to make a special purchase; Mike gets surprise help from Jesse.

4.title: Problem Dog
4.desc: A frustrated Walt takes on a risky gamble; Skyler encounters problems with her latest business venture; Hank requires Walter Jr.'s services for an unusual reason.

4.title: Hermanos
4.desc: Skyler devises a plan to cure her money woes; Hank recruits Walt to help him work out a theory, while Walt grows impatient with Jesse.

4.title: Bug
4.desc: Mistakes from Skyler's past prove to be impactful to the present; Gus is spurred to action against rivals; Jesse seeks help from Walt but the results are mixed.

4.title: Salud
4.desc: The family becomes gravely concerned when Walt doesn't show up for his son's 16th birthday celebration. And Jesse's lab skills are tested in Walt's absence.

4.title: Crawl Space
4.desc: Walt moves to protect his secret and Gus; Skyler is stymied in her attempt to help Ted with his financial problem.

4.title: End Times
4.desc: Hank leans on Gomez to explore one final lead, as Walt scrambles to protect his family. Meanwhile, Jesse learns some unsettling news and races to share it with Walt.

4.desc: The fourth season ends with Walt and Jesse squaring off against Gus. Elsewhere, Walt acquires a surprise confederate with help from Saul.

5.title: Live Free or Die
5.desc: In the series 5 premiere, Walt deals with the aftermath of the explosion, while Hank wraps up his investigation of Gus and his criminal empire.

5.title: Madrigal
5.desc: Walt and Jesse seek out an unlikely partner for a new business venture. The DEA follows up new leads in its investigation.

5.title: Hazard Pay
5.desc: Walt and Jesse put a business plan into action. Walt confesses a secret to Marie.

5.title: Fifty-One
5.desc: Walt celebrates another birthday. Skyler considers her options. An associate complicates Walt and Jesse's plan.

5.title: Dead Freight
5.desc: Walt's team must get creative to obtain the materials they need to continue their operation.

5.title: Buyout
5.desc: Walt, Jesse, and Mike struggle over the future of their business, as occupational hazards weigh on Jesse.

5.title: Say My Name
5.desc: Walt takes control of business matters as Mike grapples with the consequences of his actions.

5.title: Gliding Over All
5.desc: Walt ties up loose ends. Seeing the evidence of his success, he makes a startling and dangerous decision.

5.title: Blood Money
5.desc: As Walt and Jesse adjust to life out of the business, Hank grapples with a troubling lead.

5.title: Buried
5.desc: While Skyler's past catches up with her, Walt covers his tracks. Jesse continues to struggle with his guilt.

5.title: Confessions
5.desc: Jesse decides to make a change, while Walt and Skyler try to deal with an unexpected demand.

5.title: Rabid Dog
5.desc: An unusual strategy starts to bear fruit, while plans are set in motion that could change everything.

5.title: To'hajiilee
5.desc: Things heat up for Walt in unexpected ways.

5.title: Ozymandias
5.desc: Everyone copes with radically changed circumstances.

5.title: Granite State
5.desc: Events set in motion long ago move toward a conclusion.

5.title: Felina
5.desc: The acclaimed crime drama comes to a close in the series finale.

Sherlock plunges into a world of codes and symbols, consulting with London's best graffiti artists. He soon learns that the city is in the grip a gang of international smugglers, a secret society called the Black Lotus.

1.title: The Great Game
1.desc: A strange clue in an empty room, a blood-soaked car, a priceless Old Master, a deranged bomber. With the clock ticking, the curtain rises on a battle of wits between Sherlock, John and the shadowy stranger who seems to know all the answers...

2.title: A Scandal in Belgravia
2.desc: Rejoin the 21st-century team of Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson as they battle the worst that modern criminality has to offer.

2.title: The Hounds of Baskerville
2.desc: Watch Sherlock and Watson pursue information about research on genetically engineered animals for military use.

2.title: The Reichenbach Fall
2.desc: Watch as Moriarty poses the "final problem" and a tabloid reporter reveals the "shocking truth" about Sherlock.

3.title: The Empty Hearse
3.desc: 'Just one more miracle, Sherlock. Stop being dead.' Two years after the devastating events of The Reichenbach Fall, Dr John Watson has got on with his life. New horizons, romance and a comforting domestic future beckon. But with London under threat of a huge terrorist attack, Sherlock Holmes is about to rise from the grave with all the theatricality that comes so naturally to him. It's what his best friend wanted more than anything, but for John Watson it might well be a case of 'be careful what you wish for!' If Sherlock thinks everything will be just as he left it, though, he is in for a very big surprise...

3.title: The Sign of Three
3.desc: Sherlock faces his biggest challenge of all - delivering a best man's speech on John's wedding day.

3.title: His Last Vow
3.desc: Sherlock goes after publishing magnate and blackmailer Charles Magnussen, one of the most despicable criminals that he has ever encountered.

4.title: The Six Thatchers
4.desc: While waiting for Moriarty to make good on his beyond-the-grave threat, Sherlock is intrigued by cases of vandalism where the criminal is breaking open busts of Margaret Thatcher. He soon discovers that the vandalism is tied to Mary's past.

4.title: The Lying Detective
4.desc: To save John, Sherlock takes on the most dangerous case of his career: bring serial killer and milliionaire-philanthropist Culverton Smith to justice. Meanwhile, the mystery of Sherringford Holmes deepens.

4.title: The Final Problem
4.desc: Sherlock and John confirm that Eurus is still alive, and go to Sherringford to meet with her. However, they soon discover that it is all part of Eurus' master plan.

title: Mindhunter
description: An agent in the FBI's Elite Serial Crime Unit develops profiling techniques as he pursues notorious serial killers and rapists.

1.desc: In 1977, frustrated FBI hostage negotiator Holden Ford finds an unlikely ally in veteran agent Bill Tench and begins studying a new class of murderer.

1.title: Episode 2
1.desc: Holden interviews the eerily articulate murderer Ed Kemper, but his research provokes negative feedback at the Bureau.

1.title: Episode 3
1.desc: Dr. Wendy Carr joins Holden and Tench in their first success, when their insights lead to an arrest.

1.title: Episode 4
1.desc: Bill and Holden consult with Dr. Wendy Carr to begin classifying their subjects. They receive surprising news.

1.title: Episode 5
1.desc: Holden and Bill return to a perplexing case in Pennsylvania where a set of clues leading in multiple directions leaves no shortage of suspects.

1.title: Episode 6
1.desc: Wendy considers an offer. Holden and Bill struggle to communicate the meaning of their findings to the judicial system in the baffling Altoona case.

1.title: Episode 7
1.desc: Wendy takes a career risk to relocate and join the team full time. Holden and Bill find it harder to keep the emotional intensity of work at bay.

1.title: Episode 8
1.desc: Bill and Wendy interview candidates for a fourth member of the team. Holden is intrigued by complaints about a school principal's odd habit.

1.title: Episode 9
1.desc: Holden's methods during a disturbing interview with mass murderer Richard Speck create dissension among the team and kick off an internal FBI probe.

1.title: Episode 10
1.desc: The team cracks under pressure from an in-house review. Holden's bold style elicits a confession but puts his career, relationships and health at risk.

2.title: Episode 1
2.desc: Amid sweeping changes at the BSU, Holden deals with severe repercussions from his close encounter with Ed Kemper.

2.title: Episode 2
2.desc: To glean insight into the elusive BTK killer, Bill and Holden interview the Son of Sam, who makes a startling admission.

2.title: Episode 3
2.desc: Bill gets drawn into a horrifying crime that hits close to home. Holden receives an intriguing offer while in Atlanta to interview a pair of killers.

2.title: Episode 4
2.desc: Holden develops a controversial profile in the Atlanta slayings. Wendy conducts her first interview and finds being on the front lines suits her well.

2.title: Episode 5
2.desc: Bill's devastating family situation spills over during his interview with Holden's holy-grail subject: Charles Manson. Wendy's new romance heats up.

2.title: Episode 6
2.desc: The FBI officially sends the BSU to Atlanta to investigate the missing and murdered children. Wendy second-guesses her interview methods.

2.title: Episode 7
2.desc: Hitting a dead end, Holden suggests a bold plan to draw the killer out. Bill's family faces more scrutiny. Wendy chafes as her job begins to shift.

2.title: Episode 8
2.desc: Red tape hinders Holden's plan to narrow his suspect pool. A weary and heartsick Bill tries to connect with his son. Wendy rethinks her relationship.

2.title: Episode 9
2.desc: The investigation zeroes in on a prime suspect who proves surprisingly adept at manipulating a volatile situation to his advantage.

title: Lucifer
description: Bored and unhappy as the Lord of Hell, Lucifer Morningstar abandoned his throne and retired to Los Angeles, where he has teamed up with LAPD detective Chloe Decker to take down criminals. But the longer he's away from the underworld, the greater the threat that the worst of humanity could escape.
cast: Tom Ellis, Lauren German, Kevin Alejandro, Lesley-Ann Brandt, Rachael Harris, D.B. Woodside
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.desc: Upon leaving hell, Lucifer Morningstar retreats to Los Angeles for a more exciting life. title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
description: Comedy series following the exploits of Det. Jake Peralta and his diverse, lovable colleagues as they police the NYPD's 99th Precinct.
cast: Andy Samberg, Andre Braugher, Joe Lo Truglio, Stephanie Beatriz, Terry Crews, Melissa Fumero
advisory: Rating depends on region; check the title page on Netflix.

1.title: Pilot
1.desc: Detective Jake Peralta is a talented, but carefree police detective at Brooklyn's 99th precinct who, along with his eclectic group of colleagues, are used to having a lax captain around the office. However, when tightly-wound Captain Ray Holt takes over, he is determined to make this dysfunctional group of detectives into the best precinct in Brooklyn.

1.title: The Tagger
1.desc: When Jake is late for roll call, Captain Ray Holt assigns him to a graffiti case that Jake feels is below his level. However, when the culprit turns out to be the Deputy Commissioner's son, the case becomes a major problem. Meanwhile, Gina's psychic friend visits the precinct and gets inside Charles' head.

1.title: The Slump
1.desc: Jake has a slew of unsolved cases that he can't seem to close, and the other detectives don't want his losing streak to rub off on them. Meanwhile, Holt asks Amy to run lead on the Junior Policeman Program for at-risk youth, and she enlists Rosa and Gina's help. Also, Boyle helps Sergeant Jeffords with a special case he cannot solve.

1.title: M.E. Time
1.desc: Much to the team's annoyance, Jake hits on an attractive medical examiner, Dr. Rossi, at a crime scene and holds up the autopsy report. He learns his lesson when Dr. Rossi turns out to be more than he bargained for. Meanwhile, Amy's purse-snatching case is stalled when the sketch artist is out sick, but she discovers that Sgt. Jeffords has hidden artistic talents.

1.title: The Vulture
1.desc: A detective from Special Crimes, takes over Jake's nearly solved murder case and steals his thunder. Over a few drinks, Jake enlists the precinct to get revenge and find the murder weapon before "The Vulture" does. Across town, Captain Holt and Gina help Terry get re-certified to carry a gun.

1.title: Halloween
1.desc: It's Halloween night, a busy time of the year for any police precinct. Amy detests the holiday, and is not thrilled when she has to don a costume to go undercover on street patrol with Charles. Back at the precinct, Jake bets Captain Holt that he can steal his Medal of Valor before midnight, which results in him bringing out some costumes of his own.

1.title: 48 Hours
1.desc: When Jake makes an arrest without a lot of proof, he only has 48 hours to collect evidence, or else the "perp" will be released. After his unsuccessful interrogation of the suspect, Jake forces his co-workers to spend their weekend helping him crack the case. So, while the team is stuck at the precinct, Charles judges a pie contest between Gina and Rosa, and Holt helps Terry look better in the eyes of his in-laws.

1.title: Old School
1.desc: Jake's dream comes true when he gets to spend the day with his hero, Jimmy Brogan, a former crime reporter. But the dream becomes a nightmare when Jake's comments about Holt and the precinct are considered "on the record." Meanwhile, Terry and Charles try to teach Rosa how to be less terrifying on the witness stand.

1.title: Sal's Pizza
1.desc: When Sal's Pizza burns down and the fire marshal quickly assumes that the owner is the prime suspect in the investigation, Jake does everything in his power to prove him wrong, even if it means stepping out of his jurisdiction. Meanwhile back at the precinct, chaos ensues when a computer virus publishes everyone's browser history.

1.title: Thanksgiving
1.desc: Amy wants to host a Thanksgiving dinner for the entire precinct, but it turns into a holiday disaster when Holt and Jake have to leave to go catch a perp. Boyle steps in to save Turkey Day.

1.title: Christmas
1.desc: Captain Holt receives death threats and Jake is put in charge of his security, a job he enjoys and abuses as much as he can. Meanwhile, Amy attempts to get the precinct to take a Christmas photo for Holt, but a lack of enthusiasm and Rosa's refusal to smile defeats her efforts. Also, Sergeant Terry Jeffords gets his mojo back.

1.title: Pontiac Bandit
1.desc: Jake is interested in one of Rosa's perps, Doug Judy, who has information about the "Pontiac Bandit," a car thief whom Jake has been tracking for years. Meanwhile, the station tries to accommodate a scooter-bound Charles' every need when he returns to work, but he proves to be too much to handle. And Captain Holt struggles to find a home for two puppies.

1.title: The Bet
1.desc: Jake and Amy's ongoing bet about who can make more arrests comes to a close. Meanwhile, Charles receives the Medal of Valor for getting shot in the line of duty, but the pain medication he is taking causes him to reveal his true opinions about his colleagues.

1.title: The Ebony Falcon
1.desc: On his first task back in the field, Terry busts a steroid ring, and in doing so, takes cues from Jake on how to harness his emotions. Meanwhile, Amy and Rosa help solve a breaking-and-entering case at Gina's apartment.

1.title: Operation: Broken Feather
